findings.fix: Align the two bars to the same 24px left and bottom margins, 8px apart, both 16px high with 16px labels on a --ui-panel backing. Use --ok for hp and a muted blue for armour, with --tx-1 text on a dark plate.

findings.what: The slots are unevenly spaced and the empty slots 5-0 show only faint numerals on the wall, which look like stray text. The selected slot has an amber border, which clashes with lime meaning 'selected'. Slot 4 carries a small 'f' badge that is unexplained. The ammo card has '25 / 150' in two sizes with 'auto rifle' in grey at about 3:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 88px tiles on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border. Show the selected slot with a 2px --acc border. Raise 'auto rifle' to --tx-2 at 16px on the card. Put the ammo card's right and bottom margins at 24px, matching the left.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' chip and 'in pillager's party' tooltip
findings.what: These float with no alignment to anything. The f1 chip is 14px text on a translucent dark box over the wall, with low contrast. The 'in pillager's party' label is 14px and sits over the player with no panel border. The top-left 'keyboard' chip uses a different style again (green-tinted border, mono-looking).
findings.fix: Use one chip style (--ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px label) for all three. Place 'f1 controls' on the 24px left margin at the same baseline as the hp bar, and drop the 14px tooltip or raise it to 16px.

findings.what: The goals dropdown has a different radius, border and chevron style from the other HUD cards. Its 22px text is a different size again, and it sits tight to the top-right edge at about 18px. It is the only collapsible and looks pasted in.
findings.fix: Use the shared 4px radius, 24px edge margin, 20px text and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Match its height to the timer card (about 72px).

v.verdict: The shot is now a busy in-raid HUD instead of the 'tonight's best' card, and it has too many competing panels and a heavy always-open controls list. Only the ammo hero number and the weapon slots have clear hierarchy.

findings.what: A 310x345px keys panel is open over the play area, with about 25 rows at roughly 14-16px. It is the biggest block on screen and competes with the action. The raid spec calls for a one-line fold at mid-bottom left, opened with F1.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line ('f1 controls') at mid-bottom left. If the party demo must keep the full list, shrink it to about 220px wide and give it a 60% opacity fill. Hide the 'full list' footer row.

findings.what: Seven rows of 14-16px text, with dead players in dim tx-2 grey and '$3,950 dead' columns that are hard to read at couch distance. The header says 'current pillagers 0' and the footer says '0 out - 3 dead', so the same information appears twice. The panel has no clear title and its border does not match the controls panel.
findings.fix: Keep only the title and 'you $1,647' at 20px, and fold the dead rows behind the chevron. Raise the dead-row text to 16px at the tx-2 floor of 4.5:1. Remove the '0 out - 3 dead' footer. Use the same 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the other panels.

findings.where: extract markers, top-centre 'extract 134m' and right edge 'c 134m'
findings.what: Extract distance is drawn twice, in two teal pills with different sizes and styles. This breaks the one-place-per-line rule and splits the eye between two points.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre banner at 20px f-cond 700. Turn the edge marker into a 16px arrow only, with no repeated text.

findings.what: The red and green circle icons, 'crashing through' in red and 'in cover' in green are five separate chips in different colours. The 'hp 100' number sits over the bar and its text runs into the bottom edge at 1068, which is inside the 5% margin. Red text on the dark panel also puts danger colour on a status that is not a danger.
findings.fix: Move the hp block up to y=1000 or higher so the 54px bottom margin holds. Put 'hp' at 16px and '100' at 32px above a 12px bar. Merge the status chips into one 16px tx-1 row with small icons, and keep red for real damage.

findings.where: world labels: 'the long dock cache' (purple, 1648-1818 x 180), 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx' tag, 'pillager' tags
findings.what: There are four different label styles: a purple glow, a red filled tag, a blue-grey tag and the top-left 'pillager' bar. The purple label is off-palette. The orphan 'pillager' health bar at 14-170 x 325-358 has no panel context.
findings.fix: Use one world-label style: 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 on a --scrim pill at 4px radius. Use rarity or accent colour only for hostile (--danger) and player (amber P1 or cyan P2). Fold the 'pillager' bar into the hp block at bottom-left.

findings.where: weapon bar, 553-1010 x 955-1058, with ghost slots 3, 5-8 and 0
findings.what: The weapon slots are the clearest element, but the ghost slot numbers are about 14px at very low contrast and the ghost weapon silhouettes add noise. The slot 4 ammo bar in amber looks the same as the selected slot 1 border.
findings.fix: Remove the ghost silhouettes and keep only the three filled slots, or draw empty slots at a uniform 40% opacity with 16px numbers. Reserve the lime border for the selected slot only, and use tx-2 for the ammo bar.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown, 1603-1901 x 18-54, and the 'keyboard' chip, top-left
findings.what: The dropdown is a wide black bar with a chevron and no visible content. It looks like a closed web select. The 'keyboard' chip in the corner is a debug-looking label. The two use different fills and borders.
findings.fix: Collapse 'run info' to a 160px chip or hide it until pressed. Remove the 'keyboard' chip, or show it only for the first 5 seconds.

findings.what: The block works as the hero (12 / 24 at 56px), but its right padding is about 16px against 8px at the screen edge, and 'b / i backpack' at 14px is hard to read. The 'scav pistol' title has no weight contrast against the number.
findings.fix: Inset the block 48px from the right and bottom edges. Raise the hint to 16px at the tx-2 floor. Make '12' tx-1 800, '/ 24' tx-2 600, and the title 20px tx-2.

v.verdict: The picture is now a busy in-raid HUD rather than the earlier night card. The raid controls list sits open on screen, and several elements repeat or break the palette, so it reads as a dense debug overlay with no clear first read.

findings.what: The controls list is fully open, about 310x345px, and sits mid-left. The settled rule says a career raid shows one folded short line, mid-bottom left, and F1 opens it. The open list covers the play area and is the biggest block on screen.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') anchored bottom-left at x=48, above the hp bar. Open it only on F1. If the screen is a party-demo walk-up, hide the list after about 8s.

findings.where: top-centre 'extract 134m' pill and right-edge 'c 134m' arrow chip
findings.what: The extract distance is drawn twice, at (960,60) and (1825,493). This breaks the 'every line shows in ONE place' rule. The two chips also differ in size and weight.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre banner. Make the edge marker a 24px teal arrow with no text, or remove it.

findings.where: top-left stack: 'keyboard' tag, 'current pillagers' panel, 'pillager' bar
findings.what: Three unrelated boxes with different borders, fills and text sizes (about 14-16px) are stacked along the left edge. The value-at-risk table has a chevron, five rows of dim grey text and a footer ('0 out · 3 dead'). The 'pillager' name appears again as a floating tag over the player's head. The result is clutter, and the muted grey rows fall under the 4.5:1 floor.
findings.fix: Collapse the table to a single row ('value at risk $1,647'), expanded on a key. Drop the 'pillager' bar label, since hp already sits bottom-left. Use one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Raise the dim rows to --tx-2 at 16px or more.

findings.what: This is a magenta/lilac text label in a colour that is not in the palette. It floats loose with no panel. It is also loud, and nothing at that size and colour has any other job in the HUD.
findings.fix: Set it in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 600, with a 1px --ui-line underline or a small panel, or show it as a short banner. Do not use a violet that looks like the elite rarity colour.

findings.where: hierarchy: bottom-right ammo card vs bottom-left hp bar and top clock
findings.what: The hero ammo number is correct at about 56px, but the hp bar is a wide solid green block with 'hp 100' in white, and it competes with the ammo number. The clock '15:00' and the lime-highlighted weapon slot add more bright points. The eye lands on the hp bar before the ammo, and nothing leads from one to the next.
findings.fix: Shrink the hp bar to 320x16px with a 20px 'hp 100' label above it. Keep the ammo number as the one 56px/800 element. Reserve lime/amber for the selected slot only.

findings.what: The inactive slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 show faint ghost silhouettes, and their numerals are about 14px in grey. This reads as noise and sits below the readability floor. The pale 'f' badge on slot 2 is different again.
findings.fix: Show only the owned slots (1, 2, 4). Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlines with no silhouette. Set the numerals at 16px in --tx-2.

findings.where: status pills 'crashing through' and 'in cover', bottom-left
findings.what: Two pills sit side by side with different styles: a red outline with red text at about 24px, and a teal-green outline at 20px. Two round glyph buttons sit next to them. Four different shapes are crowded into one 370px strip, and danger red is used for a neutral status.
findings.fix: Use one pill component at 16px with a 4px radius and 8px gaps. Make the colour carry the meaning: --warn for the exposed state, --ok for in cover. Merge the glyphs into the pills.

findings.where: 'run info' dropdown top-right, and the 'pillager joined' toast
findings.what: The 'I' in 'run info' looks like a capital, which is not allowed. The dropdown is a 300x36px bar with a thin border that matches no other panel. The toast at (960,912) is a plain box with no accent or icon.
findings.fix: Check that the string is lower case ('run info') and that the font renders a lower-case i. Give the dropdown and the toast the same panel style as the other panels, with a 3px left accent bar on the toast.

v.verdict: The top-centre cluster is cleaner and the weapon slot now has a selected state, but the raid controls list is open again, a large block of key hints covers the left third of the view, and the HUD still mixes unrelated panel styles, type sizes and a stray capital letter.

findings.where: left controls list (move / fight / gear / raid)
findings.what: The full key list is open and runs about 310x345px over the left side, on top of the world. The owner's order was a career raid with one short folded line mid-bottom left that F1 opens. Here the list is on at full size, which is clutter and an explaining block. It also sits beside the player card and the pillagers panel, so three boxes stack down the left edge.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, 24px from the edge and above the hp bar. Keep the full list behind F1 only. Keep it open only for the party demo.

findings.what: The hp readout is a large green bar with a 30px 'hp 100' label that is not on a panel and has no armour bar. The label is the biggest type in the bottom-left corner and competes with the ammo hero number. The bar's left edge (24px) does not align with the controls list (16px). The label sits on the bar rather than beside it.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel plate at 24px margin. Use a 20px f-cond 600 'hp' label, a 16px-high bar and a 28px value. Use the same left edge as the controls list and the ammo card (24px).

findings.where: top-left stack: current pillagers panel and 'pillager' name card
findings.what: The pillagers panel uses 16px text in four different colours (white, green, cyan, grey) on a near-black box that has a 1px border but a different fill from the other panels. 'value at risk' at 16px grey is hard to read, and the $ column is tight against the right edge. The 'pillager' card below it is a separate tiny bar with a 2px green line and no clear relationship to the hp bar further down, so it repeats information.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel (#16191b, 4px radius) with 16px padding. Use tx-1 for names, tx-2 for labels and amber for the 'you' row. Align the $ column to the right at 16px. Remove the 'pillager' card or merge it into the hp plate.

findings.what: A flat dropdown-style box with a chevron, which looks like a web form control and not a game HUD. The 'run info' label is 20px bold and sits at the top of the screen, competing with the 15:00 clock for first read. Its 1px border does not match the other panels. It is also not part of the top-right vertical 1 by 1 list the owner ordered.
findings.fix: Replace it with a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip: 16px --tx-2 label, a small chevron icon at 16px, 8px padding. Wait for the cw-trcol list and keep its right and top margin at 24px.

findings.what: Slot 1 now has a lime border, which is good. But the numbers on the inactive slots (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0) are low-contrast grey on a busy map and some sit on the water. The slots are not on a panel. The 'f' badge on slot 2 is unexplained. The ammo card is a dark rounded panel with a 4px border, but 'scav pistol' (20px) and 'b / i backpack' (14px) use sizes that don't match the other panels, and '12 / 24' is bigger than anything else on screen. It is at the right edge, 16px from the bottom, while the hp bar is 24px.
findings.fix: Give inactive slots a --ui-panel at 70% fill and --tx-2 numbers at 16px. Drop the 'f' badge. Put the ammo card at 24px margin and use 56px for '12' only, with '/ 24' at 32px --tx-2. Set 'b / i backpack' at 16px.

findings.where: world labels ('the long dock cache', 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx', 'in pillager's party', 'c 130m')
findings.what: Four different label styles: loose lilac text with no plate, a red box with a blue edge, a black rectangle with white text, and a teal pill. The sizes range from 20px to 16px. The party tooltip is floating at the bottom of the screen, far from the player it refers to, and so reads as a stray box.
findings.fix: Use one chip spec: 16px f-cond 600, 4px radius, --ui-panel at 80% fill and a 3px colour bar on the left (rarity, extract teal, danger red, P1 amber or P2 cyan). Anchor the party tooltip 8px above the player's head.

findings.what: The clock (15:00) and the sunrise icon sit loose on the map with no panel, and the green 'extract 130m' pill is a different shape and weight from the clock. The small teal arrow below it is detached. The clock is smaller than the 56px hero size, but it also competes with the 'run info' bar.
findings.fix: Put the clock and the extract distance into one --ui-panel at 24px from the top: 32px clock, 16px teal extract line with the arrow beside it, 8px gaps.

findings.what: A tiny outlined tag with a 20px bold label is stuck in the corner at 8px from the edge. It is not on the 24px margin used elsewhere and looks like a debug marker.
findings.fix: Move it to 24px from the top and left at 16px --tx-2, or remove it once the controls line shows the device.

v.verdict: The picture is player 2's title screen, not the easy-mode dialog from the earlier review. It is a clean, centred column with a clear lime action, but the orange gradient logo fights the lime accent, the stack is small and floats in a lot of empty dark space, and the secondary text and controls are weak.

findings.what: The logo is an orange-to-amber gradient with a drop shadow. That is a gradient wash the guide bans, and its amber hue sits right next to the lime accent. The two hot colours compete and the title reads as a template wordmark. The heavy weight also lands on both the logo and the main button, which breaks the rule of boldness in one place only.
findings.fix: Fill the logo with flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) at 72px f-cond 800, with no gradient and no shadow. Or make it flat --acc and drop the button's fill to a 2px --acc outline. Pick one hot element.

findings.where: whole composition (content y360-735 on a 1080 canvas)
findings.what: Everything sits in a 560px column in the middle. About 340px of empty vignette lies above it and 300px below. The 56px hero is missing, so there is no key art or identity beyond the wordmark. The result is a generic, template-looking start screen with weak hierarchy.
findings.fix: Enlarge the logo to a 96px hero. Move the column's top to about y300. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and a --ui-panel card (24px padding, 4px radius) around the saves block. Or add a subtle key-art silhouette behind the title.

findings.where: 'player 2 window' label (y586) and 'keyboard' chip (top centre, y19)
findings.what: 'player 2 window' is a bold grey 16px line wedged 8px under the main button. It could be a caption or a second button, and it never says which. The teal 'keyboard' chip floats alone at the top edge, tight to the border, with no obvious role. Teal is reserved for extraction only.
findings.fix: Turn 'player 2 window' into a --tx-2 16px label in a 1px --ui-line-hi pill with 24px of space above it. Change the 'keyboard' chip to --tx-2 on --ui-panel, or move it into the footer next to the key hints. Remove the teal.

findings.what: The selected save row is a thin lime outline with lime text, while the three controls below it (name input, change name, create a new save) are all the same dark box. The input looks identical to the buttons, so the row of three reads as one flat strip. The 'saves' label is dim and 14-16px. The row's stats ('0 raids · $900 · 0 xp') are low-contrast grey on near black.
findings.fix: Fill the selected row with --ui-raised and add a 4px lime left bar. Raise its text to 20px --tx-1, and set the stats to 16px --tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Make the input a recessed --ui-void field with a 1px --ui-line border. Give the buttons 1px --ui-line-hi borders. Make 'create a new save' the only one that stands out, and add 16px of space above the 'saves' label.

findings.what: It is about 18px, grey and letterspaced, sitting 36px below the logo and 24px above the button. It is easy to miss, and it floats instead of being tied to the logo.
findings.fix: Set it at 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 (#aaa498), with 8px of space under the logo and 24px above the button. Or delete it, since it is a slogan and not an action.

findings.where: footer key hints (y1030-1055) and version stamp (x97, y1048)
findings.what: The hint row has tiny 12-13px key chips with 16px light-grey labels. A player would not read them from a couch at 1080, and the chip text is bolder than the label it explains. The version stamp is tiny and low-contrast, and it sits off the baseline of the hints and about 97px in from the left, which is not on the 5% margin grid.
findings.fix: Make the chips 20px f-cond 700 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px padding. Make the labels 16px --tx-2. Put the version stamp at 14px --tx-2 at x96 with its baseline matching the hints. Reduce the hints to the keys a new player needs.

findings.what: These are small 15-16px bold labels in the same dark box as the save controls. They are a different size from the 20px main button text and are 98px in from the right edge, which breaks the 5% margin. They are not aligned with the 'keyboard' chip, and the gap between them is 8px.
findings.fix: Use 48px high buttons with 16px labels and 20px side padding, and align their right edge to the 96px margin. Align them on the same top line as the 'keyboard' chip (y32). Give them a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The lime fill is right, but the label is only about 20px dark text with plain flat padding. There is no pad-focus ring or key hint, and no bounce or hover affordance is visible. The 56px height is acceptable but it does not read as a bold, bouncy Fortnite-style CTA.
findings.fix: Raise the label to 24px f-cond 700 in --acc-ink and make the button 64px tall. Add a 2px offset focus ring in --tx-1 (#efe9dc), and show the pad glyph or key chip on the right side of the button.

v.verdict: The raid controls list is now folded to one short line and the top-left roster is a collapsed bar, but the bottom-left status cluster and the world labels still crowd the edges and mix styles, and the HUD has several competing bright elements and stray capitals.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and status chips, 24-430 x 940-1068
findings.what: The hp bar sits at y~1050, about 30px from the bottom edge, which breaks the 54px margin. The 'hp 100' label is a condensed display face that does not match the rest of the HUD. Two icon circles and two chips ('crashing through', 'in cover') sit directly above the bar. 'crashing through' is red text on a red-bordered chip, so it reads as damage when it is a status. The cluster is dense and the bar is a heavy green slab.
findings.fix: Move the hp block up to y=1000 or higher, which gives a 54px bottom margin. Set 'hp' at 16px and '100' at 32px f-cond 700 over a 12px bar with a 4px radius. Merge the chips into one 16px tx-1 row of icon plus word, and keep --danger only for real damage. Drop the red border on 'crashing through'.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' bar (8-367 x 143-260) and 'pillager' bar (14-170 x 325-358)
findings.what: The roster is a dropdown with a tiny 16px label and a chevron on a hard black rectangle with a light border. It does not match the 'run info' dropdown at top-right except by shape, and it floats at an arbitrary y=143. The separate 'pillager' hp bar at y=325 is a third, unrelated panel with a green slab. The player's own name and hp are shown in three places: this bar, the world tag over the head, and the bottom-left hp.
findings.fix: Put both dropdowns at the same y=24 and the same 360x40 size, with a 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill at 85%. Delete the 'pillager' bar at left, since the hp block already covers it. Use 16px f-cond 600 text inside.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract banner, 920-1015 x 10-72
findings.what: The 15:00 timer is about 30px and sits next to a round amber icon, with a teal 'extract 74m' chip below. A thin teal arrow strip under the chip is easy to miss. The hero number is undersized for the one thing the player watches. The right-edge 'extraction c available' label repeats the same message in a second teal chip, so one fact appears twice.
findings.fix: Make the timer 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 as the one hero per screen. Keep 'extract 74m' at 20px f-cond 700 as a single teal chip. Delete the 'extraction c available' chip, or reduce it to a 16px arrow pinned to the screen edge. Remove the sun icon, or shrink it to 20px.

findings.what: The ammo card is the strongest block on screen, and it is right. The '12 / 24' at 56px is the right hero. 'b / i backpack' is 14px and 40% grey, which is below the 16px floor. The card is 242px wide and almost 150px tall, mostly empty, with a faint gun silhouette. Its right edge sits at 1910, so the margin is 10px against 54px elsewhere.
findings.fix: Inset the card to a 54px right margin. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px at --tx-2 (4.5:1). Remove the ghost silhouette, or draw it at 100% in the left half of the card. Reduce the height to about 120px.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are filled tiles and 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are bare numerals floating over ghost gun art. The numerals are about 14px at roughly 30% contrast, so they are unreadable. The slot spacing is uneven, with 3 sitting in the gap between 2 and 4. Only slot 1 has an amber border, which is fine for P1, but it reads as lime-adjacent and looks like a second selected state next to the amber hp.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 100x100 tile with a 4px radius, 1px --ui-line fill, and 16px numerals at --tx-2. Space them at 8px. Dim empty slots to 50% rather than leaving them bare. Keep the selected slot amber, for P1.

findings.where: world labels: 'the long dock cache' (1447-1618 x 130), 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx' (1313-1440 x 457), 'pillager' tags (978-1022 x 511)
findings.what: There are three label styles. The purple loot name has no backing and floats over a busy orange floor, so contrast is weak. The orange-on-dark hostile tag is about 12px. The player tag is a blue-green chip. The text is small and varies in size.
findings.fix: Use one style: 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 on a --scrim pill with a 4px radius. Put the rarity colour on a 3px left bar only. Use --danger for the hostile tag, and amber (P1) or cyan (P2) for player tags.

findings.where: toasts: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (345-740 x 777-803) and 'pillager joined' (895-1025 x 893-930)
findings.what: Both are explaining sentences, which the guide counts as clutter. The contract toast uses amber text with a bar and sits in the same screen area as the controls hint, while the black 'pillager joined' toast has no bar and a different fill. The two toasts do not match each other. The 'pillager joined' toast sits 30px from the hotbar and crowds it.
findings.fix: Shorten the contract toast to 'contract item nearby' and drop 'gold glow marks the box'. Give both toasts one style: --ui-panel fill, 4px radius, a 3px left colour bar and 16px tx-1 text. Stack them in the left feed only, per the one-place rule. Move 'pillager joined' out of the hotbar zone.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint (437-537 x 930-952) and top-left 'keyboard' tag (10-105 x 8-30)
findings.what: The controls line is now one short line, which follows the earlier advice. It sits at about 16px over a busy blue floor with no backing, so it competes with the hp chips for the same left strip. The 'keyboard' tag is a green-bordered chip in the corner with no clear purpose beyond device naming. It is 16px with a slightly different border from every other chip.
findings.fix: Back 'f1 controls' with a --scrim pill, 4px radius and 16px text, and align its left edge to the 54px margin directly above the hp block. Move the 'keyboard' tag into the 'run info' dropdown, or delete it.

v.verdict: The controls list is now folded to one short 'f1 controls' line and the clutter is mostly gone, but the HUD still mixes several panel styles, and the top-left dropdowns and the bright hp bar compete with the ammo number.

findings.what: The bright green hp fill is the loudest saturated block on screen. Its 36px 'hp 100' label is oversized and blurry. It outweighs the ammo card, which should be the one hero number.
findings.fix: Shrink the bar to 320x16px. Put a 20px f-cond 600 'hp 100' label in tx-1 above it. Use --ok at about 80% saturation for the fill. Keep the 56px/800 ammo number as the only hero element.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag, 'current pillagers 0' dropdown and 'pillager' bar; top-right 'run info' dropdown
findings.what: The dropdowns use native-looking select styling with a white chevron, a different border and a different radius from the ammo card and the banners. The 'pillager' bar, whose label sits left in blue, is a duplicate of the hp bar. The 'keyboard' tag sits at a 6px offset against the 8px grid. Two of the three left-edge stacks do nothing in a raid.
findings.fix: Restyle all of them as --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, and a 16px label. Delete the 'pillager' bar. Fold 'current pillagers 0' into the run info dropdown. Align everything to x=48.

findings.what: Floating violet text with no backing reads as the elite-rarity colour and as map noise. It is 20px, but its weight is thin and it is not tied to any panel.
findings.fix: Set it in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 600 with a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip at 80% alpha and 8px padding. Place it top-centre under the clock as a short banner that fades after 3s.

findings.where: mixed label chips: 'extract 74m' (905,47), 'extraction c available' (1630,467), 'contract item nearby' (345,775), 'pillager joined' (895,893)
findings.what: Four different chip styles: teal outline, teal text with no box, an amber bar with a document icon, and a black box with white text. The 'pillager joined' box is the only one with a different font weight and a 1px white border, and it overlaps the hotbar area. 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' is an explaining sentence.
findings.fix: Use one chip: --ui-panel fill, 3px left bar in the chip's meaning colour, 16px/600 text, 8px/12px padding. Shorten the contract chip to 'contract item nearby'. Move 'pillager joined' to the left feed above the status chips.

findings.where: bottom-left status chips 'crashing through' / 'in cover' with the red and green icon circles (24-390,945-980)
findings.what: Red and green outlined chips with differing fills, 20px text and an unlabeled eye-slash icon. They sit crowded at 12px from the hp bar and look like the hp bar's labels.
findings.fix: Use a 16px label with a 1px --ui-line-hi outline and 24px icons with a tx-2 fill. Colour only the dot. Leave 24px above the hp bar.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' chip (437,929) and hotbar numbers 3 and 5-0
findings.what: The 'f1 controls' hint is dim, 14px-ish, sits off the 48px margin and is not mid-bottom as the owner specified. The empty slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 show faded gun silhouettes with 14px numbers, which is clutter.
findings.fix: Set 'f1 controls' in tx-2 at 16px, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px radius-4 chip, left-aligned at x=48 above the status chips. Hide empty-slot silhouettes and show only the number at 16px in tx-2 at 50% opacity.

findings.what: The 'scav pistol' name is 24px right-aligned and the 'b / i backpack' hint is under 14px. The 56px '12 / 24' is good, but the card's border differs from the other panels (a lighter 2px border) and it sits 10px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the hint at 14px minimum in tx-2. Pull the card inside the 48px margin at right and bottom.

v.verdict: The controls list is now folded to one 'f1 controls' line, which was the big fix. The HUD is still a set of unrelated parts: margins and plate styles don't match, the hp bar is crammed against the bottom edge, and the 'run info' and 'current pillagers' dropdowns look like debug widgets.

findings.what: The hp bar sits flush on the screen edge, about 3px from the bottom and 24px from the left, with no plate. It is cut off by the weapon slots at its right end. The 'hp 100' text is oversized, roughly 36px, in a fat font and loses contrast on the green fill. The bar is the screen's biggest colour block but is not the thing that matters most.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel plate (#16191b, 4px radius, 16px padding) at 24px left and 24px bottom. Make the bar 16px high and 280px wide, with a 20px f-cond 600 'hp' label in tx-2 and a 28px value in tx-1 on the plate, not on the green. Keep the bar clear of the slot row by 16px.

findings.where: bottom row alignment: hp, f1 controls, weapon slots, 'in pillager's party' chip, ammo card
findings.what: These pieces share no baseline or margin. The hp bar is at y~1050. The slots end at y~1055. The ammo card ends at y~1050 and has a 12px border. The 'f1 controls' chip floats at y~940, above the slots and not above the hp bar. The party chip floats alone at x~960 with a different panel style. The row looks scattered.
findings.fix: Set one bottom margin of 24px and one left and right margin of 24px. Put hp, slots and ammo on a shared bottom edge at y=1056. Place 'f1 controls' directly above the hp plate, left-aligned at 24px. Move the party chip to the top-left stack or the left feed, and give it the same --ui-panel treatment.

findings.where: top-left stack: 'keyboard' tag, 'current pillagers 0' dropdown, 'pillager' name bar
findings.what: Three different widget styles are stacked with uneven gaps. The 'keyboard' tag is a green-tinted chip. 'current pillagers' is a black bar with a chevron that looks like a web select. The 'pillager' card has a tiny cyan-blue name on a green bar with no plate. Nothing explains why 'pillager' sits at y~340, far from the other two.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel (16px padding, 4px radius) at x=24, y=24 holding the device tag, the player list and the self row. Name text 20px tx-1, labels 16px tx-2. Use amber for P1 and cyan for P2 (per r3-13). Drop the chevron and add one 16px chevron only if the list can collapse. Remove the duplicate 'pillager' label above the player, or keep only one.

findings.what: It is a 300px-wide black bar with a mismatched chevron. It is too wide for a closed state and carries the same web-select look as the left dropdown. Nothing says it holds anything useful.
findings.fix: Shrink it to a hugging chip: 16px tx-2 label, 16px chevron, 8px 16px padding, --ui-panel, 4px radius, 24px from the top and right edges. Wait for the cw-trcol list and keep that margin. Match the left dropdown's style exactly.

findings.what: The active slot has a thick amber border and a white-on-dark pistol icon, which reads well. The inactive slots 3 to 0 are faint ghost icons with numbers floating at inconsistent heights. The 'f' badge on slot 2 is noise. Slot 1 and 2 are 100px wide, the rest are undefined.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles at 70% fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap. Put the number at 16px tx-2 in the top-left of each tile. Keep the active slot's border as lime --acc 2px (selected equals lime, and amber is P1). Delete the 'f' badge.

findings.what: The '12 / 24' is the right size and a good hero number. But the card has a thick light border, 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while the numbers hug the right edge, and 'b / i backpack' at ~14px is tiny and left-aligned. Margins differ from the left side.
findings.fix: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px padding and 24px edge margins. Align everything to the right edge. Use 56px for '12' only and 32px tx-2 for '/ 24'. Set 'b / i backpack' at 16px tx-2. Left-align it with the weapon name above.

findings.where: top-centre timer and 'extract 70m' chip, plus world labels
findings.what: The 15:00 timer is clear. The 'extract 70m' teal chip is OK but small at about 16px with a tiny arrow. World labels are inconsistent in type and colour: 'the long dock cache' is lilac, 'extraction c available' is teal on a dark chip, 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx' is a tiny red-on-black tag.
findings.fix: Put all world labels on the same chip: 16px f-cond 600, 4px radius, 8px padding. Use --tx-1 text and let a 3px left bar carry the colour (teal for extraction, rarity colour for a cache). Make the extract chip 20px and give it a clear direction arrow.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen the earlier review covered. The hp bar, ammo card and extract banner are readable. Two stray browser-style dropdowns, one capital letter, mixed type sizes and loose panel styling pull it down to a 2.

findings.where: top-right 'run Info' dropdown (x1603-1900, y20-54) and left 'current pillagers 0' dropdown (x8-367, y142-172)
findings.what: These are native-looking select boxes with chevrons, drawn in a different font and different panel style from the rest of the HUD. They look like debug controls and overlap the map. 'run Info' also has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule.
findings.fix: Hide them in a career raid, or restyle them as --ui-panel 4px-radius chips with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2 text. Align both to the 5% margin (x96). Set the text to 'run info'. Put a 16px --ui-line chevron icon in place of the browser arrow.

findings.where: HUD type scale (hp 100 at about 34px, ammo 12/24 at about 56px, 'extract 70m' at about 16px, 'pillager' name tags at 14-16px)
findings.what: Sizes are not on the scale. The hp number is drawn bold and large straight on the green bar, so it competes with the ammo hero number. Two different bold treatments fight for the eye in the bottom corners.
findings.fix: Keep one hero, the ammo, at 56px f-cond 800. Set hp to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 inside a 24px-tall bar with 8px padding. Set the name tags to 16px f-cond 600. Drop everything else to the five-size scale.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1068) and 'f1 controls' hint (x437-537, y930-952)
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat bright green slab with no border, no panel and a thin 4px margin to the screen edge. It is not in the 5% safe margin and sits on the map art with no container. The controls hint is a small dark chip floating mid-map, with the 'f1' key in a different box style.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel card with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 24px padding, inset to x96 and y(1080-54). Use --ok for the fill. Align 'f1 controls' to the same left edge as a 16px --tx-2 label with the key in a 1px --ui-line-hi pill.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 have boxes. Slots 3-8 and 0 are bare numbers over faint weapon ghosts sitting on the map. The selected slot uses an amber/gold outline, which reads as rarity gold and not the lime selected colour. The numbers are about 12px and very low contrast.
findings.fix: Give every slot a 72px --ui-panel tile with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Make the selected slot's border 2px --acc, not amber. Set the slot numbers to 16px --tx-2. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity instead of showing floating ghost icons.

findings.where: top-centre cluster ('15:00' timer, moon icon, 'extract 70m' pill, teal arrow; x905-1035, y10-95)
findings.what: The timer is the main number up there but its text is small, about 28px. The teal 'extract 70m' pill is wider than the timer and uses a bright green-teal fill. The tiny arrow below it is not tied to either item.
findings.fix: Make '15:00' 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 in a --ui-panel plate. Show extract distance as a 16px --extract text label with a 1px --extract border, under the timer and the same width as it. Put the arrow inside the pill at 16px.

findings.where: 'keyboard' chip (x10-105, y8-31) and 'in pillager's party' tooltip (x885-1035, y893-930)
findings.what: The chip has a different green-outline style from every other plate, and it sits in the 4px edge margin. The party tooltip is a plain black box with 14px text floating mid-screen, with no relation to the player or the ui panel colour.
findings.fix: Move the device chip into the footer legend at 14px --tx-2, or style it as a --ui-panel pill at x96. Restyle the tooltip with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px --tx-1 text and 8px 16px padding. Anchor it 8px above the player name tag.

findings.what: It is the strongest panel but it clips the screen's right edge, at about 10px margin. The 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px dim text jammed into the bottom padding. 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while the hint is left-aligned, so the card has two alignments.
findings.fix: Inset the card to x(1920-96) and y(1080-54). Use 24px padding. Right-align both the weapon name and the hint, or left-align both. Set the hint to 16px --tx-2.

findings.where: world labels ('the long dock cache' purple, 'extraction c available' teal, 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx' red-outlined tag)
findings.what: Three label styles use three font sizes and three colours: purple, teal and red text with different plate treatments. The purple has no clear meaning in the palette and the tiny red name tag is hard to read at couch distance.
findings.fix: Use one label style: 16px f-cond 600 on --scrim plates. Use --extract only for extraction, --r-elite for the loot-cache name, and --danger for hostile name tags. Raise the hostile tag text from about 12px to 16px.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a pile of unrelated widgets: the hp bar and chips are crammed into the bottom edge, the two top-left dropdowns still don't line up, and the timer is not the hero. The earlier fixes were mostly not applied.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and status chips, 24-430 x 940-1068
findings.what: The hp bar still sits against the bottom edge, about 12px from it. 'hp 100' is drawn as a large condensed number inside a flat green bar, which is a different style from the ammo card. The red-bordered 'crashing through' chip and the green 'in cover' chip are two different chip styles, and the two circular icons add a third. The row is crowded and the red border reads as damage.
findings.fix: Move the block to y=1000 or higher, which gives a 54px bottom margin. Draw 'hp' at 16px tx-2 and '100' at 32px f-cond 700 over a 12px bar with a 4px radius. Make the chips one 16px row of icon plus word with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Reserve --danger for real damage.

findings.where: top-left dropdowns 'current pillagers 0' (8-367 x 143-260) and 'run info' (1603-1900 x 18-55), plus the 'pillager' bar (14-170 x 325-358)
findings.what: Three different widget styles for the same kind of info. The dropdowns are different widths, sit at different y, and are hard against the screen edge. The 'pillager' name bar at left duplicates the hp block and the tag over the player.
findings.fix: Make both dropdowns 360x40, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --ui-panel at 85% fill and 16px f-cond 600 text, with a 54px margin and the same y=24. Delete the left 'pillager' bar.

findings.where: top-centre timer, 'extract 74m' and the extraction label, 920-1015 x 10-72 and 1630-1780 x 465-488
findings.what: '15:00' is about 28px and shares the row with a sun icon, so no hero number exists. The teal 'extract 74m' chip is 20px and the arrow under it is tiny. 'extraction c available' is a typo ('available' is misspelled and the 'c' is stray) floating over the map in the same teal.
findings.fix: Set the timer to 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 and shrink the sun to 20px. Keep 'extract 74m' as a single 20px teal chip. Fix the string to 'extraction c available' with the right spelling, and make it 16px with a 4px radius and the same chip style.

findings.what: The card sits 10px from the right edge, so its margin does not match the top-right dropdown. 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and dim. The weapon silhouette is nearly invisible. The '12' is large and good, but the '/ 24' competes with it.
findings.fix: Inset the card to a 54px right margin. Put 'b / i backpack' at 16px tx-2 (4.5:1). Draw the silhouette at 100% in the left half. Set '/ 24' at 32px tx-2 so '12' is the only hero.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are filled tiles, but 3 and 5-0 are bare numerals with ghost weapon icons, so the row reads as broken. The tile sizes and gaps are uneven, and slot 3 sits in an empty gap. The amber selection frame is fine.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 100x100 tile with a 4px radius, 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Set numerals at 16px tx-2. Dim empty slots to 50%. Keep the selected slot amber for P1.

findings.where: the 'keyboard' tag at top-left (8-105 x 8-32), the 'f1 controls' chip (437-538 x 930-952) and the 'pillager joined' toast (896-1025 x 893-929)
findings.what: The three small items use three different treatments: a green-bordered tag, a grey chip with a key cap, and a black toast. The toast sits right on top of the hotbar, 26px above slot 4, and 'f1 controls' sits on the water in the hp-chip row, which is cluttered. The brief puts the controls list mid-bottom left.
findings.fix: Use one 16px chip style for all three (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius). Move the toast up to y=120 under the timer. Align 'f1 controls' to the left margin directly above the hp block.

findings.where: the 'the long dock cache' label, 1447-1618 x 120-142
findings.what: The pink-purple label floats over the map in a colour outside the palette (it looks like the elite rarity purple used as text), with no backing and weak contrast on the orange floor.
findings.fix: Draw it at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 with a --ui-panel at 70% chip behind it, or use --r-elite only as a 3px bar next to the text.

v.verdict: The ammo panel and weapon slots are solid, but the previous round's fixes were mostly not applied: the hp bar is still oversized, the top-left debug-style dropdowns and the pillager bar are still there, and the chips are still inconsistent.

findings.what: The hp bar is still a 406px slab of flat green with an oversized 'hp 100' that competes with the 56px ammo hero. It sits flush against the screen edge, below the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Make the bar 320x16px at x=48, with a 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 'hp 100' label above it. Use --ok at about 80% saturation and a 1px --ui-line track. Leave 24px above it.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag (10,8), 'current pillagers 0' dropdown (8,142)-(367,170), top-right 'run info' dropdown (1603,19)-(1901,55)
findings.what: These are three different control styles with different borders and radii. Two are native-looking select boxes with chevrons, which reads as a dev tool. They sit at an inconsistent x of 8-10, not 48.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px/600 label and 16px padding. Align to x=48 and y=48. Fold 'current pillagers 0' into the run info dropdown. Hide the keyboard tag after 3s.

findings.what: This bar duplicates the player's own nameplate and hp above the character. It is a stray fourth element on the left edge with a tight 2px edge margin, and it is lit in blue and green.
findings.fix: Delete it. If a squad panel is needed, put it at x=48 with a 16px label and an 8px-high hp bar inside a --ui-panel card.

findings.what: This is lavender text floating over the map with no panel. Lavender is outside the palette, the text is small, and it is hard to read over the orange floor.
findings.fix: Set it in tx-1, 20px f-cond 600, in a --ui-panel chip at 80% alpha with 8px/12px padding. Place it top-centre under the 'extract 74m' chip and fade it after 3s.

findings.what: Four chip styles: green outline, teal text with no box, black box with white text, and a grey keycap. Sizes and padding differ. 'available' is misspelled ('avallable'), and it is a long sentence for a label.
findings.fix: Use one chip: --ui-panel fill, 3px left bar in the meaning colour (extract teal), 16px/600 text, 8px/12px padding. Fix the spelling or shorten it to 'extract c'. Move 'pillager joined' to the left feed.

findings.where: status chips 'crashing through' / 'in cover' with red and green icon circles (24-390,945-980)
findings.what: The red text on a dark red-outlined chip is the loudest thing in the bottom-left corner. It is bigger than the hp label and competes with the ammo panel. The two chips differ in outline colour and font size.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels in tx-1 with a 1px --ui-line-hi outline and 24px tx-2 icons, and colour only the icon dot. Leave 24px above the hp bar.

findings.what: The amber selected slot is good, but the empty slots 5-0 carry ghost silhouettes and numbers at about 40% opacity that read as clutter. The numbers sit at 3 different heights. Slot 3 and slots 5-0 have no frames.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as a 1px --ui-line outline at 56x56px, with a 16px tx-2 number at the top-left. Delete the ghost silhouettes. Hide the slots after the last held weapon.

findings.what: The 12 / 24 hero is correct, but the 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px, tiny and dim, and the panel sits only about 10px from the right edge. The weapon icon is missing from the panel.
findings.fix: Move the panel to a 48px right margin. Make the hint 16px tx-2. Add a 48px weapon silhouette at the left.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD is still a set of unrelated floating pieces, and almost none of the earlier fixes have landed. The bottom row has no shared edge, the top-left stack has no panel, and the empty slots 3 to 0 sit on the map unframed.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text sits on the green fill, and its unclipped descenders hit the bar edge. The bar is jammed against the screen corner at x=24, y=1036 to 1066 and almost touches the bottom edge. It is a bare bar with no plate, and it is wider and heavier than anything else in the HUD.
findings.fix: Put hp on a --ui-panel plate with 16px padding, a 4px radius and a bottom margin of 24px. Make the bar 16px high and 280px wide. Put the 'hp' label in tx-2 at 16px and the '100' in tx-1 at 28px beside or above the bar, not on the green. Keep the bar 16px clear of the slot row.

findings.where: bottom row: f1 controls, slots, party chip, ammo card
findings.what: The bottom row has no shared baseline. The slots run from y=956 to 1058, the ammo card from 902 to 1052, and the party chip floats at y=912 with no tie to anything. 'f1 controls' sits at x=435, y=940, unaligned with the hp bar. The 'in pillager's party' chip is a stray box in the middle of the screen.
findings.fix: Use one 24px bottom margin so hp, slots and ammo all end at y=1056, with 24px side margins. Left-align 'f1 controls' over the hp plate at x=24. Move the party chip into the left feed or the top-left panel, in the same --ui-panel style.

findings.where: top-left stack: keyboard tag, current pillagers dropdown, pillager name bar
findings.what: The three pieces share no container and no alignment. The tag is at x=10 and is green-tinted. The dropdown is a wide black bar 360px across, with a chevron and no reason to collapse. The pillager bar sits at x=16 and is a different width again. The name is repeated in the bar and over the player. The pillager label is drawn in cyan, which is the P2 colour, though this is the P1 screen.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel at x=24, y=24 with 16px padding and a 4px radius. Put the device tag, the 'current pillagers 0' row and the self row inside it. Make text 20px tx-1 for names and 16px tx-2 for labels. Use amber for P1. Drop the chevron.

findings.what: A 300px black bar spans x=1604 to 1900, and its label is a small 'run info' at far left with a chevron at far right. That reads as an empty form field, not a HUD chip. It also has a different border and fill from the left dropdown. The capital 'I' in 'run Info' breaks the lower-case order.
findings.fix: Shrink it to a hugging chip: a 16px tx-2 'run info' label, a 16px chevron, 8px 16px padding, --ui-panel, a 4px radius, and 24px from the top and right edges. Use the same style as the left dropdown. Make the label lower case.

findings.what: Slots 1 and 2 are 102px tiles, with 1 in an amber 3px border. Slots 3 to 0 have no tile at all, only floating grey digits and faint weapon silhouettes on the map, spaced about 112px apart. The row reads as two tiles followed by debris. The 'f' badge on slot 2 is cryptic. The amber on the active slot clashes with the lime 'selected' rule.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles at 70% fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap. Put the number in the top-left at 16px tx-2. Make the active tile's border 2px lime --acc. Delete the 'f' badge.

findings.what: The clock and the sun icon are bare text on the map. The extract chip is a teal outline and does not match the other chips. 'extraction c available' floats 700px away at x=1590, y=477, with the teal ring behind it. The same teal appears in three styles.
findings.fix: Put the clock and the extract line in one --ui-panel, centred at y=24. Use --extract only for the extract text and arrow. Draw 'extraction c available' as the same chip style, anchored to the ring, at 16px.

findings.where: world labels: the long dock cache, xx_beefstuffer69_xx, pillager
findings.what: The three labels use three different styles: a lilac bare label at about 22px, a tiny red-on-dark 14px tag, and a cyan-on-dark tag. The 14px tag is below the 16px minimum. The lilac label has no backing and is weak against the orange floor.
findings.fix: Use one world-label style: --ui-panel at 85% fill, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 text, and 4px 8px padding. Colour the text tx-1 and add only a 3px left bar for team or rarity. Raise the minimum to 16px.

findings.what: The ammo card is the strongest piece of hierarchy on screen, with a big '12 / 24' at about 56px. But 'scav pistol' is right-aligned and the 'b / i backpack' hint is tiny at about 14px. The card also sits 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, so its margins match nothing else.
findings.fix: Set the card at 24px from the right and bottom edges. Keep the 56px f-cond 800 hero number. Set 'scav pistol' at 20px tx-1 and the hint at 16px tx-2. Left-align both so they sit on one edge.

v.verdict: The HUD has an ammo card and slot tiles now, but the raw browser dropdowns, the off-grid hp bar and the crowded top-centre cluster from last review are all still here, so it still reads as a debug overlay on a good-looking map.

findings.where: top-right 'run Info' select (x1603-1900, y20-54) and left 'current pillagers 0' select (x8-367, y142-172)
findings.what: These are still native browser select controls with a default arrow. They have a capital 'I' in 'Info', an 8px margin instead of the 5% margin, and a black fill that matches no panel. The 'keyboard' tag at top-left is a third unstyled chip.
findings.fix: Hide all three in a career raid. If they stay, make them --ui-panel chips with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2 text, and a 16px chevron. Set the text to 'run info', inset them to x96 and y54, and move 'keyboard' into the same chip style.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green slab touching the bottom edge, with no panel or border. Its 'hp 100' text is about 34px and has a hard shadow, and the bar sits 24px from the screen edge, off the margin.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, inset to x96 and y(1080-54). Make the bar 24px tall with --ok fill, and set 'hp 100' to 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 with 8px padding. Left-align the card with the 'f1 controls' hint.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 are tiles. Slots 3-0 are bare numbers with ghost weapon icons floating over the map at mixed sizes. The selected slot's amber border clashes with the lime accent rule, and the 'in pillager's party' tooltip crowds the strip.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles on an 8px gap, with a 1px --ui-line border. Show empty slots at 40% opacity. Make the selected border 2px --acc. Set slot numbers to 16px --tx-2. Move the party chip off the strip, to y888 at x96.

findings.what: The '15:00' timer, moon icon, 'extract 70m' pill and tiny teal arrow are loose elements with no shared plate. The timer is about 30px with a drop shadow, and the pill is a different width from the timer.
findings.fix: Put the timer in a --ui-panel plate, 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1. Put 'extract 70m' under it as a 16px --extract label with a 1px --extract border, at the same width. Move the arrow inside the pill at 16px. Align the moon icon inside the plate.

findings.what: The card is the right idea, with 12 / 24 as the hero. But it is 10px from the right edge. The 'b / i backpack' hint is about 14px and dim. The 'scav pistol' label is right-aligned while the numbers are centred, so the three rows follow different alignments.
findings.fix: Inset the card to x1824 (96px margin). Right-align all three rows to a 24px inner padding. Set 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Keep 12 at 56px f-cond 800 and make '/ 24' 32px --tx-2.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint (x437-537, y930-952) and 'pillager' plate (x15-170, y323-357)
findings.what: The 'f1 controls' hint floats at a different left edge from the hp bar and is 16px at low contrast. The top-left 'pillager' name plate with a green bar duplicates the hp info, and its thin bar has no panel border.
findings.fix: Move 'f1 controls' to x96, directly above the hp card, as a 16px --tx-2 label with the key in a 1px --ui-line-hi pill. Remove the duplicate 'pillager' plate, or fold it into the hp card as a 16px name label.

findings.where: world labels ('the long dock cache', 'extraction c available', 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx')
findings.what: The labels use three colours (violet, teal, white on cyan) at 16-20px with no common plate. The extraction label's teal text on a dark box is low contrast against the map.
findings.fix: Use one label style: 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 on a --scrim plate with a 4px radius and 8px padding. Show the colour only as a 3px left bar: --extract for extraction, --r-elite for the cache, --acc for a player.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has a clear ammo hero and a sensible hotbar, but the corners disagree on panel style, a capital letter shows on screen, and the p2 banner, stamina/hp bars and controls hint all look off-system.

findings.where: run info collapsed bar under minimap
findings.what: A capital 'I' shows in 'run Info', which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a different style from the minimap above it: a heavy light-grey dropdown with a chevron, where the minimap is a bare dark box.
findings.fix: Render the label as 'run info'. Use the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius as the pillagers list, with a 16px label.

findings.where: hp and stamina bars, bottom left
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat saturated green block with chunky 'hp 100' text that is cramped against the bar edge. The stamina bar is a washed-out blue with grey text, so contrast is low. The two bars have different heights, fonts and fills, and neither matches the ammo panel's quiet dark style.
findings.fix: Make both bars the same 16px-high track on --ui-panel with a 1px border. Use --ok for the hp fill and --extract for stamina. Set the labels at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1, aligned left with 8px padding. Make hp the only bold element, with the number at 20px.

findings.where: p2 pad lost banner, top centre-left
findings.what: The banner sits at mid-screen left of centre, not in the top-centre alert slot, and it overlaps the building and aim area. It has a yellow left edge bar but no hierarchy beyond the title, and the title is oversized compared with the 32px title role. Its fill and border differ from the other panels. It is also not centred on the 9:00 clock or the extract chip.
findings.fix: Move the banner to top-centre under the extract chip (y≈110, centred on x=960). Set the text at 20px, put the gamepad glyph in a 24px box, and use the --ui-panel fill, 4px radius and a 3px --warn bar.

findings.where: hotbar slots 4-0 and the hint row
findings.what: Empty slots 4 to 0 are drawn as bare numbers floating on the wall and ground texture. They have no frame and low contrast, so they read as clutter. Slot 3 shows a 'f' badge and slot 2 has a thick lime border. The hotbar has no tx-2 treatment for idle slots.
findings.fix: Either hide empty slots 4-0, or draw them as 48px frames with a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px --tx-2 number. Keep the lime border only on the selected slot.

findings.what: It is a dense 8-row table of small text (about 14px) with a tight 18px row pitch, a two-column right-aligned money column, and a pink name row (fbi_surveillance_van) that adds an unexplained colour. The header text is crowded against the chevron. It floats over the map with no margin that matches the 5% rule.
findings.fix: Set rows at 16px with a 24px pitch. Use --tx-1 for names and --tx-2 for the header. Use only --acc, amber or cyan for the 'you' row. Drop the pink. Inset the panel 48px from the left edge and 24px from the top.

findings.what: This is the strongest element: the red 8 is a good hero. But the 8 is red while '/ 36' is white at an equal size, so the eye reads two competing numbers. 'b / i backpack' at about 14px sits crammed in the bottom-left corner and has low contrast. The weapon name is right-aligned while the hint is left-aligned.
findings.fix: Set the 8 at 56px in --tx-1, switching to --danger only when low. Set '/ 36' at 32px in --tx-2. Set the hint at 16px in --tx-2, right-aligned with the weapon name, with 16px padding.

findings.what: The chip is a small grey box floating above the wall, a different style from every other panel, with a 'f1' keycap and 'controls' in about 14px. It does not align with the hp bar or hotbar baseline and sits at x≈435, between them.
findings.fix: Use a 16px label on the --ui-panel fill with a 4px radius and a 1px border. Align its baseline to the top of the hotbar and place it 16px left of slot 1.

findings.what: The 9:00 clock is clear, but the teal 'extract 138m' chip has a mismatched border and padding, and the small teal triangle below it points at nothing explained. The clock has no panel while the chip does, which makes the pair feel inconsistent.
findings.fix: Put the clock at 32px f-cond 700 with a 4px-radius --ui-panel backing. Make the chip 16px with 8px padding and the same radius, and keep the teal only on the arrow and text.

v.verdict: A readable raid HUD with a good ammo hero number and a clear selected slot, but it has a capital letter, stray text clutter, inconsistent type sizes and a dim, crowded bottom edge.

findings.what: The 'I' in 'run Info' is a capital letter, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The collapsed header bar also has a different fill, border and height from the minimap above it and the roster panel on the left.
findings.fix: Change it to 'run info'. Give it the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius as the other HUD panels, with a 32px row height and 16px label type.

findings.where: bottom-centre, slot row and number strip behind it
findings.what: The hotbar numbers 4 to 0 are drawn on the road behind the slots and sit in the same band as the slots. They read as clutter or leftover art, and the faded ghost icons under them are unreadable. Slots 1 to 3 are filled but 4 to 0 are not drawn as slots, so the row looks broken.
findings.fix: Remove the loose 4 to 0 labels and ghost icons. Either draw only the filled slots, or draw the empty slots as 64px outlined tiles at --ui-line with 8px gaps.

findings.what: The two bars are different thicknesses, and the hp bar is the heavier of the two. 'hp 100' is about 32px type sitting on a light-green fill with white text, so contrast is low. 'stamina' is small text on a mid-blue fill and is also weak. Both bars have no panel and no border, and they sit directly on the busy ground and wall art.
findings.fix: Put the pair in one --ui-panel at 85% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 16px label at the left, a 20px value in --tx-1, and bars of equal height (16px) with dark track fills. Colour the hp bar --ok and the stamina bar a neutral tone.

findings.what: The roster has 8 rows of 14px text, and the money values are tiny and dense. The 'value at risk' header text is dim grey on a dark panel. The panel competes with the minimap for attention, it has an odd collapse chevron, and its row pitch is tight at about 18px. The purple name for fbi_surveillance_van has no explanation.
findings.fix: Use a 20px row pitch, 16px minimum text, --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for the header, and 16px of inner padding. Colour a name differently only for a clear reason, such as player colours (amber for P1, cyan for P2).

findings.what: The card has a strong hero ammo count, but 'view backpack' is 14px grey on a near-black card and is hard to read. There is no key or button glyph beside it, so the player cannot tell what to press. The 36 in the slot tiles repeats the reserve count. The 8 is in a red-orange (--danger) at full size even though the magazine is not empty, which reads as a warning.
findings.fix: Raise 'view backpack' to 16px in --tx-2 and prefix it with a key chip. Keep the 8 in --tx-1 and switch it to --danger only at 25% of the magazine or below.

findings.what: The '9:00' timer is good as a hero number, but the extract chip uses a teal fill, a large pill shape and a different text size from the rest. It is the only rounded pill in the HUD. The small arrow under it floats with no clear meaning, and the chip sits close to the orange icon.
findings.fix: Use a 4px-radius chip with a --extract 1px border and a --ui-panel fill, 16px --extract text, and 8px of gap from the timer. Align the arrow with the chip's centre.

findings.what: The tag is tiny, pinned at the very corner with no margin, and uses a different border and font treatment from the other panels. It is also unaligned with the 5% margin used by the roster below it.
findings.fix: Inset it 24px from the corner, use 16px --f-cond type on a --ui-panel fill, and align its left edge with the roster panel.

findings.what: Every HUD element uses a different panel style: the roster has a translucent dark fill with a light border, the minimap has a blue-black fill with a thick border, the weapon card is near-black with a lighter border, and the bars have no panel. The edge margins vary from about 8px to 24px, so the HUD looks assembled from unrelated parts instead of one system.
findings.fix: Standardise on one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 85% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, and a 24px margin from each screen edge. Apply it to the roster, minimap, run info, bars and weapon card.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a set of unrelated parts: the pillagers list, minimap, bars, hotbar and ammo card each use a different type size and fill. Capital letters remain, the pink list row is still there, and the hotbar slots 4-0 are still unstyled numerals.

findings.where: run info bar under the minimap
findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a separate, thinner box that doesn't line up with the minimap above it. My earlier advice to restyle it was not followed.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Make the bar the full width of the minimap, with the same --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the label at 16px f-cond 600 and leave an 8px gap between the bar and the map.

findings.what: The panel has a hard black fill and no inset from the left edge. The 14-15px rows have a tight pitch of about 18px. 'fbi_surveillance_van' is still pink, and pink is not in the palette. The header and the data share the same weight, and the '$' amounts are bold and bright, so the list competes with the title. There is no clear marker for the 'you' row.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the left and 24px from the top. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set rows at 16px with a 24px pitch, names in --tx-1 and the header in --tx-2. Colour only the 'you' row in --acc and change the pink to --tx-1. Set the amounts in --tx-2 and right-align them with 16px padding.

findings.where: stamina and hp bars, bottom left
findings.what: The two bars are different heights (about 20px and 32px). Both sit tight against the screen edge, only about 22px in, and the track uses a flat fill with no border. The stamina label is hard to read against its blue track, and 'hp 100' is oversized and loose, so it looks like a different font from the rest of the HUD.
findings.fix: Draw both bars as 16px-high tracks on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Fill hp with --ok and stamina with --extract. Set the labels at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 with 8px padding. Show hp as 'hp' at 16px and '100' at 20px. Inset the bars 48px from the left and 48px from the bottom, and put 8px between them.

findings.what: Slots 4-0 are bare grey numerals floating on the wall texture, at about 16px, so they are hard to read. They don't line up with slots 1-3 and have no frames. The row looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Either hide the empty slots, or draw them as 72px frames with a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px --tx-2 number. Keep the lime border on the selected slot only. Align the row to the same baseline and 8px gap as slots 1-3.

findings.what: The ammo number is red (--danger) at about 56px, so it reads as an alarm when only 8 of 36 rounds are left. The weapon name is 20px in a right-aligned pixel-style font, which clashes with the rest of the type. 'view backpack' is about 14px and cramped into the corner, and the card has no key glyph.
findings.fix: Set the hero '8' in --tx-1 f-cond 800 at 56px. Use --danger only when ammo is 25% or less. Set the weapon name in f-cond 600 at 20px. Set 'view backpack' at 16px with a key glyph, and inset the card 48px from the right and 48px from the bottom.

findings.where: top centre clock and extract chip
findings.what: The clock is bold and 9:00 reads well, but the teal chip below it has a different radius from the other panels and a hard edge. The arrow under the chip is detached and tiny, and the sun icon is a different style from the rest.
findings.fix: Use a 4px radius and the --ui-panel fill with a 3px --extract bar. Set the text at 20px. Draw the arrow as a 16px --extract chevron 8px under the chip. Keep the clock as the single hero at 56px.

findings.what: The minimap has a 1px dark frame with a harsh black empty lower half, and its corner chevron is tiny. It sits only about 20px from the screen edge, which is inconsistent with the 48px left margin on the other panels.
findings.fix: Inset the map 48px from the top and right, use a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius, and crop the empty black area. Make the chevron a 16px glyph in --tx-2.

v.verdict: The HUD is more legible than before, but it still reads as separate parts: the capital I in 'run Info' is a lowercase violation, the stamina and hp bars don't match, empty slots 4 to 0 are loose digits, and the weapon card text is too small.

findings.where: top-right, 'run Info' header under the minimap
findings.what: There is a capital 'I' in 'Info', which breaks the all-lower-case rule. This was flagged last time and not fixed. The bar is also a dark gradient strip with a chevron, and it doesn't match the roster panel.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, a 32px row height and 16px f-cond 600 text. Make the box the same width as the minimap and set its left edge to match.

findings.what: The two bars differ in weight. Stamina is a thin bar in muted blue with 20px text. The hp bar is a thick green bar with a 32px 'hp 100'. The text sits on the fills and is hard to read on the green. There is no panel, and the bars run into the bottom edge strip.
findings.fix: Put both in one --ui-panel at 85% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px inner padding and an 8px gap. Make both bars 16px tall with --ui-void tracks. Use a 16px label on the left and a 20px --tx-1 value on the right, outside the fill. Colour hp --ok, and drop below 30% to --danger. Make stamina a neutral --tx-2 or teal-grey.

findings.what: The loose '4 5 6 7 8 9 0' digits and the ghost icons are drawn straight on the terrain, at about 30% contrast. They look like leftover debug marks. The three filled slots are 100px, but the empty ones are not tiles.
findings.fix: Remove the empty slot labels. Draw only the filled slots, or draw empty slots as 100px outlined tiles at --ui-line with 8px gaps. Don't leave ghost icons. Give the slot row a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the weapon card.

findings.what: The rows are 18px apart with 14 to 15px text, which is under the 16px minimum. The 'value at risk' header is muted and small. The panel is translucent over busy terrain and the digits are cramped. The purple name 'fbi_surveillance_van' has no obvious meaning. The $ values are right-aligned, which is good.
findings.fix: Use 16px text on a 22px row pitch, an 80% opaque --ui-panel with 16px padding, and a 32px header row with a 1px --ui-line divider under it. Colour names --tx-1 and only the 'you' row amber (P1). Use a rarity or player colour for the purple name only if there is a reason. If there isn't, make it --tx-1.

findings.what: 'view backpack' is about 14px, dim, and has no key chip. The '8' is a large red number all the time. It should only turn red when ammo is low, because 8 of 36 is about 22% of a full magazine.
findings.fix: Set 'view backpack' to 16px --tx-2 with a key chip, such as [tab]. Keep the 56px hero number in --tx-1, and switch it to --danger at 25% of the magazine or below. Align the card's bottom edge and right margin (currently 10px) to the 5% safe margin or to the same edge as the slot row.

findings.what: The 9:00 timer is about 28px and floats with no panel, with a small sun icon beside it. The teal extract pill is well made but small. The tiny triangle under it is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Raise the timer to 32px and put it in a --ui-panel pill with an 8px radius. Make the 'extract' pill 16px and give it a 1px --extract border. Replace the triangle with a larger directional arrow.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip is a small 14px, almost pixel-like label with a green tint that doesn't match the other panels. It is jammed into the corner at 4px from the edge. The 'p2' tag is cyan, which is right, but the 16px type is under-sized next to the character.
findings.fix: Put the chip at the 5% margin, in the same --ui-panel with a --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond text. Make the p2 tag 20px with a 4px radius, a 1px cyan border and a small chevron pointing at the character.

v.verdict: The HUD parts are better organised, but the screen still has three loose edge treatments, a capital 'I' on screen, and thin hp and stamina bars. The pillagers list and the hotbar still look unpolished.

findings.where: run info bar under the minimap
findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar also sits only about 4px below the map and ends at the map's edge, so it looks glued on. Its 'v' chevron is a different weight from the '^' on the pillagers panel.
findings.fix: Set the text to 'run info'. Leave an 8px gap between the map and the bar. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use the same chevron glyph and size (16px, --tx-2) as the pillagers header.

findings.where: stamina and hp bars, bottom left
findings.what: The bars are not the 16px tracks asked for. Hp is a 32px solid green slab with 'hp 100' at about 32px, and stamina is a 20px muted blue strip with 'stamina' text at 20px. The text is drawn bigger than the bars, and the hp label is the loudest thing in the corner. The bars are 24px from the edge, not the 48px asked for, and they have no border or --ui-panel track. They also sit over the busy wall texture.
findings.fix: Draw both bars as 16px-high tracks on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap between them. Fill hp with --ok and stamina with --extract. Inset them 48px from the left and 48px from the bottom. Set the labels at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1, with 'hp' at 16px and '100' at 20px, sitting to the left of the track and not inside it.

findings.what: The panel is stuck 8px from the left and top edges. It has no visible border and a near-transparent fill, so the map shows through behind the text. The text is cramped at about 14px with a 18px pitch. The pink 'fbi_surveillance_van' row is an unexplained colour. 'you' has no accent, so the player's own row is not the one that stands out.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the left and 24px from the top. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Set rows at 16px with a 24px pitch and 16px padding. Colour only the 'you' row in --acc, and make the pink row --tx-1. Set the amounts in --tx-2 and right-align them.

findings.what: Slots 4 to 0 are bare, faint numbers floating on the wall texture, with no frames. They look like a rendering fault next to the framed 1 to 3 slots and are almost unreadable. The row also sits low, with the slot bottoms 24px from the screen edge, while the stamina bar is at a different height.
findings.fix: Hide empty slots, or draw them as 72px frames with a 1px --ui-line border at 40 percent opacity and a 16px --tx-2 number. Keep the lime border on the selected slot only. Use the same 8px gap and baseline as slots 1 to 3, and align the row's bottom with the stamina bar.

findings.what: The ammo card is the best-built element here, but the '10' is not the 56px hero it should be, and '/ 36' is the same weight as the hero. It is about 0 to 10px from the screen edge, much tighter than other HUD elements. 'b / i backpack' is about 12px, below the 16px minimum, and has no key glyph.
findings.fix: Set '10' at 56px f-cond 800 in --tx-1, and set '/ 36' at 20px in --tx-2. Set the weapon name at 20px f-cond 600. Set 'b / i backpack' at 16px in --tx-2 with a key glyph. Inset the card 48px from the right and 48px from the bottom, and keep its 4px radius.

findings.what: The chip has a tiny 14px label and a washed-out grey box. It sits just above the wall edge, off-axis from the hotbar and the bars, and looks like an afterthought. The key glyph 'f1' has no frame matching the hotbar's key styling.
findings.fix: Set the label at 16px f-cond 600. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Align its left edge to the stamina bar's 48px inset, or put it 8px above the hotbar's left edge. Draw 'f1' in a 24px keycap.

findings.what: The 9:00 clock has a heavy dark outline and a loose sun icon. The 'extract 138m' pill is teal, which is correct, but it is small at about 16px and its arrow floats 8px below it, with no connection to the pill.
findings.fix: Make the clock 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 with no outline, and put it on a --ui-panel plate. Set the pill label at 20px f-cond 600 in --acc-ink on --extract. Attach the direction arrow flush to the pill's bottom edge.

v.verdict: The HUD is better organised than before, with a clear roster, a hero ammo card and an uncluttered slot row. It still has a capital letter on screen, several slightly different panel styles and bars that sit directly on the world with no panel.

findings.where: top-right, 'run Info' header under the minimap
findings.what: The capital 'I' breaks the all-lower-case rule, and this was flagged last time and not fixed. The header is also 14px tall and tight, and its chevron is thin. It is not aligned to the minimap's left edge (1603 against 1604) and its border is weaker than the minimap's.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Use 16px f-cond 600, a 32px row, a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make the width exactly match the minimap.

findings.what: The bars sit directly on the busy ground with no panel and no border. The labels are drawn inside the fills and are low contrast on the blue and green. 'hp 100' is much larger than 'stamina', which gives two different type sizes for the same job. The bottom bar edge is only about 25px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Put both bars in one --ui-panel at 85% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px padding. Make the bars 16px tall on --ui-void tracks. Use a 16px --tx-2 label on the left and a 20px --tx-1 value on the right, outside the fill. Colour hp --ok, switching to --danger below 30%. Make stamina neutral teal-grey.

findings.what: Faint ghost icons and number labels 4 to 0 are drawn on the world strip behind and beside the three real slots. They read as dirt and clutter. The three filled slots have no shared container, and the numerals are tiny at about 12px.
findings.fix: Remove the ghost icons and the 4 to 0 labels. Draw only the filled slots, or draw empty ones as outlined 100px tiles at --ui-line with 8px gaps. Make the numerals 16px. Keep the lime outline on the selected slot only.

findings.what: The text is small at about 14px with a tight pitch of about 18px, and it is hard to read from a couch. The header sits very close to the first row with no divider. One purple name ('fbi_surveillance_van') is unexplained and reads as a rarity or player colour.
findings.fix: Use 16px text on a 22px row pitch with 16px padding and a 32px header row with a 1px --ui-line divider. Make all names --tx-1 and tint only the 'you' row amber. Remove the purple unless it carries a meaning.
