findings.what: 'view backpack' is about 14px and low contrast, and it has no key chip, so the action is unclear. The card is 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, which is a different margin from the left HUD and the minimap. Its bottom edge is also not level with the slot row.
findings.fix: Set 'view backpack' to 16px --tx-2 with a [tab] key chip. Align the card to the 5% safe margin and to the same bottom line as the slots. Switch the 56px hero number to --danger at 25% of the magazine.

findings.what: The notice is a long sentence, 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'. It is explanatory text, which counts as clutter. Its yellow bar and amber text compete with the lime accent, and its box is a different shape from the other panels.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Use --warn only for the glyph and --tx-1 for the text. Use a 4px-radius --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px text.

findings.what: The tag is clipped against the screen corner with about 2px of margin and a tiny size. It doesn't use the shared panel style.
findings.fix: Move it to the 5% margin (48px). Use 16px f-cond 600 on a --ui-panel fill with a 4px radius, or remove it after 3 seconds.

findings.what: The 9:00 timer is about 28px and the teal 'extract 138m' pill is crowded directly beneath it. The teal arrow below the pill points at nothing clear. The timer is not the hero number, but it is the biggest text on the top bar.
findings.fix: Keep 9:00 at 32px f-cond 700. Put 8px between the timer and the pill. Make the pill 16px with a 4px radius and put the arrow inside it. Keep teal for extraction only.

v.verdict: The title screen has a clear lime primary button, but the amber gradient logo clashes with the lime accent. Four equal-weight mode buttons and a cramped saves block make it look like a template, and the screen has no AAA polish or game identity.

findings.what: The logo is an orange-amber gradient with a drop shadow. That breaks the guide's no-gradient rule and puts amber right next to the lime accent, which the guide says never to do. It also reads as a generic wordmark with no art behind it. The logo and the full-width lime button both claim boldness, and the guide allows boldness in only one place.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat tx-1 (#efe9dc) at 56px or larger, f-cond 800, with no gradient or shadow. Or build a proper logo treatment. Keep lime for the primary button only.

findings.what: Four full-width bars (1 player, 2 player co-op, 2 player arcade demo, 1 player arcade demo) have the same weight and the same centred text. Only the lime fill separates them. The demo modes sit at the same level as the real modes. Each bar is about 560px wide for 20px text, which looks like a web form, not a console menu. The '(same machine)' text is an explaining parenthetical.
findings.fix: Keep 1 player as the lime hero at 56px height. Make co-op a secondary button. Move the two arcade demos into a 16px label-size row, or a smaller sub-row, underneath. Drop '(same machine)'. Narrow the column to about 480px and left-align it in the Halo-style column menu.

findings.what: The 'saves' label is small, dim grey and sits tight against the buttons. The 'pillager new' row has a lime border and lime text but is not clearly the focused item. The row below is a name input with two buttons, change name and create a new save, in three different widths with 8px gaps. Lime is used on non-primary text. The input looks like a button, so it is unclear which control is the input.
findings.fix: Give the saves block a panel (#16191b, 1px #2e3337) with a 16px label in tx-2 at 24px padding. Make the focused save row a --ui-raised fill with a 3px lime left bar and tx-1 text. Put the name input and its two buttons on one row of equal height (48px) with a visible placeholder.

findings.what: The go fullscreen and settings buttons are bordered boxes with about 14px text. The 'keyboard' chip floats alone at top centre with teal text. Teal is reserved for extraction only, and the chip has no clear purpose or alignment with anything else. Nothing is anchored to the 5% margins.
findings.fix: Show the input device as a 16px tx-2 chip, without teal, at top-left or inside the top-right cluster. Align the cluster to the 5% margin (96px) and give the buttons the same height as the menu buttons (48px).

findings.what: The tagline is about 18px grey with letter-spacing, and the full stops make it fussy. It sits 30px from the logo and 35px from the first button. It reads as filler.
findings.fix: Set it at 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking, 16px under the logo and 40px above the menu. Or remove it.

findings.what: The key chips and labels are tiny, at about 14px. The chips have bright white borders that are louder than the tx-2 labels. Because the legend sits on the title screen, it is clutter the player does not need before the game starts. Its vertical alignment looks slightly off between the chips and the labels.
findings.fix: Remove it from the title screen, or reduce it to a muted 14px footer with --ui-line-hi chip borders. Align the chip and label baselines.

findings.what: The version stamp is dim 12-13px text and sits at x=97 while the other items use different margins. It is under the 14px floor.
findings.fix: Set it at 14px f-body 500 in tx-2. Align it to the same 96px margin as the top-right buttons.

findings.what: The background is a flat vignette on near-black with nothing behind it: no art, no scene, no panel. The content is a small centred stack on a very large empty canvas. Nothing here says this is a top-down extraction shooter.
findings.fix: Put a dimmed raid or hideout key art image or blurred scene behind a --scrim at .80. Add a left-aligned menu column, in the Halo Reach or ARC Raiders style, with the logo at top left.

v.verdict: A clean, readable title menu with one clear lime primary action, but the saves block is cramped and unclear, the text is small, and the orange gradient title clashes with the lime accent.

findings.where: saves block (saves label, 'pillager new' row, name field + change name + create a new save)
findings.what: The saves section is ambiguous and crowded. 'pillager new' is a lime-outlined row, so it looks focused or selected next to the already-filled lime '1 player'. The label 'new' is dim. The name field and the two small buttons sit directly under it with no separation, so it is unclear which control does what. Nothing shows how many saves exist or which one is active.
findings.fix: Make the saves section one card with a 16px label, 8px gaps and one selected-row treatment. Use a --ui-line-hi border for the idle 'pillager new' row. Keep the lime outline only on the focused row, with a 3px lime left bar. Move the name field, change name and create a new save into a separate 16px-gap group, or reveal them only on the selected save.

findings.what: The primary action is right. The three secondary modes are identical in weight and badly ordered: '2 player arcade demo' and '1 player arcade demo' are listed in reverse numeric order, and 'co-op (same machine)' is a parenthetical explainer. The list reads as four equal rows rather than a play group and a demo group.
findings.fix: Order the rows 1 player, 2 player co-op, 1 player arcade demo, 2 player arcade demo. Drop '(same machine)' or move it into 16px muted text. Add a 24px gap before the two demo rows, or style them as quieter ghost rows (no fill, --tx-2 text).

findings.what: The orange-gold vertical gradient plus drop shadow reads as generic and glossy. It competes with the lime accent, and the guide says amber is for warnings and lime is the single accent. The title is about 80px, far above the 56px hero token, and the 8px tagline gap makes it look ad hoc. The tagline is muted grey at roughly 18px with wide tracking.
findings.fix: Fill the title flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) with no gradient and no shadow, or make it the logo art. Use 56 to 64px f-cond 800. Set the tagline to 20px --tx-2, 16px below the title, and keep 48px between the tagline and the first button.

findings.where: bottom key legend (wasd move, mouse aim, lmb fire, e search, f1 controls)
findings.what: This is the footer legend. It is about 15px, low contrast, and centred under the menu. The key caps are small boxed pills with 11px text. It is unreadable from a couch at 1080 and competes with the menu column. It also shows keyboard hints on a pad-capable title.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px, keep key caps in --tx-1 on --ui-raised with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and use --tx-2 for the verbs. Show only f1 controls on the title, or swap the glyphs to match the active device. Keep it at the bottom edge with a 32px bottom margin.

findings.what: The buttons are small (about 48px high with 14px text). They are bordered the same as the menu rows but sit far from the column. 'go fullscreen' is a utility that takes the same weight as settings. The 5% margin looks fine (about 100px to the right edge), but the buttons are not aligned to the footer margins.
findings.fix: Use 16px text, 40px height and 8px gaps. Replace 'go fullscreen' with an icon button, or move it into settings. Align the right edge with the 5% margin used at the bottom. The version stamp on the left is at x=97, so make both margins the same, 96px.

findings.what: The stamp is about 12px and low contrast, below the 14px fine token, and its baseline is not aligned with the key legend (y≈1047 vs 1042).
findings.fix: Set it to 14px --tx-2 and align the baseline with the legend. Put the stamp in the footer row and keep it 96px from the left edge.

findings.what: The column is 558px wide and the whole stack sits about 40px below centre. It leaves large dead vertical space above the title and below the saves block, and the background vignette is flat with nothing identifying the game. There is no art, character or raid scene, so it feels like a template.
findings.fix: Add a dim, blurred raid key-art layer (at about 25% opacity) behind the column, or a left-aligned hero image. Move the stack up so the optical centre sits at about 45% of the screen height. Keep the 4px radius.

findings.where: small text elements (saves label, 'new' tag, the 'pillager' field)
findings.what: The saves label is about 14px with low contrast, and 'new' is a dim 14px tag. The 'pillager' name field has no visible label or placeholder styling, so it looks like a button. The field text is bold white, the same as the buttons.
findings.fix: Set the saves label and 'new' tag to 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Style the field as an input (--ui-void fill, 1px --ui-line border, regular weight, a caret or placeholder such as 'name') so it is not confused with the buttons.

v.verdict: This is an in-raid HUD, not the bank landing, so the earlier logo and menu advice can't be judged. As a HUD it is cluttered: panels differ in style, the controls list is always open, and extraction is shown twice.

findings.what: The capture shows a live raid, not the bank landing, so the previous logo, mode-list and saves-block fixes cannot be checked. Either the capture harness is wrong or the landing screen is missing.
findings.fix: Re-capture the bank landing at 1080 and check that the landing state is reached before the shot. Judge the landing separately.

findings.what: The full controls list is open and takes about 310x350px of the left side, with 3 columns of tiny 16px text. It competes with the player bar and the status chips. Section 0 says a career raid should show one folded line at mid-bottom left, opened with F1. This is also explaining text on screen.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line, 'f1 controls', at x=96 and y=~1000. Open the full list only on F1, as a 90% card or a side panel, with a scrim of rgba(6,7,8,.8).

findings.what: The same distance is shown twice in two different teal chips, with two different arrow styles and two label formats. Section 0 says a line drawn twice is a defect.
findings.fix: Keep one cue. Use the top-centre chip as the single extract readout, 20px f-cond 600 teal text on a --ui-panel fill, 4px radius. Reduce the edge arrow to a bare teal chevron with no text.

findings.where: top-left stack: 'current pillagers 3' list (8-367, 143-242), player bar (16-170, 325-358) and the 'keyboard' chip (10-105, 5-32)
findings.what: Three unrelated boxes with different fills, borders and text sizes (about 14px to 16px). The pillagers list has tight rows. The 'pillager' name bar floats alone with an unlabelled green line. The keyboard chip uses a different green-outlined style and sits at the very corner, outside the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Put all three in one left column at x=96, y=48, all on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 16px labels, a 24px row pitch and 8px padding. Make the 'value at risk' header tx-2. Move the keyboard chip into the top-right cluster.

findings.where: bottom-left status (24-330, 940-1068): hp bar, status icons, 'concealed' and 'in cover' chips
findings.what: The big 'hp 100' text, about 40px, sits on a flat green bar with a different font and no panel, so it reads as a stray label. The amber 'concealed' text and the teal 'in cover' chip are 28px, bigger than the body scale, and they crowd the hp bar by under 12px. The first slot numbers 3, 5 to 0 are faint ghosts that look like clutter.
findings.fix: Set hp as a 56px hero number only if it is the one hero on this screen, otherwise 32px. Put the bar in a 4px-radius panel with 16px 'hp'. Set the chips to 16px with 8px gaps and 16px above the bar. Raise slot-number contrast to tx-2 at 16px, or drop the empty ones.

findings.what: It is a full-width dark bar with a chevron, a different style from every other panel. It overlaps the map room edge and has no clear reason to be so wide. In the capture the 'I' of 'info' looks like a capital, which breaks the all-lower-case order.
findings.fix: Shrink it to about 200px wide, 40px tall, on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, at the 96px right margin. Check the string is rendered in lower case with the font's lower-case i.

findings.where: banner 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (345-740, 777-803) and toast 'pillager joined' (895-1025, 893-930)
findings.what: The amber banner has a hard left bar and a sentence of explaining text. The 'pillager joined' toast is black with white text, a different style again, and floats mid-screen. Together with the pillagers list, this means alerts use three different styles.
findings.fix: Cut the banner to 'contract item nearby'. Put alerts in the top-centre banner only and move the join message into the left feed. Use one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px border, 16px text.

findings.what: The slot bar and the ammo panel are different sizes. The ammo block has a bold '12 / 24' hero, which is good, but 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are tiny and tight to the edge, outside the 5% margin. The slot icons use mixed pixel-art assets of different scales. The rarity bars are barely visible.
findings.fix: Align the ammo panel's right and bottom edges to a 96px and 54px margin. Set the labels to 16px tx-2 with 16px padding. Give both blocks the same height and a 4px radius. Make the rarity bar 3px, full width, at the slot base.

findings.what: The light-purple location name floats over the map with no panel or contrast guard. It is off-palette and hard to read over the orange floor.
findings.fix: Put it in the top-centre banner for 3s at 20px f-cond tx-1 on --ui-panel. Or drop the purple and use tx-1 with a 1px dark outline.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title menu I reviewed before. It has a clear ammo hero number and a readable hp bar. The left side is crowded with three stacked panels, and several lines are clipped or in the wrong case.

findings.what: The two-column key legend is a large opaque slab of 14-16px text at mid-left. It covers the map and competes with the HUD, with 'full list' hint text at the bottom. It sits left, not mid-bottom, and is open instead of folded to one line as the owner ordered (rs-1). The key caps are low contrast.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line at the bottom-left, centred around x=480: 'f1 controls'. Open it only on F1. When open, use #16191b with a 1px #2e3337 border, a 4px radius and 16px tx-1 text. Do not draw it at 0.9 opacity over the play area.

findings.where: left column stack: pillagers list (8-367, 143-242), 'pillager' bar (14-170, 325-358), controls panel
findings.what: Three differently styled boxes are stacked on the left at different widths and paddings, with no shared margin. The 'value at risk' list has 14px text and a tiny chevron. The name tag has a lime-green bar of unclear meaning. Together they read as clutter.
findings.fix: Align them to a 5% (96px) margin and a single panel style: #16191b fill, 1px #2e3337 border, 4px radius, 16px text, 8px padding. Collapse the pillager list to a single line 'pillagers 3' that expands on key press. Move the player name tag into the hp bar.

findings.where: capitals on screen: 'run Info' (1610, 33), 'F1' key cap (44, 776)
findings.what: 'run Info' has a capital I, and the 'F1' cap is drawn as 'f1', but 'run Info' breaks the all-lower-case order. The map marker 'c 152m' next to 'extract 152m' shows the same distance twice. The objective is repeated in two places on screen.
findings.fix: Lower-case 'run info'. Show the extract distance once, in the top-centre chip only. Remove the edge 'c 152m' chip or the top one.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown (1603-1900, 18-54) over the building
findings.what: The dropdown is a wide bar with a chevron that overlaps the building art and sits flush with the screen edge at 20px. It has no state and no content, and it does not follow the vertical 1x1 career list order.
findings.fix: Make it a 16px label chip, 40px high, right-aligned to the 96px margin. Use the same panel style as the left stack. Show its contents only when it is open.

findings.where: bottom-left status: 'concealed' (118-229, 945-978), 'in cover' (238-327, 945-978), two circular icons (24-111)
findings.what: Four elements sit in a row with mixed styles: amber text on one chip, teal text on another, and round icons in different outlines. The icons repeat the words. The row crowds the hp bar directly below it (gap about 20px).
findings.fix: Keep the icons or the words, not both. Use the same chip height (32px), tx-1 text and a warn or ok glyph only. Leave a 24px gap above the hp bar.

findings.what: The hint uses a long two-part sentence ('contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box') in amber on a dark strip with a 4px left bar. This is an explaining sentence. The toast is a plain black box with different padding and no accent. The two disagree on style, and the hint sits tight against the bottom building edge.
findings.fix: Shorten the hint to 'contract item nearby'. Give both the same panel (#16191b, 1px #2e3337, 4px radius, 16px text, 8x16 padding). Keep the hint on the left feed and the toast in a single banner slot at top-centre.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are drawn as tiles with a lime or amber selected border. Slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are only faint ghost icons with floating numbers, so the row feels broken and uneven. The number labels at 14px are barely readable. The 'f' badge on slot 2 and the 24 count are cramped.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as equal 96x96 tiles on #16191b with 1px #2e3337 borders and an 8px gap. Show empty slots at 40% opacity inside the same tile. Use 16px numbers in tx-2 inside the top-left corner. Keep the lime border for the selected slot only.

findings.what: The ammo hero '12 / 24' is correctly the biggest element, but the panel is pushed against the right and bottom screen edges (about 10px). The 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and dim. The hp bar is a flat bright green with no panel, and 'hp 100' is oversized relative to the bar. Both break the 96px margin.
findings.fix: Inset both panels by 48px from the screen edges. Put hp inside a panel with a 16px 'hp' label and 56px max number. Set the 'b / i backpack' hint at 16px in tx-2. Use the same panel fill and border as the other HUD panels.

v.verdict: This file is named p2-bank-landing but shows an in-raid HUD, so the bank landing was not judged and none of the earlier title-menu advice could be checked. As a HUD it is readable, with a strong ammo hero, but the left column is a stack of mismatched panels and the extraction distance is drawn twice.

findings.what: The capture is a raid HUD, not the p2 bank landing. The bank landing could not be checked, and the previous advice on the saves block, mode list, title and legend could not be confirmed as followed.
findings.fix: Re-capture 161-p2-bank-landing at the title/bank state and re-run the review.

findings.where: left column: 'current pillagers' list, 'pillager' nameplate, controls list
findings.what: Three panels sit on the left with three different widths, fills, border treatments and text sizes. The controls list is about 310x345px and covers a large part of the map. The pillager list text is about 14px, which is under the 16px minimum. This contradicts the 'folded to one short line, mid-bottom left' order.
findings.fix: Use one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Set all text to at least 16px. Fold the controls list to one line ('f1 controls') at the bottom-left, 32px from the edge, and open the full list only on f1.

findings.where: extraction distance: top-centre 'extract 152m' and right-edge 'c 152m' with arrow
findings.what: The same fact is drawn twice with two different pill styles, which breaks the one-place-per-line rule. The teal arrow below the top pill and the edge arrow add more noise.
findings.fix: Keep one teal --extract readout (the top-centre one at 20px). Remove the 'c 152m' edge pill and keep only a small edge arrow without text.

findings.where: bottom-left status: concealed / in cover pills and round icons, plus hp bar
findings.what: The status chips use 2 different border colours, and the icon discs and text pills have different heights. The 'hp 100' text sits on the bar at about 32px with no label hierarchy. The bar is a bright flat green with the number overlapping its edge.
findings.fix: Make the chips one 32px height with 8px gaps and an 8px gap to the hp bar. Put 'hp 100' at 20px inside the bar with --acc-ink or --tx-1 and a 4px radius. Use --ok for the fill and give the bar a 1px --ui-line border.

findings.what: A full-width bar (about 300x38px) with a navy fill and a chevron. It does not match the near-black panels elsewhere, and its role is unclear because the career top-right was ordered as a 1x1 vertical list. It also crowds the 'the long dock cache' label below it.
findings.fix: Use the same --ui-panel fill and --ui-line-hi border as the other panels. Make it a 16px label with a 24px gap above the zone name, and fold it into the cw-trcol list.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3 to 0 are dim grey over busy ground art and look like part of the floor. The empty-slot weapon silhouettes add clutter. The selected slot uses an amber border, which clashes with the 'lime means selected' rule.
findings.fix: Render empty slots as flat --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border and a --tx-2 16px number. Remove the faint silhouettes. Use a 3px --acc border on the selected slot.

findings.where: ammo block bottom-right ('scav pistol 12 / 24', 'b / i backpack')
findings.what: The 56px+ hero number works well and is the clear focal point. The 14px 'b / i backpack' hint is too small. The weapon name is also large next to the hero, so two items compete for weight.
findings.fix: Set the weapon name to 20px --tx-2 and the hint to 16px --tx-2. Keep the 12 at 56px weight 800. Make the panel border and fill match the left panels.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' toast (centre) and 'the long dock cache' (purple, top-right)
findings.what: The toast floats mid-screen over the play area with no relation to other panels, and the 20px purple zone name is a one-off colour that matches neither --acc nor a rarity colour.
findings.fix: Move the party toast to the top-centre banner or the left feed. Set the zone name to --tx-1, 20px, with a 1px text shadow for contrast, or tint it as a rarity colour only if it is a rarity.

v.verdict: The raid HUD reads clearly in the middle (timer, extract, ammo, hp), but the corners use inconsistent panels, the controls list is large and always open, and several small texts are hard to read from a couch.

findings.what: The list is open at about 310x345 px and covers the map. It uses 14 to 16px text in three columns. The career-raid rule says it should be folded to one line at mid-bottom left, with F1 opening it. The party demo may keep the open list, so this is only acceptable if this really is the party demo.
findings.fix: In career raids, fold it to one 16px line 'f1 controls' at the mid-bottom left, 32px from the edge. If this is the party demo, keep the list but cut it to the 8 most-used rows. Use 16px minimum text, --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: extraction info: top-centre 'extract 152m' chip and right-edge 'c 152m' chip
findings.what: The same extract distance is drawn twice, which the one-place-per-line rule forbids. The right-edge chip's label is truncated to 'c', which reads as a typo. The two chips also use different fills.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre chip and delete the right-edge chip. If an edge pointer stays, show only the teal arrow, with no text.

findings.where: panel system: value-at-risk list, pillager hp card, 'run info' dropdown, controls list, ammo card, 'in pillager's party' tooltip
findings.what: The panels do not share a style. Radii, border weights, header sizes and fill opacity all differ. The 'run info' dropdown is a full-width bar at 1600-1900 px, and its collapsed state wastes space. Names and values in the at-risk list are about 14px and crowded at about 18px row pitch.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 90% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Set row text to 16px with a 24px row pitch. Shrink the 'run info' bar to about 220px wide and right-align it to the 96px margin.

findings.where: hierarchy: hp bar bottom-left and ammo card bottom-right
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, fully saturated green slab with a 'hp 100' label at 32px. It is the loudest element on the screen and competes with the 56px ammo hero number. The green is also wider and brighter than needed.
findings.fix: Thin the bar to 16px tall and 280px wide with a --ui-panel track. Use --ok for the fill and a 16px 'hp 100' label above or inside it. Keep the ammo '12 / 24' as the one hero element.

findings.what: The empty slot numbers and gun silhouettes are very dim, about 2:1 contrast, and they sit directly on the busy map. The two filled slots have a different border style: amber on the selected slot, grey on the other.
findings.fix: Put all 10 slots on a shared --ui-panel strip. Use --tx-2 for the numbers at 16px. Mark the selected slot with a lime --acc border, not amber, because lime means selected.

findings.where: top-left stack: 'keyboard' chip, at-risk list, 'pillager' card
findings.what: There are three separate small boxes at different x offsets and with uneven vertical gaps. The 'pillager' card is about 150px wide, with a tiny label and a thin bar. It duplicates the 'pillager' name tag over the character.
findings.fix: Align all left-column items to x=32 with 16px gaps. Merge the 'pillager' card into the hp block, and drop the 'keyboard' chip once the device is known.

findings.where: status chips 'concealed' / 'in cover' and the two round icons (y945-980)
findings.what: The text is 24px in amber and green condensed type with a different box style from every other panel. Amber is meant for warnings only, but here it just marks a status. The icons next to the chips carry the same information.
findings.fix: Show the icon and a 16px --tx-1 word inside one 40px-tall chip, in --ui-panel with a 4px radius. Keep a colour only on the icon.

findings.where: world text 'the long dock cache' (top right)
findings.what: This is purple 24px text floating over the orange room with no plate. It is hard to read, and its colour is not in the palette (closest is --r-elite).
findings.fix: Draw it in --tx-1 with a 2px dark outline, or place it on a small --ui-panel plate. Use --r-elite only if it marks a rarity.

v.verdict: The HUD works as a collection of parts, but the pieces don't share one style. Four competing text sizes, three different box treatments and two alert styles scatter attention across the screen, and the ammo number is the only strong hero.

findings.where: top-left scoreboard 'current pillagers 0' and the 'pillager' health plate below it
findings.what: The scoreboard panel is crowded: five rows of 14-16px grey text with no hierarchy between the header, the 'you' row and the dead rows. The muted grey on the translucent dark panel is below 4.5:1. The 'pillager' name plate then sits just beneath it with an unrelated style and a blue name. The 'current pillagers 0' header, the 'value at risk' label, the 'x out · 3 dead' footer and the '$' values all share the same size and weight, so nothing leads.
findings.fix: Cut the panel to the 'you' row at 20px tx-1 plus one 16px line. Fill with --ui-panel at 90% opacity and use tx-2 #aaa498 for the rest. Put 24px between it and the 'pillager' plate, or merge the two into one block. Collapse the dead rows behind the chevron.

findings.where: center banner 'grenade hit cover / get clear' versus the 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' toast
findings.what: The alert styling is inconsistent. The red banner has a red border, a warning glyph and a 32px title. The contract toast has a tiny amber left bar, a thin pill and 18px text. The contract toast also carries an explaining sentence ('gold glow marks the box'), which is clutter. The banner is also a small floating box that sits on the pillar and overlaps the scene.
findings.fix: Use one alert component: --ui-panel fill, 3px left bar in the semantic colour, 20px title, 16px body, 4px radius. Delete 'gold glow marks the box'. Shorten the banner to 'grenade' + 'get clear' with a 24px margin from the pillar.

findings.where: bottom hotbar slots 1-0, 'f1 controls' chip and 'pillager joined' toast
findings.what: The hotbar mixes sizes. Slot 1 is selected with a yellow outline, slots 2 and 4 are filled, and slots 3 and 5-0 are ghosted weapon icons that clutter the row. The selected outline is amber rather than the lime --acc accent, so it reads as the wrong colour. Slot numbers are 14px and low contrast. The 'f1 controls' chip sits loose to the left of the bar. The 'pillager joined' toast floats above the bar at an unrelated size and position.
findings.fix: Show only the filled slots. Use a 2px #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised fill on the selected slot. Raise numbers to 16px tx-1. Align the f1 chip to the bar's left edge with an 8px gap. Dock the toast to the left feed instead of floating it mid-screen.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is large (~32px), bold and sits on a flat mid-green bar. It beats every other element for weight, yet hp at 100 is the least urgent information. It is also in the player's amber/cyan zone with the two round status icons above it, which crowd the corner. The bar edge touches the screen margin (~24px, not 5%).
findings.fix: Make the bar 12px tall with a 20px 'hp 100' label above it in tx-1. Keep the hero size for ammo. Space the status icons 16px above the bar and inset the group by 48px.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and top-centre timer/extract chip
findings.what: The 'run info' box is a native-select style dropdown with a chevron. That is a web-form look, and it is much wider than the content needs. The timer cluster uses a different pill style (teal-bordered 'extract 130m' with a stray teal arrow below it) than any other element. The sun icon beside the timer has no label.
findings.fix: Shrink 'run info' to a hug-width 16px label panel with the same panel fill and border (#4a5257, 1px, 4px radius) as the scoreboard. Group the timer at 32px with 'extract 130m' as a 16px teal text line beneath, with no pill and no loose arrow. Drop the unlabelled icon or give it a 16px label.

findings.what: The ammo card is the best element here. The hero number is about 56px with a '/ 24' reserve, and the 'b / i backpack' hint is only 14px. The weapon name 'scav pistol' is right-aligned over the number, which leaves the numerals visually off-centre. The card is a different corner radius and fill than the scoreboard.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe (fill #16191b, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius) on every HUD box. Keep the hero at 56px weight 800. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2.

findings.where: keyboard chip top-left and world-space 'pillager' name label
findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip uses a green monospace-feeling fill that matches nothing else on screen, and it sits at the very edge with about 8px margin. The 'pillager' name over the players uses a blue boxed label at about 28px, which is oversized for a nameplate. It covers the character heads and doubles the info in the top-left plate.
findings.fix: Restyle the 'keyboard' chip as 16px tx-2 text with no fill, inset 48px, or remove it. Reduce the world nameplate to 16px with no box and place it 8px above the head. Use the P1 amber and P2 cyan player colours instead of blue.

findings.what: Edge margins vary: about 8px for the keyboard chip, 24px for the hp bar, 10px for the scoreboard. Border colours also vary between boxes (amber, red, teal, grey). Together this makes the HUD read as assembled from different templates, with no unifying identity.
findings.fix: Set all corner anchors to 5% of the screen (about 96px by 54px at 1080p) or at minimum 48px. Use --ui-line-hi borders everywhere, and reserve colour for one semantic bar per component.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD is readable at a glance, but the same grenade warning is drawn three times, the panels use inconsistent styles and type sizes, and several overlaps and tiny labels fall short of polished.

findings.where: grenade warning: top-centre banner, world label above the players, bottom-left feed
findings.what: The 'cooked grenade! throw grenade now' warning shows in two places (the world label at centre and the left feed), and the 'grenade hit cover / get clear' banner repeats it. The owner's rule from 10-27 is that an alert goes only in the top-centre banner and every other line goes only in the left feed. This also clutters the screen.
findings.fix: Keep one alert: the top-centre banner. Delete the world-space red label at y≈398. Keep the 'cooked grenade' text only as a feed line, or drop the banner and keep only the feed. Remove the duplicate so each message appears once.

findings.where: player name tag 'pillager' overlapping the 'cooking 0.9s' chip (x≈740-900, y≈430-445)
findings.what: The name tag is cut off by the cooking chip, so it reads 'pillag|er'. The chip sits on the tag and both are tiny at about 12-14px.
findings.fix: Anchor the cook timer 8px above the tag or move it to the reticle. Make it at least 16px. Never overlap with the name tag; if space is short, hide the name tag while cooking.

findings.what: The panel is crowded: five rows of 14-15px text, a dim 'dead' label, a grey on dark price column and a chevron, all stacked tight. It pulls the eye to the top-left, where the player is not looking. The 'pillager' health plate below it floats with no clear relation to it, and the panel's border and fill differ from the other panels.
findings.fix: Collapse it to a single line by default ('value at risk $1,647') and expand on a key press. Use text at least 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498) and the shared --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Add 16px of space between this panel and the health plate.

findings.where: panel and banner styling across the screen (alert banner, feed warning, 'run info' dropdown, ammo card, 'pillager joined' toast, 'keyboard' chip)
findings.what: Each element has its own look. The alert is a red fill with a left bar, the feed warning is an outlined dark chip, 'run info' is a wide dropdown with a bright white border, the toast is a black box with a thin border, and the 'keyboard' chip has a green border and a different font. Corner radii differ and there is no shared panel token.
findings.fix: Put every HUD box on --ui-panel (#16191b) with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use red fill only on the one alert banner. Put 'run info' and 'keyboard' into the same chip style at 16px f-cond 600.

findings.what: The hotbar hierarchy is weak. Empty slots 3 and 5-0 show faint ghost icons and numerals that look like clutter. The selected slot's yellow border (amber, not the lime --acc) has a different weight from the others. The slot numerals are about 14px grey, and the ammo count sits at the edge of its slot. The hotbar floats over the water and bush art with no panel behind it.
findings.fix: Hide empty slots or draw them at 20% opacity with no numerals. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border to match the focus colour. Put a --ui-panel strip behind the hotbar. Use at least 16px for slot numerals.

findings.what: The hero number '12 / 24' is good and carries the hierarchy, but the card is tight at the bottom-right edge. Its margin is about 12px against the 5% safe margin. The 'b / i backpack' line is 14px and low contrast, and 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while the footer text is left-aligned.
findings.fix: Move the card in to the 5% margin (about 96px from the right and 54px from the bottom). Left-align the card text and raise the hint to 16px in --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number.

findings.where: bottom-left health bar and status icons
findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is a large 32px+ label in a different, heavier, rounded style that competes with the hero ammo number. It also sits flush with the screen edge at x≈24. The two circular status icons (crossed-eye and clover) have no labels and are cramped above the bar.
findings.fix: Set 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 inside the bar, not at 40px. Inset the bar to the same 5% margin as the ammo card. Add a 16px gap above the icons and label them or remove them.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract chip, plus top-right 'run info' dropdown
findings.what: The clock '14:58' with its sun icon and the teal 'extract 131m' chip are good, but the chip is at 14-16px. The extract arrow below the chip is also tiny. The 'run info' dropdown is a wide empty bar on the far right whose wide bar and dropdown arrow add nothing and clash with the 1 by 1 top-right list the owner asked for.
findings.fix: Raise the chip text to 16px and attach the arrow to the chip's own bottom edge. Shrink 'run info' to a content-width chip (about 140px wide) or remove it until the top-right list from cw-trcol ships.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD reads clearly: the ammo block, hp bar and grenade alert are solid. But it carries capitals, a dead player-name label, tiny low-contrast text and a lot of competing small widgets, so it falls short of polished.

findings.what: It shows a capital 'I' ('run Info'), which breaks the all-lower-case order. The control is also an unexplained wide dropdown in the corner the career HUD list owns (cw-trcol). It looks like a browser select, not game UI.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Replace the select with a 56px-tall --ui-panel chip at the same 4px radius, with a lime focus ring and an 'f2' key hint. Keep it at most 200px wide.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a green mono/pixel-style chip. It breaks the rule of no pixel or mono headline and uses a different chip style from every other label. The raid panel under it has about five type sizes and muted rows at roughly 13-15px in dim grey. 'value at risk' and the '$' figures sit below the 16px floor and are low contrast.
findings.fix: Draw the 'keyboard' tag in --f-cond 600 16px on a --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set all panel rows to 16px --tx-1 for names and --tx-2 (#aaa498) for dead rows. Drop the header to a single 16px line, and delete the redundant '0 out · 3 dead' footer.

findings.where: centre-bottom 'in pillager's party' tooltip and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The party tooltip floats over the map at 14px with no relationship to anything near it. It is clutter and an explaining sentence. The 'f1 controls' chip overlaps a corpse sprite and sits left of the hotbar with no alignment to it. The 'f1' key cap is not a consistent key style.
findings.fix: Remove the party tooltip, or move it into the player label as a 16px tag. Set the controls chip 16px with 8px padding and a --ui-panel fill. Align its baseline to the hotbar top (y≈955) and leave 24px clear of the corpse and the hotbar.

findings.what: The empty slots 3-0 are ghosted at about 15% opacity. Their numerals are tiny and nearly unreadable over the blue water tint, and the faded weapon silhouettes add noise. Hierarchy is flat: the hotbar's selected slot is the only strong item.
findings.fix: Hide unowned slots, or draw them as 1px --ui-line outlines at 40% with a 14px --tx-2 numeral. Remove the silhouettes. Keep the selected slot's 3px lime border.

findings.where: player name label 'pillager' above the characters
findings.what: The label is blue-on-dark in a heavy boxed plate. It is cyan-ish, while P1 is amber and P2 cyan. It floats over two characters, so it is unclear which player it names, and its 28px size competes with the grenade alert. The blue tint also shows on the 'pillager' bar at left.
findings.fix: Shrink it to 16px --f-cond 600 in --tx-1. Put it on a 1px --ui-line chip and tint only the ring or number in the player colour (amber P1, cyan P2). Put one label above each character, or none.

findings.what: The banner is clear and in the right place, but the red fill with a red border and red title is heavy. 'get clear' is an explaining sub-line at about 16px. The banner has a thin progress line along the bottom that is barely visible. It also sits close to the extract chip, with only about 20px between them, and the dotted tether line runs down to the cover with no clear purpose.
findings.fix: Use a --ui-panel fill with a 3px --danger left bar and a 32px --f-cond 700 title in --tx-1 and a 20px --danger icon. Remove 'get clear'. Make the timer bar 4px tall in --danger. Leave 24px between the banner and the extract chip.

findings.what: The ammo block is the right hero (56px+ '12 / 24'), and 'b / i backpack' is a 14px hint that is near the minimum. The hp bar is a flat green bar with the 'hp 100' text in an oversized 36px white outlined style that does not match the ammo type. The text clips against the bar's left edge, and the two status icons at far left, amber and teal, are unlabelled. The corner blocks have different panel treatments: the hp block has none, and the ammo block has a dark fill with a border.
findings.fix: Give hp the same --ui-panel and 4px radius as the ammo block. Set 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 32px --f-cond 700. Add 16px padding. Align the baseline of both blocks at y=1032. Label the two icons or group them in one 8px-gap chip.

findings.where: overall map overlay and HUD margins
findings.what: The big purple-blue vision wash over the whole map lowers contrast on all HUD text around it. HUD elements sit on inconsistent margins (left 8px, bottom 24px, right 12px) and not on the 5% safe margin (96px at 1080), so everything crowds the screen edges.
findings.fix: Cap the wash alpha at about .25 and keep the HUD out of it. Use 48px margins (--sp-5) for every corner block and align all corners to the same inset.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has a clear hero ammo number and a readable alert banner, but the same warning is drawn three times, the hud corners are cluttered and mismatched, and several things overlap the player.

findings.where: top-centre banner, floating text above player, bottom-left alert chip
findings.what: The grenade warning is drawn three times: the 'grenade hit cover' banner, the red 'cooked grenade! throw grenade now' strip over the players, and the same text in a bottom-left chip. This breaks the settled rule that every line shows in one place (alerts only in the top-centre banner).
findings.fix: Delete the world-space strip at y≈398 and the bottom-left chip at y≈789. Keep only the top-centre banner, and make it carry 'cooked grenade, throw now' as its single line.

findings.what: The 'pillager' name tag, the cooking pill and the p1/p2 rings overlap each other and the characters' heads. The name is clipped by the cooking label ('pillag|er'), and the bright tint on the tag competes with the sprite.
findings.fix: Anchor the cooking timer on the grenade reticle (the red 0.9 already there) and delete the pill. Offset the name tag 12px above the head with a 16px gap from any neighbouring label.

findings.what: The panel is cramped. The title is 14px or smaller and the values sit hard against the panel edge. The grey rows for 'dead' players use mixed weights, and the footer '0 out · 3 dead' is dim and tiny. It is a lot of data on a panel that is not the main action. The blue 'pillager' bar below it is a separate unlabelled box with no matching style.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels with 8px padding and 24px row height. Fold the footer into the header. Align the player bar to the panel's left edge and the same 4px radius.

findings.what: Capitals appear on screen: 'run Info' has a capital I in the top-right dropdown, and 'f1 controls' and 'b / i backpack' also read oddly. The pillager name 'pillager' is fine, but 'run Info' breaks the all-lower-case order.
findings.fix: Render 'run info' in lower case.

findings.where: hp bar bottom-left and status chips
findings.what: The 'hp 100' number is large, but it is heavy and sits on a flat green bar that is too bright against the scene. The status chips ('concealed', 'in cover') are dim grey on dark and fall well below 4.5:1, and the two circular icons are different sizes from the chips. The row feels like three unrelated widgets.
findings.fix: Make the status chips tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter at 16px with 8px padding, align icon and chip heights to 32px, and drop the hp text to 20px inside a 24px bar with the 56px hero reserved for ammo.

findings.what: The hotbar is washed out. The ghosted slots 3-0 are low contrast, and the slot numbers are tiny at about 12px, below the 16px minimum. The selected slot has an amber border, but lime is the only colour meant for 'selected', and the amber also reads as P1. The 'f1 controls' hint above it is a small button style that nothing else on screen uses.
findings.fix: Use a --acc #e6ff3d 2px border for the selected slot, set slot numbers at 16px, and fade empty slots to a uniform 40% opacity. Make 'f1 controls' a 16px key hint in the same style as 'b / i'.

findings.what: The tooltip sits over the main play area and the hotbar edge with no clear anchor, so it reads as a stray label. Its text is about 14px on a heavy black box.
findings.fix: Anchor it to the player or move it into the left feed. Use 16px text on the standard --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and the red barrels
findings.what: The wide 'run info' bar sits over the barrels and shows a chevron that does nothing visible, so it competes with the clock and the extract chip at top centre. The clock and extract chip also use different fills and radii.
findings.fix: Shrink the run info bar to content width and fold it into the career top-right vertical list. Give the clock and extract chip the same 4px radius and one panel fill.

v.verdict: The grenade banner and contract toast are gone, but the HUD is still scattered. It has mixed type sizes, a capital 'I' in 'run info', and a mid-screen toast. The left cluster has four loose elements, and the selected hotbar slot is amber instead of lime.

findings.what: The text reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The control is a full-width 300px bar with a chevron and a different fill and border from the other panels. It looks like a web select box.
findings.fix: Render the label as 'run info' in lower case at 16px f-cond. Shrink the control to hug its text, about 140px wide. Use the --ui-panel fill, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius, the same as the scoreboard panel.

findings.where: top-left cluster: 'keyboard' chip, 'current pillagers 0' bar, 'pillager' plate
findings.what: Three unrelated boxes sit at x=8 to x=370 with different widths, fills and fonts. The 'keyboard' chip is green-tinted, the pillagers bar is a wide dropdown, and the pillager plate is a small plate with a green bar. The 'keyboard' chip is not aligned to the other two. The gaps between them are uneven (about 40px, then 150px). The scoreboard dropdown is the same width as the run info bar.
findings.fix: Stack them in one left column with an x=48 inset and 16px gaps between them. Give all three one panel style: --ui-panel at 90%, a 1px #4a5257 border, a 4px radius, and 16px tx-1 labels. Make the 'pillager' plate the same width as the pillagers bar, or merge the plate into that panel as a row.

findings.what: The selected slot has an amber border, but lime is reserved for 'selected'. The slot numbers are about 12px and low contrast. The empty slots 3 and 5 to 0 show ghost weapon icons that make noise and look dimmer than a real empty state. The slot labels are not aligned to a common baseline.
findings.fix: Use a 2px #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised fill on the selected slot. Raise the numbers to 16px tx-1 and put them at the same offset (8px top-left) on every slot. Show only filled slots, or reduce the empty ones to a 1px outline with no icon.

findings.what: The toast floats mid-screen directly above slot 4 and the hotbar. It has a black fill with no border, and its 15px text does not match any alert style. It crowds the hotbar and could be read as part of it.
findings.fix: Dock it to the left feed (x=48, y about 40% down), or put it at the top-centre alert position. Use --ui-panel, a 3px left bar in --ok, 16px text and a 4px radius. Leave 24px clear of the hotbar.

findings.where: top-centre timer '14:58', sun icon and 'extract 130m' chip
findings.what: The timer is bright and the extract chip is a green pill with a loose teal arrow below it. Three treatments sit within 60px of each other: a bare number, an icon in a circle, and a pill. The arrow has no label. The extract chip is the only green-bordered pill, so it reads as a different component.
findings.fix: Set the timer at 32px f-cond 700 tx-1. Put 'extract 130m' under it as 16px --extract text with no pill or border. Drop the loose arrow or place it inline before the text at 16px. Give the sun icon a 16px label, or move it into the 'run info' panel.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and status icons
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green block with a huge 'hp 100' label drawn on top of it. The label is about 36px, so it competes with the ammo number. The icons above it are two circles in different colours (amber and green) with no labels. The 'f1 controls' chip and the corpse sprite next to the icons are clutter.
findings.fix: Use a 12px-tall bar with a 20px 'hp 100' label above it in tx-1. Put the status icons 16px above the bar in one consistent colour with the same stroke weight. Align the group to the same x=48 inset as the top-left stack. Move the 'f1 controls' chip to a mid-bottom-left position aligned with the hotbar's left edge, with an 8px gap.

findings.what: The panel is the strongest element and is well built. 'scav pistol' at 24px and 'b / i backpack' at 14px sit at different scales to the rest of the HUD. The panel has a different border and fill to the other HUD panels, and it sits tight to the screen edge at about 10px.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom edges. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px. Use the same 1px #4a5257 border and 4px radius as the left-side panels.

findings.where: world: grey pillar, grenade arc and scene overall
findings.what: The pillar splits the screen in two, and the dotted aim trail runs under it. The wide blue vision cone and the blue wash over the lower third lower the contrast of the hotbar icons.
findings.fix: Cut the cone's blue wash to about 50% opacity near the hotbar. Add a --scrim strip behind the hotbar at about 60% opacity so slot art and numbers hold at least 4.5:1.

v.verdict: The duplicate grenade alert is gone and the cook timer no longer sits on the name tag, but the HUD still mixes box styles, small text and a capital letter, and the bottom strip is cluttered.

findings.what: 'run info' has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The box is also a wide black bar with a chevron, unlike the top-left 'current pillagers' bar. Neither matches the ammo card or the 'keyboard' chip.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info'. Put both dropdowns in one chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600. Make them the same height (32px) and width, and inset 24px from the screen edges.

findings.where: Hotbar, bottom centre (slots 3, 5-8, 0 and the water-coloured strip)
findings.what: The empty slots show ghost weapon icons and numerals at about 12px. The strip is transparent, so the slot numbers and the 'f1 controls' tab lose contrast against the blue ground. The slot-1 selection is a thin amber ring, not the accent, and the ammo count '24' is tiny.
findings.fix: Put a --ui-panel strip at 90% opacity behind the whole hotbar. Hide empty slots, or draw them at 15% opacity with no icon. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot. Make numerals and ammo counts 16px minimum. Keep 'f1 controls' on that same strip, 8px above it.

findings.where: Left column: 'keyboard' chip, 'current pillagers 0' bar, 'pillager' name plate with hp bar
findings.what: Three unrelated boxes are stacked with uneven gaps of about 120px and 150px. The 'current pillagers 0' text is about 14px. The 'pillager' plate is blue-tinted, a third style. 'current pillagers 0' also explains nothing the player needs.
findings.fix: Stack them with 16px gaps in one 24px-inset column. Set the text to 16px in --tx-1 or --tx-2. Put the plate on --ui-panel with a 3px P1 bar. Fold 'keyboard' into the controls chip at the bottom, or put it in the same 32px chip style.

findings.what: The bar is a flat saturated green fill with a large 'hp 100' in a different weight and size from every other HUD number. It is the heaviest element after the ammo card, which splits the hierarchy. The two round icons above it (an eye and a clover) are unlabelled and sit loose.
findings.fix: Make the bar 12px tall on --ui-panel with a --ok fill. Put '100' in 20px f-cond 700 over it or beside it. Group the two icons in a 32px chip row 8px above the bar, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius.

findings.what: 'scav pistol 12 / 24' is correct and the hero number is clear, but the card is a heavy black box with a 'b / i backpack' hint at about 14px. It also sits tight against the screen corner and the hotbar's right edge.
findings.fix: Set the card to --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the hint to 16px --tx-2. Inset it 24px from the edges and leave 24px between the hotbar and the card. Use --acc only for the active weapon.

findings.where: Grenade world overlay: blast ring, '1.1' fuse label, 'cooking 1.1s' chip
findings.what: The big red blast ring and dotted arc are readable, but the '1.1' fuse label is about 14px and sits on a mid-tone floor. The 'cooking 1.1s' chip is about 14px. The ring covers the 'pillager joined' toast and part of the hotbar.
findings.fix: Raise both labels to 16px with a 1px dark outline. Use a --danger stroke at 60% opacity and 2px wide for the ring. Move the toast to top-centre under the clock, so the ring never covers it.

findings.what: The toast is an isolated black box at the bottom centre, over the ring and next to the hotbar. The extract chip is a teal-bordered green pill with a different radius from the other chips. Together they make 6 or more box styles on one screen.
findings.fix: Use one toast style (--ui-panel, 4px radius, 16px text). Put it at the left feed, not bottom-centre. Give the extract chip a --extract 1px border, a 4px radius and --ui-panel fill.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the earlier fixes mostly weren't applied: there is still a capital 'I' in 'run Info', native-looking dropdowns, a stray party tooltip, ghost weapon silhouettes in the hotbar and a name tag that is too large.

findings.what: A capital 'I' appears on screen, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The control is also an unstyled native select and doesn't match the panel language. It is 300px wide.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Replace the select with a 56px-tall --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, a lime focus ring and an 'f2' hint. Make it at most 200px wide, inset 48px from the screen edges.

findings.what: A floating black tooltip with a sentence on it. It is clutter, an explaining sentence, and it sits unanchored just above the hotbar and next to the controls chip.
findings.fix: Delete it. If the party info is needed, show it as a 16px tag inside the player label.

findings.what: Eight ghost weapon silhouettes with numerals at roughly 30% opacity fill the bar. They add noise, imply items the player doesn't own, and the numerals are too dim to read.
findings.fix: Hide unowned slots, or draw them as 1px --ui-line outlines at 40% with a 14px --tx-2 numeral and no silhouettes. Keep slots 1 and 2 at 100px with the 3px lime border on the selected slot.

findings.what: The name is about 28px with a heavy black plate and a single label for two characters. It is the loudest item in the scene, and the blue text doesn't match the amber (P1) or cyan (P2) ring colours.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px --f-cond 600 in --tx-1 on a 1px --ui-line chip. Place one label per character, with the ring or number tinted amber for P1 and cyan for P2.

findings.what: The panel is a native dropdown that is nearly empty ('0'). The 'keyboard' tag sits in a different style in the corner. The two have different heights, fills and borders, and neither lines up with the 'pillager' health card below.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel style: 16px --f-cond 600, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 8px padding. Left-align all three at x=48 with 8px gaps. Drop the dropdown arrow, or hide the panel when the count is 0.

findings.what: The chip is small and low-contrast, and it overlaps the dead body beside it. It has no clear anchor to the hotbar, and the 'f1' key cap is a different style from the hotbar's key badges.
findings.fix: Use a 16px chip on a --ui-panel fill with 8px padding and 4px radius. Put its baseline at the hotbar top (y≈955) and leave 24px clear of the corpse and the hotbar. Use the same key-cap style as the hotbar.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is oversized, sits unevenly on the bar and is at the screen edge. The bar is 400px wide and sits at x=24, outside the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Move the bar to x=48, y=1080-48-32. Make it 32px tall with 20px --f-cond 700 text. Add a 1px --ui-line border and put the number on the right.

findings.what: The large violet-blue cone washes out the map and lowers the contrast behind the HUD chips, especially the party tooltip and controls chip at the bottom.
findings.fix: Lower the cone fill opacity to about 10% and darken the edge. Keep the HUD chips on solid --ui-panel at 90% or more so they stay readable on any background.

v.verdict: The floating 'cooking' strip and the alert chip are gone, but the HUD is still cluttered, with a capital 'I' in 'run Info', dim status chips and a hot-pink blast ring that overpowers the whole scene.

findings.what: The text reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. This was flagged last time and is still not fixed. The dropdown is also a wide, mostly empty bar that looks like a generic form field.
findings.fix: Render 'run info' in lower case. Shrink the bar to about 200x40px, 16px f-cond, with a 4px radius and a --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The chip text is dark grey on a dark fill and about 3:1 contrast, so it can't be read from a couch. The two chips don't line up with the round icons: icon circles are 40px and chips about 28px.
findings.fix: Use --tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter at 16px, with a 32px chip height and 8px padding. Make the icons and chips 32px so they share one baseline. Show the chip text only when the state changes.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is oversized at about 36px and sits inside a thin bar, so it competes with the ammo hero number. The bar hugs the screen edge with no 5% margin.
findings.fix: Use a 24px-high bar with 20px text, set inside a 48px margin from the screen edge. Keep the 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.what: The dropdown says '0' while one pillager is listed below it, and the list and the player bar are not aligned. A bare dropdown arrow and a floating name card read as unfinished. Both use 14 to 15px type.
findings.fix: Fix the count or the label. Make the panel 16px type on a --ui-panel fill, with 8px padding and 24px rows, and align the bar's left edge to the header at x=8.

findings.where: world: blast ring and tooltips ('in pillager's party', 'cooking 1.1s', name tags)
findings.what: The huge red radius ring and the bright circle fill dominate the screen, and the grenade reticle is only a tiny '1.1'. The 'in pillager's party' tooltip floats over the hotbar with no clear purpose, and the 'cooking 1.1s' strip duplicates the 1.1 on the reticle.
findings.fix: Draw the ring at 40% opacity with a 2px stroke and no fill. Delete the 'cooking' strip, since the 1.1 on the reticle already shows the time. Bring the reticle number up to 20px. Remove the party tooltip or move it into the left feed.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3 to 0 and the faded weapon icons are low contrast clutter. The 'f1 controls' chip overlaps the slot row and is only about 14px, so it is hard to see.
findings.fix: Show only the owned slots, plus a dimmed lock for the rest. Move 'f1 controls' 16px above the hotbar, in 16px --tx-2 type.

findings.where: keyboard chip top-left and clock top-centre
findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip uses a green mono-style label that matches nothing else, and 'extract 131m' is a small teal pill under the clock with the sunrise icon.
findings.fix: Make 'keyboard' a 16px --tx-2 f-cond label with no fill. Make the extract pill 16px type with 8px padding, and keep teal for extraction only.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the prompt card I reviewed before. The ammo hero number and hotbar are strong, but the open controls panel, a cramped scoreboard and low-hanging status chips make it busy, and it doesn't follow the quiet-HUD rules.

findings.what: The career raid controls list is fully open: about 25 rows of 16px text in two columns, 312x346px over the left map. The settled rule says it starts folded to one short line, mid-bottom left, and F1 opens it. Open, it is the biggest panel on screen and out-shouts the ammo and hp.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line at x16, y1040 ('f1 controls'), tx-2 on a 4px --ui-panel pill, and open the full list only on F1. If the list stays open (party demo), cut it to 8 rows and add 8px padding between the groups.

findings.what: The card is crammed: a header, five rows at 14-16px with no padding, and a 'value at risk' column in tx-2 grey. The dead rows sit below the 4.5:1 contrast floor over the orange map. 'current pillagers 0' reads as noise, and '0 out · 3 dead' repeats what the rows already say.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel at 90% opacity with 16px padding. Drop the '0 out · 3 dead' footer line. Use 16px rows on a 24px pitch. Keep the 'you' row in tx-1 and lime the $1,647 only. Make the dead rows --tx-2 #aaa498 with a strike or a small --danger skull glyph, not a dimmer grey.

findings.where: hp and status area, x24-430 y940-1068
findings.what: The hp bar sits flush against the bottom edge (y1068 of 1080), which is outside the 5% safe margin, and its '100' is clipped at the left. The two status chips ('concealed' amber, 'in cover' teal) and two round icons repeat the same information, and they crowd the bar with about 8px of gap. Amber next to teal pills reads as a loud pair.
findings.fix: Raise the hp bar to y≤1026 (a 54px margin) and make it 28px tall. Merge each icon and word into one chip at 16px, and drop the large 22px text. Keep chip fill at --ui-panel with a 1px border in the state colour. Leave a 16px gap between the chips and the hp bar.

findings.what: It is a collapsed dropdown bar 297px wide with a chevron, in a dark fill at 42px tall. It is not tied to the scoreboard on the left, and the lone label has no content to justify the width. The 'i' in 'info' reads like a capital I at this size.
findings.fix: Shrink it to about 160px wide and 32px tall. Align it to the same 16px top margin and the same panel fill, border and radius as the scoreboard. Check that the glyph is a lowercase 'i'.

findings.where: player nameplates, x16-170 y324-358 and x418-466 y504-520
findings.what: 'pillager' is drawn twice: once as a large bar top-left, and once over the character. The top-left name bar is 154x34 in a different style (blue text on a green bar) from the scoreboard card and the hp bar below.
findings.fix: Remove the floating nameplate or the top-left one. Keep one, on the scoreboard's 'you' row. Use P1 amber for the name, as the guide says.

findings.what: The hero number is good: 56px+ and bold. But the card is cut by the right and bottom edges (1909, 1052), so it sits about 11px from the edge instead of the 5% margin. 'b / i backpack' at 14px is hard to read.
findings.fix: Move the card to x≤1824, y≤1026. Make the hint 16px tx-2. Use the same --ui-panel fill and 4px radius as the other panels.

findings.what: 'pillager joined' is a small black pill with 16px text. It sits on top of the hotbar's top edge (y957), about 27px away, in a different colour from the other pills.
findings.fix: Move the toast to the left feed or the top-centre banner per the one-place rule. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The selected slot has a lime border (good), but slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are faded numerals with ghost silhouettes. They are hard to read and add noise. Slot 2's 'f' keycap is the only keycap shown.
findings.fix: Draw the empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlines at 40% opacity and drop the ghost weapon art. Use the same 16px numeral position in every slot.

v.verdict: This is now an in-raid HUD, not the easy-mode modal I reviewed before, so the earlier advice can't be judged. As a HUD it is crowded and inconsistent: seven separate boxes with different fills, type sizes and corner anchors, and capitals on screen.

findings.what: The capture is a raid HUD (keyboard tag, controls list, party feed, hp, ammo). The easy-mode card ('want easy mode?' with y/n buttons) I scored last time is gone. This is a different screen, so the p2 title capture is still missing.
findings.fix: Re-capture the real p2 title/easy-mode screen under this filename, or rename the file. The earlier card advice still stands: 880x360 --ui-panel card on an 80% scrim, 64px yes/no buttons.

findings.where: Capitals: 'Item' in '1 Item left' (x 378-443, y 527), 'Info' in 'run Info' (x 1611-1665, y 33)
findings.what: Capital letters appear on screen. The owner ordered all lower case.
findings.fix: Lower-case both strings at the source ('1 item left', 'run info'). Search for any other title-casing helper in the draw path.

findings.what: The list is a tall fully open box, about 310x345. The owner's rule is one folded line, mid-bottom left, opened with F1. It covers the map and fights the left-side feed. The section labels (move/fight/gear/raid) are about 14px in --tx-2 and read as noise. The 'raid' column starts at a different y from 'move', so the columns are ragged.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 32px line at x 5%, y 1040-1072 reading 'f1 controls'. When opened, use 16px labels and a 2-column grid with equal row pitch of 24px, aligned to the same baseline per column.

findings.where: Left stack (x 8-367, y 143-260) and pillager tag (x 14-170, y 323-358)
findings.what: The value-at-risk box has 5 type sizes in 100px: a bold header, 14px muted rows and a dim 'dead' tag. The pillager bar below it is a different box style, with a bare 2px-bordered green bar and no panel padding. Each of these panels has its own fill, border and padding.
findings.fix: Put both in one --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Use 16px f-cond for rows. Keep numbers right-aligned in one tabular column. Make 'you $162' the single --tx-1 row and the rest --tx-2.

findings.what: The box is dark and wide with a chevron. It collides with the building wall behind it, and its text is smaller than the 'the long dock cache' label just below, which is purple and unboxed. Two unrelated styles sit in one corner.
findings.fix: Make the header 40px tall, 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1, on --ui-panel. Give the cache label a --ui-panel pill with a 3px bar in --r-elite instead of free-floating purple text.

findings.what: The label is a heavy 32px, drawn over a saturated flat green bar with a hard-clipped bottom edge. It is also the loudest element on the screen, louder than the ammo hero number. The bar's bottom runs flush against the screen edge, with no 5% margin.
findings.fix: Put the label at 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1 in a 24px-tall bar, with a 1px --ui-line border and a bottom margin of 32px. Use --ok at 85% for the fill. Leave the hero size to the ammo count.

findings.what: The slot numbers 3-8 and 0 float without slot frames, and ghost gun icons at 25% opacity add clutter. Only slots 1 and 2 have boxes. The selected slot uses an amber outline, which clashes with the lime selected colour.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72x72 frames with a 1px --ui-line border and no ghost icons. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc outline and the P1 amber on its number chip only.

findings.where: Ammo panel (x 1668-1910, y 902-1052), 'in pillager's party' toast (x 885-1035, y 893-929)
findings.what: The ammo panel is the right idea, with a hero 12 / 24, but its fill and radius differ from the other boxes, and 'b / i backpack' is about 14px. The toast floats mid-screen over the scenery with no obvious anchor and is a fourth panel style.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel with a 4px radius and 16px padding on every HUD box. Set the hint at 16px --tx-2. Move the toast into the top-centre alert slot or the left feed as the quiet-hud order says.

v.verdict: The title screen is a clean, centred column menu with a readable wordmark, but the error banner and its lime retry button compete with the focused row, the saves block is weak, and the orange gradient wordmark clashes with the lime accent.

findings.what: The red alert sits between the menu and the saves list, so it reads as a fifth menu row. Its filled lime 'retry' button (about 150x48) is the loudest object on screen and outshouts the focused '2 player arcade demo' row. The body copy is a two-line explaining sentence at about 15px.
findings.fix: Make 'retry' an outlined 40px button with a 1px --acc border and no fill, since the banner is not the primary action. Shorten the copy to one line, 'player 2 is in a raid in another window', at 16px in tx-1. Move the banner to y≈395, above the list, or set it 24px clear of the list with a 3px --danger left bar only.

findings.what: The orange-gold gradient wordmark with a drop shadow is a gradient wash that looks like rarity gold. It sits beside a lime accent and amber is reserved for P1, so it muddies the palette. It is also the only gradient on screen and reads as a template effect.
findings.fix: Use a flat --tx-1 wordmark at 800 weight, about 96px, with no gradient or shadow. If the orange stays, make it one flat --warn fill, and never beside lime. Put the tagline 16px below it, with 48px between tagline and list.

findings.what: All four rows are identical 56px boxes, with the primary route '1 player' no stronger than 'arcade demo'. The focus state is a faint 3px lime left edge plus a 1px lime border on a barely lighter fill. At couch distance it is hard to see, and the cursor sits on a demo mode, not the main action. The labels '2 player arcade demo' and '1 player arcade demo' are arcade wording and explaining text.
findings.fix: Fill the focused row with --ui-raised and add a 4px --acc left bar. Make the border 2px --acc and the text 22px, on a 64px row. Make '1 player' the default focus, and move the demos into a smaller secondary group 24px below, named 'demo'. Drop '(same machine)' to a 16px tx-2 sublabel.

findings.what: The block has three problems. The 'saves' label is about 15px tx-2 and low contrast. The 'pillager new' row also has a lime border and lime text, so it competes with the menu's lime focus; lime means selected only. The bottom row, with a name field and two buttons, looks like a debug form. The three controls have unequal widths and no shared rhythm.
findings.fix: Set the 'saves' label at 16px with +.04em tracking in tx-2 (≥4.5:1). Use the lime border on the saves row only when it has focus, otherwise --ui-line-hi. Make the field and buttons one 40px row on an 8px gap, with equal-width buttons and the name field set 16px in from the card edge. Put the whole block in a --ui-panel card with 16px padding.

findings.what: The 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' buttons are 14-15px bold text on outlined boxes with a different corner radius and border weight from the menu rows. They sit at a 33px top margin and a 97px right margin, which is not the 5% (96px) grid. They are visually cramped, with an 8px gap.
findings.fix: Use 16px f-cond 600 labels, 40px high, a 4px radius and 16px side padding. Align the right edge to x=1824 (96px margin) and the top to 48px, with a 16px gap. Use the same --ui-line-hi border as the menu rows.

findings.what: The legend is 15-16px tx-2 text with tiny key caps. 'wasd move / mouse aim / lmb fire / e search / f1 controls' explains the controls on the title screen, which is clutter. The caps are small, with 6px padding, and the legend is not aligned with the 96px margin.
findings.fix: Remove the first four entries from the title screen, since the raid controls list already shows them. Keep only 'f1 controls' at 16px, tx-2, 32px from the bottom. If kept, make the caps 24px tall with 8px padding and an 8px gap between pairs.

findings.what: The stamp 'v0.1222 · oct 28 2:50 pm et' is about 13px, dim, and at x97 is the only thing on the left. It is below the 14px fine-text floor and almost vanishes on the dark vignette.
findings.fix: Set it at 14px f-body 500 in --tx-2 (#aaa498), aligned to the same 96px left margin and the same baseline as the legend, y≈1040.

findings.what: The column is vertically centred around y≈550 with a large empty vignette, and the menu is not clearly tied to the wordmark. The 1px page-edge frame is the only chrome. Nothing shows the game's world, so identity is generic.
findings.fix: Add a low-opacity (15-20%) raid key art or an extract-silhouette scene behind the vignette, and drop the scrim to .80. Group wordmark, tagline and list as one block starting at y≈220, with 48px between wordmark and list.

v.verdict: The real p2 title screen now shows a clear lime primary button, but the controls hint strip is clipped by an overlapping toast, the title is a gradient-orange template wordmark, and the saves block and top-right buttons are loosely styled.

findings.where: Bottom hint strip and toast (x 726-1193, y 1004-1056)
findings.what: The 'in pillager's party' toast sits on top of the key-hint row, cutting the keycaps and the words 'mouse', 'aim', 'lmb', 'fire', 'e', 'search' in half. It is unreadable and reads as a bug.
findings.fix: Move the toast to y 940-976, or to the top-centre banner slot. Keep the hint row on one clear 32px line at y 1040-1072. Never let two elements share that band.

findings.what: A glossy orange gradient on a heavy face is the template look the guide bans (gradient washes). It is also the loudest thing on screen next to a lime button that is the main action, so boldness is not in one place and the orange fights the lime.
findings.fix: Fill the wordmark flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) at --fs-hero 56px, f-cond 800, with no gradient and no drop glow. Alternatively use flat --acc, with the button changing to a quiet outline.

findings.where: Saves list and name row (x 681-1239, y 615-735)
findings.what: The 'pillager new' save row has a 1px lime border plus lime text for selected, which is fine. But the three controls below it have different heights (40px) and styles, and the name box has no label. The saves label at 16px is dim and light, and all of this is about 15px type, below the 16px minimum.
findings.fix: Make every row 48px tall on an 8px gap, 20px f-cond 600 text, --ui-panel fill and 1px --ui-line-hi borders. Put 'saves' as a 16px --tx-2 label with 8px of space under it. Keep lime only on the selected row's border.

findings.what: It is a tiny, bold, grey caption jammed 12px under the main button. It reads as a label, not a mode choice, and neighbours the button too tightly.
findings.fix: Make it a 16px --tx-2 f-cond line with 16px of space above and 24px below, or make it a proper secondary button of the same width as the main action. Remove the bold weight.

findings.what: The two buttons use 14-15px text, sit at x 1823 instead of the 5% margin (x 1824 is close, but y 33 is not on the 8px grid), and have heavy white borders that outweigh the secondary content.
findings.fix: Use 48px tall buttons at y 40, right edge x 1824, 16px f-cond 600 text, and a --ui-line-hi border. Highlight only on focus.

findings.what: A teal outlined chip stuck to the top edge reads as a debug badge. Teal is reserved for extraction only.
findings.fix: Recolour it --tx-2 text with a --ui-line-hi border, 16px type, and move it to y 40 beside the top-right buttons. Or drop it, since the hint strip already names the device.

findings.what: The tagline is a thin, mid-grey 18px line with strong letterspacing, and sits 30px under the wordmark, so it looks loose.
findings.fix: Set it to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-2 at +.04em, with 16px between wordmark and tagline and 32px before the button.

findings.what: The stamp sits at x 97, off the 5% margin line (x 96 is close) and shares the baseline band with the hint strip. It is fine in size, but it competes with the clipped hints.
findings.fix: Align it to x 96, baseline y 1056, 14px --tx-2. Once the toast is moved this band is clean.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is readable and lower case, but too many differently styled boxes compete: the dropdowns, the player card, two toasts and a floating controls tag. Nothing is clearly the main element, and the contrast is weak in places.

findings.where: top-left and top-right dropdowns, x8-368 y142-172 and x1603-1901 y18-54
findings.what: 'current pillagers 0' and 'run info' are default-looking black bars with white chevrons. Their font is not the style guide's (the guide asks for f-cond 600 at 16px) and their widths are arbitrary, 360px and 298px. They look like debug UI and sit unaligned with the clock and the other HUD blocks. The label 'run info' also has a capital I.
findings.fix: Make both collapsible panels 40px high with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.
