Use 16px f-cond 600 at +.04em tracking in tx-1, equal widths of 240px, a 48px margin and a 16px chevron in tx-2. Change 'run info' to 'run info' in all lower case, and change 'current pillagers 0' to 'pillagers 0'.

findings.what: 'pillager is searching' is 22px and 'pillager joined' is 16px. They are different sizes, different fills and in different places, one on a wall and one floating mid-screen. The left toast sits on a wall and hides it. The 'pillager joined' line also contradicts the one-place rule: the left feed is the place for every non-alert line.
findings.fix: Put both in the left feed as one stack, starting at x48 and y=240. Use 16px f-cond 600, a 32px row height, a --ui-panel fill at 85% and a 3px left bar in the player colour. Delete the floating copy.

findings.where: player and name tags, x15-170 y323-358 and x417-465 y505-520
findings.what: The 'pillager' health card at the left has no context (no avatar or P1 marker) and floats alone mid-left. It is a different style from the other HUD boxes: a green bar, a blue-tinted name and a 1px border. The world tag 'pillager' is 12px, which is too small and fails the 16px minimum for anything read.
findings.fix: Dock the player card at x48, 56px below the pillagers panel, with the same panel style and a 3px amber (P1) bar. Raise the world tag to 16px and give it a 70% dark pill for contrast against the blue ground.

findings.what: The 'concealed' and 'in cover' pills use a dim amber and a dim teal on a dark fill, with a measured contrast of about 3:1. 'in cover' in particular nearly vanishes on the blue floor. The two round icons beside them say the same thing, so each state is drawn twice. The 'f1 controls' tag at x440-540 y930 floats unanchored beside them, which is clutter.
findings.fix: Keep only the icons, at 40px, each with a 3px label beneath in 16px tx-1, or only the text pills. Use a --ui-panel fill with tx-1 text and a 3px coloured left bar. Anchor 'f1 controls' on the line above the hotbar, centred at y=900, in 16px tx-2.

findings.what: The hp bar is a full-strength flat green slab with a text label that is crowded against the left end ('hp 100' at about 32px). It is the loudest colour block at the bottom of the screen and competes with the ammo number. It also sits 16px closer to the edge than the hotbar and has no border.
findings.fix: Make it a 12px-high bar, 320px wide, in --ok on a --ui-panel track, with a 1px border. Put 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 700 above the bar, aligned to x48 and the bottom margin of 48.

findings.what: Slot 1 has an amber border, while slots 3 and 5-0 are drawn as faint ghost icons with no frames. The numbering sits on different baselines (y968 and y1040). Slots 2 and 4 have no selected state beyond a darker fill. Weapon art on slot 4 is more saturated than on slot 1, so the strip looks uneven.
findings.fix: Use one slot size of 96x64 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap. Make selected a 2px --acc border, because the guide reserves lime for selected and the amber here contradicts it. Put the key number at the top-left at 14px and the ammo count at the bottom-right at 16px. Drop the empty slots to 30% opacity.

findings.what: The card has a 12/24 hero number at about 56px, which is correct, but the card sits 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, so its margins match nothing else. 'b / i backpack' at 14px tx-2 is under the 16px floor, and the key hints are in a different style from 'f1 controls'.
findings.fix: Align it to a 48px right and bottom margin. Raise the hint to 16px f-cond 600 at +.04em, and style it the same as 'f1 controls'. Keep the 56px 800-weight number in tx-1 with '/ 24' in tx-2 at 32px.

findings.what: The 14:59 clock and the 'extraction 387m' teal pill are stacked with a different font weight and size, with a small triangle marker hanging below the pill at y82. The sun icon sits right of the clock and is not centred on it, so the stack looks lopsided.
findings.fix: Centre the clock on x=960 at 32px f-cond 700. Put the icon in a 24px slot with a fixed 16px gap. Put 'extraction 387m' directly beneath at 16px in --extract on a --ui-panel pill, and fold the direction arrow into the pill's left end.

v.verdict: The toast collision and the 'player 2 window' line are gone and the menu is now a clean single column with one lime primary, but the amber gradient wordmark still clashes with the lime accent and the lower menu is a cramped stack of mismatched row types.

findings.what: The orange-amber gradient with a drop shadow is the only gradient on the screen. It reads as a template logo and sits beside a lime button, which breaks the guide's rule against putting amber and the accent side by side. It also reads as the P1 colour.
findings.fix: Fill the wordmark flat --tx-1 #efe9dc at 56px f-cond 800 with no gradient or shadow. Alternatively use flat --acc and make the button an outline. Keep a 32px gap to the tagline.

findings.what: Four full-width rows share one weight and size, and the three secondary rows read as equal to each other. 'arcade demo' items sit at the same level as 'co-op', so the list has no grouping. Row heights are inconsistent: 56px for the lime row, then 48px, 48px and 48px. The gaps are 8px, which makes the stack dense.
findings.fix: Make all rows 48px high, or give only the lime row 56px. Put the two demos below a 24px gap and a 16px --tx-2 'demos' label, or move them into a quieter 16px row. Order the rows by importance and keep the 8px gap within a group.

findings.what: The 'pillager new' row is 42px high with a lime 1px border and lime text. It is the only row there, so it looks like a focused control when it is not. The row below holds three controls of unequal widths at 40px. Heights of 56, 48, 42 and 40 across one column look uneven. The 'saves' label is small and dim, around 14px at about 4:1.
findings.fix: Use 48px rows with 8px gaps for every row in the saves block. Reserve lime for the focused row only. Make 'saves' 16px --tx-2 f-cond 600 with 8px under it. Make the name field, 'change name' and 'create a new save' all 48px high. Label the name input 'name' at 16px.

findings.what: The key caps are bold bright-outlined boxes of about 14px text, and they outweigh their muted 16px labels. The strip is separate from the menu and sits about 225px below it, so it floats. Key-cap text is too small to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Set the key caps to 16px f-cond 600 with a --ui-line-hi border and --tx-1 text. Set the labels to 16px --tx-2. Use a 24px gap between pairs and keep the strip at y 1040-1072.

findings.what: The buttons are about 48px high with 16px bold text and bright borders. They are fine, but they weigh almost as much as the secondary menu rows. The right edge sits at x 1823 and the top at y 33, which is off the 8px grid and the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Set the top margin to y 40 and the right edge to x 1824. Give the buttons a --ui-line border and --tx-2 text, and go to --tx-1 with a --ui-line-hi border only on focus.

findings.what: 'ascend. pillage. extract.' is about 18px --tx-2 with wide tracking and sits 32px under the wordmark. The size is off the 16/20 scale, and it is too close to the lime button at about 25px.
findings.fix: Use 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Leave 16px under the wordmark and 32px above the first button.

findings.what: The stamp is bold and condensed at about 13px in --tx-2. The guide wants --fs-fine in f-body 500. It is also left-inset at x 97, which matches no margin, and it sits on the same baseline as the hint strip, so it looks like part of that row.
findings.fix: Use 14px f-body 500 --tx-2. Align the left edge to x 96, the 5% margin, and the baseline to y 1056 so the left and centre rows line up.

findings.what: The radial vignette is nearly flat black with almost no identity. There is no key art or ground texture, so the screen has no ARC Raiders or Zero Sievert feel.
findings.fix: Add a low-contrast 10-15% opacity map or ground texture behind the title at --ui-void. Keep it away from the text column.

v.verdict: The HUD is much calmer than before, with the left clutter and floating toasts gone and a clear ammo block, but the team score panel overlaps the extract chip, the bars sit on busy ground, and the hotbar, goals dropdown and keyboard tag don't share one panel style.

findings.where: team score panel, x826-1094 y111-214, with the extract chip at x888-1032 y225-257
findings.what: The 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' text runs past the panel's right edge at x1094, and 'p2 0 sp' touches the border. The 0 sp hero line, the two small lines and the label sit at different baselines and weights. The extract chip is jammed 11px under the panel and uses teal in a different pill style.
findings.fix: Widen the panel to 320px with 16px inner padding. Lay it out as a left column with 'team score' at 16px tx-2 above '0 sp' at 56px f-cond 800. Put 'you' and 'p2' in a right column, 16px aligned to one baseline each, with a 3px amber bar on the you row and a cyan bar on the p2 row. Leave 16px between the panel and the extract chip, and draw the chip in the same --ui-panel fill with a 3px --extract left bar.

findings.where: bottom-left hp and armour bars, x24-430 y965-1067
findings.what: Both are loose bars sitting on the busy wall and ground with no panel behind them. 'armour 60' (blue) and 'hp 100' (green) are drawn at different text sizes and in different treatments. The hp label is bigger than the armour label and is the only one with a heavy outline. The bars start at x24, not on the 48 margin used elsewhere, and the bottom edge sits at y1067, only 13px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Dock one 320x72 --ui-panel block at x48, with its bottom at y1032. Put hp on top as a 16px bar, and armour below as a 10px bar. Use 16px f-cond 600 labels in tx-1 on the left and numbers on the right, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Leave 8px between the two bars.

findings.where: hotbar, x0-1610 y935-1060, and its slot numbers 1-8 and 0
findings.what: The slot numbers are 16px tx-2 text in the wall texture, low contrast, with a rule line running through them. Only slots 4 and 6 hold weapons, so the bar reads as mostly empty floating digits. The lime-bordered selected slot is the only focus cue, and the two filled slots are 100px wide while the empty ones have no box at all.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 96x96 --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and the number at 16px in the top-left corner. Centre the row at x960 with 8px gaps, and keep a 2px --acc border only on the active slot. Remove the horizontal rule behind the numbers.

findings.where: top-right goals dropdown, x1603-1901 y22-64, and the 'keyboard' tag at x10-105 y8-31
findings.what: The goals panel has a 4px radius, a 1px border and a chevron, but it is 298px wide and sits at x1603-1901, so its right margin is 19px and its top is 22px. The 'keyboard' tag at top-left uses a different green-tinted pill, 16px, 10px from the corner. The two corner elements don't match each other or the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Set both to a 40px height and a 240px width (the keyboard tag can be auto width) with 48px margins. Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, with a 16px tx-2 chevron. Remove the green tint from the keyboard tag, or keep it only as a 3px left bar in the player colour.

findings.what: The block is strong, with a 56px-class '7 / 42' hero number, but it hugs the right edge (10px) and sits on the bottom wall at y1017 without lining up with the hp block. The weapon name is in a 28px style that competes with the number. '/ 42' is the same colour and nearly the same weight as the loaded count.
findings.fix: Set the block's right edge to x1872 (48px margin) and its bottom to y1032 to match the hp block. Make the weapon name 20px f-cond 600 tx-2, the loaded count 56px 800 tx-1, and '/ 42' 32px 600 tx-2.

findings.what: It floats at the left end of the hotbar, 35px above the hp bar, in a flat dark pill that differs from every other panel. It looks accidental next to the hotbar, and the 'f1' is not set apart from 'controls' by the same key-cap style used for 'f' on the weapon slot.
findings.fix: Move it to x48, y 900, as a 28px high key-cap pill: 'f1' inside a 1px --ui-line-hi box in tx-1, with 'controls' at 16px tx-2 beside it, no fill behind the text.

findings.where: timer and weather icon, x887-1065 y18-103
findings.what: The 9:37 timer is a strong hero at the top centre, but the weather icon is a separate round button at 40px with a different blue and no label, floating 12px to the right. The timer plate is a harder black than the other panels.
findings.fix: Put the weather icon inside the timer plate, 24px, at the right, in tx-2. Match the plate fill to --ui-panel and use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

v.verdict: The team score panel is gone and the quiet-HUD rules are mostly followed, but the HUD blocks still don't line up: hp, hotbar, ammo and the two dropdowns each use different margins, heights and panel styles.

findings.what: The hp bar is a bare green slab with 'hp 100' at about 32px. It touches the bottom edge, has no panel, no border and no armour row. It sits at a different margin from the ammo block and the hotbar.
findings.fix: Put it in a 320x56 --ui-panel block at x48 with its bottom at y1032. Draw the bar 16px tall inside 8px padding, with the 'hp' label at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 and '100' at 20px tx-1 on the right. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use --ok for the fill.

findings.where: hotbar, x553-1540 y955-1060, and the slots 3, 5-8, 0
findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are boxes of different widths and sizes. Slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are floating numbers with faint weapon ghosts and no box. The row looks half built, and the number labels are barely legible at about 14px.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 96x96 --ui-panel boxes with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 8px gaps, and 16px tx-2 numbers in the top-left. Leave empty slots at 40% opacity. Keep the 2px --acc border only on the active slot (the lime one is correct). Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032.

findings.what: The block's right edge is at about x1910, a 10px margin, and its bottom is at y1052. This does not match the 48px margins elsewhere. The '/ 24' is nearly as large as the 12, so the hero number does not stand out. 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and nearly unreadable.
findings.fix: Move the right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y1032. Set the weapon name to 20px tx-2, '12' to 56px 800 tx-1, and '/ 24' to 32px 600 tx-2. Make the hint 16px tx-2. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: 'current pillagers 0' dropdown x8-367 y142-171, 'run info' dropdown x1603-1901 y22-64, and the 'keyboard' tag x10-105 y8-31
findings.what: The three top chips use three widths (359, 298 and 95), three heights (29, 42 and 23) and three margins. 'current pillagers 0' is a debug-looking bar that needs no chevron. Neither dropdown has a fixed width. The 'keyboard' tag has a green tint that matches nothing else.
findings.fix: Make all three 40px tall with a 48px left or right margin and --ui-panel fill. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text. Give both dropdowns a 240px width and a 16px tx-2 chevron. Align 'current pillagers' with the 'keyboard' tag at y48, or drop it from the always-on view. Use a neutral fill for 'keyboard' with a 3px amber left bar.

findings.what: The tag has a heavy dark box and a green bar, and its blue name text is a different colour from every other label. It sits at an arbitrary position at the left edge of the screen with no clear relation to the hp bar.
findings.fix: Give it the same --ui-panel treatment at 320px wide, x48. Put it directly above the hp block at y960, with the name in 16px tx-1. If it is a teammate row, add a 3px cyan left bar for P2. Otherwise remove it, because the hp block already shows the player.

findings.what: The 'concealed' and 'in cover' chips are low-contrast: tx-2 on dark with a dim border, and 'in cover' is cut off at x330 by the crate. The two round icons beside them add clutter.
findings.fix: Give the chips a --ui-panel fill, 16px tx-1 text and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Remove the 'in cover' overlap by placing the chips at y900, above the hp block. Keep one icon per state at 24px, or drop the icons.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' x14-410 y775-803
findings.what: This is an explaining sentence, which the owner treats as a defect. It overlaps the bottom building's wall, and its amber bar and about 20px text mix two weights in one line. It sits at x14, off the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' with a 3px --warn bar, 16px type, and left edge x48. Drop the 'gold glow marks the box' part. Move it above the status chips so it never overlaps the wall.

findings.where: 'pillager is searching' x284-479 y637-669 and 'pillager joined' x895-1025 y893-929
findings.what: The two toasts use different box styles and sizes: 24px text on a rounded dark box against 16px text on a squared box. They also sit at different places. Under the one-place rule, the joined line is a feed line and belongs in the left feed. The searching line is a world-anchored status.
findings.fix: Move 'pillager joined' to the left feed at x48 and give it the same 16px --ui-panel row as the other feed lines. Use one toast style, 16px tx-1 with a 4px radius, for both. Keep the searching label only if it anchors to the player in the world.

v.verdict: The top-centre timer, score and extraction block reads well, but the earlier advice was mostly ignored: the hp and armour bars are still bare, the hotbar slots are still unboxed, and the ammo block, goals dropdown and keyboard tag are still inconsistent.

findings.where: bottom-left hp and armour bars, x24-430 y965-1068
findings.what: These are still bare bars on the map. The 'hp 100' text is oversized, in a different font from the other labels, and set on a green fill. The armour bar sits right under the 'f1 controls' chip, and its blue tone is not in the palette. The bars have no panel, border or padding, and they touch the screen edge at 24px.
findings.fix: Put both in one 320x72 --ui-panel block at x48, with its bottom at y1032, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Inside, use two 12px bars with 8px padding. Put 'hp' and 'armour' in 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 and the numbers in 20px tx-1, right-aligned. Make the hp fill --ok. Make the armour fill a desaturated tx-2 grey, or --extract if you want a second colour.

findings.what: Only slots 2 and 4 are drawn as tiles. Slots 1, 3, 5-8 and 0 are just floating digits over the map, so the row looks broken. The active slot's amber border is correct but the slot is only ~100px wide and sits far left of centre. Because the row is unevenly spaced and has no panel fill, its legibility depends on the map behind it.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 96x96 --ui-panel boxes with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps, with the 16px tx-2 number in the top-left corner. Show empty slots at 40% opacity. Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032. Keep the 2px accent border on the active slot only.

findings.what: This chip floats in the middle of the map, directly above the armour bar and left of the hotbar. It has a different fill and radius from every other element and is only 29px tall. It collides visually with the armour bar below it. The owner placed the controls hint mid-bottom left, but it should be a deliberate part of the HUD, not a stray tag.
findings.fix: Make it a 40px high --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put an 'f1' key cap in --ui-raised and 'controls' in 16px tx-2. Anchor it at x48, with its bottom at y928, directly above the hp block. Leave a 16px gap.

findings.what: The block is clipped almost to the right edge (10px margin), its bottom is at y1017 where the bar blocks end at y1068, and it has no border. '30 / 180' is good as the hero number, but the gun icon is almost invisible and the weapon name is right-aligned with no hint of the reload or the key. Margins differ from every other element.
findings.fix: Set the right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y1032, to match the hp block. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius and 16px padding. Make the weapon name 20px tx-2, '30' 56px 800 tx-1 and '/ 180' 32px 600 tx-2. Raise the icon to 50% opacity or remove it.

findings.where: 'goals 0/3' dropdown x1603-1901 y22-64 and 'keyboard' tag x10-105 y8-31
findings.what: The goals dropdown is a 42px bar with a 14px margin from the right edge, and its text is bigger than the keyboard tag. The 'keyboard' tag is a 10px-margin green-on-dark chip that looks like a debug label. The two do not share a margin or height. The pale chevron is fine, but the dropdown's text is 20px against 16px elsewhere.
findings.fix: Make both 40px tall at y48, with 48px margins left and right. Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text. Keep the dropdown 240px wide with a 16px tx-2 chevron. Make 'keyboard' neutral with a 3px amber left bar, so amber means P1 as the owner decided.

findings.where: 'player 2' teammate tag, x14-170 y322-358, and the world tags 'player 2' x1760-1818 and '1 item left' x1617-1721
findings.what: The off-screen teammate tag is drawn in blue on a flat bar with a green and cyan double stripe. It is a third style of label next to the world tags, and the cyan P2 colour is used with a green health line, which muddies the player colours. The '1 item left' tag is amber, while amber is meant for P1. The world labels 'shield' and 'player 2' are 11-14px and very small.
findings.fix: Draw the edge tag as a 160x40 --ui-panel chip with a 3px cyan left bar (P2), 16px tx-1 name and a 4px-tall --ok hp line under the text. Use --warn for '1 item left' instead of amber. Raise world labels to 16px with a --scrim backing.

findings.what: The timer, the score panel and the extraction chip are three separate boxes, each with a different width (148, 268 and 172px) and a 4-8px gap, so they read as stacked stickers. 'you 0 sp' and 'p2 0 sp' are about 18px and sit tight against the right border (about 12px). The compass icon on the right of the timer is a lone 40px disc.
findings.fix: Join them into one 268px column, centred on x960, with 8px gaps and the same --ui-panel fill, 1px border and 4px radius. Give the score panel 16px padding all round and use 16px tx-2 for 'you' and 'p2'. Move the disc to the right of the column at 48px, or drop it.

findings.what: The map's orange and purple wash is busy, and the HUD elements that have no panel (digits 1, 3, 5-8, 0, the hp bar edges, 'f1 controls') have low contrast against it. The numbers 5-8 are about 40% contrast on the purple.
findings.fix: Put every HUD element on an opaque --ui-panel at 85% or more. Add a bottom vignette of rgba(6,7,8,.5) over the lowest 160px. Keep slot numbers at 16px tx-2, at least 4.5:1.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen reviewed before. It has a clear ammo block and hotbar, but the corners hold a scatter of unrelated chips and dropdowns, the timer is weak, a capital letter shows on screen, and the same state is drawn twice.

findings.where: '1 Item left' chip over the player (x 377-453, y 516-540)
findings.what: The text has a capital 'I', which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The amber chip also covers the 'pillager' nameplate right above it, so the name is half hidden.
findings.fix: Change the text to '1 item left'. Move the chip 8px above the nameplate, or drop the nameplate while the chip shows. Use 16px f-cond 600 in --warn on --ui-panel.

findings.where: 'pillager is searching' (x 344-540, y 637-669) and '1 item left'
findings.what: The same search state is drawn twice, as a world chip and as a 20px+ text bar. That is a clutter defect, and it breaks the one-place-per-line rule: every raid line shows in one place. The bar also sits on the wall tile at a different size from the other chips.
findings.fix: Keep only the left-feed line, or only the in-world chip. Delete the other. If a chip stays, make it 16px f-cond 600 with a 4px radius and an 8px/16px padding.

findings.where: Timer (x 927-992, y 12-42) and extraction chip (x 892-1027, y 48-74)
findings.what: The clock is about 30px, the same weight as the labels, so the screen has no hero. It also sits 4px from the extraction chip. The teal chip is a heavy boxed bar for a secondary fact.
findings.fix: Make the clock 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 with a 16px gap below. Drop the chip's fill and show 'extraction 381m' as 16px --extract text with a 4px radius only if it needs a pill. Keep one --fs-hero use for the ammo number.

findings.where: Left and right corner dropdowns: 'current pillagers 0' (x 8-367, y 142-171), 'run info' (x 1604-1900, y 20-54), 'keyboard' tag (x 10-105, y 6-32)
findings.what: Three different panel sizes and edges: 359px wide, 296px wide, and a green-outlined tag. The margins are 8px, 20px and 10px. The chevrons read as web form controls, not game HUD. 'current pillagers 0' also shows an empty state as a full-width bar.
findings.fix: Use one panel style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 40px high). Put all of them on a 24px margin. Cut 'current pillagers' to about 200px wide, or hide it at 0. Fold 'keyboard' into the f1 hint, and use 16px --tx-2 for the labels.

findings.what: The faded weapon silhouettes at 0.15 contrast are floating art with no slot frames. The numbers 3-0 sit at different heights from the filled slots 1-2. The row looks unfinished and noisy, and the numerals fall below 4.5:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 112x112 --ui-panel boxes with a 1px --ui-line border at an 8px gap, or show only the filled slots. Make the numerals 16px --tx-2. Drop the silhouettes to 8% opacity inside the frames.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' (x 884-1036, y 893-929) and 'f1 controls' (x 435-537, y 929-953)
findings.what: The party chip floats in the middle of the play area with no anchor and is not aligned to any grid. The controls hint is 16px dim text on a busy teal floor and sits 8px from the hotbar edge at a different baseline.
findings.fix: Anchor the party chip to the left feed at x 24, or remove it. Give the f1 hint a --ui-panel fill, 16px --tx-1 text and a 24px left margin aligned with the hp bar at x 24.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is drawn at about 32px straight onto the green fill with its glyph tops clipped, at 6px from the screen bottom. It is tight and low in contrast (cream on mid-green).
findings.fix: Lift the bar to y 1008-1040 (24px bottom margin), make it 28px high, and use 20px f-cond 700 --acc-ink text, or put the number outside the bar in --tx-1. Add a --ui-line-hi 1px border.

findings.what: The panel is the strongest part of the screen, but its right edge is 10px from the screen edge, not the 24px used elsewhere. 'b / i backpack' is 14px, below the 16px reading minimum.
findings.fix: Set the right and bottom margins to 24px. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number.

v.verdict: The earlier clutter around the player is gone, but the 'want easy mode?' modal is an unframed, scrimless slab that overlaps the team score and extraction chips, and the HUD around it still uses four different panel styles.

findings.what: The modal has no scrim, no border and no radius, so it blends into the map. It sits on top of the 'extraction 171m' chip (y 225-257) and the bottom of the team-score panel. The lime bar at its top-left (x 493-562, y 261) is a stray sliver. The 11 countdown is 16px grey in the corner with no label.
findings.fix: Put an 80% scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)) behind the modal. Give it a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Centre it vertically at y 540 and keep it 48px clear of the HUD. Delete the lime sliver. Draw the countdown as a 4px progress bar along the bottom edge, or as a 32px --acc number.

findings.what: Yes is a huge flat lime slab, so the primary action is visually louder than the title. Its label is only about 24px. The no button is a nearly invisible 1px outline. The 'y' and 'n' key hints are the same weight as the word, so they read as typos. The title sits at the top left with a 100px dead gap before the buttons.
findings.fix: Make the buttons 56px high and 360px wide, with a 16px gap. Use 20px f-cond 700 labels. Draw the key hint as a 16px --tx-2 chip, separate from the label. Give no a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-raised fill. Use a 4px radius on both. Reduce the gap between title and buttons to 32px. Make the title 32px and align its left edge with the buttons at x 539.

findings.what: The clock (x 887-1033), the weather icon, the team-score panel (x 826-1094) and the extraction chip are three different widths. The chip is not centred under the score. 'you 0 sp' and 'p1 0 sp' are 18px and crowd the 0 sp number. This is about 240px of stacked boxes in the top centre.
findings.fix: Make one column 240px wide with 8px gaps. Put the clock at 32px, the score row at 20px with a single 56px hero number, and the extraction chip at the same 240px width. Move the 'you' and 'p1' split into a 16px --tx-2 line under the hero number. Move the weather icon out to the left edge of the clock panel.

findings.where: Corner and status panels (keyboard x 10-105 y 6-32; goals 0/3 x 1603-1900 y 22-64; ammo x 1606-1910 y 868-1017; 'in pillager's party' x 885-1036 y 893-929)
findings.what: Four panel styles are in play. Keyboard is a green-bordered chip, goals is a rounded dropdown with a chevron, ammo is a large panel, and the party tag is a 12px label. The party tag is unreadable and floats over the hotbar. The margins differ: 10px, 20px and 10px.
findings.fix: Use one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Put everything on a 24px margin. Make the party tag 16px --tx-2 and move it to the left feed, or delete it. Fold 'keyboard' into the f1 controls chip. Keep ammo as the one hero panel.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are only ghost numerals over silhouettes with no frames, and the strip is cut off by the bottom edge. The numerals are about 14px and low in contrast. Only slots 3 and 5 are filled, so the bar reads as scattered noise. The selected slot's amber frame also clashes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72x72 --ui-panel boxes with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Lift the whole bar to y 960-1032, leaving a 48px bottom margin. Make the numerals 16px --tx-2. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border. Drop the silhouettes to 8% opacity.

findings.what: The 'concealed' and 'in cover' pills are about 32px bold amber and green text, louder than the armour and hp numbers, and they sit on top of the f1 controls tag. They are two different pill fills. The armour (x 24-430, y 965-987) and hp bars are thin and have different heights. The 'hp 100' text is not aligned with the 'armour 60' text.
findings.fix: Make the pills 16px f-cond 600 on one --ui-panel style with a 4px radius, and put them 8px apart. Move f1 controls to its own row 16px lower. Make the armour and hp bars 20px high with 4px gaps, with their labels left-aligned at x 32 in 16px.

findings.what: The 'player 1' tag is cramped, sitting right against the wall and the red barrels. The blue text on a dark panel with a double bar reads as a debug label. The name uses 20px, but the bar is only 6px high.
findings.fix: Use 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 with an amber (P1) 3px underline. Put 8px padding on a --ui-panel fill, and make the bar 8px high with the hp colour only.

v.verdict: The easy-mode modal that blocked the last version is gone, but the HUD is still a pile of mismatched panels with an unreadable hotbar and no clear focal point.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 5 are drawn as boxes. The other eight are bare numerals floating on the map, and the faint weapon silhouettes clash with the wall art. The bar is also at the bottom edge with no margin, so the 360 counts sit about 25px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72x72 --ui-panel boxes with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Lift the bar to y 960-1032 for a 48px bottom margin. Make the numerals 16px --tx-2, mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border, and drop the silhouettes to 8% opacity.

findings.what: Four stacked boxes of different widths (clock 148, score 268, extraction 160) with a floating weather icon. The score panel has three type sizes, and the 'you 0 sp / p1 0 sp' lines are crammed against the right edge. A dark grid shape shows through behind the '0 sp'. The map label 'packing floor' sits right under the cluster with no space.
findings.fix: Make one 240px column with 8px gaps. Set the clock to 32px and the extraction chip to 240px wide. Keep a single 56px hero 0 sp. Put you/p1 on one 16px --tx-2 line under it. Give the panel an opaque --ui-panel fill. Move the weather icon to the left edge of the clock panel and move the area label at least 24px below the chip.

findings.where: Panel styles across the HUD (goals x 1603-1900, ammo x 1606-1910, party tag x 885-1036, keyboard chip x 10-105, controls chip x 410-536, name card x 14-170)
findings.what: Six panel treatments: different fills, radii and borders, with no shared margin. The 'keyboard' chip uses a green-tinted mono face that no other element uses. The goals dropdown has a heavier border than its neighbours. The 'in pillager's party' tag is a floating black rectangle with 14px text, which is small for a couch.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius everywhere, on a 24px screen margin. Make the party tag 16px --tx-2 and move it to the left feed, or remove it. Fold 'keyboard' into the f1 controls chip and use f-cond for it.

findings.where: Player 1 name/health card (x 14-170, y 322-358) and world tags ('1 item left' x 310-412 y 507-535, 'player 1 is searching' x 268-514 y 633-673)
findings.what: The name card is a tiny, dim 20px label with two stacked thin bars and no panel. It floats alone at the left edge, far from the hp and armour bars. The '1 item left' tag overlaps the 'player 1' name tag, so the text collides at y 510. The yellow-on-black tag and the large white 'searching' pill use different sizes and fills.
findings.fix: Either remove the left name card or merge it into the hp/armour block at x 24 and y 960. Offset the world name tag 16px above the '1 item left' tag so they never overlap. Make both tags 16px f-cond on --ui-panel with a 4px radius.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is about 32px and sits in a flat green bar, while 'armour 60' is 20px in a light blue bar. The bars are different heights, tightly stacked and only 12px from the bottom edge. The green and light-blue fills are bright and flat, and they fight the lime accent and the hotbar. The hp readout is bigger than the ammo hero number's label, so the hierarchy is muddy.
findings.fix: Make both bars 12px high on a --ui-panel track with 16px --tx-1 labels, 8px apart, inside a 24px margin (bottom at y 1032). Use --ok for hp and a desaturated blue for armour. Show the value at 20px, right-aligned in the bar. Keep one hero number, the ammo.

findings.what: This is the right focal point, but 60 / 360 is two sizes with no 56px hero rule, and 'support mg' is 28px and floats top-right. The panel sits 10px from the right edge and 63px from the bottom, so it doesn't align with the 24px margin or with the hotbar baseline.
findings.fix: Set 'support mg' to 16px --tx-2 left-aligned. Set 60 to 56px f-cond 800 --tx-1 and / 360 to 20px --tx-2. Inset the panel 24px from the right and bottom (x 1576-1896, bottom y 1032), aligned with the hotbar.

findings.what: A collapsed 'goals 0/3' with a chevron at the top right is a 297px-wide bar for almost no information. It is cut tight against the right-hand map walls, and it ignores the vertical 1-by-1 top-right list the owner ordered (cw-trcol).
findings.fix: Shrink it to 200px wide with a 24px margin from the top and right edges. Use a 16px label and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep the corner free for the cw-trcol list.

findings.where: Extraction chip and compass arrow (x 880-1040, y 224-290)
findings.what: The teal 'extraction 111m' chip is 20px text on a panel, which is fine, but the teal arrow hangs loose under it. The chip overlaps the bottom of the score panel by about 8px.
findings.fix: Put the arrow inside the chip, left of the text. Leave an 8px gap under the score panel, and make the chip the same 240px width as the column above it.

v.verdict: The ammo panel and the hotbar's active slot now read well, but the HUD still scatters about ten small elements at inconsistent edges, sizes and fills, so it looks assembled rather than designed.

findings.what: The hp bar is a bare green fill that sits on the bottom edge, only 12px from the screen edge, and the 'hp 100' text sits on the fill in a heavy font. It has no panel, border or label hierarchy, and it does not align with the ammo panel, which ends at y1050.
findings.fix: Put the hp bar in a 320x56 --ui-panel block at x48 with its bottom at y1032 and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 12px --ok bar, a 16px tx-2 'hp' label and a 20px tx-1 number right-aligned. Share the y1032 baseline with the ammo panel and the hotbar.

findings.what: Only slots 1, 2 and 4 are real tiles. Slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are floating faint weapon silhouettes with bare numerals and no tile, so the row looks broken and uneven. The tiles run to y1060, which is 20px from the bottom edge, and the row does not line up with the hp bar or the ammo panel.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 80x80 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Show empty slots at 40% opacity with the number at the top-left in 16px tx-2. Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032. Keep the lime border on the active slot only.

findings.where: top-left stack: 'keyboard' x10-105 y5-32, 'current pillagers 0' x8-367 y142-171, pillager bar x13-170 y323-358
findings.what: Three unrelated elements sit at different x offsets (8, 10, 13) and at random y positions. The 'current pillagers 0' dropdown is a wide 360px bar with tiny text, a big chevron and an empty value. The 'keyboard' tag is in green rather than a neutral colour. Together they read as debug widgets.
findings.fix: Put them in one column at x48. Start at y48 with the 'keyboard' tag at 32px high, then the 240px 'current pillagers' dropdown at a 16px gap, then the pillager card at a 16px gap. All three use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text. Colour 'keyboard' tx-2 with a 3px amber left bar for P1.

findings.what: The dropdown is black with a hard chevron, its left edge is at x1603 and it is 19px from the right edge. It has no relationship to the other top elements and its text is smaller than the 16px label minimum. The old 'goals' label is lost.
findings.fix: Make it 240px wide and 40px tall, with its right edge at x1872 and its top at y48. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, and a 16px tx-2 chevron. Put 'goals 0/3' back as a right-aligned tx-2 value.

findings.where: status chips x24-330 y943-978 plus 'f1 controls' x435-538 y929-952
findings.what: The 'concealed' and 'in cover' chips use 22px amber and teal display text on dark pills, which is heavier than the hp number and competes with it. Two round icons sit beside the chips and repeat what the chips say. 'f1 controls' is a tiny chip floating 280px away from them, with a dim label that is hard to read over the blue floor.
findings.fix: Drop the two round icons, because the chips already say it. Set the chips to 16px f-cond 600 with a 3px state-colour left bar. Stack them directly above the hp block at x48, 8px apart. Move 'f1 controls' to x48 in the same row, 40px high with an --ui-raised key cap, and anchor it at least 16px above the hp block.

findings.what: The banner is a long amber-barred strip that spreads two ideas and a '·' separator across 400px. The explanatory second half ('gold glow marks the box') is an explaining sentence. The strip sits tight against the left edge at x14 and floats with no relation to the other left-side items.
findings.fix: Cut the text to 'contract item nearby'. Use a 40px chip at x48 with a 3px --warn left bar, a --ui-panel fill and 16px tx-1 text. Place it in the same left column, 16px above the status chips.

findings.where: toast 'pillager joined' x895-1025 y893-930 and the top-centre timer 'extraction 387m' x892-1030 y47-73
findings.what: The toast sits on top of the hotbar's top edge at y893-930, only 25px above slot 2, and floats alone. The extraction chip is teal on dark, which is fine, but it hugs the clock with a gap of only 6px, and the little compass arrow under it is clipped.
findings.fix: Move the toast to the top-centre banner position at y120 so it does not crowd the hotbar. Leave a 16px gap under the clock before the extraction chip, and set the chip to 16px f-cond 600 with a 28px height. Drop the arrow or put it inside the chip.

findings.what: The panel is the best-structured HUD element: the 12 is a clear hero, and 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' sit in a reasonable hierarchy. The right edge is only 10px from the screen edge, though, and the panel is not aligned with the other HUD edges. 'b / i backpack' at 14px is below the 16px minimum for text a player reads.
findings.fix: Move the right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y1032 so it shares the 48px margin and the baseline with the hp block and the hotbar. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number.

v.verdict: The screen is calm and readable, with one clear lime action, but the orange gradient logo clashes with the lime accent, and the type is small and inconsistent. The lower half is a loose stack of tiny, unevenly styled controls.

findings.what: The orange-to-amber gradient wordmark has a drop shadow. It competes with the lime button and with warn amber, and the guide bans gradient washes and says amber must not sit next to the accent. Two hot colours fight for first read.
findings.fix: Make the logo flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) at 800 weight, with no gradient or shadow. Or keep it as art and take the lime button down a step. Give one element the heat.

findings.what: The 'saves' label is about 15px, light weight and muted. The save row, the name field, 'change name' and 'create a new save' are three different heights, borders and weights. The lime border and lime text on 'pillager new' reads as a second primary action under the main button.
findings.fix: Use one row height of 56px with an 8px gap and a 4px radius on --ui-panel. Set 'saves' to 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Mark the selected save with a 2px lime left bar and --tx-1 text, not lime text.

findings.what: A tiny grey label sits directly under the button with no clear role. It looks like a caption or a link, and it is below 16px.
findings.fix: If it is an action, make it a 48px secondary button, 20px, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, placed 16px below the primary. If it is only a status, remove it.

findings.where: Top-centre 'keyboard' chip (x 912-1007, y 7-31) and top-right buttons (x 1611-1823, y 33-81)
findings.what: The chip hugs the top edge at 7px and uses a green outline that matches no token. The buttons sit at a different margin from the chip and the version stamp. 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' have text about 15px, tight inside the boxes, and heavy white borders.
findings.fix: Move the chip and buttons onto a 48px top margin. Give them 56px of height, 20px text, 16px side padding and a --ui-line-hi border. Draw the chip in --tx-2 and --ui-line, not green.

findings.what: The hints are 16px muted labels with white key caps. They are fine as a legend but sit 25px from the bottom, not aligned to the 5% margin that the version stamp (x 97) uses. The stamp is about 13px, below the 14px fine-print floor.
findings.fix: Put the legend and the version stamp on one 48px bottom margin. Set the stamp to 14px f-body 500 --tx-2, with its left edge on the same 96px margin as the other items.

findings.what: The tagline is about 18px grey with wide tracking and sits 30px under the logo. It is off the 20px body size and low in contrast.
findings.fix: Set it to 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 with +.04em tracking, 16px below the logo and 24px above the button.

findings.what: The column is 558px wide and sits in a large empty vignette. The logo is the only identity. There is no key art or background, so it feels like a generic template next to ARC Raiders or Destiny menus.
findings.fix: Add a low-contrast raid scene or silhouette art behind the column at 20-30% opacity. Keep the column on a --ui-panel card with a 24px padding.

v.verdict: The core raid hud is readable, with a clear timer, ammo and score. The corners still don't share a margin or panel language, and the hotbar and bars are loose, so it still reads as unfinished.

findings.what: Only slots 2 and 4 are drawn as tiles. Slots 1, 3 and 5-0 are bare floating numbers with faint ghost icons over busy ground, so the row has no frame. The lime-bordered active slot is also amber-looking and sits on the same baseline as nothing else.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 80x80 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Dim empty slots to 40% and put the number at the top-left in 16px tx-2. Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032. The active slot gets a 2px --acc border, not amber.

findings.where: hp and armour bars x24-430 y965-1068
findings.what: Both bars are bare fills with no panel, border or track, glued to the screen edge at x24. The 'hp 100' number is a different size from 'armour 60' and sits flush against the bottom edge. They don't line up with the hotbar or the ammo panel.
findings.fix: Put the pair in one 320x72 --ui-panel block at x48 with its bottom at y1032 and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 12px bars on a --ui-line track (--ok for hp, #3f9de9 for armour). Use 16px tx-2 labels and 20px tx-1 numbers right-aligned, both the same size. Keep an 8px gap between the rows.

findings.where: corner margins and panel style: keyboard tag x10-105 y5-32, run info dropdown x1603-1901 y18-54, ammo x1605-1910 y868-1017, timer x887-1033 y18-102
findings.what: Every element sits at a different inset: 10px, 18px, 24px and 10px. The panels have different corner radii and opacity, and the 'goals 0/3' dropdown is a near-black strip with no border. 'keyboard' is a tiny green-grey tag crammed into the corner. It doesn't read as one system.
findings.fix: Use a 48px outer margin on every corner. Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. 'keyboard' becomes a 32px-high tag at x48,y48 with a 3px amber left bar. The goals dropdown becomes 240x40 with its right edge at x1872 and its top at y48.

findings.where: team score block x826-1094 y110-215 and extract chip x888-1032 y225-257
findings.what: The score block is overcrowded. 'team score', a 0 sp at about 36px, and 'you 0 sp' and 'p2 0 sp' in different sizes are packed into an unevenly padded box, and the right text nearly touches the edge. The extract chip hangs underneath with its own style, and the timer stacks directly on top. Three stacked boxes with different widths make the top centre messy.
findings.fix: Make one 268px-wide panel under the timer with 16px padding. 'team score' is a 16px tx-2 label, and '0 sp' is 32px tx-1 on the left. 'you' and 'p2' sit as two 16px rows on the right, with the p1 amber and p2 cyan 3px bars as markers. Put the extract chip inside the same column at 16px gap, using --extract text with a 3px --extract left bar and the same 4px radius.

findings.what: The 30 / 180 hero number is good, but the panel hugs the right edge at about 10px. The 'golden' tag at x1830 y1052 is 14px text floating below it with no contrast against the ground. 'compact smg' is the same weight as the labels elsewhere.
findings.fix: Right-align the panel to x1872, with its bottom at y1032. Fold 'golden' into the panel as a 16px --r-gold label at the top-left, or remove it. Keep the weapon name at 16px tx-2 and make the 30 the 56px f-cond 800 hero.

findings.where: world labels: 'the long dock cache' x1678-1892 y320-345 and 'c 152m' chip x1748-1850 y470-508
findings.what: The purple cache name is a large soft-glow text with no plate, and it is the loudest text on the right side, louder than the hud. It nearly touches the right edge. 'c 152m' repeats the extract distance already shown in the top-centre chip, so the same line is drawn twice.
findings.fix: Shrink the cache label to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 on a --ui-panel plate with a 3px --r-elite left bar, and keep it 24px or more from the screen edge. Drop the 'c 152m' chip, since the top-centre extract chip already carries the distance, and keep only the edge arrow.

findings.what: The hint floats mid-left over the room, unaligned with the hp block at x24 or the hotbar at x553. It has a dark box with a different opacity from the other panels.
findings.fix: Move it to x48, 16px above the hp block. Make it a 40px-high chip with a 28px --ui-raised key cap holding 'f1', 16px tx-2 text and the standard panel recipe.

findings.where: weapon slot 4 'f' key badge x900-922 y1015-1035 and slot ammo counts x740-762
findings.what: The tiny 'f' badge and the 14px ammo counts inside the tiles are hard to read from a couch, and the counts sit on top of the underline bar.
findings.fix: Raise the counts to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 at the bottom-right with a 6px inset, above a 4px ammo bar. Make the 'f' badge a 20px square --ui-raised cap with a 16px glyph at the top-left.

v.verdict: The ammo hero number is now strong, but the hotbar slots are still amber-bordered and uneven, the corner margins and panel recipes still vary, and the hp bar is a bare strip.

findings.what: Only two slots are drawn, as small tiles with different borders. The active slot is amber, not lime. The other slot numbers (1, 4-0) float over the wall with no tile behind them, so the row reads as broken and the numerals are hard to read.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 80x80 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Dim empty slots to 40%. Put the number top-left in 16px tx-2. Give the active slot a 2px --acc border. Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032.

findings.what: The bar is a bare red-outlined strip that sits about 8px from the bottom edge. It has no panel, no armour pair and no label hierarchy. The 'hp 22' text is crammed into the left of the bar. The red frame also reads as danger on a screen that is already tinted red.
findings.fix: Put hp in a 320x72 --ui-panel block at x48 with its bottom at y1032 and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 12px bar on a --ui-line track. Use a 16px tx-2 'hp' label and a 20px tx-1 '22' right-aligned. Switch to a --danger fill only below 30%.

findings.where: corner margins: keyboard tag x10-105 y5-32, goals x1603-1901 y22-65, ammo x1605-1910 y868-1017, f1 controls x410-536 y921-950
findings.what: Every HUD element sits 0-18px from the screen edge, and the panels use different fills, borders and radii. The goals chip is the only one with a chevron and a different black. The ammo panel overshoots the right margin to x1910.
findings.fix: Use a 48px outer margin on all four corners. Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put 'keyboard' at x48,y48 and the goals chip at 240x40 with its right edge at x1872. Put the ammo panel's right edge at x1872 and its bottom at y1032.

findings.what: The block is crowded. A big '0 sp' sits beside the 'you 0 sp' and 'p2 0 sp' lines, which are 16px and cramped against the right edge. The player lines have no p1 amber or p2 cyan markers. The block is also wider than the timer, so the stack above it is ragged.
findings.fix: Use a 268px panel with 16px padding. Put 'team score' in 16px tx-2, '0 sp' in 32px tx-1 on the left, and two 16px rows on the right with 3px amber and cyan left bars. Keep the extract chip in the same column, 16px below, with a 3px --extract bar.

findings.where: player 2 tag x14-170 y322-358 and recovering badge x12-180 y435-480
findings.what: The two left-side widgets use different shapes, a flat bar and a pill. 'player 2' is blue rather than the cyan P2 colour. The pink heart badge brings in a new hue and is not part of the palette.
findings.fix: Put both in the standard panel recipe, aligned to x48. Colour the player 2 name and bar with the P2 cyan. Make the recovering heart --ok or --warn, with 16px tx-2 text.

findings.what: The hero '25' is good, but '/ 150' is nearly the same weight and size, so the pair has no clear primary. The weapon name floats right-aligned with no label hierarchy.
findings.fix: Make '25' 56px f-cond 800 tx-1. Make '/ 150' 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Keep 'auto rifle' at 16px tx-2, left-aligned at 16px padding.

findings.what: The 'player 2' and 'crawler m-26' name tags overlap, so 'player 2' is unreadable. The red '!' sits on top of them.
findings.fix: Stack the tags with an 8px gap, or hide the ally tag when it is within 24px of an enemy tag. Use a 16px minimum with a dark 70% backing.

v.verdict: this is an in-raid hud, not the title screen my earlier notes described, and it reads clearly. The hp bar, team score block and ammo block each follow a different panel style and type size, so the hud feels assembled rather than designed.

findings.what: The block is crowded. A 'team score' label, a large '0 sp', and 'you 0 sp' / 'p1 0 sp' are packed into one box. The 'p1' line is a different label from 'player 1' elsewhere. It sits tight against the timer above and the extract chip below, so three boxes stack with no breathing room.
findings.fix: Use one clear score value (56px hero would be too big here, so use 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1). Put the two per-player lines at 16px --tx-2 on one row below it, and name them 'player 1' and 'player 2'. Leave an 8px gap to the timer and the extract chip. Tint the p1 and p2 lines amber and cyan.

findings.what: A thick red outline around the whole bar makes it the loudest element at the screen edge. 'hp 11' is small and low in contrast on the dark red fill. The bar is wide enough to cross the tile it sits under and collides with 'the forge' label just above it.
findings.fix: Shrink it to about 280px wide and 16px tall. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --danger fill. Write the number at 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1 beside the bar. Add a 16px gap above it to clear 'the forge'.

findings.what: The block is large and heavy compared with the other hud boxes. '25 / 150' is the hero number, which is correct, but the block hugs the right edge with only about 10px of margin. 'auto rifle' is also a different size from every other label.
findings.fix: Move the block to a 48px margin from the right and bottom edges. Keep '25' at 56px f-cond 800, with '/ 150' at 20px --tx-2. Set 'auto rifle' to 16px --tx-2. Use a 4px radius on --ui-panel.

findings.where: hotbar (x 782-990, y 955-1053) and weapon number row
findings.what: The hotbar slots (3, 4) are small. The yellow outline on the selected slot looks like a different accent from the lime. The slot numbers 5-8 and 0 are floating dim text on the map, so they are unreadable and clutter the bottom of the screen. The row also sits off the screen centre.
findings.fix: Use 64px slots with a 2px --acc border on the selected slot only. Show numbers only on filled slots, in 14px --tx-2 in the corner of the slot. Delete the floating numerals and centre the row at x=960.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' chip and top-right 'goals 0/3' dropdown (x 8-105, y 8-31; x 1603-1900, y 24-64)
findings.what: The two corner widgets have different heights, borders and type sizes. The chip hugs the screen edge at about 8px, outside the 48px margin. The goals text is larger than any other label in the corner.
findings.fix: Put both on a 48px top margin at the same 40px height. Use 16px f-cond 600 text and a --ui-line-hi border. Draw the 'keyboard' chip in --tx-2.

findings.what: The name tag has a blue fill with a tiny bar, and the pill below has a pink heart ring. Neither follows the amber (P1) / cyan (P2) rule. The two pieces sit at different x positions and different sizes.
findings.fix: Colour the P1 tag amber. Align the tag and the pill to a shared 48px left edge. Make the heart ring --danger. Set both to 16px text on a --ui-panel fill with a 4px radius.

findings.where: world prompts 'hold to breach', 'f1 controls', 'the forge' (x 1254-1402, y 680-720; x 410-536, y 922-950; x 332-408, y 982-1002)
findings.what: The three prompts use different treatments. 'hold to breach' is a dark box, 'f1 controls' is a dark chip with a key cap, and 'the forge' is bare orange text with no backing. 'the forge' is low contrast against the map.
findings.fix: Use one prompt style: a --ui-panel box, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, with a key cap for the key. Put 'the forge' on that same backing. Place 'f1 controls' on the 48px left margin.

findings.what: The teal chip is correct for extraction, but it is 32px tall against the 40px or taller boxes around it. Its arrow floats separately below it.
findings.fix: Make the chip 40px tall. Attach the arrow to the chip's lower edge, or put it on the left inside the chip. Keep the teal border at 1px.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but it still has no shared panel recipe or margins, the empty hotbar slots are bare numbers floating over the map, and the hp bar is still jammed into the bottom-left corner.

findings.what: Only the two filled slots have tiles. The empty slots (1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 0) are loose numbers sitting on the wall art with no container. The row reads as two stray cards. Slot numbers are about 14px and low contrast, and the 'f' key badge on slot 5 is tiny.
findings.fix: Draw all nine slots as 80x80 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Dim the empty ones to 40%. Put the number in 16px tx-2 top-left. Give the active slot a 2px --acc border, not the current amber one. Centre the row on x960 with its bottom at y1032.

findings.what: The hp bar is a heavy red-outlined bar flush against the bottom-left edge, with a 4px margin. The whole bar reads as danger even though 22 hp is the only data. The 'hp 22' text is one mixed-weight string with no label/value split. It is the most important survival stat and the least designed element.
findings.fix: Put it in a 320x72 --ui-panel block at x48 with its bottom at y1032 and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 12px bar on a --ui-line track. Use a 16px tx-2 'hp' label and a 20px tx-1 '22' right-aligned. Fill with --danger only below 30%.

findings.where: corners: keyboard x10-105 y5-32, goals x1603-1901 y22-65, air strike x1522-1908 y805-858, ammo x1605-1910 y868-1017, f1 controls x410-536 y921-950
findings.what: Margins run from 4px to 20px and differ per corner. Panel styles differ too: some have borders, some are flat, and radii vary. 'keyboard' is a green mono tag in a different style from everything else. The air strike bar overlaps the ammo panel's edge, and the f1 chip sits at an arbitrary x.
findings.fix: Use a 48px outer margin on all four corners. Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put 'keyboard' at x48,y48 in tx-2 16px. Align the goals, air strike and ammo right edges at x1872, with 8px between them. Put f1 controls at x48 above the hp block.

findings.where: team score block x762-1158 y110-215 and clock x887-1033 y18-103
findings.what: The block is 396px wide, which is too wide, and it is crowded against the clock. 'team score' is centred while the numbers sit left and right, so the alignments clash. The '7,050 sp' is 36px bold. You 4,250 and p2 2,800 are cramped at the right edge. The extract chip hangs off the bottom with no spacing.
findings.fix: Make it a 300px panel with 16px padding. Put 'team score' in 16px tx-2 left-aligned. Put '7,050 sp' at 32px tx-1 on the left. Stack the two 16px rows on the right, each with a 3px amber or cyan left bar. Leave a 16px gap before the extract chip, with a 3px --extract bar.

findings.where: player 2 tag x14-170 y322-358 and recovering badge x12-180 y435-480
findings.what: The tag and badge are floating pieces with a 12px margin, each in a different shape (a bar and a pill). The pink heart ring clashes with the red-tinted map and is the only pink element in the HUD. 'to 85' is small and dim.
findings.fix: Put both in the standard panel recipe at x48. Colour the player 2 name and bar in P2 cyan. Make the heart --ok or --warn. Use 16px tx-2 for 'to 85' and 20px tx-1 for 'recovering'.

findings.what: '25 / 150' is a good hero number, but 'auto rifle' is a small right-aligned label above it. The panel is very tall for two lines, and the 150 is almost as large as the 25, so there is no clear hierarchy inside it.
findings.fix: Make the 25 56px weight 800 tx-1 and the '/ 150' 24px tx-2. Left-align 'auto rifle' at 16px tx-2. Cut the panel to 80px tall.

findings.where: whole screen, red damage vignette over the map
findings.what: The pink-red wash covers the whole frame and drops contrast under the tan HUD text and the grey panels. It reads as a muddy tint, not a damage cue.
findings.fix: Limit the tint to the outer 12% of each edge at 35% opacity, fading to 0 towards the centre. Keep it away from the HUD panels.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable and all lower case, but it is still a cluster of mismatched dark boxes with no shared margin, size or border. The earlier fixes to the hp bar, hotbar numerals and top chips were mostly not applied.

findings.what: The bar is still a 416px red-outlined strip with 'hp 12' jammed against the screen edge and the bottom of the frame. The 'recovering' chip sits above it with no clear relation to it. A red fill outline on a near-empty bar reads as an error box, not a health meter.
findings.fix: Make the bar 280x16 at x=48, y=1016 (48px margin). Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --danger fill. Put 'hp 12' at 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1 to its right. Stack the recovering chip 16px above the bar, left-aligned to x=48.

findings.what: The slots are inconsistent. Numerals 1-4 and 7-0 float on the wall art with no slot, while 5 and 6 are 96px tiles. The selected slot has an amber border, though lime means selected. The numerals have poor contrast over the walls.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px --ui-panel tiles with 8px gaps, centred at x=960, ending 48px above the bottom edge. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Show the numeral at 14px --tx-2 inside each tile's corner. Remove the floating numerals.

findings.what: The block is a wide box with the labels 'team score', '7,050 sp', 'you 2,800 sp' and 'p1 4,250 sp'. The player naming is inconsistent: 'you' and 'p1' both refer to players, while the world label says 'player 1'. The 'player 1' label above the character also reads as the same entity as 'p1'. The hero number is about 36px and does not clear the 56px hero rule.
findings.fix: Name the lines 'player 1' and 'player 2'. Tint them amber and cyan at 16px --tx-2. Put them on one row under the 7,050 sp figure, set at 32px f-cond 700. Keep an 8px gap to the extract chip.

findings.where: ammo block (x 1606-1910, y 868-1017) and air strike bar (x 1522-1910, y 805-858)
findings.what: The two panels are 300px and 388px wide with different left edges, and the ammo panel sits 10px from the right edge. The air strike row is a third panel style with a 14px label and a tiny bar. Only the ammo number reads at distance.
findings.fix: Use one 304px column with a 48px right margin. Put the ammo panel at y=880-1032. Put the air strike strip under it as a 40px row in the same 4px-radius --ui-panel. Set the label to 16px --tx-2. Make the bar 8px tall, and use --acc only when it is ready.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' chip (x 10-105, y 8-31) and top-right 'goals 0/3' dropdown (x 1603-1900, y 24-64)
findings.what: The chips sit at different heights (8px and 24px tops), with different heights, borders and fills. 'keyboard' is jammed in the corner with only 8px margin, and the goals box has an unexplained chevron.
findings.fix: Put both at y=48, 40px tall, with a 48px side margin, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 text. Draw 'keyboard' in --tx-2. Make the goals box 220px wide.

findings.where: player 1 mini frame (x 12-170, y 322-360) and 'the forge' label (x 1680-1760, y 250-275)
findings.what: The player frame is a thin, low-contrast bar with the blue 'player 1' text clipped against its top edge. The forge label in orange is floating text with a glow that shares nothing with the other UI. The tiny 14px hp bar fill is unreadable.
findings.fix: Give the player frame a 40px --ui-panel row with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px padding. Put the name at 16px, tinted amber for P1, and use a 6px bar. Set 'the forge' in 16px --tx-1 on a --ui-panel tag with a 4px radius.

findings.what: The chip floats in the mid-left bottom area over the wall art. It is semi-transparent and its text is 20px. It sits about 15px above the hotbar line with no alignment to anything else.
findings.fix: Fix it as a 32px --ui-panel chip at x=48, y=960 (bottom-left, above the hp bar stack). Use a 16px label and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: A strong red vignette covers the left and right edges, so the HUD text gets muddy over the pink panels. It makes the 'player 1' label and the recovering chip lose contrast.
findings.fix: Cap the vignette at 25% alpha and use --scrim .80 behind any HUD panel that sits over it.

v.verdict: The run-over card has a clear hero number and a calm layout, but the p1/p2 stat grid is misaligned, the labels are too small, and the card is half empty and stays too quiet against a busy lobby behind it.

findings.what: The columns do not line up. p2 has no deaths cell, so its kills sit at x906 against p1's x856, and its extractions at x1108 against p1's x1008. The p1 and p2 labels sit on the label baseline instead of next to the number, so the rows read as scattered.
findings.fix: Use one 5-column grid: a 48px label column, then four 200px columns for score, kills, extractions and deaths. Left-align every value and label on the same x in both rows, show deaths for p2 too (0), and centre the p1/p2 tags on the number line.

findings.where: all small labels (team score, score, kills, award captions) y310-730
findings.what: The labels render at about 13px in tx-2 on the panel. That is under the 16px minimum, and they are unreadable from a couch at 1080p.
findings.fix: Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking, in tx-2 (#aaa498). Set award values to 20px tx-1. Give the grid 8px extra row gap to make room.

findings.what: The card is only 37% of the screen width, with the lobby still bright behind it. Characters, a cut-off 'player' label and the 'player 2 joined' toast all compete with it. The right half of the team-score block (x810-1285, y330-420) is empty.
findings.fix: Use scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) plus a 6px blur. Hide the toast and world labels while the card is up. Widen the card to 1000px, or put the 7,050 sp hero on the left and a p1/p2 split bar on the right of that block.

findings.what: The six awards are two rows of three at the same weight, with a lime '4,250 sp' as the only accent. Lime is meant for selected and the primary action, so the crown value reads as a stray highlight. The p1/p2 attribution is buried in the tiny caption.
findings.fix: Make award values tx-1. Put the crown on a 3px --r-gold left bar, not lime. Colour the 'p1' and 'p2' suffixes amber and cyan to match the player colours. Add 24px between the two rows.

findings.what: A 37x4 lime stub on the card's top edge looks like a rendering glitch. It is not tied to the title or to any state.
findings.fix: Either extend it to a 3px lime bar the full 56px width of the 'run over' title, placed above it, or delete it.

findings.where: title x633 y268-297 and hero x633-807 y345-395
findings.what: 'run over' is about 28px, below the 32px title spec, and sits only 12px above the 16px 'team score' label. The gap from the hero to the divider (y422) is about 27px. The header spacing is uneven.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px/700. Use 16px between the title and the label, 8px between the label and the hero (56px/800), and 24px before the divider.

findings.what: The 'press any key' prompt is the primary action and is already correct (ring and text). It is small and low-weight for a couch, and it crowds the divider above it.
findings.fix: Raise it to a 20px/700 label in tx-1 with the 28px ring. Leave 24px above and below it, and put it at the right edge x1285 with 24px bottom padding.

v.verdict: The run-over card is clean and readable, with a good hero number and a live prompt. The p1/p2 stat rows don't align, the labels are tiny, and the dimmed background still shows through and adds noise.

findings.what: The two rows don't share a column grid. p1 has three stats and p2 has four. Score sits at x=705 in both, but kills sits at x=906 in p1 and x=856 in p2. Extractions sits at x=1108 and x=1008. The p1/p2 row labels sit on the label baseline instead of beside the number, and p1 has no deaths column. The table reads as ragged.
findings.fix: Use one 4-column grid with 160px columns starting at x=705 (score, kills, extractions, deaths) for both rows. Show deaths for p1 too. Align the p1 and p2 row labels to the number baseline, 20px f-cond 700, tinted amber and cyan. Put a 16px gap between rows.

findings.where: labels across the card (team score, score, kills, extractions, awards labels; y 310-730)
findings.what: The labels are about 13-14px grey on a dark panel, below the 16px minimum for anything read. They are hard to read from a couch at 1080. The award labels are the worst, because the label and the value are both small.
findings.fix: Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Set values to 20px, except the team score at 56px. Use an 8px gap between label and value.

findings.what: The party room is blurred but still readable behind the card. It has bright circles, characters and a 'player 1' label that sits at the same brightness as the card, so it competes with the card. The brown/blue tints are noisy, and the right and left black bars look unfinished.
findings.fix: Use scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) over the whole frame, including the bars. Remove or hide the 'player 1' world label while the card is open.

findings.what: The six awards are plain label/value pairs at the same weight as the stat rows. They read as a second table, not as highlights. Only the crown value is lime, and lime is reserved for selected and primary action, so it is misused here.
findings.fix: Make awards 3 columns of 20px values under 16px --tx-2 labels. Use --tx-1 for all values, including the crown, and drop the lime. Add a 1px --ui-line divider above the grid, with 24px padding.

findings.where: card title and top accent (x 633-740, y 265-297; accent bar x 634-670, y 237)
findings.what: The 'run over' title is only about 28px, and the small lime tick on the top edge doesn't align with anything. The title, the 'team score' label and the 7,050 hero are stacked with uneven gaps (about 20px and 30px). The hero is also left-heavy, with a large dead space to its right.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Use 24px padding and a 16px gap to the label, then the hero at 56px f-cond 800. Delete the lime tick or make it a full-width 2px bar. Consider putting the hero and the player rows side by side to use the empty right half.

findings.what: The primary prompt is right-aligned and small (about 22px), with a lime dot that is not the pad glyph and a fairly weak contrast with the card. The footer of the card has a lot of empty space on the left.
findings.fix: Use 24px f-cond 700 --tx-1 text with a 32px key or pad glyph chip. Centre the prompt in a 56px row, with a 1px --ui-line divider above it and 24px padding.

findings.what: The lime 'join your team · team score 7,050 sp' line in the background repeats the team score already shown on the card and adds a second lime text line. The tiny 'keyboard' chip at the top is nearly invisible against the background.
findings.fix: Hide the bottom strip and the keyboard chip while the card is open. If kept, set them to 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The card is only about 37% of the screen width and has a 1px border with no elevation. The interior padding is about 32px on the left but the content is not symmetric, so the right edge is ragged.
findings.fix: Widen the card to 760px with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 32px padding on all sides, and align the right-hand columns to the 32px right edge.

v.verdict: The earlier advice was mostly followed: the stat grid is aligned, the backdrop is blurred and the player colours are right. What's left is a small card with a wide dead strip on the right and a few type-scale slips.

findings.what: The card is 718px wide and the 7,050 sp hero sits on the left with nothing opposite it, so the right half of that block is empty. The card looks like a settings form, not a result screen. The 56px hero is also not far above the 20px stat numbers.
findings.fix: Widen the card to about 1000px. Put the hero on the left and a p1/p2 split bar on the right of that block: 8px tall, amber (4,250) and cyan (2,800) segments sized in proportion, with a 'p1 60%' / 'p2 40%' label (16px) under it. Alternatively raise the hero to 72px.

findings.what: The award captions and values look about 18px and 17px. That is off the 16/20 scale, and the values are dense at couch distance. Only the crown row has a gold bar, so the best streak row looks like it is missing something. The bar is also not aligned with the text above it.
findings.fix: Set the captions to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 and the values to 20px tx-1. Give every award cell a 3px left bar in its player colour, with the crown's bar in --r-gold. Use 24px column gaps and a 16px row gap, and align the first bar flush with the grid's left edge at x633.

findings.what: The two player rows look heavy. The 'score' caption repeats under every number (in both rows), so the 16px labels add clutter. The columns are not equal widths: score is 152px wide and extractions starts at x1000. The 'p1' and 'p2' tags are 16px but sit on the top line of the row, not centred on the number.
findings.fix: Show each caption once, as a column header row above p1 (16px tx-2), and drop it from the p2 row. Use 5 columns: a 48px tag column, then four 200px columns. Centre the p1/p2 tags on the number baseline. Dim the 0 values to tx-2 so 13 and 8 stand out.

findings.what: The prompt is the primary action and reads fine, but it is right-aligned in a card with all other content left-aligned. At 20px it is no stronger than the stat numbers, and the lime ring is small (32px).
findings.fix: Keep the prompt, but make the lime ring 40px and the text 24px f-cond 700 tx-1 so it clearly beats the stat numbers. Put 32px of space above it. Alternatively centre the prompt at the card's bottom edge.

findings.what: The title is about 28px, under the 32px title token, and 'team score' sits only 24px below it, so the two nearly merge. Nothing separates the title from the hero as its own block.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Add a 16px gap under it, and a 1px --ui-line rule below the title row, matching the dividers lower in the card.

findings.what: The card has a 1px border and no depth, and the blurred backdrop is still busy: bright game sprites show at x300-600 and x1400-1700. The card fill (#16191b) is barely different from the scrim.
findings.fix: Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.85) and the blur to 8px. Give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5) shadow so it separates from the backdrop.

findings.what: The dividers are inconsistent. The last one at y770 sits 5px under the award text and has no padding above the footer, while the other sections have about 24px around them.
findings.fix: Add 24px of padding above and below each divider, and make the bottom divider 1px --ui-line with 24px above the 'press any key' row.

v.verdict: The card now has a clear hierarchy: a 56px hero score, a stat grid with aligned columns, and a lime-ringed prompt. It is clean and consistent, but it is a bit small and sparse on the screen, and the awards block is still ragged.

findings.what: The awards are inconsistent. Only 'crown' gets a lime-yellow left bar and an indent (text starts at x=648, the other five at x=633). The two rows have different rhythm, and 'best streak' sits close to the bottom divider (y 770). Labels and values are both about 16-18px and nearly the same weight, so the labels read as co-equal with the values.
findings.fix: Give all six awards the same 3px left bar in --ui-line, or give none a bar and mark the crown with a small glyph. Keep every text start at x=633. Labels 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2, values 20px --tx-1. Use a 24px row gap and 24px padding above the bottom divider.

findings.what: The card is 717px wide, about 37% of the screen. That breaks the 'nearly entire screen' window rule and wastes the blurred frame. The hero sits alone at the left with a dead right half (x 810-1286, y 320-400), and the whole thing is hard to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Widen the card to about 90% of the screen, or at least about 1100px. Put the team score hero on the left and a short p1/p2 score split bar on the right in the same row. Alternatively keep the card compact but raise the stat values to 24px.

findings.what: The p1/p2 tags (16px, x 633) are small and sit at the top of the row rather than on the value baseline. 'sp' values (about 30px) are a fifth size outside the 56/32/20/16/14 scale. Zero values for extractions and deaths carry the same weight as real data, so they add noise.
findings.fix: Set the values to 32px f-cond 700 (the title token) or 20px, never 30px. Set the p1/p2 tags to 20px f-cond 700 on the value baseline. Dim zero values to --tx-2.

findings.what: The prompt is the primary action but it is only 20px, bottom-right, with a small 32px ring marker. The lime ring is the only accent on the card, so the eye finds the hero first and the action second (acceptable), but the action is easy to miss from a couch.
findings.fix: Raise the prompt to 24px or keep 20px with the ring at 40px. Add a 1px --ui-line divider above it with a 24px gap. Keep it right-aligned.

findings.what: The 'run over' title (32px) and the 'team score' label are tightly stacked, and the 56px hero follows at a 20px gap. The vertical rhythm is uneven: 24px from title to label, then about 30px from label to hero.
findings.fix: Use 16px between the title and the 'team score' label, 8px between the label and the hero, and 24px below the hero before the divider.

findings.what: The blurred background still shows a 'player 1' world label (amber, x 420-540, y 720-750) and the bars at the top and bottom. The scrim is slightly lighter than the .80 spec, so ghost UI competes at the card's edge.
findings.fix: Hide world labels while the card is open and raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) over the full frame, bars included.

findings.what: The card has a 1px border in --ui-line and a flat fill, but no accent on the card itself. It reads as a generic dark rectangle with little game identity.
findings.fix: Add a 2px --ui-line-hi top rule, or a 24px lime tick under the title. Use only one of them and keep the radius at 4px.
