The screen has nothing to say that this is a top-down extraction shooter, so it feels like a generic template.
findings.fix: Add a dimmed top-down raid art layer at 15-20% opacity behind a 80% --scrim. Or add a faint grid or terrain texture with a lime hairline at the title. Move the column up 40px so it sits at the optical centre.

v.verdict: A clean, focused title screen with a clear lime primary action, but the amber gradient logo, the weak 'player 2 window' label, the small low-contrast type and the cramped saves block keep it below polished.

findings.what: The logo is a glossy orange-amber gradient with a drop shadow. The guide bans gradient washes and says amber is only a warning colour. It competes with the lime CTA, and the amber also reads as the P1 player colour. Two hot colours sit stacked in the centre column.
findings.fix: Use a flat --tx-1 wordmark, or a flat --acc one. Remove the gradient and shadow. Keep it at 56px hero weight 800 and leave lime to the CTA.

findings.what: It is a 14px bold grey label 18px below the CTA, with no button shape. It reads as a caption of the CTA but is really a separate action. It is ambiguous and low-contrast, and it has no pad focus state.
findings.fix: Make it a real secondary button of the same width (558px) and 40px height with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, text at 20px in --tx-1. Leave 16px of space above and below it. Or move it into the top-right group.

findings.where: saves block (label, row, name input row)
findings.what: The 'saves' label is 16px and dim grey. The selected row's lime border and lime name are fine. Its '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is dim and small. The input and its two buttons sit only 10px under the row, and the heights differ (42px against 40px). Three controls in one strip have no hierarchy, and 'create a new save' and 'change name' have equal weight.
findings.fix: Use 16px dividers and a 24px gap between the row and the input strip. Make all rows 48px high. Raise the meta text to --tx-2 at 16px minimum. Give 'create a new save' the --ui-line-hi border and 'change name' a quieter, border-less style.

findings.what: The hints are 16px with a dim grey verb next to a bold white key cap. They look like a tutorial strip pinned to the bottom, 40px from the edge, and only 'keyboard' at the top says which device they are for. They add clutter to a title screen, and the pad prompts are not shown.
findings.fix: Drop the strip from this screen. If it stays, use --fs-fine 14px in --tx-2 with a 24px bottom margin and one consistent cap style.

findings.what: The chip is teal (the extraction colour) with a border, floating alone at the top centre. It is not aligned with any other element, and it uses the teal that is reserved for extraction.
findings.fix: Move it into the top-right group next to settings and make it neutral: --ui-line-hi border and --tx-2 text. Alternatively delete it, since the legend already shows the device.

findings.what: Both buttons are 46px high with bright white bold 16px text and a thick border. They pull the eye away from the title. The 48px right margin is fine, but their weight matches the secondary buttons below, so there is no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Use a border of 1px --ui-line and text in --tx-2 at weight 600, and reserve the white text for focus.

findings.what: The vignette is flat and almost empty. The content block sits slightly below centre with 360px of void above it and 300px below. The screen has no game art and could be any template, so identity is low.
findings.fix: Add a faint key-art silhouette or the undercroft backdrop at 15 to 20% behind the title. Shift the block up by about 40px so the title sits at the optical centre.

findings.what: The stamp is 14px at about 50% grey on near-black, below the 4.5:1 floor. It is also misaligned with the 48px margin used elsewhere and has a build date that adds clutter.
findings.fix: Use --tx-2 at 14px, align it to a 48px left and bottom margin, and drop the date and time.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen from the earlier review. It reads clearly in the middle, but the edges are messy: duplicated extract info, a clipped label, one stray capital, tiny low-contrast text, and panels that don't match each other.

findings.what: Capital 'I' in 'run Info', which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a thin dark strip with no visible border that overlaps the roof edge, and its label is small and light-weight.
findings.fix: Render it as 'run info'. Give it the --ui-panel fill (#16191b), a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set it to 56px height at 20px f-cond 600. Move it to the 5% margin (x≈96, y≈48) and stop it touching the building wall.

findings.where: extract banner at top centre vs 'c 152m' with arrow at the right edge
findings.what: The extract distance is shown twice, which the one-place rule forbids. The right-hand copy is clipped to 'c 152m', so it reads as a bug, and it sits against the screen edge.
findings.fix: Keep only the top-centre 'extract 152m' banner. Delete the right-edge pill. If an off-screen direction cue is needed, use a bare 24px teal (--extract) arrow with no text, inset 48px from the edge.

findings.what: The panel is tall and dense. Its columns are crowded and the section labels (move, fight, raid, gear) are dim grey at about 14px, below the 4.5:1 floor. The key caps are small dark boxes with weak borders. The panel is also a different size, radius and padding from the scoreboard above it. It sits on the screen edge with no 5% margin.
findings.fix: Set labels and keys to 16px --fs-label in --tx-2 (#aaa498) or brighter. Use 1px --ui-line-hi borders on key caps, 4px radius, and 24px padding. Put the panel at x=96 or fold it to one line as the guide asks. Align its width and left edge with the scoreboard above it.

findings.what: The text is about 14px with 18px row pitch, so it is crowded and hard to read from a couch. Names and $ values sit far apart with no row separators, and it hugs the corner at x=8. It shares no styling with the other panels.
findings.fix: Use 16px text with 32px row height and 1px --ui-line dividers. Put the panel on the 96px margin with 16px padding, fill --ui-panel, radius 4px. Give 'you' a 3px amber (P1) left bar. Show values in --tx-1 at 16px with tabular numerals.

findings.what: Empty slots are just a floating number and a faint weapon silhouette. They have no frame, and the numerals are low contrast over the busy map. Slots 1, 2 and 4 are framed and 3 is not, so the row looks broken. The amber outline on slot 1 competes with the lime-means-selected rule.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line border and a 4px radius, with the number at 16px in --tx-2. Show the selected slot with a 3px --acc bar on top, not an amber outline. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and the two circle icons
findings.what: The 'hp 100' text overlaps a flat green bar, and the oversized numeral clashes with the 20px type scale. The two round icons (amber crossed-eye, teal) above it are unlabeled and use amber and teal, which are reserved colours. The cluster hugs the left edge with no margin.
findings.fix: Set the number at 32px f-cond 700 inside a 24px-tall bar, with a --ui-void track behind the green (--ok) fill. Move the bar to x=96. Show the status icons as 32px glyphs in --warn/--extract only while that status is active, with 8px gaps.

findings.what: This is the best-composed element, but the '/ 24' reserve is italic at a different size from the '12', and the 'b / i backpack' hint is tiny. The panel runs flush to the screen corner, off the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Set '12' at the 56px hero token with '/ 24' at 32px --tx-2, both upright. Set the hint at 16px. Inset the panel to 96px right and 54px bottom.

findings.where: left feed 'pillager abandoned' and top timer 14:35
findings.what: The feed line is a thin teal-outlined tag sitting over a roof edge, with weak separation from the map. The timer uses a different, heavier numeral style than the rest of the HUD, with a sun icon beside it that has no label.
findings.fix: Give the feed line a --ui-panel fill at 85% with a 3px left bar and 16px text. Put the timer in f-cond 700 at 32px, tabular, with a --scrim chip behind it.

v.verdict: This raid HUD has a clear hero in the 12 / 24 ammo block and the lime-on-dark language is consistent, but the open controls card, the doubled extract readout and the faint low-contrast overlays make it noisy and unfinished. The previous advice was about the title screen, so there is nothing to compare against here.

findings.what: The full three-column key list is open and covers about 310x350 px of the playfield next to the player. The raid-controls order says it should sit mid-bottom left, folded to one line, with F1 opening it. If this is the party demo, it still never collapses, so it competes with the ammo and hp blocks.
findings.fix: For career, fold it to a single 16px line at bottom-left, above the hp bar, reading 'f1 controls'. For the demo, auto-fold after 8s or the first move input. Drop the 'raid' group and 'fl full list' from the open state.

findings.where: top-centre 'extract 152m' banner and the bottom-right 'c 152m' edge marker (x 1810-1860, y 486)
findings.what: The extract distance is drawn twice. The edge-of-map marker is clipped to 'c 152m' with its leading letters cut off. This breaks the 'one place per line' rule and the clipped text looks like a bug.
findings.fix: Keep the banner (teal, 20px) and make the edge marker an arrow only, or inset the label so it never clips: 16px margin from the right edge and 8px padding, with the label placed left of the arrow.

findings.what: It is cyan text on a translucent blue chip, laid over a blue water tile. Contrast is well under 4.5:1 and the chip border merges into the map. It is easy to miss even though it is the only event line.
findings.fix: Give the feed rows a solid --ui-panel fill at 90% with a 3px left bar in the event colour. Use --tx-1 for the text at 16px minimum. Add 8px vertical padding and a 16px gap from the controls card.

findings.where: hotbar slot numbers 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0 and the faded gun silhouettes (y 968-1000)
findings.what: The numerals for empty slots are drawn straight on the map in a dim grey. They vanish against the water and wall colours. Slots 3, 5 and 6-0 have no panel, so the row reads as three cards floating among stray digits.
findings.fix: Draw all 9 slots as 56px --ui-panel cells with a 1px --ui-line border at 4px radius. Put the number at 16px in --tx-2 inside the cell. Dim empty cells to 50% fill, not to a bare numeral.

findings.where: top-left panels: 'keyboard' chip and 'current pillagers 3' list (x 8-367, y 8-242)
findings.what: The chip sits at 10px from the edge and the pillager list at 8px, off the 5% margin used elsewhere. The list is tight at roughly 18px row pitch, the 'value at risk' header is dim, and the rows are small, so a couch reader cannot parse the $ column.
findings.fix: Set the row pitch to 28px with 16px text. Use --tx-2 for names, with your own row in --tx-1 plus a 3px amber bar (P1 colour). Right-align the $ in the tabular font. Bring the chip and the panel to a consistent 24px inset.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is about 32px, sits over a flat light green bar with no track and no border, and has no container. It is heavier than the title tokens allow and clashes with the ammo hero number. The two unlabeled round status icons above it are the same size as a hotbar slot and are unexplained.
findings.fix: Make the bar 24px tall in a --ui-panel track with 1px --ui-line-hi. Put 'hp' at 16px in --tx-2 and '100' at 20px in --tx-1 inside the bar. Shrink the icons to 32px and move them to the right of the bar, or add 16px labels.

findings.what: It is a wide empty bar with a tiny chevron far to the right. The label is lower-case Barlow that reads as a capital 'I' in 'Info'. It floats off the 5% margin at the right (20px) and does not line up with the top-left panel.
findings.fix: Shrink it to a hugging width (~160px) with the chevron 8px from the label. Check that the glyph is a lower-case i. Align its top and right edges to the same 24px inset as the top-left panels.

findings.what: The hero number is strong, but the block hugs the screen edge at about 10px. 'b / i backpack' is 14px grey and nearly illegible. The 'scav pistol' name is 24px, bigger than the 20px body token, and the slash and '24' are a much lighter weight than the 12.
findings.fix: Inset to a 24px margin. Set the name to 20px, the hint to 16px in --tx-2 at 4.5:1, and '/ 24' to 28px in --tx-2. Keep '12' at the 56px hero token in --tx-1, and turn it --danger below 25%.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the p2-idle title screen I reviewed before. It reads clearly, with the ammo hero number and a lime-free calm dark panel set, but it is cluttered. The controls list is wide open, two alerts and two extract readouts compete, and the hp bar and hotbar are rough.

findings.what: The full controls list sits open as a 300x300 card over the playfield. The owner's rs-1 order says it should be one short folded line at mid-bottom left, opened with F1. The list is also eight rows of 15px text, which is clutter.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, 24px above the hp bar. When opened with F1, use 16px minimum text, one column group, and 1px --ui-line-hi borders.

findings.what: The alert banner floats mid-screen, 100px below the clock, over the building. Its red wash and 2px edge compete with the clock and extract chip. It is not pinned to the top-centre, and its text is mixed 32px/20px with no clear anchor.
findings.fix: Pin it at y=24 below the clock group, centred on x=960, fixed 480x72 on --ui-panel with a 3px --danger left bar. Use a 32px title and a 20px --tx-2 subline, and give it the same 4px radius as the other panels.

findings.what: The bar hugs the screen edge (about 12px from the bottom, 24px from the left) and is a flat saturated green slab. The 'hp 100' text is 30px with an arbitrary size and sits on the fill with weak contrast. It has no panel, so it is out of style with the ammo card on the right.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the left and bottom (5% margin). Make it 360x24 on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line border, using --ok for the fill. Put 'hp' at 16px and '100' at 20px in --tx-1 above or beside the bar, not on it.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 have a frame. Slots 3-0 are bare floating numbers at about 14px, low contrast, and they collide with the scenery. The amber selected border is the player colour, but it reads close to the lime focus rule.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 64x64 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border at 40% opacity when empty, and numbers at 14px in --tx-2. Keep the selected slot as the only one with a 2px border.

findings.what: The same 146m distance is drawn twice, top-centre and at the right edge. The right marker's tiny 14px text and teal arc touch the screen edge and add noise. Under the one-place rule this is a duplicated line.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre extract chip at 20px and drop the right-edge 'c 146m' label. Keep only the arrow, with a 24px inset from the edge.

findings.what: It is a wide, nearly empty dropdown bar with a 20px label and a chevron. It is far wider than its content and unrelated to the left 'current pillagers' card. Its style differs (flat black, no border).
findings.fix: Make both cards the same --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Size the run-info card to its content, about 200x40, and align its top edge with the pillagers card at y=24.

findings.what: The card is 8px from the left edge. 'value at risk' is about 14px --tx-2, and the dollar column and names are the same weight, so there is no hierarchy. The 'you' row is not distinguished by the amber P1 colour.
findings.fix: Inset it 24px from the left. Give the header 16px --tx-2 and the rows 20px, with 'you' in the P1 amber, and add 8px of row padding.

findings.what: A green-on-dark chip jammed into the corner with 6px of margin. It is a stray element in a different style from every other panel.
findings.fix: Remove it from the raid HUD. If it stays, put it in the controls list header at 16px --tx-2.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the p2-progress screen I reviewed before, so my earlier notes don't apply. The ammo block and slot bar are clear, but the open controls card, a doubled extract readout and a mix of panel styles make it look assembled rather than designed.

findings.what: It sits open as a 300x300 two-column key card over the play area. It has about 20 rows, a keycap on every one, and 'move' and 'fight' sub-labels at low contrast. It is the biggest block on screen and has no focal point. If this is the party demo, it still hides the left flank of the map. In a career raid it should be folded to one line.
findings.fix: For career, fold it to one 32px line at mid-bottom left ('f1 controls') and open it only on f1. For the party demo, drop it to 6 rows (move, fire, reload, search, extract, backpack) and 16px text. Group labels go to --tx-2 at 16px, and 'full list' becomes a footer line.

findings.where: extract readout: top-centre 'extract 146m' chip plus right-edge 'c 146m' marker, with 'x extract' in the controls list
findings.what: The same distance is drawn twice, in two shapes, with two labels. A line drawn twice is a defect. The cryptic 'c 146m' also reads as a stray label.
findings.fix: Keep the teal top-centre chip as the only readout, with a 16px arrow. Reduce the edge marker to a bare teal arrow with no text, or delete it.

findings.what: A wide, flat, saturated green bar with 'hp 100' at about 32px bold in a different weight. It is as loud as the ammo block, so there are two heroes in the bottom corners. The text sits on the bar edge with no padding, and the bar is clipped by the screen bottom margin.
findings.fix: Make the bar 240x12px, --ok fill on a --ui-panel track, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put 'hp 100' at 20px in --tx-1 above it. Lift it 24px off the screen edge. Keep the 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.where: panel language across the HUD: current pillagers list, run info, 'the long dock cache' tag, host disconnected banner, controls card, ammo block
findings.what: The panels have different fills, radii (about 2 to 8px) and padding, and the borders are inconsistent. The list is a plain black box. 'run info' is a wide bar with a tiny chevron. The cache tag floats loose below it. The banner is red-tinted with an icon. Nothing reads as one system.
findings.fix: Use one panel: --ui-panel fill at 0.9 alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Only the banner gets a 3px --danger left bar. Narrow 'run info' to about 200px and attach the cache tag inside it.

findings.what: Rows are about 16px and tightly stacked at about 18px pitch, with no dividers. 'value at risk' and the chevron are small and dim. The $ values are in a different, tighter number style than the names. 'you' is not marked as the player.
findings.fix: Use a 24px row pitch. Names are --tx-1 at 16px and values are tabular numerals right-aligned. Mark 'you' with a 3px amber bar (P1 colour). Put the header in --tx-2. Add 16px padding.

findings.what: Slots 1 and 2 are large tiles, but slots 3-0 are bare numerals floating over the map at low contrast, so they are unreadable on the walls and water. The amber focus border on slot 1 is good. The 'f' badge on slot 2 is tiny.
findings.fix: Draw slots 3-0 as 48x48 empty tiles at --ui-panel 60% with a --ui-line border, with the numeral at 16px in --tx-2. Keep slot 1 at 80px with the amber border, and make the others 64px.

findings.what: A small green-on-dark chip jammed into the corner with 0px margin. It matches no other panel and it is not lime.
findings.fix: Move it to 24px from the edges, restyle it as a neutral chip (--ui-line-hi border, --tx-2 text, 16px), or drop it after the first 5 seconds.

findings.what: The red title is large, but the banner sits right under the extract chip and overlaps the building wall, so it is crowded. It is not at the top-centre edge. The second line is dim body text on a red tint with low contrast.
findings.fix: Put it at y 72 centred on the timer. Use a 56px-high bar with a 3px --danger left edge on --ui-panel. The title is 20px in --danger and the sub-line is 16px in --tx-1.

v.verdict: The run-info clutter, the right-edge extract pill and the open controls list are gone, but the HUD still looks like loose, undersized, inconsistent boxes sitting in the corners with no shared margin, type scale or panel style.

findings.what: It is a dense 11-line text block at about 16px with indented sub-lines and no dividers. It reads as the loudest element on the screen, ahead of the timer. Contract text sits in white and lacks lime or muted tiers. There is a mixed-case 'in' that renders as a capital I. The section labels (dawn clear, contracts, run goals) have the same weight as the content. It also hugs the screen edge with only 18px of margin.
findings.fix: Show only the 3 active goals at 16px, with the labels in --tx-2 and the content in --tx-1. Use 32px row height with 1px --ui-line dividers. Put sp rewards right-aligned in tabular numerals. Collapse the rest behind the chevron by default. Inset the panel to the 96px / 48px margin. Use 16px padding and a 4px radius.

findings.where: top-centre stack: timer 9:59, score box, extract 170m, hold e to breach (x860-1160, y18-215)
findings.what: Four separately styled boxes are stacked and overlap. The score panel sits under the timer, the teal extract pill overlaps the score panel edge, and the 'hold e to breach' tooltip collides with the pillager tag and the player. The three widths (138, 198, 112) do not align. The result is crowded, and the hero number '0 sp' is small, only about 28px against the 56px hero size.
findings.fix: Make the timer the single 56px hero with the score as a 20px line beneath it, in one 240px-wide panel. Move the extract banner to its own row 16px below, on the same centre axis. Move the 'hold e to breach' prompt to 48px above the player so it no longer collides with the pillager tag.

findings.what: Only slots 1, 2 and 4 are drawn as tiles. Slots 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are bare numbers floating over the map with no tile, so the bar looks broken, and the stray digits are unreadable at about 12px. The selected slot is an amber outline, which conflicts with the rule that lime means selected. Tile size and spacing are uneven, with slot 3 hidden behind the scenery.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots at 64px with 8px gaps, a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line border and a 4px radius. Put the number at 16px in --tx-2. Make the selected slot a 3px --acc top bar. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity. Centre the bar at x=960.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1070) and 'f1 controls' chip (x437-537, y928-952)
findings.what: The 'hp 100' is drawn as a huge bold type over a flat green bar with no panel, and it sits 10px from the screen edge, off the margin. It is as heavy as the title, which breaks the rule of one bold element. The 'f1 controls' chip floats in an unrelated place and is 14px grey, below the label floor. The two do not align with each other or with the scoreboard.
findings.fix: Put hp in a 64px-high --ui-panel bar at x=96, y=968 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the 'hp 100' label to 20px f-cond 600 and keep the green fill (--ok) to 8px high. Dock 'f1 controls' on the same left edge at 16px --tx-2, 8px above the bar.

findings.what: The panel is tight against the edge, only 8px from the left. Rows are about 18px apart with no dividers, text is about 15px, and the 'you' row has no highlight, so it reads as a list of identical names. The chevron is tiny. The 'keyboard' chip above it at 10px from the corner is an extra, unaligned element.
findings.fix: Move it to x=96, y=48. Use 16px text, 32px rows, 1px --ui-line dividers and 16px padding. Give 'you' a 3px amber left bar and a --ui-raised fill. Align the '$' values right in tabular numerals. Move the 'keyboard' chip into the same 96px margin or drop it.

findings.what: The panel is the best-structured element here, with a 56px-plus hero number. But the '24' next to the '12' is in the same weight and size family, 'b / i backpack' is at 14px in grey, and the panel sits only 10px from the right edge. Its fill and border differ from the other panels, which have no visible border.
findings.fix: Make '12' the 56px 800 weight and '/ 24' 32px in --tx-2. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Inset the panel to the 96px / 48px margin, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and use the same border on every HUD panel.

findings.where: toasts: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x15-410, y775-802) and 'pillager joined' (x894-1025, y893-929)
findings.what: The two toasts use different styles: one has an amber left bar and an icon, the other is a plain black box. They sit in separate corners of the screen, and the first is a long explaining sentence over the busy map, which counts as clutter. Both are about 16px, with weak separation from the background.
findings.fix: Use a single toast style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px text, 3px left bar coloured by type, stacked in the left feed at x=96. Shorten the first to 'contract item nearby'. Drop the explaining clause.

findings.what: Panels are inset by 8 to 24px at the screen edges instead of the 5% margin, with five different panel looks and no shared header treatment, so the HUD reads as generic dark boxes. Nothing in it uses the lime accent for focus, and the amber of the selected slot and the toast bar is the only colour.
findings.fix: Apply one HUD panel class (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding) to every box. Set all of them to the 96px / 48px safe margin. Reserve lime --acc for the selected hotbar slot and the one active prompt (hold e to breach).

v.verdict: The controls list now folds to one line, the edge marker is gone and the clutter is down, but the HUD is still a pile of mismatched boxes with tiny text, and the unfinished hotbar and weak alert hierarchy keep it at a 3.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are big filled tiles, while 3 and 5-0 are bare numerals floating over the map. The row looks unfinished and reads as inconsistent. The numerals are low contrast and 3 collides with a map object.
findings.fix: Draw all 9 slots as 56px cells with --ui-panel at 90% and a 1px --ui-line border at 4px radius. Put the number at 16px in --tx-2 inside each cell. Dim empty cells to 50% opacity. Keep the lime border on the selected slot only (it is amber now, so change it to --acc). Space the cells 8px apart.

findings.what: It is a dense block of 15-16px white text with five levels of rows and no weight contrast. 'goals 0/3', 'dawn clear', 'contracts', 'run goals' and the rewards all look alike. The panel is the largest text mass on the HUD and competes with the timer for attention.
findings.fix: Make the header 20px --tx-1 and the section labels 16px --tx-2. Set the items at 16px --tx-1 with the reward right-aligned in --tx-2 and a 28px row pitch. Move 'dawn clear' into the timer cluster. Use 24px padding, a --ui-line divider between sections, and a 3px --acc bar at the left of the header only.

findings.where: Top-centre cluster: timer, score, extract, breaching (x 860-1160, y 18-225)
findings.what: Four items stack and overlap: the score box, the 'extract 170m' chip and the 'breaching 42%' text sit tight against each other and the 'pillager' tag. The breach label sits on top of the player sprites. The timer, score and extract chip each use a different box style and size.
findings.fix: Use one panel style for the timer and score, with 16px between them. Move the extract chip to the same 20px style, centred 16px below the score. Move the breach readout to a 20px --warn label, anchored 24px above the ring and not over the sprites. Hide the 'pillager' nameplate while the breach label shows.

findings.what: The card is clipped about 10px from the screen edge, and its margin differs from the goals panel (20px) and the pillagers panel (8px). The '12 / 24' hero is good, but 'b / i backpack' is 14px and low contrast.
findings.fix: Set every HUD panel to a 24px inset from the screen edge (5% margin is the guide, 48px at minimum for safe areas). Move the card in so its right and bottom edges are 24px from the edge. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2.

findings.where: Top-left pillagers panel (x 8-367, y 143-242) and 'keyboard' chip (x 10-105, y 8-30)
findings.what: The panel is 8px from the edge, with 15px text and a 18px row pitch, so it is cramped. The 'you' row has no highlight. The chip sits alone in the corner with a green outline that matches nothing else.
findings.fix: Use a 24px inset, 16px text and a 28px row pitch. Give your own row --tx-1 plus a 3px amber (P1) left bar, and make the other rows --tx-2. Right-align the $ amounts in a tabular face. Restyle the chip with the shared panel fill and 16px --tx-2 text.

findings.where: Bottom-left feed 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x 15-410, y 776-802)
findings.what: It is a long explaining sentence, which the brief calls a defect. The amber bar and icon are fine, but the line sits right against the building edge and is only 16px high.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the 'gold glow marks the box' text. Use 16px --tx-1 on a --ui-panel 90% fill with 8px vertical padding, and keep the 3px --warn bar.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint (x 437-537, y 930-952) and 'pillager joined' toast (x 894-1025, y 893-929)
findings.what: The two chips use different fills, radii and text sizes, and they sit right on the hotbar edge. The toast is a plain black box with no event colour, unlike the feed line.
findings.fix: Use one chip style: --ui-panel 90%, 4px radius, 16px text. Place the hint 16px above the hotbar's left edge and the toast 16px above the hotbar's centre. Give the toast a 3px --acc or event-colour bar so it matches the feed.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is oversized at about 32px and the bar is a flat green block with no frame. It sits 10px from the bottom edge, so it clashes with the quiet panels and has no inset of its own.
findings.fix: Use a 24px bar with a --ui-panel track and a 1px --ui-line border. Set 'hp 100' to 20px f-cond 700 inside the bar's left edge. Move it to a 24px inset, aligned with the ammo card's bottom edge.

v.verdict: The controls list is now folded to one line and the disconnect banner and right-edge marker are gone, but the hud still has too many separately boxed readouts of different sizes with no shared margin or hierarchy.

findings.what: It is a dense 11-line wall of 16px text with no hierarchy. Section labels ('contracts', 'run goals', 'dawn clear') and the goal rows are the same weight and colour. Contracts and run goals are listed together with their rewards, and in the middle of a raid this is clutter. It also sits 20px from the edge, outside the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Collapse it to a header row ('goals 0/3') plus the 3 active goals at 16px --tx-1. Render section labels at 14px --tx-2. Move the rest behind the chevron, folded by default. Inset the panel 48px from the top and right edges.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text sits on the green fill at about 32px and is heavy, so it reads as the loudest element in the corner. The bar is flush against the corner (24px inset) and sits tight against the hotbar. Dark green-on-green text has low contrast.
findings.fix: Make the bar 360x24 on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line border and an --ok fill. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 and '100' at 20px --tx-1 above it or to its left, not on the fill. Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges.

findings.where: stacked top-centre group: timer (x891-1029), score (x861-1059, y97-187), extract chip (y196-222), party toast (x885-1035, y893-930)
findings.what: Four boxes of different widths and fills are stacked off-centre and touching each other. The score box overlaps the timer's edge and the extract chip crowds it. The 'in pillager's party' toast floats unanchored above the hotbar. The 'hold k to breach' prompt (x1026-1158) is shifted off the stack's centre.
findings.fix: Use one top-centre column centred on x=960 with 8px gaps: the timer (hero 56px), then one 480px score and extract strip at 20px. Fix the toast at y=860, centred, 20px on --ui-panel. Give all of them the same 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line border.

findings.what: Slots 1-2 are 100px tiles, while slots 3-0 are bare, unboxed numbers floating over the map. The row reads as two items and a scatter of digits. The selected slot's amber border also reads as player colour, not 'selected'.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 64x64 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border, with numbers at 14px --tx-2. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border.

findings.what: It is folded as ordered, but the 'f1' cap and the label are tiny and sit on a low-contrast dark chip jammed against the hotbar's left edge. It is not on the mid-bottom left axis the owner specified, and it floats 8px above the hotbar line.
findings.fix: Set the chip at x=48, y=972 in 16px --tx-2, aligned to the same left edge as the hp bar. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px padding.

findings.what: The 56px hero '12 / 24' is correct, but the panel runs to within 10px of the right edge, and its 'b / i backpack' hint at 14px is dim and crammed into the bottom-left corner of the panel. The '/ 24' competes with the hero number.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom edges. Set '/ 24' at 20px --tx-2 and keep '12' at 56px. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2 with 16px padding.

findings.where: top-left roster panel (x8-367, y142-242) and 'keyboard' chip (x10-105, y8-32)
findings.what: The roster's mixed 16px rows are cramped at 1px dividers. It has an unlabeled chevron and a 'value at risk' header that is dimmer than the rows. The 'keyboard' chip is a green mono-style tag that sits in the margin and looks like debug UI.
findings.fix: Use 24px row pitch and 16px --tx-1 rows with 14px --tx-2 headers. Inset the roster 48px from the top and left. Drop the 'keyboard' chip from the raid screen, or move it to the footer at 14px --tx-2.

findings.what: The panels use inconsistent insets (8, 10, 20 and 24px), box styles and type sizes. Together with the cluttered goals and roster text, the HUD reads as a pile of debug boxes and not as one system.
findings.fix: Apply one panel spec to every HUD box: --ui-panel at 85% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Use a 48px screen inset and the type scale 56/32/20/16/14 only.

v.verdict: This is an in-raid HUD, not the p2-progress menu I reviewed before, so none of the earlier advice (wordmark, player 2 button, saves block) was applied or could be checked. As a HUD it is a cluster of small, unevenly sized dark boxes: the timer, score and breach label overlap, the corner margins are far below 5%, and the text is cramped and hard to read.

findings.where: Top-centre cluster: timer 9:59, score box, 'breaching 42%' label, 'extract 170m' chip, 'pillager' tag
findings.what: Five elements are stacked within about 120px and overlap. The 'breaching 42%' label (x1027-1157, y181-215) runs into the bottom-right corner of the score box (x860-1060, y97-187) and sits on the 'pillager' name tag. The 0 sp score is a low-priority number but it is bigger than the breach prompt, which is the action in progress. The cluster is also crowded around the ring where the player is looking.
findings.fix: Move the score into the left feed or the top-right list. Keep only the timer at top centre (56px hero). Place the breach label 24px above the progress ring, centred on it, with a --ui-panel fill and 8px padding so it clears the pillager tag. Allow 16px minimum between any two HUD boxes.

findings.what: It is a dense text block with a bare caret and about 14-16px text. Four things share one weight: 'goals 0/3', section labels (dawn clear, contracts, run goals), contract rows and reward rows. The reward values ('+300 sp') are the same colour as the task names, so nothing reads first. 'alr strike' looks like a typo because the font draws l and I almost the same. 'in chill row' has the same problem.
findings.fix: Use 20px --tx-1 for task names and 16px --tx-2 for labels. Put the rewards right-aligned in --acc or --tx-2 in a column. Add a 1px --ui-line divider between 'contracts' and 'run goals', and 16px padding. Fold the section down to the open goals only, and fix the l/I glyph ambiguity (use a font with a slashed or serif I, or check that the string says 'air strike').

findings.where: Left 'current pillagers 3 / value at risk' panel and the 'pillager' bar below it
findings.what: Names are about 14px and the money values sit far to the right with no row separation. The panel has a 1px edge, so it competes with the goals panel at equal weight. The 'pillager' name plate directly beneath it, with its green bar, is a second style of label from the same HUD. The two have different fills, edges and type.
findings.fix: Use one panel style for all three side panels: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Set the rows at 16px with 24px height and make the rows for other players --tx-2. Shade the player's own row (you) with --acc text, or put an amber (P1) / cyan (P2) 3px bar on the left of the row.

findings.where: Bottom edge: hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1068), hotbar, 'fl controls' chip
findings.what: The hp bar sits about 10px from the bottom edge, outside the 5% margin (about 54px), and the screen edge crops it. 'hp 100' is large condensed text over a bright green fill with poor contrast, in a different type style from the ammo number. The hotbar slot numbers 3-0 are tiny and disappear into the map. 'fl controls' reads as a typo for f1 and its chip is floating on its own at the left.
findings.fix: Lift the hp bar to y≥1026 (54px from the bottom), height 24px, with a 1px dark border. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 on the left and '100' at 20px in the bar. Give hotbar slots a --ui-panel fill and numbers in 16px --tx-1. Write the key as 'f1' in a 1px-bordered chip, aligned to the hotbar's left edge.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' tooltip at bottom centre (x885-1035, y893-928)
findings.what: It is a floating black box with no relation to anything and it sits on top of the wall art above the hotbar. It is an explaining sentence on screen, which the brief counts as clutter. It also appears at a different size and corner radius from every other box.
findings.fix: Delete it, or show 'party' as a 16px --tx-2 tag on the player's name row in the left panel. If it stays, 16px text, 4px radius, 24px above the hotbar.

findings.what: The 12 / 24 hero number is good, but 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while 'b / i backpack' is small (about 14px) and low contrast. The panel is only about 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, so its margins do not match the 24px gap used for the left panels.
findings.fix: Set 'scav pistol' at 20px --tx-1 and keep 12 at 56px weight 800 with '/ 24' at 32px --tx-2. Make the backpack hint 16px --tx-2. Pull the panel in to a 48px margin from the right and bottom.

findings.what: It is a tiny green-on-dark chip with no relation to the other HUD boxes. It is clipped near the corner and uses a green that is not a token. It adds noise during a raid.
findings.fix: Remove it from the raid HUD (show the device only in the controls list on f1), or restyle it as a 16px --tx-2 chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px from the corner.

findings.what: There are four or more box styles: near-black translucent rectangles with different corner radii (about 0 to 6px), edge weights and padding, plus the amber-edged hotbar slot. The type sizes are all over the place (14, 16, 18, 20, 28, 56px). It reads as a template, not as a system, and nothing says ARC Raiders x Zero Sievert.
findings.fix: Use one HUD panel token: --ui-panel at 85% alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding. Keep text at three sizes only (16, 20, 56px). Use --acc only for the active hotbar slot and main prompt.

v.verdict: The active-reload status chip is a tiny, dim badge in the left margin, and the HUD around it is crowded and inconsistent: it has a capital 'I', '$' pill styling that varies by panel, and a 'run info' bar that clashes with the rest.

findings.what: It contains a capital 'I' ('run Info'), which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The bar is also a full-width dark strip with a chevron, unlike the other HUD panels, and it overlaps the 'the long dock cache' room label.
findings.fix: Lower-case it to 'run info'. Make it a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip at 16px, the same as the left roster. Move the room label out from under it.

findings.what: It is the focus of this screen, but it is the weakest element. The icon ring is thin, the title is about 16px green on a dark pill, and '+15% damage' is about 12px grey, below the 14px floor. It sits in the left margin away from the weapon and ammo, and a tooltip-sized pill has no hierarchy next to the bright roster.
findings.fix: Put it near the weapon slots or ammo block. Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1, with the detail at 16px tx-2. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use a 40px icon, with lime only for the ring while the effect is active.

findings.what: Four rows are crammed at about 16px with tight 18px line spacing. '$' values in tx-1 compete with the names, 'value at risk' is small grey, and the panel is 360px wide, so it eats the map with text-heavy clutter.
findings.fix: Use 24px row pitch and 16px labels. Name in tx-2, value in tx-1. Collapse to the player's own row by default. Pad 16px.

findings.what: Panels use different treatments: the roster is black with a thin border, the pillager bar is a small blue-bordered tag, the reload chip is a pill, the ammo block is a sharp box, and the extract chip is teal. Radii and fills vary, so it reads as a pile of templates.
findings.fix: Standardise on --ui-panel #16191b, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius for every HUD box. Reserve colour for state only.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is oversized, at about 36px in a condensed face, and sits on a flat green fill with no panel or border. It competes with the ammo hero number, and the 'hp' label is cut off at the screen edge (x≈24, y≈1075).
findings.fix: Give it a 56px hero only for ammo. Make hp a 20px label plus number on a 12px bar, inset 48px from the screen edge, with --ok fill on --ui-raised.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a small green-bordered chip jammed into the corner, and 'fl controls' sits oddly over the water room at about 16px with low contrast on the busy map. 'f1' is rendered as 'fl'.
findings.fix: Put the input tag in 14px tx-2 at a 24px inset. Move the controls hint to mid-bottom-left on a --ui-panel pill, and render the key as 'f1' in a keycap.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3 and 5–0 float as unboxed grey digits over the map, and the ghost weapon icons are barely visible. Ammo '50' on slot 1 is tiny and touches the slot border.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as equal 96px tiles with a --ui-line border and a 4px radius, with the number in the top-left at 16px. Put the ammo count at 16px with 8px padding.

findings.what: The off-screen pointer 'c 152m' is cryptic and duplicates 'extract 152m' in the top-centre. A stray teal arc is clipped at the right edge.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate readout, or label it 'extract' only. Delete the clipped arc, or draw it as a full ring.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the corners are crowded with small low-contrast panels in different styles. The one thing the screen is meant to show, the active reload x3 status, is a tiny chip that is easy to miss.

findings.where: active reload x3 status chip (left, y~452)
findings.what: The new status is the point of this screen, but it is a tiny 16px dark pill with 11px sub-text '+35% damage'. It sits in empty space between the pillager bar and the hp bar and has no link to either. It is far below the 16px minimum for anything read, and it is not on the ammo or weapon element it affects.
findings.fix: Anchor it to the ammo block or the hp bar, 8px above it. Make the title 20px f-cond 600 and the sub-line 16px tx-2. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, with a 3px lime bar on the left edge while it is active.

findings.what: Dense 14-15px text with a dim grey header ('value at risk') on a near-black box. The rows are packed at roughly 18px pitch and the dollar figures are cramped against the right edge. The panel's corners and border differ from the ammo panel, and the 'pillager' name bar below it is a third style. Nothing in this group is the hero.
findings.fix: Put all three on one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Use 16px labels and 20px names and values with 8px padding and a 24px row pitch. Show only 'you' with a count and collapse the other rows by default.

findings.what: 'run info' is a wide black bar with a chevron. It is capitalised ('run Info', with a capital I) and floats over the map with no panel language shared with the neighbouring panels. 'c 152m' is an unexplained tiny chip that duplicates the 'extract 152m' banner at top centre, so the same line is drawn twice.
findings.fix: Fix the capital I in 'run info' (a capital is a defect). Delete the 'c 152m' chip or keep only the edge arrow. Restyle 'run info' as a collapsed 40px-high card in the shared panel style, 16px text, 8px padding.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is large and heavy, but it is clipped by the bar and the bottom screen edge with almost no margin (about 20px from the left, 10px from the bottom). The flat green fill is the loudest block on screen and it fights the lime accent. The bar is also detached from the weapon slots.
findings.fix: Use a 48px safe margin (the 5% rule), a 24px-high bar with a --ok fill and a dark track, and 20px f-cond text sitting inside it. The 56px hero size belongs to ammo only.

findings.where: bottom-left icon row and 'f1 controls' hint
findings.what: Two unlabeled circular icons (orange and teal outlines) have no explanation and use player-colour hues, which breaks the rule that lime is the only selection colour. 'f1 controls' is a tiny 14px tag half-lost over the dark teal floor with a mismatched key chip.
findings.fix: Use one outline colour (--ui-line-hi) for idle icons, 32px with 8px gaps. Make the 'f1 controls' hint 16px tx-2 with a single key chip, sitting on the same baseline as the slot bar.

findings.what: The selected slot has an amber border, but lime is the only 'selected' colour. Empty slots 3 and 5-0 show faint ghost silhouettes that clutter the row, and the slot numbers are about 12px.
findings.fix: Change the selected border to --acc at 2px. Remove the ghost icons from empty slots. Make the numbers 16px tx-2.

findings.where: 'pillager joined' toast and the 'the long dock cache' tag
findings.what: Two different black boxes with different paddings and type sizes. The toast sits 90px above the slot bar and floats over the playfield with no clear tie to the left feed that the guide says should hold it.
findings.fix: Move the toast to the left feed. Give it the shared panel style (16px text, 8px 16px padding, 4px radius), and use the same style for the cache tag.

findings.what: The ammo block is the best-built element. '12 / 50' is a real hero number, but the 'b / i backpack' line is 14px and low contrast, and the 'scav pistol' name is right-aligned with a different margin from the number.
findings.fix: Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2 and align it on the same right padding as the name and number, at 16px. Lower the '/ 50' to tx-2 so '12' leads.

v.verdict: The active reload status chip is clear, but the HUD around it is cluttered and inconsistent: it has mixed panel styles, a stray capital, a near-invisible P2 marker, and several overlapping or floating elements.

findings.what: The capital 'I' in 'run Info' breaks the all-lower-case rule. The dropdown is also a wide empty bar with nothing visible inside it. The 'scav pistol' ammo card in the bottom right is also a different panel style.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Shrink the bar to its content, about 200x40px, and use one 4px-radius --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px label type for every HUD panel.

findings.where: active reload x1 chip, left, y~452
findings.what: The chip is the focus of this shot but is the weakest thing on screen. It has a thin ring icon, a muted green title at about 16px, and a '+15% damage' subline at about 12px. That is below the 14px floor, and the chip sits unanchored below the health card. The '%' has no lower-case issue, but the green clashes with the lime/teal system and reads as a rarity or ok colour.
findings.fix: Make the chip 48px high with an 8px gap under the status card. Use tx-1 20px f-cond 600 for 'active reload x1', 16px tx-2 for '+15% damage', and a lime --acc ring only while the buff is active. Use the same panel fill and border as the other HUD cards.

findings.where: 'pillager' name card, left, y~335 and the world tag above the player
findings.what: The P2 name card is a thin bar with a tiny blue-white label and a green health line. It does not match the 'current pillagers' list panel above it, and it carries no P2 cyan identity. The same name appears again in a floating tag above the character, so it is drawn twice.
findings.fix: Put P2 in the standard panel with a 3px cyan (P2) left bar and 16px text. Keep either the card or the world tag, not both. Align its left edge to the 16px margin used by the list above.

findings.where: bottom-left row: 'f1 controls', 'in pillager's party' tooltip, and the hp bar
findings.what: Three bottom-centre and bottom-left items float with no shared grid. The 'f1 controls' chip and the 'in pillager's party' black box are different styles and sit over the world with no relation to each other. The party box is an explaining sentence and is not needed. The 'hp 100' bar is a big lime-green fill with oversized, blurry-looking type that overpowers the ammo hero number, so two heroes compete.
findings.fix: Delete the 'in pillager's party' tooltip, or fold it into the player card. Put 'f1 controls' on the left margin at a 16px label size in a standard chip. Shrink the hp numeral to 32px, set it inside a 24px-tall bar, and let the 56px ammo number be the only hero.

findings.what: The active slot has a 3px amber border, but its numeral and style do not match the other slots. The numbers 3 to 0 float on the world with no panel, and slot 7 is partly lost behind a prop. The slot numbers use a warm grey that does not hit 4.5:1 on the busy tile art.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots 3 to 0 as 64px --ui-panel tiles at 60% opacity with a 1px --ui-line border. Use the lime --acc border for the selected slot, since amber is player colour only and lime means selected. Use 16px tx-2 numerals.

findings.what: The panel is a dense four-row list at about 14–16px with the value column small and tight at about 22px row pitch. The header, the 'value at risk' column label and the collapse chevron are all the same weight, so nothing leads. The panel is also pressed close to the left screen edge at about 8px.
findings.fix: Use a 28px row pitch, 16px label for the header in tx-2 and 20px tx-1 for the names and values. Align the left edge to the 5% margin (96px) or at least 16px, and match it to the run info panel on the right.

findings.where: extract marker and c 146m, top centre and right edge
findings.what: The same 146m distance shows twice. There is the 'extract 146m' teal pill at the top and a 'c 146m' arrow chip on the right edge. The 'c' label is cryptic and in a third panel style, and the teal ring arc next to it is clipped at the edge.
findings.fix: Keep one distance readout. Remove the 'c 146m' chip, or reduce it to a bare edge arrow with no text. Use the same 4px radius and 16px type as the extract pill.

findings.what: The small lime-green 'keyboard' label with a green border floats in the corner with no relation to any panel. It uses a mono-style face in a different style from the other HUD text.
findings.fix: Render it as a 14px f-body label in tx-2 on the standard panel, or only show it at start-up. Put it on the same 16px margin as the other left-edge elements.

v.verdict: The reload buff chip is readable, but the HUD around it is scattered and inconsistent, with a capital letter, a status chip that is too small and too dim, and a fragmented layout.

findings.what: The word 'Info' has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The dropdown is a wide, empty bar that says nothing and competes with the clock for attention.
findings.fix: Change to 'run info'. Shrink the bar to content width (about 200x40) or collapse it to an icon. Align its left edge to the 5% margin (96px) to match the other corner blocks.

findings.where: active reload x3 chip, left, y=450
findings.what: This is the screen's subject but it is tiny and low-key. The title is about 16px teal on a dark pill, and '+35% damage' is about 12px grey, under the 14px floor. The chip floats between the pillager bar and the world with no clear grouping, and the teal, which is reserved for extraction, is used for a buff.
findings.fix: Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 and the sub-line to 16px tx-2. Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Put the ring icon in --acc. Dock the chip 8px under the pillager health bar at the same left edge (x=16) so the two read as one status block.

findings.where: player count and value-at-risk panel, top left
findings.what: The panel is dense and has three different type sizes. The 'current pillagers 3' header and the 'value at risk' label are about 14px, the rows are about 16px, and the amounts are right-aligned with tight 18px row spacing. The values are shown with $ and no hierarchy, so the 'you' row does not stand out. The panel is also far wider than its content.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels and 20px values with 28px row pitch. Highlight the 'you' row with --acc or an --ui-raised fill. Give the amber P1 and cyan P2 colour chips to each name. Trim the panel width to about 300px.

findings.what: The hp bar is a solid green slab that is very wide (about 410px). The 'hp 100' text sits on top of it, is huge, and overlaps the bar edge. The green fill is a different style from the thin bars above it and has no panel, border or frame, so it clashes with the rest of the HUD. It also touches the screen edge and ignores the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Make it a 320x16 bar with a --ui-panel track and 1px border, and set the number as a 32px f-cond 700 hero number to the left of the bar, not on it. Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges, with 8px between the number and the bar.

findings.where: hotbar slots 1-0 and 'f1 controls' chip, bottom centre
findings.what: Slot numbers 3-0 float with no slot frames and are low-contrast and hard to read on the busy map. The 'f1 controls' chip is crammed against the left of slot 1 with a stray grey key box. Slot 1 is selected with an amber/gold border, not the lime accent, which breaks 'lime means selected'. The lit slot's weapon icon is small.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 64px --ui-panel squares with a --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Set the selected border to --acc 2px. Move the controls hint out of the hotbar row, to mid-bottom left as the guide specifies, and use one 16px line.

findings.what: The 12 / 50 hero number is good, but the panel is a dark box with a thin border and is inset by about 10px from the screen edge, where the other blocks use a different margin. 'b / i backpack' is about 14px at low contrast, and the weapon name is right-aligned while the footer is left-aligned.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom edges to match the other corner blocks. Align the name, number and footer to the same edge. Raise the footer to 16px in --tx-2. Make the 12 --acc-coloured and the '/ 50' tx-2.

findings.where: banner, floating labels and distance chips: 'extract 146m', 'c 146m', 'in pillager's party', 'the long dock cache'
findings.what: There are several unrelated floating dark label pills with different paddings, radii, fonts and sizes. 'extract 146m' repeats as 'c 146m' at the right edge, which is the same line drawn twice. 'in pillager's party' sits in the middle of the room with no anchor.
findings.fix: Show the extract distance once, in the top-centre banner only. Delete the 'c 146m' edge chip or use just an arrow. Use one label style: 16px f-cond 600, --ui-panel at 80%, 4px radius, 8x4 padding. Anchor the party label to the player name tag.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a tiny green-on-black box jammed into the corner with no margin. It is a different style from every other chip, and it is left over from testing.
findings.fix: Move it inside the 48px margin and restyle it as a 14px --tx-2 label with a 1px --ui-line border and 4px radius, or remove it outside the party demo.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a set of unrelated boxes with different borders, fills, type sizes and positions. Most of last round's advice was ignored, and a capital letter remains on screen.

findings.what: The label still has a capital I ('run Info'). The bar is a full-width dropdown, so it is the heaviest top-right element and sits over the building art. The room tag 'the long dock cache' hangs underneath it.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Make it a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip at 16px, about 160px wide, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 48px inset from the screen edge. Move the room tag out from under it, to the top-left or into the run info chip.

findings.what: It is a dense four-row table at about 14px with tight row spacing. The value column is bright and the labels are not, so the whole box competes with the HUD. It is open by default. The 'value at risk' header is dim, and the panel has a different fill and border from the other chips.
findings.fix: Collapse it to the player's own row by default. Use a 24px row pitch and 16px labels, with names in tx-2 and values in tx-1. Pad it 16px on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is large condensed type in dark ink on a wide green bar. It is the loudest element on screen apart from the ammo. The bar is jammed against the bottom edge at x=24, which is inside the safe margin, and it nearly touches the weapon slots. The small 'pillager' bar at left (y≈335) is a second, unrelated health bar.
findings.fix: Make it a 20px 'hp 100' label with a 12px bar, filled in --ok on --ui-raised, inset 48px from the left and bottom edges. Drop the duplicate 'pillager' bar or fold it into the roster.

findings.what: The chip floats mid-left with no relation to the weapon or ammo. Its fill is darker than the rest, its border is a different weight, and its icon is a bare ring.
findings.fix: Put it just above the weapon slots at x=48. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 and the detail to 16px tx-2, with a 40px icon. Use lime only for the ring while the effect is active.

findings.where: contract notice, 'pillager joined' toast and ammo block
findings.what: The contract notice has an amber left bar and a lone yellow icon. The 'pillager joined' toast is a plain black box in the middle of the screen over the weapon bar. The ammo block is a third panel style with a wider radius. The three do not match.
findings.fix: Give all three the same --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Keep amber to a 3px --warn bar on the contract notice only. Move the toast to the left feed. Keep the 56px hero number for ammo only.

findings.what: The empty slots 3 and 5-0 are drawn as faint ghost icons at about 20% opacity, which adds clutter. The selected slot's amber border is correct, but 'f' and the ammo count sit at 14px or smaller. The 'fl controls' hint sits floating above slot 1, and 'fl' is probably an f1 glyph that reads as a typo.
findings.fix: Show only the occupied slots plus slot numbers. Set slot counts and key hints to 16px in tx-2. Render 'f1' with a clear key glyph and put it in the left-hand footer legend at 14px.

findings.what: The '14:57' timer is clear, but the sun icon beside it is dim and unlabeled. The teal 'extract 152m' chip is a different shape from every other chip. The distance is repeated at bottom-right ('c 152m'), which is a duplicate line.
findings.fix: Remove the bottom-right 'c 152m' and keep the top-centre one. Give the extract chip a 4px radius, --ui-panel fill and a 1px --extract border. Drop the sun icon or label it.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag has a green outline that matches nothing else. The two circular status icons (amber and teal rings) at the bottom-left are unlabeled and use colours that already mean P1 and P2 elsewhere.
findings.fix: Fold the input tag into the left feed or remove it. Give the status icons a --ui-panel backing with 16px labels, or drop them. Do not reuse the player colours for status.

v.verdict: The reload chip is a little clearer, but the HUD still looks like unrelated widgets: it has a capital letter, mixed panel styles, a duplicate extraction cue and a cramped hp bar.

findings.what: The word 'run Info' still has a capital I, which the all-lower-case order forbids. The bar is also a full-width dark strip with an arrow, so it matches no other panel.
findings.fix: Render it as 'run info'. Make it a 40px-high card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond text, 8px padding and a 48px right margin.

findings.what: It is still floating in mid-left, with no tie to the hp bar or the ammo block. The icon ring is teal, which is reserved for extraction. The title is about 20px, which is correct, but the sub-line is white at about 18px, so it competes with the title. There is no lime bar to show it is active.
findings.fix: Dock it 8px above the hp bar at x=48. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and a 3px lime bar on the left edge. Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 and the sub-line to 16px tx-2. Change the ring from teal to --acc.

findings.what: It is still flush against the screen edge at x~25 and y~1035-1068, in a loud flat green that is brighter than anything else on screen. The oversized 'hp 100' text is clipped by the bar, and the bar is 32px tall.
findings.fix: Move it to x=48 and bottom=48. Make it 24px tall with a dark --ui-panel track and an --ok fill. Put '100' inside it at 20px f-cond 700 and a 'hp' label at 16px tx-2. Keep the 56px size for ammo only.

findings.what: There are two panels with different fills, different border treatments and tiny text at about 14px. There is a 90px gap between them and no shared padding. The list shows four rows of dollar values that nobody needs to read mid-raid.
findings.fix: Use one panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 8px padding, 16px labels, 20px values and a 24px row pitch. Show 'you' by default and collapse the other rows behind the chevron. Stack the 'pillager' bar 8px under the list.

findings.where: 'c 152m' chip beside the arrow (right, y~485) and 'extract 152m' at the top
findings.what: The same distance appears twice. 'c 152m' is a cryptic abbreviation with unclear meaning, and it sits half over the building edge.
findings.fix: Delete the 'c 152m' chip and keep the edge arrow. Keep 'extract 152m' as the only distance readout, in a teal 16px chip with a 4px radius.

findings.where: bottom-left icon pair and 'f1 controls' hint
findings.what: The icons use two outline colours, orange and teal, with no meaning behind them. The 'f1 controls' hint is about 16px but sits on a busy blue floor at x~440 with a weak chip, and it is not on the slot bar's baseline.
findings.fix: Draw both icons 32px with 8px gaps and a --ui-line-hi outline, using --acc only when active. Make the hint 16px tx-2 with a --ui-panel backing and a single key chip. Align it to the slot bar's bottom edge at x=48.

findings.where: ammo card (bottom right) and slot bar
findings.what: The ammo block is strong and correctly the main hero element, but 'b / i backpack' is about 14px, and the card's edge is 12px from the screen edge, not 48px. The slot bar's numbers 3 and 5-0 are almost invisible against the floor, and the empty slots have no frame.
findings.fix: Pull the ammo card in to a 48px margin. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2. Give empty slots a 1px --ui-line outline on a --ui-panel fill at 60% opacity, with numbers in 16px tx-2.

findings.where: 'pillager joined' toast and 'the long dock cache' label
findings.what: These are two more panel styles: a black box with a thin border, and a smaller dark chip. The toast floats above the slot bar at y~910 and is not aligned with anything.
findings.fix: Use the shared panel style. Put the toast in the left feed column at x=48, with 16px text and 8px padding.

v.verdict: The active-reload chip is now a proper card, but the rest of the HUD still fights it: 'run Info' still has a capital I, the hp bar is still the loudest thing at bottom-left, and the tooltip, controls chip and player card are all still unstyled leftovers.

findings.where: top right 'run Info' dropdown, x1600-1900, y18-55
findings.what: The capital 'I' in 'run Info' is still there, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a 300px-wide black strip with a chevron. It is the widest and darkest box on the screen and carries almost no content.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Shrink the bar to about 200x40px, with a 4px radius, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 text. Keep the chevron at 16px in tx-2.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' numeral is about 36px high, set in a bar that is 32px tall and runs off the bottom edge. It is the loudest element on the screen and competes with the 56px ammo hero. The solid mid-green fill reads as a template bar and clips at the screen edge.
findings.fix: Make the bar 24px tall and 320px wide, with its bottom edge 16px above the screen bottom. Put 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 in --acc-ink or tx-1, inside the bar. Use --ok at 100% and --danger below 30%. Keep a 1px --ui-line border.

findings.where: 'pillager' card, left, y323-358, and the world tag above the player at y471
findings.what: The same P2 name appears twice. The card is a bare 160px strip with a green bar and a blue name, with no panel and no cyan P2 bar. The card's left edge is at x14 and the active-reload chip below it is at x8, so the left edges don't line up.
findings.fix: Keep the card and drop the world tag. Build it from the standard panel with a 3px --extract-free P2 cyan left bar, 16px tx-1 text and a 4px radius. Align its left edge with the list above and the chip below at x16, using 8px gaps.

findings.what: This floating black box sits in the middle of the playfield. It is an explaining sentence, it is not attached to anything, and it is the same size as the real HUD cards.
findings.fix: Delete it. If the party tag is needed, put it as a 16px tx-2 line inside the player card from the previous finding.

findings.what: The chip is much better. The icon, 20px title and 16px sub-line work, and the sub-line contrast is fine. But it uses a different fill, border and left edge than the cards above it, and the lime ring is on all the time rather than only while the buff is active.
findings.fix: Use the standard --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, with a left edge at x16 and an 8px gap under the player card. Show the lime ring only while the buff is active, and fade the chip out when the buff ends.

findings.what: The chip is a tiny 16px-tall black pill floating mid-screen above the hotbar. Its 'f1' key cap is barely distinguishable from the label and it is not on the left margin.
findings.fix: Move it to x16, directly above the hp bar. Make it a 32px-tall standard chip with a 24px key cap box, 16px text and a 4px radius.

findings.where: weapon slots 3 to 0, y960-980, and the slot 2 tile
findings.what: Empty slots 3 to 0 are bare 16px numerals floating over the world, so they have no tile and are hard to read on the busy ground. The slot 2 fist icon is tiny and its 'f' tag is almost illegible. The lime-vs-amber selected border is correct, but the other tiles carry no border at all.
findings.fix: Draw slots 3 to 0 as 64px tiles in --ui-panel at 60% opacity with a 1px --ui-line border and 16px tx-2 numerals. Give slot 2 the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px tx-2 numerals. Make the selected slot's border lime --acc, 3px.

findings.what: The panel is the only one with a 4px radius and a sensible header, but its rows are 14px type, below the 16px floor, and the 'value at risk' header is in dim grey. It also sits 8px from the screen edge while other HUD pieces sit at different offsets.
findings.fix: Set the rows to 16px f-cond 600 and the header to 16px tx-2. Use 8px row padding, set the left margin to 16px like the other HUD cards, and right-align the dollar values in tabular numerals.

v.verdict: The active reload chip now reads well, but the HUD around it is still a pile of mismatched boxes, with a capital in the dropdown, a wide empty bar, an unstyled hp bar and a hotbar that sits on top of the map.

findings.what: The capital 'I' is still on screen, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is about 300px wide and mostly empty, and it sits at x≈1600, off the 5% margin. The label is in a different font weight from the other blocks.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Shrink the bar to about 200x40 and align its right edge to 1824px (the 5% margin). Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and 16px f-cond 600 text.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is drawn on top of the green fill. It is a flat 400px bar with no track or border. It sits 24px from the left edge and almost touches the bottom, so it clips. The number is not a hero number, and the bar's green competes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Put a 32px f-cond 700 number to the left of a 320x16 bar. Give the bar a --ui-panel track and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and fill it with --ok. Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges, with 8px between the number and the bar.

findings.what: Rows are 18px apart, with 14 to 15px text. That is under the 16px minimum, and the row pitch is tight. The value column is crowded against the right edge. The 'you' row has no highlight, and there are no amber or cyan player chips. The panel hugs the left edge at x=8, not on the 96px margin. A 'pillager' health bar then floats unattached 30px below it.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels and 20px values on a 28px row pitch. Fill the 'you' row with --ui-raised and add a 3px amber P1 bar. Set the panel to x=96, 300px wide, with 16px padding. Dock the health bar 8px under the panel at the same left edge.

findings.where: bottom hotbar slots 1-0 and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: Slots 3 to 0 are bare numbers floating over the map, while slots 1 and 2 are filled boxes. The number 7 collides with a pickup. The amber slot-1 border reads as P1 colour, but lime should mean 'selected'. The 'f1 controls' chip sits on the water, 120px left of the hotbar, and is not in the mid-bottom-left position the guide specifies. The 'f1' text also uses an 'fl' glyph that looks like a typo.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px --ui-panel squares with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Move the controls hint to the mid-bottom left, as one 16px tx-2 line at x=96, y=1000. Use 'f1' in the f-cond key cap.

findings.what: The chip is better, but it floats 80px below the health bar and is not docked to it. It is 8px from the left edge, not on the margin. The 20px bold title is fine, but the +35% sub-line is under 16px. The lime ring is not on the --acc token.
findings.fix: Dock the chip 8px under the pillager health bar at the same x. Use 20px title and 16px tx-2 sub-line on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the ring stroke to --acc.

findings.what: The '12 / 50' hero number is good, but 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while 'b / i backpack' is left-aligned. The card edge sits at 1910, only 10px from the screen edge. The weapon name and the hint are about 14px and too faint.
findings.fix: Align both to the left. Set the card's right edge to 1824px (96px margin) and its bottom to 1000px. Make the weapon name 20px tx-1 and the hint 16px tx-2. Use a flat --ui-panel fill with a 1px border.

findings.where: extract chip and compass chip, top centre and right
findings.what: The 'extract 146m' chip is teal, which fits, but 'c 146m' at right is a separate 14px floating chip with its own arrow. 'the long dock cache' and 'in pillager's party' are further tooltip-style chips in a third style. There are 5 or more unrelated chip styles.
findings.fix: Use a single chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, 8px/16px padding. Allow --extract text only for the extract chip. Merge 'c 146m' into the extract chip.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is 20px tall and pinned to the corner at x=8, y=8, with a different green outline from every other panel. It reads as debug output.
findings.fix: Remove it, or fold it into the 'f1 controls' line as a 16px tx-2 text. If kept, put it on the 96px margin with the standard chip style.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but it is still a scatter of mismatched boxes with no shared panel treatment. The earlier fixes were mostly not applied, and capitals remain on screen.

findings.what: The label still has a capital I ('run Info'). It is a full-width dark bar with a chevron, 300px wide, that sits on the map and covers the room name. The earlier advice to make it a chip was not followed.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Make it a 160px --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius at 16px. Set it 48px from the right edge. Move the 'the long dock cache' tag to the top-left.

findings.where: 'fl controls' hint at x≈440,y≈940 and 'c 152m' tag at right (y≈485)
findings.what: The controls hint is lost in the middle of the map, so it does not sit at the mid-bottom left as the owner ordered. It reads 'fl' where it should read 'f1', and it is dim and small. The 'c 152m' tag is a truncated duplicate of the 'extract 152m' banner, which draws the same line twice.
findings.fix: Dock the hint at x=48 just above the hp bar, written 'f1 controls' at 16px tx-2 inside a --ui-panel chip. Delete the 'c 152m' tag, or fold it into the top-centre extract banner.

findings.what: The bar is a flat green slab with a 36px 'hp 100' label that is bigger than every other label. It has no panel, it is only 10px from the left edge, and it touches the bottom edge. The separate 'pillager' bar at y≈335 repeats the same information.
findings.fix: Use a 20px 'hp 100' label with a 12px bar on --ui-raised, inset 48px from the left and bottom edges. Remove the 'pillager' bar at y≈335.

findings.what: The roster is an open table with 14px text at a tight 18px row pitch. It sits on a black panel with no visible border, and the title and 'value at risk' header sit tight against the rows. This is a lot of explaining text for a quiet corner. The 'keyboard' tag above it uses a different chip style again.
findings.fix: Collapse the roster to the player's own row by default. Use a 24px row pitch, 16px text and 16px padding, with names in tx-2 and values in tx-1. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Give the 'keyboard' tag the same chip style.

findings.what: This chip is now a proper chip, but it floats alone mid-left, 8px from the edge, apart from the weapon slots. The 20px title is fine, but the +15% detail is small. The lime ring is correct.
findings.fix: Move it to x=48 directly above the weapon slots. Use a 40px icon, a 20px f-cond 600 title and a 16px tx-2 detail on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep lime on the ring only.

findings.where: contract notice, 'pillager joined' toast, ammo block
findings.what: The three use three different surfaces. The contract notice has an amber left bar and a 16px icon. The toast is a plain black box with sans text in the middle of the map. The ammo block has a larger radius and a heavy border. The toast also lands on top of the weapon slots.
findings.fix: Give all three --ui-panel, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Keep the 3px --warn bar on the contract notice only. Move the toast to the left feed. Keep the 56px hero number for ammo only, and use 16px for 'b / i backpack'.

findings.where: weapon slots 1-4 and empty slot ghosts 5-0
findings.what: The slot numbers and ghost silhouettes are about 30% contrast, which is below the 4.5:1 floor, and they look like noise on the map. Slot 3 is empty with no frame, so the row is uneven. The two bottom-left icons (hidden eye, clover) use mismatched amber and teal rings.
findings.fix: Draw the empty slots as a 1px --ui-line outline at 56px with 16px numerals in tx-2. Remove the ghost silhouettes. Give both status icons the same 1px --ui-line-hi ring and 48px size.

findings.what: The clock is a clear hero at 14:57, but the teal 'extract 152m' pill is a different shape from every other chip, and the sun icon next to the clock is an unexplained glyph.
findings.fix: Use the standard 4px-radius chip with a 1px --extract border and tx-1 text at 16px. Align the pill's centre to the clock at x=960, and either label the sun icon or remove it.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is still a patchwork of unrelated chip styles: only the hp bar and the reload chip were partly fixed, and 'run Info' keeps its capital letter, the duplicate 'c 152m' chip and the loose, unaligned top-left cluster.

findings.what: A capital 'I' is still on screen, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is a black strip with a chevron that sits flush against the map and clips into the building wall. It has no radius, no border and no right margin, and it looks like a different system from the other chips.
findings.fix: Render it as 'run info'. Make it a 40px-high card with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond text and 8px padding. Set its right edge at 48px from the screen edge and keep the chevron inside the padding.

findings.where: 'c 152m' chip with arrow (right, y~485) and 'extract 152m' (top centre)
findings.what: The distance is shown twice. The 'c 152m' chip was not deleted, and it floats half over a wall edge. The 'extract' chip's lime-yellow arrow under it is tiny and reads like a stray glyph.
findings.fix: Delete the 'c 152m' chip and keep only the edge arrow, with no label. Keep 'extract 152m' as the single readout in a teal 16px chip with a 4px radius. Remove the arrow tucked under the chip, or make it 16px and centred.

findings.what: The hp bar sits only 3px from the bottom edge and about 24px from the left edge, so it looks clipped. It is an unbordered flat green fill with no track. 'hp 100' is drawn at roughly 32px, which is larger than the 20px body size and competes with the ammo hero number. The status icons float loosely above it.
findings.fix: Move the bar to x=48 and bottom=48. Make it 24px tall on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put '100' inside it at 20px f-cond 700 and a 'hp' label at 16px tx-2. Align the two status icons to the bar's left edge, 8px above it.
