findings.what: The list is a dense black box, with 16px text and 14px sub-labels that are squeezed into 20px rows. It has no border and no radius, and it uses the 10px margin instead of 48px. The 'pillager' name bar below it is a different style again, with a tiny label and a thin green bar. The gap between the two (~80px) is arbitrary. The two do not align on a left edge with the reload chip or with the 'keyboard' tag.
findings.fix: Give both the same panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 8px padding. Set the left edge to x=48. Use 16px labels, 20px values and a 24px row pitch. Show only the 'you' row by default and collapse the rest behind the chevron. Stack the 'pillager' bar 8px below the list.

findings.what: The chip is plain black with no border, a 4px radius and no accent bar. The teal ring contradicts the rule that lime means selected, and the sub-line is smaller and dimmer than needed. It floats 130px above the hp bar and has no link to the rest of the HUD.
findings.fix: Dock the chip at x=48, 8px above the hp bar. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and a 3px --acc bar on the left edge. Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 and the sub-line to 16px tx-2. Change the ring from teal to --acc.

findings.where: ammo card (bottom right) and weapon slots (bottom centre)
findings.what: The ammo card's 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and low-contrast. The hero number is 56px and there is also a 'scav pistol' title above it, which is good. The empty slots 3 and 5-0 show faint ghost weapon icons that add clutter. The slot strip, the hp bar and the ammo card do not share a baseline.
findings.fix: Remove the ghost weapon icons from empty slots and keep only the faded slot numbers. Align the bottoms of the hp bar, the slot strip and the ammo card at 48px from the screen edge. Raise the 'backpack' hint to 16px tx-2.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (left, y~789) and 'f1 controls' tag (y~940)
findings.what: The banner is an explaining sentence, which is clutter. The left feed line has a different style from every other chip, with a gold bar and plain black fill. The 'f1 controls' chip is tiny and sits on the blue floor with poor contrast.
findings.fix: Shorten the banner to 'contract item nearby' and drop the explanation. Put it on the same --ui-panel chip style with a 3px --warn bar. Raise the 'f1 controls' chip to 16px on --ui-panel and place it at x=48, bottom=96.

findings.where: 'pillager joined' toast (centre, y~912) and 'keyboard' tag (top left)
findings.what: The toast is a plain black rectangle with 16px text that floats above the slot strip and overlaps the play area. The 'keyboard' tag is a tiny, differently styled chip that sits tight in the corner with a green border.
findings.fix: Restyle the toast as a --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and move it to the left feed with the other lines. Put the 'keyboard' tag on the same chip style with a 48px margin, or remove it.

v.verdict: The reload chip is better, but the run-info bar, hp bar, world tag and party tooltip are unchanged, and the screen is cluttered with floating tags and panels that don't match each other.

findings.what: The capital I is still there, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The bar is also still 300px wide and nearly black, with no border and no panel style, so it looks different from the other panels.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Make it 200x40px with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px f-cond 600 text. Make the chevron 16px in tx-2.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green block that runs against the bottom edge of the screen with no margin or border. The 'hp 100' text is oversized, and the green clashes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Make the bar 320x24px and put its bottom edge 16px above the screen bottom (y1040), with its left edge at x16 to match the other panels. Use 20px f-cond 600 text in tx-1 on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line border. Use --ok at full health and --danger below 30%.

findings.where: in-world tag 'pillager' above the player, x358-404, y463-483, plus the left card at y323-358
findings.what: The player is named twice: once in a world tag with a blue fill and once in a card. The card has an unlabelled green bar, and the names use two different type styles and colours.
findings.fix: Delete the world tag. Keep the card, with a 3px P2 cyan left bar, 16px tx-1 text, a 4px radius and a --ui-panel fill. Align its left edge to x16.

findings.where: bottom-centre 'in pillager's party' tooltip, x884-1036, y893-929
findings.what: The tooltip floats in the middle of the map with no anchor. It is explaining text and counts as clutter, and it overlaps the world.
findings.fix: Delete it. If the party tag is needed, add it as a 16px tx-2 line inside the player card.

findings.where: left column stack: pillagers list y143-242, card y323-358, reload chip y430-475
findings.what: The three panels have three different left edges (x8, x13 and x8), three widths and three different border treatments. This reads as unrelated boxes instead of a single system.
findings.fix: Put all three on x16 with 8px gaps between them. Give them the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 8px inner padding. Keep the reload chip's lime ring only while the buff is active.

findings.what: The chip is clearer, with a ring icon and an 'x1' count. But 'active reload x1' in 20px bold with a 15px sub-line makes it louder than the pillager card, and the sub-line is below the 16px minimum.
findings.fix: Make the title 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1 and the sub-line 16px in tx-2. Make the chip 192x44px. Do not use bold type for the title.

findings.where: bottom-left 'f1 controls' chip, x435-538, y929-953, and the hotbar slot numbers 3 to 0 at y960-975
findings.what: The chip floats mid-bottom over the pool tiles. The slot numbers 3 to 0 are 14px and almost invisible over the map. The chip is the only one that has a keycap style.
findings.fix: Anchor the chip at x16, y1008, as a 16px tx-2 line with a keycap. Show slot numbers at 16px tx-2 on a 60% scrim, or only on the slots that are filled.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag, x10-105, y5-32, and the 'c 146m' chip, x1810-1865, y487-513
findings.what: The tag and the chip use a green outline style that matches no other panel. The 'c 146m' chip has no label to say what 'c' is.
findings.fix: Restyle both with the standard panel, a 4px radius and 16px text. Change the chip to 'extract 146m' or add a teal --extract icon.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a set of unrelated boxes: a capital 'I' in 'run Info', an hp bar stuck to the bottom-left corner, a clipped hotbar and chips with mismatched padding, borders and type sizes. Almost none of the earlier advice has been applied.

findings.what: The capital 'I' is still on screen, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is about 300x36 with a chevron and hugs the top edge (y≈18). It reads as an unstyled web select and looks nothing like the player list opposite it.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Make the bar 200x40, right edge at x=1824, with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use 16px f-cond 600 text and a 12px chevron in tx-2.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 are drawn. Slots 3-0 are bare numbers floating over the map. The slots are about 100x100 with uneven sizing, and slot 2 has a 'f' tag but no selected state. The selected slot uses an amber border (#f5b73b-ish) instead of --acc, so 'lime means selected' is broken. The row also overlaps the wall art and has no panel behind it.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px --ui-panel squares with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps, centred at the bottom with 48px from the bottom edge. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Use 16px f-cond numerals in tx-2 at the top-left of each slot. Dim empty slots to 50%.

findings.what: The bar sits flush at the screen corner (x≈24, y≈1035-1068) with the label crammed inside the fill. It is 400px wide, loud and saturated mid-green, and the '100' sits on the fill with weak contrast. Its left edge matches nothing else. It is much heavier than the 'pillager' mini bar higher up, so there are two health bars in two different languages.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges. Put a 32px f-cond 700 number to the left of a 320x16 bar with a --ui-panel track, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill. Use the 16px label 'hp' in tx-2 and keep the number off the fill. Make the 'pillager' bar the same component.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers' panel and the 'pillager' bar below it
findings.what: The panel is flush at x=8 and the title and values are 16px, so the title and value rows are indistinguishable. The 'you' row has no highlight or P1 amber bar. The 'value at risk' header is dim and the chevron is cramped. The 'pillager' bar underneath is a different panel style (no border, 4px green line) and floats 40px away.
findings.fix: Set the panel to x=96, 300px wide, with 16px padding and a 28px row pitch. Use 16px tx-2 labels and 20px tx-1 values. Fill the 'you' row with --ui-raised and add a 3px amber bar at its left. Dock the pillager bar 8px under the panel at the same left edge and the same width.

findings.what: The chip is at x=8, 40px below the pillager bar, with no shared left edge. It has a 20px title and a 14px sub-line (below the 16px minimum) and a plain dark fill with a barely visible border. The ring icon is teal-white and not --acc. It is a third panel style on the same side.
findings.fix: Dock it 8px under the pillager bar at the same x and width. Use a 20px title and a 16px tx-2 sub-line on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the ring stroke to --acc and make the icon 32px.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' chip and 'in pillager's party' tag
findings.what: The 'f1 controls' chip sits at x≈435 on the left, on top of the pool area and just above the hotbar, in a style unlike the other chips. The 'in pillager's party' tag floats mid-screen over the world with no anchor, so it reads like debug text. The 'keyboard' tag top-left (green mono text, 105px) is a third tag style.
findings.fix: Move the controls hint to mid-bottom left as one 16px tx-2 line at x=96, y=1000, with 'f1' in an f-cond key cap. Anchor the party tag under the pillager list as a 16px tx-2 line. Restyle the 'keyboard' tag as the same chip with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px border, or remove it.

findings.what: The panel is the best-built element, but it is 242px wide and tight against the screen corner (x≈1668-1910, 10px margin). The 'b / i backpack' text is 14px at low contrast. The panel's border and radius do not match the left-hand chips.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px (right edge at x=1824, bottom at y=1032). Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2. Share the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius with every other HUD panel.

findings.what: The timer, a sun icon and the teal chip stack tightly. The teal chip overlaps the timer's baseline area and the arrow triangle floats below it. The 'c 146m' marker on the right edge is a second, unrelated distance readout with a clipped ring. The timer has no hero treatment.
findings.fix: Put the timer at 32px f-cond 700, with 8px between it and a 16px extract chip. Put the arrow inside the chip. Drop the duplicate 'c 146m' marker or pin it 48px from the right edge in the same chip style.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD is functional but scattered: it uses several panel styles, mixed type sizes and a capital letter, the hp bar dominates the screen, and the small corner widgets are hard to read.

findings.what: The label shows a capital 'I' ('run Info'), which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The bar is also a wide black strip with a chevron that matches no other panel, and it sits over the map with a floating 'the long dock cache' tag directly beneath it.
findings.fix: Render 'run info' fully lower case. Restyle the bar as --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and drop its width from about 300px to about 200px. Give the cache tag 16px of clearance from the bar.

findings.what: It is the largest and brightest element in the HUD: a 400px-wide flat green slab with oversized 'hp 100' text. It outweighs the ammo block, and its left edge touches the screen edge (about 24px) with no inset from the bottom. The text is not aligned to the weapon slots.
findings.fix: Reduce the bar to about 240px by 20px. Set the hp number in 20px f-cond. Use --ok for the fill with a --ui-panel track. Align its left edge to the 5% margin (96px) and its baseline to the weapon-slot row.

findings.what: It uses a heavy black fill with 14px-class type, a thin caret, and 'value at risk' in dim grey. It has no P1/P2 colour cue or divider, and 'you' looks the same as the other rows. It also overlaps the building and has a different border style from the ammo panel and the weapon slots.
findings.fix: Use 16px type with --tx-2 for the header and --tx-1 for rows. Mark the 'you' row with an amber 3px left bar and a --ui-raised fill. Match the border and radius of the ammo panel (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px). Add 8px row padding.

findings.what: The '10 / 50' hero number is good, but 'auto rifle' sits at the top right while 'b / i backpack' is about 12px at the bottom left, which is too small and low-contrast. Mixed alignment inside the panel looks accidental, and the panel hugs the screen corner.
findings.fix: Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px in --tx-2. Left-align both text lines to the same inset (16px). Keep the 56px hero number. Move the panel to the 5% margin, about 48px from the bottom and right edges.

findings.what: The empty slots 6/7/8/0 show faint ghost silhouettes that run into the map, and the slot numerals are small and low-contrast. The selected slot 3 has an amber border instead of lime, and 'pillager joined' sits awkwardly above it. The 'f' tag on slot 4 is unexplained.
findings.fix: Set the selected border to --acc, 2px. Make slot numerals 16px at --tx-2 or brighter. Remove the ghost icons, or dim the empty slots to 30% opacity on a --ui-panel fill. Move the toast to the left feed zone.

findings.what: The 'pillager' name plate is a small blue-text box with a thin green bar, a style used nowhere else. The 'keyboard' chip in the top-left corner is clipped at the screen edge and uses a monospace face with a green border, which is a third style.
findings.fix: Fold the plate into the shared panel style with --tx-1 text. Set the keyboard chip in f-cond 16px with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px inset from the screen edge.

findings.what: The two round amber and teal icons have no labels and are not aligned with 'f1 controls'. That chip sits on the map at an arbitrary position and is only about 14px. The controls hint should live mid-bottom-left per the owner's order, but it is dim and it floats.
findings.fix: Put 'f1 controls' in a 16px --tx-2 chip with a --ui-panel fill, at the 48px left margin, 16px above the weapon slots. Group the icons on the same baseline, 8px apart.

findings.what: '14:57' is in the hero position but only about 28px, below the 56px hero spec. The extract chip is teal, correct for extraction, but 'extract 152m' is duplicated by the 'c 152m' marker at the right edge. The duplicate is clutter, and the 'c' label is cryptic.
findings.fix: Keep one extract readout: the top-centre chip, or an edge arrow with only the distance. Remove the 'c' prefix. Set the timer to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD has the right pieces but they are scattered, use mismatched type sizes, and the left side is crowded. Several panels fight for attention, the ammo number is the only clear hero, and the hp bar is oversized and clipped at the bottom-left.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat saturated green slab with a 'hp 100' label. It touches the bottom-left edge with no margin and is the loudest element on screen next to the ammo card. It has no panel, border or radius, so it is inconsistent with every other HUD box, and its green clashes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Inset it to 5% margins (48px from the left, 32px from the bottom). Reduce it to 14px tall inside a 4px-radius --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1, and use --ok for the fill.

findings.where: left column: 'current pillagers' list, 'pillager' bar, 'active reload x2' chip
findings.what: Three unrelated boxes sit at different x offsets, widths, heights and type sizes (about 14px rows, a 16px name, a 20px chip title). Their gaps are uneven, which makes the left edge look like leftover pieces. The 'pillager' bar floats with no panel, and the list rows are too small and tight for a couch at 1080.
findings.fix: Stack them in one 8px-grid column at x=48 with a shared width (about 320px), 8px gaps, and --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the list rows to 16px minimum with 8px row padding. Give the 'pillager' bar the same panel as the others.

findings.what: Hierarchy is flat. The 56px ammo '12 / 50' reads first and the extract timer 14:57 is the second hero, but the quick-slot bar, the 'f1 controls' chip, the 'in pillager's party' toast and the bright 'active reload' ring all compete at similar weight. Lime is used only on the selected slot, which is good, but the teal extract pill and the yellow slot border are close in strength.
findings.fix: Keep one hero (ammo) at --fs-hero. Drop the timer to 32px. Make the party toast and controls chip --tx-2 at 16px with no border so they recede. Give the active reload chip a 16px label and no glow.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' label
findings.what: The 'run info' bar is a wide 300px empty strip with a chevron and a lot of dead space. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats below it with no connection. Neither matches the left-hand panel styling (different border and fill, 14-16px text), and the dock cache tag looks like a stray tooltip.
findings.fix: Shrink 'run info' to a fit-content pill, 40px tall, with 16px text in the shared panel style. Attach the location name as a second line inside the same panel, or move it into the top-centre banner. Align the right edge to x=1872 (48px margin).

findings.what: Slot numbers 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0 float as bare grey digits over the map with no cells, so empty slots are unreadable against the terrain. Slots 1 and 3 have different border treatments (yellow-orange vs dark). The yellow-orange selected border is amber, not --acc lime. Slot 1 also carries a white '50' while slot 3 uses an 'f' key badge, so the two cells are inconsistent.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 64px cells with --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Use a 2px --acc border for the selected slot only, 16px --tx-2 numerals inside the cell, and the same ammo count position in every filled cell.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' toast and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The party toast is a separate black box with 16px text floating mid-screen above the slot row. It is the only centred message and has no icon or role. The 'f1 controls' chip has a different dark fill and a tiny key cap. Both sit on busy tile art, with weak separation from the background.
findings.fix: Use one pill style (--ui-panel at 0.9 alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px text). Put 'f1' in a key cap at 16px. Place the controls chip at x=48 above the hp bar, and the party toast as a top-centre banner under the clock, per the one-place-per-line rule.

findings.what: The ammo card is the strongest element and the right idea (hero number), but 'scav pistol' is right-aligned at about 20px while 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and tucked at the bottom-left of the card. The inner alignment is mixed, and the card sits 12px from the screen edge, off the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Left-align the weapon name (20px f-cond 600) and the hint (16px --tx-2) on the same inner 16px padding. Inset the card 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom. Keep 12 at 56px 800 and '/ 50' at 32px --tx-2.

findings.what: The extraction pointer 'c 146m' is a tiny 14px black tag with a teal arrow and a faint arc, sitting hard against the right edge. It duplicates the 'extract 146m' pill at the top centre, so the distance is shown twice.
findings.fix: Keep one: either the top-centre pill or the edge arrow. If the edge arrow stays, make it a 16px teal-bordered tag inset 24px from the edge and drop the distance text from it.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has working pieces, but it is scattered and its type sizes, panel styles and colours are inconsistent. Several lines compete with each other, and the lower-left and top-right corners look unresolved.

findings.what: Every widget uses a different container. The top-left list is a hard black box with a white border. The run info pill is rounded with a chevron. The extract chip is teal outlined. The ammo card is a different dark square. The 'pillager joined' toast is a black rectangle. The 'active reload' card has a ring icon. The guide asks for one panel fill (--ui-panel), 4px radius and one border.
findings.fix: Use one panel: #16191b fill, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 8px padding. Apply it to the pillagers list, run info, active reload, toast, ammo and controls chip. Drop the extra white and teal outlines.

findings.what: The text is about 14-15px, which is under the 16px minimum for anything read. Names and values sit tightly stacked with no row dividers. The header 'value at risk' is muted grey on near-black, and the box has no padding on the left. It is the largest block on screen yet carries no hierarchy. 'you' is not marked as P1 amber, and it is the same weight as the other rows. Money is shown correctly with '$'.
findings.fix: Set rows to 20px f-cond 600 with a 32px row height and 1px #2e3337 dividers. Set the header to 16px tx-2. Add 16px padding. Give 'you' an amber (P1) tag or bar. Show only the other pillagers' $ value in tx-1.

findings.what: The 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' line is an explaining sentence with a yellow bar. It also sits in the left feed next to the active reload card. The controls hint 'f1 controls' is small and floats in the middle of the map. 'c 152m' near the right edge repeats the 'extract 152m' banner. 'b / i backpack' is tiny text inside the ammo card. Several different spots are showing small instructions.
findings.fix: Cut the 'gold glow marks the box' explanation to 'contract item nearby'. Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' marker or turn it into a bare arrow. Merge the hints into the single f1 controls line at the mid-bottom left, set at 16px with the pad focus style. Remove 'b / i backpack' or set it at 14px in the card footer.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is an oversized bright green bar with 40px text that sits on the map, and it touches the bottom and left screen edges (about 24px, 1034-1068). The bar is the loudest element on screen next to the ammo number. It has no panel, and the text sits on a flat green fill with no label alignment. The two status icons above it (amber and teal rings) are unlabelled and unexplained. The 'pillager' health plate floating at 330 left duplicates the HP.
findings.fix: Put hp in a panel at the 5% safe margin (54px left, 54px bottom). Use a 12px tall bar and a 32px number with an 'hp' label at 16px. Align it with the weapon slots. Label or group the two status icons into one 40px chip row. Remove the second HP plate or fold it into the list.

findings.what: The slot row is hard to read. The numbers 2, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are faint, sit at different heights, and the ghost weapon silhouettes bleed into the map. The selected slot has an amber border, but lime is meant to be the selected colour. Slots 3 and 4 show identical blue rifles with an 'f' tag chip that has no explanation. The row runs under the screen edge on the right, and the ammo values at 50 are tiny.
findings.fix: Use a uniform 96x96 slot with a 4px radius and the panel fill. Draw the selected slot with a 2px #e6ff3d border. Set the key number at 16px tx-2 in the same top-left corner for every slot. Hide empty slots or draw them at 30% opacity inside their own panel. Set ammo at 16px bold.

findings.what: The hierarchy is right: 12 / 50 is a big hero number. But the card is pushed against the right and bottom edges (about 12px margin), and the '/ 50' competes with 12. The 'scav pistol' name is light grey and thin.
findings.fix: Move the card in to the 5% margin (96px right, 54px bottom). Set 12 at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1, '/ 50' at 32px tx-2, and the name at 20px.

findings.where: top-right run info and the dock cache label
findings.what: The 'run info' dropdown has odd capitalisation: 'run Info' shows a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. It is wide and mostly empty, and it overlaps the building edge. 'the long dock cache' is a white pill that sits next to it with no consistent style.
findings.fix: Change to 'run info' in lower case. Narrow the dropdown to its content, 240px, with the standard panel. Style the cache label as a 16px tx-2 map label with no fill.

findings.what: The timer (14:57) is a good hero. However, the sun icon is crowded beside it, and the extract chip below it is a different teal outlined pill with a tiny arrow pointing at the timer, which is cramped. The timer uses a light weight and has no panel, so it loses contrast over the walls.
findings.fix: Put the timer at 56px f-cond 800 on a panel strip. Put the extract chip under it with 8px spacing, 20px text, extract teal (#47d8c6) text only, and no outline.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD reads clearly and keeps to lower case, but it is a pile of mismatched widgets: five different panel styles, four competing readouts in the bottom-left, and no clear hero element.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, saturated green slab with oversized 'hp 100' text. It is the biggest, brightest element on screen and nothing in the style guide supports it. It uses a different font size and bar style from the pillager bar above it, and the text clips against the bar's top edge. The bar sits flush against the screen edge, outside the 5% margin, and runs under the weapon slots.
findings.fix: Rebuild it as a 16px-tall bar with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on a --ui-panel fill, using --ok for the fill. Put the hp value at 20px f-cond 700, inset 24px from the left and bottom. Keep it clear of the slot row, with at least 16px between them.

findings.what: This is correctly the hero element (10 / 50), but the '10' is about 60px and the '/ 50' is a separate italic size. The weapon name 'auto rifle' is right-aligned while 'b / i backpack' is left-aligned, so the card has two alignment axes. The card sits 10px from the screen edge, not the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Set the number to --fs-hero 56px f-cond 800, with '/ 50' at 32px in --tx-2 on the same baseline. Right-align every line in the card. Add a 3px --acc underline or low-ammo state. Inset the card 48px from the edges.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers' list, 'pillager' bar and top-right 'run info'
findings.what: Three differently styled panels sit in the corners: a black table with a chevron, a tiny bar with a blue-tinted fill, and a dropdown. Their corner radii, border treatments, paddings and font sizes (about 14 to 20px) all differ. The 'pillager' label sits flush against its bar with no padding. The $ list is dense, with 14px rows and a 'value at risk' column that has low contrast.
findings.fix: Give all three the same chrome: --ui-panel at 90% alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Set row text at 16px minimum. Put 'value at risk' in --tx-2. Make the list's row height 24px, and align the three panels to one 48px left or right margin.

findings.what: The slot numbers 1 to 0 float as bare grey digits, and only slots 1 and 3 have tiles. The empty slots 2 and 4–0 are unmarked and low contrast against the busy map, so the row reads as inconsistent. The selected slot has an amber border, which clashes with the 'lime = selected' rule. The 'f' key chip and the '50' ammo count are tiny, at about 12px.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border. Draw the selected tile with a 2px --acc border, not amber. Set the ammo count at 16px f-cond 600 and the key hints at 14px.

findings.where: top-centre timer, extract chip and compass
findings.what: The timer '14:58' is white on the map with only a thin shadow, so its contrast is weak. The sun icon beside it is unexplained. The teal 'extract 146m' chip sits directly under the timer, and a second 'c 146m' chip with an arrow floats at the right edge, so the same distance is shown twice. The 'the long dock cache' tooltip sits loose in the map with no relationship to any element.
findings.fix: Put the timer on a --ui-panel plate at 32px f-cond 700. Show the extract distance once, either in the teal chip or the edge arrow. Tie the cache label to its object or remove it.

findings.what: The hint sits mid-bottom-left at about 16px, centred on nothing and floating over the pool. The key chip is a different grey from the other chips, and the text is small. It is correctly folded to one line, but it competes with the slot bar directly beside it.
findings.fix: Anchor it to the left margin at x=48 and 16px above the hp bar. Use the shared key-chip style (--ui-raised fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border). Keep the text at 16px in --tx-2.

findings.what: The tag is a green-outlined chip in a mono-like face, unlike every other element. It is a second font and accent colour on the HUD and is clipped to the corner with no margin.
findings.fix: Restyle it as a standard panel chip in --f-cond 16px --tx-2, inset 24px from the corner. Or drop it, since the device is already named in the prompts.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD has a strong ammo block and hp bar, but it is cluttered with scattered boxes in different styles, capital letters, and duplicated extraction info.

findings.where: run info header (top right), pillager name tags, the 'run info' label
findings.what: A capital 'I' shows in 'run Info'. The owner ordered all lower case with no exceptions outside art.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info' and check every HUD string for capitals. Do not use text-transform or a font whose small caps look like capitals.

findings.where: extraction info: the teal 'extract 152m' pill at top centre and the 'c 152m' chip with an arrow at right
findings.what: The same distance is drawn twice, and the right-hand chip is truncated to 'c 152m'. This breaks the rule that every line shows in one place. The two chips also use different styles from each other.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre pill only. Delete the right-edge chip, or if an edge arrow is needed, draw the arrow alone with no text. Use one 16px label size.

findings.where: left column: the 'current pillagers 3' list, the 'pillager' bar, the 'active reload x3' card and the 'contract item nearby' toast
findings.what: Four boxes with four different looks: different widths, left edges (8, 14 and 16px), fills, corner radii and type sizes. The list is dense, 14px-ish text with little contrast. No shared panel token is used, so the column reads as stacked leftovers.
findings.fix: Put every left item on one 16px left margin with the same --ui-panel fill, a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 16px for label text and 20px for names. Give each item 8px spacing. Fold the 'pillager' bar into the list or the hp block.

findings.where: hierarchy: hp bar (bottom left) against the ammo block (bottom right)
findings.what: The hp bar is a big flat green slab with oversized 'hp 100' text and has no panel. The ammo block is a dark card with a 56px hero number. The two read as different games. The hp bar also fights the ammo for first attention, and the green is a loud fill.
findings.fix: Put hp in the same dark --ui-panel card as the ammo block, with a 32px number, a 12px bar and label text in --tx-2. Reserve the only hero number (56px) for ammo.

findings.where: hotbar slots 1 to 5 and the faded slots 6 to 0
findings.what: Slot 2 holds a fist icon with an 'f' key badge. The icon sizes and fills are uneven. The numbers 3 and 5 float outside empty slots. The ghost weapon silhouettes for slots 6 to 0 add noise and clip into the barrel and the tree.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 100 by 100px tile on an 8px gap, with the number inside the top-left corner. Show only the filled slots plus at most 2 empty ones. Remove the ghost silhouettes.

findings.where: 'fl controls' (bottom left centre) and 'pillager joined' toast (bottom centre)
findings.what: 'fl controls' uses a faint tag over a busy tile area and its low contrast hurts legibility. The 'pillager joined' toast is centred above the hotbar, so it collides with the hotbar's space and breaks the left-feed rule.
findings.fix: Give 'fl controls' a solid --ui-panel fill with --tx-1 text. Move 'pillager joined' into the left feed with the other messages, since that feed is the only place lines are meant to show.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' chip and the 'run info' dropdown with its chevron
findings.what: Both are small boxes in the corners with different heights and borders. 'keyboard' is cramped, and the 'run info' bar is wide with a lot of dead space. The two look like debug or template widgets.
findings.fix: Make both 32px tall with the same panel token. Cut the 'run info' dropdown to its content width, about 160px. Make the 'keyboard' chip match.

findings.where: world and HUD contrast: the 'pillager' tag over the player, the lime 'pillager' label and the amber 'contract item nearby' toast
findings.what: The player tag is a tiny blue-on-blue label that blends into the water. Accent colours are used inconsistently. The amber toast with its gold bar sits right beside lime and gold, and it is hard to tell which one means 'selected'. Per the guide, P1 is amber and P2 is cyan.
findings.fix: Put a --ui-void plate at 80% opacity behind the world name tags and use 16px text. Keep lime for the selected hotbar slot only. Make the contract toast a --warn glyph with --tx-1 text.

v.verdict: The lime call-to-action leads correctly, but the title is a gold gradient with a glow, the saves block is crammed and low in contrast, and the screen is mostly empty and generic, so it reads as a template title card.

findings.what: The title is a heavy amber-orange vertical gradient with a drop glow in a fat display face. This breaks the guide's flat-dark-panel look, the ban on gradients, and the Barlow Condensed title style. It also puts a second hot colour right above the lime button, and amber is the P1 colour. At about 90px it competes with the CTA, so the screen has two 'bold' places.
findings.fix: Make the title flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) in f-cond 800 at 56px (--fs-hero) with no gradient or glow. Keep the lime button as the only hot element. If a brand colour is wanted, use a 3px lime bar under the title.

findings.where: saves section ('saves' label, 'pillager new' row, name field row)
findings.what: The save row and the create row look like one clump. The row has a lime border and lime text, which is a second use of lime next to the main button. Its meta text '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is dim grey at about 15px. The input, 'change name' and 'create a new save' sit tight together at 8px gaps with no grouping. The input field looks like another button.
findings.fix: Use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border for the row. Show the selected state as a 3px lime left bar, with name text in --tx-1 at 20px. Put the meta in --tx-2 at 16px. Add 24px of space above the create row. Give the input a visible placeholder and a line-only style so it differs from the buttons.

findings.what: This is a small dim grey line that looks like a caption but is probably a clickable action. It has no button treatment, no focus state and about 12-13px text, so it is unreadable from a couch. It sits 18px under the CTA and is not clearly tied to anything.
findings.fix: If it is interactive, make it a secondary button at the same 558px width, 48px high, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 20px text. If it is only a label, delete it.

findings.what: There are too many small sizes. 'saves' is about 15px light grey, the version stamp is about 13px, the key hints are about 15px, the tagline is about 18px, and the top-right buttons are about 15px. Several of these fall below the 16px minimum and the contrast is low (the 'saves' label, the key-hint words and the version stamp are around 3:1).
findings.fix: Limit sizes to 56, 32, 20, 16 and 14. Set the tagline, the 'saves' label and the key-hint words to 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Keep 14px only for the version stamp, and keep the stamp in --tx-2.

findings.where: top-right 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' buttons, top-centre 'keyboard' chip
findings.what: The two buttons are identical outlined boxes with no icons and tiny text. They sit 100px from the right edge, which is off the 5% margin. The teal 'keyboard' chip floats alone at the top centre. It is the only teal item on the screen and teal is reserved for extraction, so its meaning is unclear and it looks like a stray debug label.
findings.fix: Align the buttons to the 5% margin (x=1824 to 1824) and give them a 16px label with 40px height. Turn the 'keyboard' chip into a plain --tx-2 device label with no border, or drop the teal. Do not use --extract for device state.

findings.what: All content sits as a narrow 558px column in the centre while the top 330px and the bottom 300px are empty. The vignette is the only background, so there is no sense of place and no art, which makes it feel like a generic template and not ARC Raiders x Zero Sievert. The title, CTA and saves are spaced unevenly (title to tagline 40px, tagline to CTA 30px, CTA to saves 50px).
findings.fix: Put a key-art or a dim environment plate behind the column (at 30-40% opacity under the --scrim). Set the vertical rhythm to 8px multiples (32/24/48). Move the whole stack up by about 60px so the optical centre is higher.

findings.what: Five hints (wasd move, mouse aim, lmb fire, e search, f1 controls) sit in a loose row. The keycaps are bright white boxes that pull more attention than the lime-free body, while the labels are thin dim grey. The row is also near the bottom edge, 40px from it. It explains controls on a title screen, which is clutter, and it is also missing a device-aware gamepad version for P2.
findings.fix: Keep it only if needed. Restyle the keycaps as --ui-raised boxes with a --ui-line-hi border and --tx-1 16px text, and set the labels to --tx-2 16px. Space the pairs 32px apart and pull the legend up to the 5% bottom margin (54px).

findings.what: The button is a good primary, but it is a flat 558x56 slab with a 4px corner and no focus ring, hover state or pad prompt, so it is not clear that it is selected. The label is 20px and light for such a large fill, and there is no bounce or accent detail as the guide promises for Fortnite-style CTAs.
findings.fix: Raise the label to 24px f-cond 800 in --acc-ink. Add a 2px outer focus ring in --tx-1 with a 4px offset when focused. Show a key or pad glyph on its right end (e.g. 'enter'). Use --acc-hover on hover and --acc-press on press, with a 90ms scale of 1.02.

v.verdict: This is a different screen from the HUD I reviewed before, the walk-up 'tonight's best' card: it is clean and lower case, but it is a tiny, empty card with a weak empty state, and a stray 'player 2' tag from the world shows through the scrim.

findings.what: The amber in-world tag is sharper and brighter than everything else behind the scrim. It is not blurred or dimmed with the rest of the scene, so it competes with the card and looks like a bug.
findings.fix: Hide world-space name tags while any modal is open, or dim them to the same 80% scrim. Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) so the scene sits back more.

findings.what: The card's only content is a small ~20px line in tx-1, left-aligned in a large dead area. It reads as a placeholder, and the player gets no sense of what this screen is for.
findings.fix: Centre it in the body. Set it to 20px --tx-2 inside a 96px-tall body block. Add a ghost row skeleton (3 rows of 40px, 1px --ui-line dividers, with rank, name and sp columns) so the empty state still reads as a scoreboard.

findings.where: 'press any key' prompt (bottom right of the card)
findings.what: The primary action is the right size in weight but small at ~22px for a couch at 1080. The lime dot is the only accent, and the prompt sits on the same line as the divider with only about 20px of padding.
findings.fix: Set the prompt to 24px f-cond 700 with a 16px gap after the dot. Give it a 24px gap below the divider and 24px above the card bottom. Keep tx-1 text and the lime dot.

findings.where: x button (top right of the card, 1159-1206 x 430-476)
findings.what: On a screen that continues on any key, a boxed x is a second, redundant action. It also reads as a clickable affordance that the prompt already covers, which is clutter.
findings.fix: Remove the x on this walk-up card. If it must stay, make it a bare 20px glyph in --tx-2 with no border, 24px from the card corner.

findings.what: The card is about 29% of the screen width, while the style guide asks for a centred card of nearly 90% of the screen. It reads as a small alert box, not a scoreboard. The 36px lime stub at the top-left edge is an unexplained detail that looks like a rendering glitch.
findings.fix: Widen the card to at least 960px, or 50% of the screen width, with a 56px header and a 72px footer row. Either make the lime bar the full width of the card top at 3px, or delete it.

findings.what: A bold ~28px wordmark sits unframed in the corner over the busy scene. It competes with the card title, and the guide says boldness goes in one place per screen. It also lines up with nothing.
findings.fix: Dim it to --tx-2 at 20px, or drop it while the card is open. If it stays, align it to the 5% margin (96px), which it already does, and put it on the card's scrim layer.

findings.what: The blurred demo scene shows saturated coloured circles and tinted blocks behind the card, so the focus area is noisy. The dark vertical bars at the left and right edges look like a letterbox mismatch.
findings.fix: Use a 12px blur and the .80 scrim, plus a 40% radial vignette toward the edges, so the card area is the calmest part of the image.

v.verdict: This is the in-raid HUD, not the walk-up card I reviewed before. The ammo block reads well, but the widgets use mixed panel styles and type sizes, some lines are drawn twice, and the bottom edge is cluttered.

findings.where: top-centre 'extract 152m' banner and right-edge 'c 152m' arrow chip
findings.what: The extraction distance is drawn twice, and the right chip is clipped ('c 152m') and reads as a bug. This breaks the 'every raid line in ONE place' rule.
findings.fix: Delete the 'c 152m' chip and keep only the teal top-centre banner. If an edge arrow is needed, make it a bare 24px teal arrow with no text. Set the banner text to 20px f-cond 600.

findings.where: bottom hotbar (slots 3 and 5-0 ghost icons) and 'pillager joined' toast (about 960,911)
findings.what: The six empty ghost slots add clutter and noise. The toast sits on top of the hotbar row at the same height as slot 4, so it reads as part of the bar.
findings.fix: Show only the occupied slots 1, 2 and 4, plus one dimmed spare. Remove the ghost weapon silhouettes and the numerals 5-0. Move the toast into the left feed, or to 96px above the hotbar. Set the toast to 16px with an 8px gap.

findings.what: The bar is a flat, wide, saturated green slab with 'hp 100' at a size that competes with the 12/50 ammo hero. It is also tight against the screen edge and the bottom of the hotbar.
findings.fix: Make the bar 8px tall and 320px wide on a dark --ui-panel track. Show 'hp 100' as 20px f-cond 700 above it. Keep a 32px margin from the screen edge. Use --ok green, with danger red below 30%.

findings.where: left widgets: 'current pillagers' panel, 'pillager' name plate, 'active reload x3' chip, 'contract item nearby' strip
findings.what: Four different panel treatments (hairline box, bare bar, circle chip, amber-edge strip) in different widths and text sizes of roughly 14-22px. The contract strip carries an explaining sentence ('gold glow marks the box'). The result is stacked clutter with no shared left edge.
findings.fix: Use one panel: --ui-panel at 80% fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 8px/16px padding. Align them all to x=32 with 16px vertical gaps. Set label text to 16px and values to 20px. Cut the 'gold glow marks the box' clause so it reads 'contract item nearby'.

findings.where: world label 'pillager' (about 440,551) and the top-left 'pillager' name plate
findings.what: The player's name is shown twice, once on the HUD plate and once as a world tag. The world tag is blue, which collides with the rule that P1 is amber.
findings.fix: Remove the HUD name plate and keep the world tag, recoloured to --warn amber for P1. Or remove the world tag and keep only the HUD plate.

findings.what: The 'I' in 'run Info' looks like a capital. The wide 300px bar with a chevron is a different widget from the 'value at risk' panel's chevron, and it sits far from the top-right 1x1 list.
findings.fix: Check that the font's lowercase 'i' is not rendering as a capital. Set the header to 16px f-cond 600 in the same panel style as the left widgets. Cap the width at 200px.

findings.what: Two unlabelled round icons (a crossed-out eye and a green glyph) have no meaning at a glance. The amber and teal ring colours clash with the player-colour rule.
findings.fix: Make them 40px chips on the standard panel, with a 16px label or a 16px key hint under each. Give both the same --ui-line-hi ring and tint only the glyph.

findings.what: The chip is tiny, around 16px, and low contrast against the blue-teal floor. It sits on top of the room art and is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Put it on the standard panel (--scrim fill) with 16px tx-1 text and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Align it to the hotbar's left edge, 16px above the bar.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen the earlier notes described, and it is a readable but scattered pile of unrelated boxes. Margins, type sizes, panel styles and the focal point all differ from piece to piece, and the roster, a duplicate extract marker and the floating hotbar numbers add clutter.

findings.where: left column: roster panel, 'pillager' name bar, 'active reload x3' buff card
findings.what: Three differently styled boxes are stacked at x=8 with uneven gaps of about 90px and 30px. Their widths are 358, 155 and 203. The roster uses 16px text with a divider line, the name bar is a bare fill, and the buff card has a teal ring icon and 20px text. None of them sits on the 5% margin (96px).
findings.fix: Put all left-column modules in one stack at x=48, 16px apart, with the same width of 360. Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Give every module a 16px --tx-2 header.

findings.where: 'pillager' health bar (x=17, y=325) vs the 'hp 100' bar (bottom-left)
findings.what: Player health is drawn twice, as a small teal bar and as a large green bar. The large bar is flush to the screen edge at x=24 and sits 5px from the bottom. Its 'hp 100' label is oversized, uses a different type weight, and has no panel behind it. It is the loudest element on screen and also the least aligned.
findings.fix: Keep one health readout: a 320x24 bar at x=48, bottom=48. Use --ok for the fill on a --ui-panel track, with a 20px 'hp 100' label in --tx-1 beside it. Delete the left-column bar, or turn it into a squad-only element.

findings.where: hotbar slots 3 to 0 (y=968) and the slots 1 and 2
findings.what: Slots 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are bare floating digits drawn over the map with no cell and no contrast. Slot 7 collides with a prop. Slots 1 and 2 are 100px tiles, so the row reads as two big tiles plus loose numerals. The lime-yellow outline on slot 1 is the only clear focus cue, and the 'f' badge in slot 2 is tiny.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with 8px gaps, each with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show the selected slot with a 3px --acc outline and a 16px number in --tx-2. Hide empty slots, or dim them to 40%.

findings.what: The same extract distance is shown twice, and the second copy is a tiny white label with a teal arrow that is cut by the right edge and fights the teal arc. The clock '14:57' is a 28px hero element that sits right next to a small pill. Together they form a cramped cluster with no clear first read.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre pill only and drop the edge 'c 146m' tag. Show direction as a 16px teal arrow inside the pill, set the pill to 32px high with 16px text, and keep a 16px gap below the clock. Let the 56px --fs-hero size go to the timer when it is under 60s.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' tag
findings.what: The collapsed 'run info' bar is a dark pill, 298px wide and 38px high, with a chevron. It has a different border and fill from the roster panel and sits at x=1603, which is 17px from the edge, not on the margin. The 'I' of 'info' reads as a capital. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats under it with no alignment to the bar. The empty bar wastes the corner.
findings.fix: Make 'run info' a 160px collapsed chip, right-aligned at x=1872, using the same panel recipe as the roster. Verify the text is all lower case. Dock the location tag as a 16px --tx-2 line inside the same panel.

findings.what: The 12 is the right hero number, but the panel is 240px wide with a 3px yellow-tinted border and 20px weapon text in a different alignment from the left panels. The 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and low contrast. The panel is 10px from the edge instead of the margin.
findings.fix: Right-align it at x=1872, bottom=48. Make the 12 --fs-hero 56px in --tx-1 and '/ 50' 20px in --tx-2. Show 'scav pistol' at 16px in --tx-2 and the hint at 16px, and use the same border as the other panels.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' chip (x=435, y=940) and 'in pillager's party' toast (y=912)
findings.what: The controls chip is a translucent badge with 16px text. It sits over a wall, has a different fill from the other chips, and is close to the hotbar. The party toast is a 150px black box in the middle of the playfield with 16px text and no icon, so it is a stray rectangle. The two are not aligned to each other.
findings.fix: Dock the controls hint to the left stack at x=48, 16px above the hp bar, as a --ui-panel chip with a --ui-line-hi border. Move the party line into the roster header, or fade it after 3s, and drop the centred box.

findings.what: A green-outlined chip sits in the corner at x=10, y=7. Its 14 to 16px text uses the extract teal or ok green for device state, which breaks the colour rules, and it overlaps no other element, so it only adds clutter.
findings.fix: Remove the chip from the raid HUD. If a device label is required, show it as 16px --tx-2 text with no border, at x=48, y=24.

v.verdict: The earlier clutter fixes (ghost hotbar icons, the extra left widgets and the name plate) are mostly in, but a blocking 'want easy mode?' modal now sits mid-screen with an oversized lime slab and a lone unlabeled '9', and the HUD around it is still crowded and uneven.

findings.what: The modal is a flat black rectangle with a 1px border, no scrim, and a 4px radius that barely shows. The world stays fully bright behind it, and the card collides with the extract banner (y 261) and the score panel above it. The title is a 32px bold left-aligned line with a lot of dead space around it. The '9' countdown at the top right has no label or ring, so it reads as a stray number.
findings.fix: Add a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) full-screen layer behind the card. Shrink the card to about 640x300 and centre it at y=540, so it clears the HUD. Put the '9' in a 56px --fs-hero style or a 40px countdown ring, or fold it into the 'no' button as 'n no 9'. Set the title to 32px with 32px padding.

findings.what: The lime fill is a huge 405x100 slab. It is the loudest thing on screen and the default is 'yes' to easy mode, which nudges the player toward it. The 'n no' button is a black rectangle with a hairline border and nearly invisible, so the pair is unbalanced. Button text is about 24px, which is too small for the button size. The 'y'/'n' key letters sit in the label with no key-cap treatment.
findings.fix: Make both buttons 56px tall. Keep lime on only the focused button, and give the other button a 1px --ui-line-hi border with --tx-1 text. Put 'y' and 'n' in 16px key-caps with a 4px radius. Set the labels to 20px f-cond 700 and centre them with 16px between the buttons.

findings.what: Three separately boxed items are stacked with different widths: the clock at 148px, the score panel at 268px, and the extract chip at 140px. The 'team score' panel has three competing number sizes ('0 sp' at about 36px, 'you 0 sp', 'p2 0 sp'). The extract chip sits flush against the modal edge. The hamburger circle floats beside the clock with no alignment to anything.
findings.fix: Merge the clock and score into one 268px panel with 8px/16px padding. Show the team total at 20px, with the per-player values as 16px --tx-2 text. Put 'extract 141m' at 16px teal with 16px of clearance above the modal. Align the menu button to the 32px right edge or the top-right cluster.

findings.where: bottom hotbar and bottom-left bars (24-430 x 965-1068, slots 560-1460)
findings.what: Armour at about 22px tall and hp at about 34px tall are different heights, and both use big 24-30px labels that crowd the fill. The bars start at 24px, not the 32px margin. Slot numerals 2-5 and 7-0 are still drawn as grey ghost digits on the road, and there are only two occupied slots. 'f1 controls' sits in a dark chip that touches the armour bar's row.
findings.fix: Make both bars 12px tall and 320px wide at x=32. Put the labels above at 16px, with hp value 20px. Remove the empty numerals 2-5 and 7-0 and show one dimmed spare slot. Put 'f1 controls' at 16px, 32px above the hotbar's left edge.

findings.where: left widgets: 'player 2' plate (16-170 x 322-358), 'active reload x3' chip (8-263 x 430-486), 'keyboard' and 'elite cache' tags (top-left)
findings.what: The four items use four different widths, positions and styles. 'player 2' is a light-blue text with a translucent fill. 'active reload x3' is a 256px chip with a 28px bold title and sits at x=8, outside the margin. 'keyboard' is in a monospace-looking font and 'elite cache' has a different fill. The reload title is bolder than the player name.
findings.fix: Put all of them on one --ui-panel at 80% fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, and x=32. Use 16px gaps. Set the labels to 16px, the 'active reload' title to 20px f-cond 600 and the '+15% damage' line to 16px --tx-2. Set 'keyboard' in f-cond 600 like the rest.

findings.where: world tag 'e search crate' + 'pillager joined' toast (893-1050 x 850-930)
findings.what: The toast overlaps the player sprite and the '2' tag, with its lower edge near the hotbar. The search prompt and the toast are stacked at different widths and styles. The toast is also still a stray centre-screen item, which the previous review asked to move.
findings.fix: Move 'pillager joined' into the left feed at x=32, or to 96px above the hotbar, at 16px. Keep the 'e search crate' prompt as the only item near the player, with the 'e' key-cap at 16px.

findings.what: The ammo panel sits at x=1606 with only a 10px edge gap, and its panel is larger than the slots beside it. The '12 / 50' hero is good, but the name is right-aligned at 28px, which competes with it. 'goals 0/3' has a chevron but sits 19px from the edge with a different fill and radius.
findings.fix: Set the ammo panel at a 32px margin and 4px radius, with the name at 16px --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number. Align 'goals' to the same 32px right margin, with the same fill and border.

findings.what: The HUD panels are semi-transparent over a busy, bright map (tan walls and orange floor). The text on the 'player 2' plate and the 'pillager joined' toast has weak contrast. Panel fills differ between items, which breaks the guide's single-panel rule.
findings.fix: Set every HUD panel to --ui-panel at 85% opacity and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and use --tx-1 for text. Keep the light-blue player 2 tint for the name only.

v.verdict: The 'want easy mode?' modal is a plain flat rectangle in the middle of a busy HUD, with a huge empty header band, a lime 'yes' that takes the choice for the player, and cramped, unaligned HUD modules around it.

findings.what: The card is a flat black rectangle with no border, no radius, no scrim and no close or back affordance. The HUD stays at full brightness behind it, so the clock, score and hotbar compete with it. The title sits at about 32px but is bold and cramped to the left, with about 90px of dead space under it. The lime countdown line at the top-left (x=492-562) is a tiny sliver that is easy to miss. The '9' countdown floats at the right with no label.
findings.fix: Draw a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) over the whole screen. Make the card 720x360 with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, centred. Use 32px padding, a 32px --tx-1 title at y+32, and cut the dead gap so the buttons sit 24px under the title. Turn the countdown into a full-width 4px --acc bar along the card's bottom edge that drains, and keep the '9' at 20px --tx-2 beside the title.

findings.what: The lime 'yes' fill is about 405x100px, a huge slab that outweighs everything else on screen, and it is the default pick for a difficulty choice, so it steers the player. The 'no' button has a 1px border that is nearly invisible against the card. The key-letter prefixes ('y yes', 'n no') are the same size and weight as the label, so they read as one run. The labels are about 24px, small for a 100px button.
findings.fix: Make both buttons 56px high and 280px wide with 16px between them, centred, 4px radius. Keep 'yes' as the --acc fill with --acc-ink 20px text, and give 'no' a 1px --ui-line-hi border with --tx-1 text. Show 'y' and 'n' as 16px --tx-2 key chips on the left of each button. Put pad focus on a 3px --acc outline with a 4px offset.

findings.where: left column: 'player 1' bar, 'active reload x3' card, 'armour 60', 'hp 100'
findings.what: Four modules use four different recipes: a translucent bar with a teal fill, a dark card with a ring icon, a blue bar and a green bar. They sit at different x offsets (17, 8, 24) and different widths. 'player 1' and 'hp 100' are two health readouts for the same player. The 'hp 100' number is about 34px, the biggest text in the left column, so it outshouts the title.
findings.fix: Stack them in one column at x=48, 360px wide, with 16px gaps and one panel recipe (--ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding). Keep one health bar, 24px high, with --ok fill and a 20px --tx-1 'hp 100' label. Put the 'armour 60' bar directly above it at 16px high. Make 'player 1' a 16px --tx-2 label, not a second bar. Make the buff card 64px high, with its text at 20px/16px.

findings.where: top-centre cluster: '9:58' clock, storm icon, 'team score' panel, 'extract 118m' pill
findings.what: These are three stacked boxes of different widths (about 146, 268 and 140px) with different fills, and they overlap each other: the score panel butts into the clock and the extract pill touches the panel's bottom edge. The score panel is crowded, with 'you 0 sp' and 'p1 0 sp' hard against its right edge and a large '0 sp' that competes with the clock. The storm icon is an orphan floating to the right of the clock.
findings.fix: Make one 280px panel centred at x=820-1100. Put the clock at 32px --tx-1 in the top row, a 16px --tx-2 'team score 0 sp' row below it, and the 'you / p1' split on one row at 16px with 16px padding. Leave a 16px gap, then a 32px-high extract pill with 16px --extract text. Dock the storm icon inside the panel at its right, 24px.

findings.what: Slots 1 and 3 are 100px tiles, with the selected one in an amber outline, while 2 and 4 to 0 are bare numbers with ghost art and no tile. The row reads as two things plus clutter. The selected outline is amber (--warn hue) rather than the accent. The spacing is uneven, with a 124px gap between 1 and 3. The bottom row sits at y=1055, close to the screen edge, and under the 'hp 100' bar's baseline.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with 8px gaps, centred at the bottom with a 48px margin. Give empty slots a 1px --ui-line border at 40% opacity and a 16px --tx-2 number. Make the selected slot a 3px --acc outline. Keep the ammo count at 16px inside the tile.

findings.what: The panel is the correct hero idea, but it is a hard black box with no border. The weapon name is right-aligned at about 28px while '12 / 50' is about 70px, past the 56px hero cap. The panel has no left or bottom alignment to the 48px margin, so the right and bottom edges sit about 10px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Right-align the panel to x=1872 and bottom=1032 (48px margins). Make the number --fs-hero 56px 800, with '/ 50' at 20px --tx-2, and the weapon name at 20px --tx-1. Use the shared panel recipe with 16px padding.

findings.what: 'goals 0/3' is a 300px bar with a chevron, in a third panel style, at x=1603, so it misses the 48px margin. The 'keyboard' tag at the top-left is about 14px with a green border, tucked into the corner at x=10 and hard to read. 'f1 controls' sits at the bottom of the map with no relation to the other HUD edges.
findings.fix: Right-align 'goals 0/3' to x=1872, 160px wide, with the shared panel recipe. Move 'keyboard' to a 16px --tx-2 chip at x=48, y=24. Dock 'f1 controls' at x=48 above the hp bar as a 16px --tx-2 hint.

v.verdict: A clean, readable title menu with a clear lime primary action, but it floats small in a big dark void, has a gold-gradient logo that breaks the one-accent rule, and a vague, cluttered saves block.

findings.what: Orange/gold gradient wordmark with drop shadow fights the lime accent and breaks the guide's 'no gradient washes' and 'gold is never a fill' rules. It reads as a different game's logo and is the loudest element, competing with the 1 player button.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark solid --tx-1 (#efe9dc), f-cond 800 at the 56px hero size or larger, no gradient or shadow. Keep lime only for the selected button.

findings.what: The whole menu is a 558px column in the middle of a 1920 canvas with about 40% empty black above and below. The background is a flat vignette with no art, so the screen looks like a template and has no ARC Raiders or Halo Reach identity.
findings.fix: Add a subdued key-art or raid-scene backdrop at 20-30% opacity, or left-align the column at x=96 (5% margin) with art on the right. At minimum raise the column to 600px and centre it vertically at about 50%.

findings.what: The save row has a lime 1px border and lime name text, which makes it look selected or focused and competes with the filled lime '1 player' button, so two things claim 'selected'. The 'saves' label is about 14px, dim and detached. The save meta text '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is muted and small.
findings.fix: Use a --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 name on an idle row. Reserve lime for the single focused item. Set the label and meta at 16px, tx-2 minimum 4.5:1, and tighten the 'saves' label to 8px above the row.

findings.where: bottom row: name field, 'change name', 'create a new save'
findings.what: The name input, 'change name' and 'create a new save' are three equal-weight controls crammed into one 40px row. The input looks like a button with no field affordance, and the two buttons are tiny (about 14-15px text) compared with the 20px menu buttons. It's setup clutter on the main menu.
findings.fix: Fold this into a 'manage saves' secondary action or a window. If it stays, use 48px-high controls, 16px+ labels, an input with a --ui-raised fill and a visible caret, and an 8px gap.

findings.what: '2 player co-op (same machine)' has a parenthetical explaining sentence. '2 player arcade demo' and '1 player arcade demo' sit as equal peers of the real modes, so the list is 4 same-looking buttons with weak hierarchy below the primary. 'arcade' also winks at the banned arcade tone.
findings.fix: Rename to '2 player' and drop the parenthetical. Group the demos under a quieter 'demo' tier at 16px tx-2, or move them to a secondary row. Keep rows 48px with 8px gaps.

findings.what: The two buttons are small (about 15px text, 46px high) and are outlined boxes with no focus path indicated. They're the right place, but the type is below the 20px body size and the pair is the only chrome in the corner.
findings.fix: Set the text to 16px minimum (20px per the button spec), align the top margin and right margin to 48px, and show the pad focus state in lime like the main list. Consider an icon plus label for settings.

findings.where: bottom key legend and version stamp
findings.what: The legend sits at about 16px with tx-2 labels and boxed keys, and the keys are white-bordered chips that are brighter than the labels. The version stamp is about 12px and dim, below the 14px fine floor. The legend is also not centred on the same axis as the menu (about x=960 centre, fine) but it adds a second explaining row to a title screen.
findings.fix: Raise the version to 14px with tx-2. Make the key chips --ui-line-hi bordered with tx-1 text at 16px and match their height to the labels. Consider hiding the legend on the title (it already lives in F1 controls).

findings.what: The tagline is about 18px with wide tracking, mid grey, and wedged between the logo and the first button with only about 24px to the button. It is low-contrast, off-scale (not 16 or 20), and crowds the primary action.
findings.fix: Set to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2, with 16px under the logo and 32px above the 1 player button.

v.verdict: The title screen has a clear order: logo, then a lime main action, then the saves. The logo's amber gradient, the tiny type and the loose edge elements keep it below polished.

findings.what: The logo is amber with a vertical gradient wash. It sits next to a lime button, so two near-hue hot colours compete, which the guide forbids. The gradient is a template tell. The logo is also modest for a title screen, about 90px tall, and sits in a void with no art or scene behind it.
findings.fix: Make the logo flat --tx-1 or flat --acc, with no gradient. Scale it to roughly 120px. Put a dark key-art or silhouette layer behind it so the screen has an identity.

findings.where: saves list, 'saves' label and save row
findings.what: The label 'saves' is about 14px and grey, below the 16px floor, and it is dim. The row's '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is muted grey and small, so stats are hard to read from a couch. The lime border and lime name make the row look like a second primary action beside the filled button.
findings.fix: Set the label and stats to 16px minimum in --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Set the row name to 20px in --tx-1. Show selection with a 3px lime left bar and a --ui-raised fill instead of a full lime outline.

findings.what: It is a tiny muted grey bare text link, about 14px, jammed 18px under the button. It does not read as clickable and has no focus affordance. It is also unclear whether it is a secondary action or a caption.
findings.fix: Make it a proper secondary button, 16px label, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 40px tall, with 24px spacing from the primary button. Or move it into the save group.

findings.what: The strip repeats the controls (move, aim, fire, search, f1 controls) on the title screen. The 'keyboard' pill at the top is also a device label. Both are clutter on a menu with no raid. The hint text is dim grey at about 15px.
findings.fix: Delete the control legend from the title screen, since f1 already opens it in raid. Keep only the device chip, or fold it into the top-right group. If the hints stay, use 16px --tx-2 and a footer row aligned to the 5% margin.

findings.what: The three items are scattered. The pill is centred at y=19 with a green outline that matches no token. The buttons sit at y=57 and are 142px and 85px wide with a 16px gap, aligned to neither the 5% margin nor the pill. The pill is cramped against the top edge.
findings.fix: Put all three on one 56px header row at y=24 with matching 40px height and a shared border style. Use a 5% side margin (96px). Drop the green outline and use --ui-line-hi.

findings.where: create row: name field, 'change name', 'create a new save'
findings.what: The row has three equal-weight controls at 40px, and the text input's 'pillager' value looks like a button. Its edge is the same grey as the buttons, so it is not clear which control acts on what. 'change name' and 'create a new save' are ambiguous together.
findings.fix: Add a 16px label such as 'name' above the field, or a placeholder. Give the field a --ui-void fill and a clear caret or focus. Keep the two actions as quiet secondary buttons with 8px gaps. Consider a single 'rename' and a '+ new save'.

findings.what: A full-width lime bar is good for hierarchy, but the label is only about 20px at weight 600. It is the least bold part of the biggest element, and the bar has no hover or press cue. The bar is about 558px wide against a 56px height, which feels like a form submit.
findings.fix: Raise the label to 24px or heavier, weight 700, with +.04em tracking. Add a bounce on focus, per the settled motion. Add a pad glyph to the label if a pad is in use.

findings.what: 'v0.1257 · oct 28 11:08 pm et' is about 14px grey and sits at x=97, not on the same margin as the other edge items. It is a legal-style stamp but the contrast is low.
findings.fix: Align it to the 96px margin on the same baseline as the hint strip. Use 14px --tx-2. This is acceptable as a footer legend.

v.verdict: The menu column is clean and the focus bar reads, but the wordmark is still a gold gradient with a shadow, a loud popup-blocker banner has been added, and the screen is still a small column on an empty black field with no key art.

findings.what: The wordmark is still an amber-to-gold gradient with a drop shadow. This was flagged last round and not fixed. It is a gradient wash, it reads as warn/rarity gold, and it competes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Make it flat --tx-1 #efe9dc, f-cond 800, 72px or more, with no gradient or shadow. Leave lime for the focused row only.

findings.what: A red-bordered banner with a full lime 'retry' fill sits in the middle of the menu. It is a second primary action and it is brighter than the menu itself. It also uses an explaining sentence, which is clutter, and a 14px-looking body size.
findings.fix: Show it only when triggered, as a toast or a one-line status. Shorten it to 'popup blocked' and make 'retry' a --ui-line-hi outlined button at 48px high. Keep lime off it. Use --danger for the border only.

findings.what: A 560px column sits in the centre of 1920x1080 with about 70% empty black, a faint vignette and no key art. The screen could belong to any game, and the menu sits far from the corner buttons.
findings.fix: Left-align the column at x=96 and put raid key art or a scene at 25-30% opacity on the right. Alternatively add a dim backdrop behind a 600px centred column.

findings.where: menu rows: '2 player co-op (same machine)', 'arcade demo' x2
findings.what: The parenthetical is an explaining sentence. The two demos have the same weight and size as the real modes, so the hierarchy is flat. The lime bar is on row 2 while '1 player' sits first, so focus does not start on the main action.
findings.fix: Rename to '2 player'. Put the demos under a quieter 16px tx-2 'demo' tier, or make them 40px rows. Start focus on '1 player' and make it the lone main action.

findings.what: The 'saves' label is dim grey at about 15px and sits 24px from the row. The lime-bordered row with lime name looks focused while a different row has focus, so there are two lime states. The meta '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is dim.
findings.fix: Set the label to 16px tx-2 at 8px above the row. Use a --ui-line-hi border and a tx-1 name when idle. Raise the meta to tx-2 at 16px. Keep lime for the focused item only.

findings.where: bottom row: name input, 'change name', 'create a new save'
findings.what: The row is 40px high with small 16px text and an input that is nearly invisible against the background. Its widths are uneven and it competes with the saves row above.
findings.fix: Use 48px controls, a --ui-raised input fill with a --ui-line-hi border, and an 8px gap. Alternatively fold the row into a 'manage saves' secondary action.

findings.where: top-right 'go fullscreen' / 'settings' and bottom key legend
findings.what: The top buttons are small, about 14px text in tight boxes, and far from the column. The legend keycaps are tiny. The version stamp is about 12px, below the 14px floor.
findings.fix: Set the buttons at 48px high with 16px text and 24px side padding. Set the legend at 16px. Raise the version stamp to 14px at tx-2.

v.verdict: This is a readable raid HUD with one clear hero (the ammo block), but the corners are inconsistent in size and weight, and the chrome is crowded, tiny, or doubled up in several places.

findings.what: The 410px solid green bar with 'hp 100' in 32px 800-weight type is the loudest thing on screen. It competes with the ammo hero and covers the map edge. A flat green fill also breaks the dark-panel language used everywhere else.
findings.fix: Make it a 12-16px high bar on a --ui-panel plate, with a --ok fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 above it or at its left. Keep the 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.what: The rows are about 14px with tight 18px leading and no padding to speak of. Names and '$' values run together, and the panel is hard to read from a couch. The title and the 'value at risk' header are the same weight as the rows, so there is no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Use 16px minimum for the rows with a 28px row pitch and 16px padding. Set the header at 16px tx-2, with 'you' in tx-1 and the others in tx-2. Add 1px --ui-line row dividers. Use --rad 4px.

findings.where: extract info: top-centre pill 'extract 152m' and bottom-right 'c 152m' with arrow
findings.what: The same distance is drawn twice, in two different pill styles. The rule is that a line is shown in one place. The teal arrow on the right edge is cryptic, and 'c' is unexplained.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre pill only. Move the edge arrow to a bare teal chevron with no text, or drop it. Delete the 'c 152m' chip.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 sit as dim ghost digits at about 14px over the map, with a low-contrast gap against the blue floor. The slot 1 selection uses a gold-amber border, while the guide says lime means 'selected'. The 'f' hint badge in slot 2 is tiny.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles at 60% alpha with a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px tx-2 digit. Make the selected border 3px --acc, not amber. Make key hints 16px.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint, left of the hotbar
findings.what: It is about 14px with a dark chip on a blue room. It is hard to see and floats by itself, 120px left of the hotbar, with no clear alignment to anything.
findings.fix: Make it a 16px tx-1 label on a --ui-panel plate at 85% alpha with 8px padding. Anchor it on the hotbar's left edge, 16px above it, so it lines up with the slot row.

findings.what: A 300px-wide dark bar showing only a title and a chevron sits at an offset from the top edge. It has a different top margin from the left panel (the left panel starts at y=142, this one at y=20), and its right margin is 18px against the ammo block's 12px.
findings.fix: Shrink it to its content with a 16px label, or let it be a fixed 48px row. Set one 48px safe-area margin at all four corners (about 5% of the screen). Check that 'run info' contains no capital I.

findings.where: left-edge stack: 'active reload x3', 'pillager abandoned', and the two round icons
findings.what: The buff card, feed line and unlabelled circular icons all use different shapes, borders and sizes: a 200px card, an unboxed teal line with a left bar, and amber and teal rings. The two circles have no labels, and the amber ring reads as a warning.
findings.fix: Put all three in one left column with a shared 8px gap, one --ui-panel plate and one 4px radius. Use a tx-1 20px title and a tx-2 16px sub-line. Give the icons 40px tiles with a --ui-line-hi border instead of coloured rings.

findings.what: The block is the strongest piece, but 'scav pistol' (about 22px, right-aligned) and 'b / i backpack' at about 14px are cramped, with 12px inner padding at the bottom. The '/ 50' is nearly as large as the 12, so the hero is slightly diluted.
findings.fix: Set '12' at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1. Set '/ 50' at 32px tx-2. Set the weapon name at 20px and the backpack hint at 16px. Use 16px padding on all sides and one divider between the weapon name and the count.

v.verdict: This is a readable in-raid HUD with a good hero ammo number and a clear hotbar, but it reads as a scatter of mismatched boxes with different sizes and corners. The 'run info' box in the top right is a duplicate of the top-left pillagers panel and there is no common type scale.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers' panel and top-right 'run info' bar
findings.what: Two big dark boxes fight the clock and extract tag for attention at the top. The roster at about 14px type is the biggest block on screen. 'run info' is an empty-looking bar with a chevron and a different width, border and fill. The top-right bar clips against the building edge.
findings.fix: Fold the roster into 'run info', or collapse it to a single 16px line ('3 pillagers, $1,647 at risk') with no panel. Give both boxes the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Make them the same width, pinned at x=48 and x=1872.

findings.where: hotbar slots 1-4 and the dead numbers 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0
findings.what: Slot 1 has a thick amber ring and slot 2 'f' fist has none, so P1 amber is used as 'selected', which the guide reserves for lime. Empty slots show ghost weapon silhouettes and bare digits that are too faint to read. The number labels are about 12px, below the 14px floor, and are tx-2 on a busy map.
findings.fix: Make the selected slot's border 2px --acc (lime) and keep the other slots at 1px --ui-line-hi. Show only occupied slots plus at most 2 empty ones. Set slot numbers to 16px tx-2 with a --ui-panel pill behind them. Delete the ghost silhouettes.

findings.where: bottom-left: 'hp 100' bar, the two round icons, and 'pillager abandoned'
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat full-width green slab with the biggest letters in the bottom row but no frame, so it fights the ammo hero. The green is not --ok. The two round icons sit with no label, and the amber and green rings are inconsistent. 'pillager abandoned' is a teal strip with a different left bar than the other toasts. It sits on top of the hp area.
findings.fix: Put hp in a 4px-radius --ui-panel frame at 16px label size with a 56px high number. Use --ok #76b97c for the fill, 12px tall at 360px wide. Give the status icons the same 32px size and a 1px --ui-line-hi ring. Move toasts into the single left feed column at x=48, 24px above the hp block.

findings.where: 'active reload x3 +15% damage' buff card at the left
