findings.what: It is a third box style, with a teal ring icon and a bold 20px title over 16px grey detail text. It floats mid-left between the roster and the feed with no anchor and overlaps the map. It competes with the roster for the eye.
findings.fix: Anchor it to the status-icon row at bottom left, as a 40px chip: icon plus 'reload x3 +15%' in 16px tx-1. Use the same panel fill and border as the roster.

findings.what: It is a tiny dark tag at 16px with a key-cap on a blue floor. It touches the hotbar edge and the hp bar and has weak contrast against the water, so it is easy to lose.
findings.fix: Use a 28px high chip with a --ui-panel fill and tx-1 text at 16px. Keep it 16px clear of the hotbar slot 1 and centre it on the hotbar.

findings.where: top 'extract 152m' tag and the right-edge 'c 152m' tag
findings.what: The same data is drawn twice (the top teal pill and the right edge marker). That breaks the one-place rule. The two pills also differ in fill and shape, and 'c 152m' is cut at the right edge. The 'keyboard' badge at top-left is a fourth small label style.
findings.fix: Keep the top pill only and drop 'c 152m', or keep only the edge arrow with no text. Move the 'keyboard' device badge into 'run info' or hide it after 3 seconds.

findings.where: ammo block bottom-right, 'scav pistol 12 / 50' and 'b / i backpack'
findings.what: This is the best element: it has a clear hero number. But the right-aligned gun name is 24px and louder than a label should be. The '/ 50' is about as heavy as the 12, and the key hint 'b / i backpack' is a 14px legend jammed into the box corner.
findings.fix: Make the gun name 16px tx-2. Make '12' 56px at 800 weight in --tx-1 and '/ 50' 32px at 600 in tx-2. Drop 'b / i backpack' from the box and move it into the controls list.

findings.where: world labels 'crawler m-77', 'crawler a-83', 'the long dock cache'
findings.what: The tags are three different sizes and fills, they stack tightly with a 4px gap, and they are about 14px. The 'dock cache' label reads like a UI panel with a purple item beside it.
findings.fix: Use one world-tag style: a 16px label on a --ui-panel fill at 80% opacity with 8px horizontal padding, and 8px between stacked tags. Anchor the name to the enemy and show the 'cache' tag only within about 6 metres.

v.verdict: The raid HUD reads clearly: the ammo number is the hero, the alert banner is obvious, and everything is lower case. The corner widgets share no panel recipe, they sit at different margins, and the extract distance is drawn twice.

findings.where: top-left cluster: 'keyboard' pill, 'current pillagers' list, 'active reload x3' buff card
findings.what: The three left-side widgets use three different recipes. The pill is a green-outlined chip with a different font weight. The list is a square-cornered panel with a 14px gap between rows and a 16px 'value at risk' label. The buff card has a round icon and a different height. Their left edges are 8px, 8px and 16px from the screen edge. The green pill also reads as debug UI.
findings.fix: Use one HUD panel: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px padding. Align all left widgets to one x of 5% (96px) with a 16px gap between them. Restyle the 'keyboard' chip as a 16px --tx-2 label with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or fold it into the controls hint.

findings.where: extract marker at the top ('extract 146m' pill) and 'c 146m' with an arrow at the right edge
findings.what: The same extraction distance is drawn twice. The guide says a line drawn in two places is a defect. The edge marker label 'c 146m' is also cryptic and about 14px.
findings.fix: Keep one. Prefer the compass arrow at the edge, labelled 'extract 146m' at 16px in --extract. Remove the pill under the clock, or keep the pill and delete the edge marker.

findings.what: The bar is a wide, saturated green slab about 410px long that is more visually prominent than the hero ammo number. Its fill is a flat light green that competes with the map foliage, and the 'hp 100' text sits tight against the left end. It hugs the screen corner at x=24, y=1036, so it risks being clipped on a TV. It also breaks the 8px grid.
findings.fix: Cut it to about 280px wide and 16px tall. Fill it with --ok at 70%, on a --ui-panel track with a 1px border. Put 'hp 100' at 20px in --tx-1 above or beside the bar. Inset it to the 5% margin (96px left, 54px bottom).

findings.what: Slots 1 and 2 are solid dark cards. Slots 3 to 0 are bare numerals floating on the map at about 14px, and they vanish against the water and walls (6, 7 and 0 are nearly invisible). The row reads as broken and the slot numbers are far below the 4.5:1 contrast floor. Slot 1's amber outline also competes with the lime-means-selected rule.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots 3 to 0 as 64px --ui-panel tiles at 50% opacity with a 1px --ui-line border, so the row reads as one strip. Put the numbers at 16px --tx-2 inside each tile. Mark the selected slot with a --acc 3px bar and a 2px outline, not amber.

findings.where: 'host disconnected / you are hosting now' banner
findings.what: It is the right element (the single top-centre alert), but it sits 150px down, partly over the extract pill area. It has a 4px red left bar, a red fill and red 32px title text on red, so contrast is weak. The sub-line is tiny, about 16px, and the banner overlaps the building walls behind it.
findings.fix: Anchor the banner at y=96 below the clock cluster, with 24px clear of the extract pill. Use a --ui-panel fill at 92% with a 4px --danger left bar. Set the title in --tx-1 at 32px with a --danger icon, and the sub-line in --tx-2 at 16px.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' label
findings.what: 'run info' is a full-width 300px dark bar with a chevron, so a collapsed menu takes a lot of space for no content. It is not the vertical 1-by-1 list the owner ordered for that corner. The map label under it is about 14px, with a different pill style again.
findings.fix: Shrink it to a 160px chip with the same panel recipe as the left widgets, or hold it until cw-trcol ships. Put the map label in a 16px --tx-1 label with the shared panel fill.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint, mid-left over the pool
findings.what: It is a small, low-contrast chip floating at x=435 over the water, not anchored mid-bottom-left as the owner's order specifies. It reads as a stray object, and the 'f1' keycap is near-invisible.
findings.fix: Anchor it at the bottom, left of centre, at 16px --tx-2 with a keycap. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and the shared panel fill. Keep it 24px from the hotbar.

findings.what: The ammo card is the best-built element, but 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and dim. It sits only 12px from the screen edge, and the 'scav pistol' label in grey is weak. The '/ 50' is also heavy and competes with the 12.
findings.fix: Set '12' at 56px f-cond 800 in --tx-1 and '/ 50' at 32px in --tx-2. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2. Inset the card to the 5% margin and match its corner radius to the other HUD panels.

v.verdict: This is the raid HUD, not the p2 title screen the earlier advice covered. It is readable and mostly lower case, but it has too many competing panels, inconsistent type and styling, and a few clipped or capitalised bits.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers' list: 'you' row and the $ values
findings.what: The list is 4 rows of 16px text in a dense box with no divider or padding. 'you' sits in the same weight and colour as the other three players, so your own row does not stand out. Rows are about 18px apart, and the 'value at risk' header collides with the chevron. The figures are right-aligned but the names are crowded against the left edge.
findings.fix: Set row height to 24px with 8px padding inside a --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 16px --tx-2 for the header and 20px for names. Colour the 'you' row amber for P1 (not lime, which means selected). Keep a 16px gap between the name column and the value column. Move the chevron 8px clear of the header text.

findings.where: centre banner 'host disconnected / you are hosting now'
findings.what: This is the loudest thing on screen (red-filled panel, large red title), and it competes with the extract timer and the ammo block. The subline is about 14px and low contrast on the dark red. The banner also overlaps the red barrels and has an irregular left edge bar.
findings.fix: Keep it as the one top-centre alert (it follows the 186a rule), but sit it 16px below the extract chip and centre it on the clock's axis. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 3px --danger left bar and --tx-1 title text at 32px. Make the subline 16px --tx-2. Give it a 4px radius and 16px padding, and fade it out after about 4s.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' tag
findings.what: The 'run info' bar is a full-width collapsed accordion with no meaning until opened, and it is larger than the clock. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats on the map with a different fill and a different corner radius. The distance chip 'c 146m' uses a third small style. The career HUD corner should be a vertical 1 by 1 list of equal items (cw-trcol), and this is not it.
findings.fix: Fold 'run info' into the cw-trcol list at 16px with a 40px row height. Put the 'the long dock cache' name and 'c 146m' in one shared chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px --tx-1. Align the right edge to the 5% margin (96px).

findings.where: bottom-right weapon block 'scav pistol 12 / 50' with 'b / i backpack'
findings.what: The ammo number is correctly the hero (about 56px), but the box is a different, heavier panel from the left-side HUD pieces. 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and nearly invisible. The weapon name is right-aligned while the count is left-heavy, and the box runs close to the screen edge.
findings.fix: Set the panel to --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 24px padding, inset 48px from the right and bottom edges. Show '12' at 56px weight 800 in --tx-1, with '/ 50' at 20px --tx-2 on the same baseline. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2, or remove it, since the pickup stack and the b / i keys can live in the controls list.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat full-green strip with 'hp 100' in oversized text that is cut off at the bottom edge. It touches the screen edge, with no margin and no panel. The big green bar becomes a second hero on the screen next to the ammo count.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges. Make it 16px tall with a 4px radius and a --ui-line track. Put 'hp 100' at 20px --tx-1 above or beside it, not inside it. Keep the green fill (--ok), and switch it to --danger below 30%.

findings.where: hotbar slots 1 to 0 and 'f1 controls' hint
findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 are drawn as tiles, and slots 3 to 0 are bare floating digits over the map with no tiles. The selected slot has an amber outline, which is the P1 colour and reads as a second accent. The 'f1 controls' chip is a third small style, and it floats above the hotbar, so it collides visually with the slot tiles.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 56px tiles with an 8px gap, using --ui-panel and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show the selected slot with a 3px --acc bar on top. Move the 'f1 controls' chip to the left of the row and align it with the hp bar. Use the same chip style as the other chips.

findings.what: The icon is lime and green and sits in a pill with a third border and radius style. The heading is 20px, and the second line is 14px and low contrast. It floats alone mid-left with no relation to the hp bar, hotbar or list, and it adds clutter.
findings.fix: Move it into a stacked buff column directly above the hp bar, at x=48. Use the shared chip style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius). Set the name to 16px --tx-1 and the effect to 16px --tx-2. Drop the lime ring.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' pill is clipped at the top-left corner, has a green outline, and is mono-styled, so it does not match anything else on screen. The teal 'extract 146m' chip is correct as extract colour but has a different border and radius from the other chips.
findings.fix: Put the 'keyboard' device chip in the shared chip style, 16px --tx-2, inset 48px from the top-left corner. Give the extract chip the same radius and padding, keeping --extract only for the text and glyph.

v.verdict: The hud reads clearly and the ammo hero is strong, but the left side is crowded, the kill feed repeats itself, and the earlier hp, hotbar, extract-chip and f1 fixes are only partly applied.

findings.where: left column: pillagers panel, 'pillager' bar, three buff cards, three damage lines
findings.what: Six stacked blocks down the left edge, each with its own width, fill, font size and padding. The buff cards use a ~24px title with a 16px sub-line, the pillager list uses ~14px text, and the damage lines are lime on a different plate. This is the busiest area of the screen and there is no hierarchy in it.
findings.fix: Give every left-edge block one shared width (~220px), one --ui-panel fill at 85% alpha, --rad 4px and 8px padding. Use 20px f-cond 600 for titles and 16px for sub-lines. Put 16px gaps between blocks. Drop the plate behind the 'pillager' mini bar, or merge it into the pillagers panel.

findings.where: kill feed, right edge (3x 'pillager killed crawler' + 'you killed crawler')
findings.what: The same line is repeated four times at ~20px on opaque plates. Together with the three damage lines at left (pillager > crawler h-15 and so on) the same kills are shown twice, which the one-place rule forbids. The feed is also the brightest text near the middle of the screen.
findings.fix: Collapse repeats into 'pillager killed crawler x3'. Show kills in one place only, either the feed or the damage lines. Use 16px tx-2 on a 60% alpha plate, with only 'you' lines in tx-1 and no lime.

findings.what: The 'hp 97' label is drawn at about 32px inside a ~30px bar, in a heavy font with an outline. The bar has no border or plate, so it looks pasted on. The green fill is also close in hue to the pillager bar above it, and the bar sits ~25px from the screen edge, which is tighter than the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Make the bar 14px high on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ok fill. Put 'hp 97' at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 above the bar, left-aligned. Inset the bar to x=48 (5% margin) and align it with the hotbar baseline.

findings.what: The empty slots (3, 5-0) have bare digits floating at inconsistent heights with ghost weapon icons, so they look like a rendering leftover rather than empty slots. The digits are ~14px and low contrast. The selected slot has a good amber border, but the guide wants --acc for selected and amber is the P1 colour.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 72px tiles at 60% alpha with a 1px --ui-line border and the digit at 16px tx-2 in the top-left corner. Drop the ghost icons. Use a 3px --acc border on the selected slot (or keep the P1 amber ring and add an --acc corner pip).

findings.what: Three lines are drawn at ~18px with uneven indents ('dawn clear', then the contracts indented 14px). The card is wider than its content and has no divider. It also leaves the top-right corner crowded while the planned vertical list for that corner (cw-trcol) is not in.
findings.fix: Use a 16px tx-2 label per section with 20px tx-1 values. Set a 16px left inset and a 1px --ui-line divider between 'dawn clear' and 'contracts'. Shrink the card width to its content plus 16px padding.

findings.where: 'c 152m' chip with arrow, right edge, y~428
findings.what: This is a second extract readout, and it repeats the top-centre 'extract 152m' pill. It floats next to the wall with no anchor. The earlier advice to delete it was not followed.
findings.fix: Delete the chip and its text. If an edge arrow is kept, use a bare 24px --extract chevron with no label.

findings.what: The 'f1 controls' hint is ~16px on a barely visible plate and sits off the hotbar's left edge at a different baseline. The toast is a centred ~16px black box with a 1px border, which doesn't match any other panel style.
findings.fix: Put the hint on a --ui-panel plate at 85% alpha with 8px padding, 16px above the hotbar's left edge. Restyle the toast to the same plate (--rad 4px) and place it in the left feed instead of over the map.

findings.where: 'keyboard' tag, top-left, and the two round icons, bottom-left
findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a ~20px green-bordered box in the corner and shows what is probably a debug device label. The two circular status icons (crossed-out eye and green icon) have no labels and are close to the hp bar, so they crowd it.
findings.fix: Remove the 'keyboard' tag or shrink it to a 14px tx-2 label with no box. Move the circular icons up to align with the buff column, with 16px of space above the hp bar.

v.verdict: The hud reads clearly, but it is still a pile of mismatched boxes: the two top panels differ in width, the left-edge stack has no common margin, and the empty-slot ghosts and tiny text keep it short of polished.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers' panel vs top-right 'run info' panel
findings.what: The earlier advice to match the two panels was not followed. They differ in width (about 360 vs 300px), sit at different y positions (143 vs 20), use 12-14px text, and are packed with no padding. Run info is a left-aligned list with a tiny chevron, and its 'extract carrying 2x servo actuator' line nearly touches the right edge.
findings.fix: Give both the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding, at 360px wide, pinned to the 48px margins and top-aligned at y=48. Set row text to 16px minimum with 8px row gaps, and make the chevron 16px.

findings.where: hotbar, empty slots 3 and 5-0 and the ghost weapon silhouettes
findings.what: The ghost silhouettes and dead numbers are still there. Floating numbers like 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are about 12px and low contrast. They clutter the busiest part of the map, and the silhouettes bleed into the world art. Slot 1 does have a lime-ish selection border, but it is amber/yellow, not --acc.
findings.fix: Delete the ghost icons and show only slots 1-4 plus at most one empty slot, all 96px square. Put the selected slot in a 2px --acc border and the others in 1px --ui-line-hi on --ui-panel. Set slot numbers to 16px tx-2 inside a --ui-panel pill at the top-left.

findings.where: left edge stack: buff cards, kill/feed lines, status icons, hp
findings.what: The left edge has four different alignments and card styles: buff cards at x=8 with 14-20px text, feed chips at x=15 in a blue tint, status circles at x=24, and hp at x=22. Nothing sits on the 48px margin. The feed line 'pillager abandoned' uses a different chip style (blue bar) from the kill lines, and the blue/cyan text clashes with the amber and lime palette.
findings.fix: Pin everything to x=48. Buff chips are 40px high with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px tx-1 text. Feed lines are 16px tx-1 on --ui-panel, with a 3px bar in the player colour only. Space the groups 24px apart.

findings.what: 'hp 97' is large, but it is drawn as raw outlined text over a bright green bar with no panel. It is clipped by the bottom edge (about 28px of margin missing), and the number's outline fights the fill. The green is brighter than --ok.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel frame at x=48, bottom 48px. The bar is 360x12 in --ok #76b97c. The number is 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 with no outline, and a 16px 'hp' label sits above it.

findings.where: right column pickup stack and 'c 152m' marker
findings.what: Four identical 'pillager killed crawler' rows stack with no grouping and sit flush to the screen edge at x=1920. They carry no count, and they run to about 14px text. The 'c 152m' chip floats above them without a clear owner.
findings.fix: Collapse repeats into one row, 'pillager killed crawler x4', at 16px. Pin the column at the 48px right margin with 8px gaps. Put the 'c 152m' marker with the extract indicator at the top.

findings.what: The ammo block is the clear hero, which is right. But 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and dim, the panel's right-aligned name is small, and the box sits at x=1668-1910, off the 48px margin and out of line with the hotbar's baseline.
findings.fix: Move the panel 48px from the right and bottom edges. Name at 16px tx-2, count at 56px, and the key hint at 16px tx-2 inside the same panel.

findings.what: The f1 chip is tiny (about 12px text) and sits in the world art, half-hidden against the blue floor, left of slot 1. The toast floats mid-screen with a different black box than every other panel.
findings.fix: Make the f1 chip 28px high on --ui-panel with 16px text, centred under the hotbar. Send the 'pillager joined' toast to the left feed column and style it like the other feed rows.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag at x=10 is a lone tab with a green outline unlike any other element. The extract chip is teal, which is fine, but it sits 4px under the timer with a different corner radius.
findings.fix: Remove the 'keyboard' tag, or restyle it as a 16px tx-2 label inside the roster panel. Set the extract chip radius to 4px and put 8px between it and the timer.

v.verdict: The ammo card and buff stack are readable, but the HUD still has no single panel style, the hp bar and hotbar are unchanged, and the banner sits in the middle of the playfield.

findings.what: The bar is still about 400px wide and hugs the screen edge with no margin. The 'hp 100' text is a fat, bold green-on-green number that clips against the bar. Neither point from the last review was followed.
findings.fix: Make the bar 280x16 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on a --ui-panel track. Fill it with --ok. Put 'hp 100' at 20px in --tx-1 above the bar. Inset it to 96px left and 54px bottom.

findings.what: Slots 3 to 0 are bare floating digits over the map. Only slots 1 and 2 have tiles, so the strip falls apart at slot 3. The slot 1 selection is amber, not --acc.
findings.fix: Draw slots 3 to 0 as 64px --ui-panel tiles at 50% opacity with a 1px --ui-line border. Put the numbers inside each tile at 16px --tx-2. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc bar and a 2px --acc outline.

findings.where: left column: 'current pillagers' panel, buff cards, kill feed, 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The left HUD uses four different panel styles with different heights, fills and borders. The kill feed has coloured left ticks and the buff cards have 32px icon circles. The widgets also sit at different x positions, between 8 and 16px. The column has no shared edge or rhythm.
findings.fix: Put every left widget on one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px padding. Align them all to x=96 with a 16px gap. Use 16px --tx-2 for sub-lines and 20px --tx-1 for names.

findings.where: 'host disconnected / you are hosting now' banner
findings.what: The banner floats at x 820 to 1100, y 152 to 222, on top of the map, 90px below the extract pill. It is a saturated red slab with a red outline. It looks like a debug message and is the loudest object on screen. The title is about 30px in red on dark red, which has low contrast.
findings.fix: Anchor it at top-centre, y=96, with 24px clear of the extract pill. Use a --ui-panel fill at 92% with a 4px --danger left bar and no outline. Set the title at 32px in --tx-1 with a --danger icon, and the sub-line at 16px in --tx-2.

findings.where: extract markers: 'extract 146m' pill under the clock and 'c 146m' with an arrow at the right edge
findings.what: The same distance is drawn twice with two different pill styles. The 'c 146m' label is only 14px, tiny and low contrast. The cyan arrow under the top pill adds a third marker.
findings.fix: Keep the edge compass arrow only. Label it 'extract 146m' at 16px in --extract on a --ui-panel tile. Delete the top pill and its small arrow, so the clock stands alone.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' chip and top-right 'run info' dropdown
findings.what: The two corner chips use unrelated styles: a green-outlined tag at the left and a wide dark dropdown with a chevron at the right. The 'keyboard' chip is a debug-looking tag with no job. 'run info' is a 300px-wide bar of mostly empty space, and the 'the long dock cache' tag below it is a third box style.
findings.fix: Fold 'keyboard' into the f1 controls hint, or restyle it with the standard panel recipe. Cut 'run info' to about 160px wide. Apply the same recipe to the location tag.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' tag and 'f1 controls' chip, bottom-centre-left
findings.what: Both are small 14 to 16px labels floating over the map in the middle of the lower screen, with no alignment to anything. The party tag sits above the hotbar for no reason. The f1 chip is dim, with weak contrast.
findings.fix: Move the f1 controls chip to the 96px left margin, at 16px in --tx-2 on the standard panel. Anchor the party tag to a fixed spot, such as under the 'current pillagers' list. Use the panel recipe for it too.

findings.what: The ammo card is the best element on screen, with a 56px hero number and quiet text. But the '/ 50' is amber, a second accent, and 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and dim.
findings.fix: Set '/ 50' in --tx-2. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Keep the 12 in --tx-1.

v.verdict: The old disconnect banner is gone and the weapon block is a clear hero number, but the HUD still has about eight panel styles, four text sizes of the same row, and a hp bar and pillager list that ignore the earlier advice.

findings.what: The advice was not followed. The bar is still jammed into the corner at about 24px from the left edge and 8px from the bottom, with 'hp 100' drawn inside the bar. The text is about 32px, and its dark green-on-green contrast is poor. It touches the hotbar and is clipped by the screen edge.
findings.fix: Inset the bar 48px from the left and bottom edges. Make it 16px tall with a 4px radius and a --ui-line track. Put 'hp 100' at 20px --tx-1 above or beside it, not inside it. Keep the --ok fill and switch it to --danger below 30%.

findings.what: The 'you' row has the same white as the other rows, so it does not stand out. Text runs 12-14px, below the 16px floor. The panel sits flush at about x=8, off the margin. The chevron is cramped next to 'value at risk', and the row spacing is tight at about 18px. The $ values are right-aligned with a small gap to the names.
findings.fix: Set the text to 16px and the rows to 24px, inside a --ui-panel box with 8px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Colour 'you' in --warn or amber for P1. Move the panel to x=96, y=96. Put 8px of space between the chevron and the header text.

findings.where: left column: 'pillager' bar, three buff cards, three kill-feed rows
findings.what: These are five different left-edge components: a bar with no panel, buff cards at about 210px wide with icons, and kill rows with coloured left ticks of different widths. Their left edges are 8, 8 and 16px and their gaps are uneven (about 60px, 250px). The column reads as scattered pieces. The 'pillager' bar and name are also at 14px, which is small.
findings.fix: Put every left-side element on the same x of 48px, with a single panel style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) and an 8px gap between rows. Stack buffs, then feed, with no 250px dead gap. Give the teammate bar a label at 16px.

findings.what: This is the pickup/feed stack. It has four identical rows in lime text, with a different panel style from the left feed, and 'you killed crawler' repeats the left feed's 'you > crawler x2'. Lime means selected, so using it for body text breaks the guide. Under the 186a rule a line should show in one place only.
findings.fix: Remove the right-side kill lines (kills belong to the left feed only). Keep the right stack for pickups, set in --tx-1 at 16px on a --ui-panel row with a 3px rarity bar. Merge repeats into 'crawler x4'.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown, 'the long dock cache' tag, 'c 146m' tag
findings.what: The three are in three different styles: a wide 300px bar with a chevron, a small tag at x=1675, and a tiny chip at x=1780. Their right edges differ (1900, 1797, 1838) and none sit on the 96px margin. The text is at 14-16px. The teal arrow beside 'c 146m' is cut off the edge of the chip.
findings.fix: Use one chip style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px --tx-1, 40px rows). Right-align all three at x=1824. Fold 'c 146m' into the 'run info' content. Hold the dropdown closed by default.

findings.where: bottom-right weapon block 'scav pistol 12 / 50' and 'b / i backpack'
findings.what: The 56px hero number reads well, but the block is only 12px from the right and bottom edges, and the 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and dim. The panel has a different border and fill from the left rows. The block also visually collides with the hotbar slot numbers '0' and '8' to its left.
findings.fix: Inset the block 48px from the right and bottom edges, with 24px padding. Keep the '12' at 56px and '/ 50' at 20px --tx-2. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2, or drop it into the f1 controls list.

findings.what: Slots 3-0 are only bare numbers floating on the map with no slot frame, so they look like stray text. The numbers are about 14px. Slots 1 and 2 have different frame sizes and spacing from the rest. 'f1 controls' is a small chip sitting at mid-left, not mid-bottom, in 14px.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 64px squares with 8px gaps and the same --ui-panel frame. Dim the empty ones to 40% opacity. Only slot 1 has the lime border. Put 'f1 controls' at 16px, centred under the hotbar.

findings.what: The 14:58 timer is 28px, not the 56px hero size. The teal chip below it is a good use of the --extract colour, but it overlaps the building wall behind it and has a 14px label. The sun glyph next to the clock is tiny and unexplained.
findings.fix: Raise the timer to 32px f-cond 700 and keep the chip at 16px with a --ui-panel fill, 8px below the timer. Remove the sun glyph or give it a label.

v.verdict: A clean, calm title screen with a clear lime primary action and a good dark column, but the orange gradient logo breaks the one-accent rule, the type is too small and low-contrast in places, and the bottom half is a loose pile of unrelated elements.

findings.what: The wordmark uses an orange-to-gold gradient with a drop shadow. That is a gradient wash, and it competes with the lime accent and sits close to the rarity-gold and warn hues. The title and the lime 1 player button both pull the eye, so boldness is in two places.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) with a single lime underline bar or dot, or give it real logo art. Remove the gradient and shadow. Keep lime only on the focused 1 player button.

findings.where: saves block: 'saves' label, pillager new row, name input and buttons
findings.what: The saves block is cramped and mixes four row types. The 'saves' label is about 14px grey, below the 16px minimum. The selected save row is a 42px outlined strip with lime text and a lime border, and it looks like a second focused element beside the filled 1 player button. The name input, change name and create a new save sit in a row with no hierarchy, and the 'pillager' input looks the same as the buttons.
findings.fix: Set the 'saves' label to 16px f-cond +.04em in tx-2 with 16px space below. Make the save row 56px tall on --ui-raised with a 3px lime left bar and tx-1 text, with no lime border or lime text. Put the name input and change name on one row at 48px, and make create a new save a secondary 48px button. Leave 24px between the menu block and the saves block.

findings.where: mode buttons: 2 player co-op, 2 player arcade demo, 1 player arcade demo
findings.what: The three unfocused buttons all look the same, with 1px borders and 20px text. The list is ordered oddly: the 2 player arcade demo comes before the 1 player one. The '(same machine)' text is an explaining parenthetical. Demo modes sit at the same level as the real play modes.
findings.fix: Order the list as 1 player, 2 player co-op, 1 player arcade demo, 2 player arcade demo. Cut '(same machine)' down to 'local co-op', or drop it. Put the two demos in a quieter tx-2 group after a 16px gap. Use 56px rows at an 8px gap, in the same style.

findings.where: bottom key legend (wasd move, mouse aim, lmb fire, e search, f1 controls)
findings.what: The legend is 16px or less, and the 'move' and 'aim' words are grey (about #8a8a8a) on near-black, which is weak from a couch. The key caps are cramped, with about 4px between the cap and the label. The legend is also a how-to-play sentence on a menu, which is clutter. No pad glyphs show, although pad focus matters for this screen.
findings.fix: Raise the legend to 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498) with 8px between each cap and its label and 24px between pairs. Show only the f1 controls hint here, and move the full list into the controls screen. Switch to pad glyphs when a pad is in use.

findings.what: The two buttons are small, about 48px tall, with 16px text at a 1px border. They sit 6px apart and are inset from the corner by a different margin (about 96px right, 33px top) than the 48px / 5% margin used elsewhere. They look like the same tier as the main menu buttons, and nothing tells the player how to reach them with a pad.
findings.fix: Pin both to a 48px margin (right and top) at 48px tall with an 8px gap. Style them as ghost buttons in tx-2 until focused, and make sure they are reachable with pad up or a shoulder button, with the lime focus ring.

findings.what: The tagline is about 18px grey with letter-spacing, and it sits 32px below the logo, which is tight against the 32px space to the first button. The vertical rhythm is uneven: the logo and the button block float in the middle with about 220px of dead space above and 140px below, so the composition feels unanchored. There is no background art or key art, so the screen reads as a generic template with no identity.
findings.fix: Set the tagline to 20px tx-2. Move the group up so the logo's centre sits at about 30% of the screen height. Add key art or a dim top-down raid scene at 15% opacity behind the column, with a scrim of rgba(6,7,8,.80). Use 8px-grid spacing: 24px logo to tagline, 32px tagline to buttons.

findings.what: The stamp 'v0.1258 · oct 28 11:49 pm et' is about 14px, grey and slightly cramped. It sits at a different left inset (97px) from the 48px margin and from the top-right buttons. Build timestamps are dev clutter on a player menu.
findings.fix: Set it to 14px f-body 500 in tx-2 at left 48px and bottom 48px, aligned to the legend baseline. Shorten it to 'v0.1258' and keep the timestamp for debug builds only.

findings.what: The focus state is only a lime fill on 1 player. The menu rows have no focus bar or hover state, and the 4px radius is applied on the buttons but the outlines are thin and low contrast (about #3a4045 against #0b0c0d), so the unfocused rows nearly vanish. With a pad it would be hard to tell what is selected once focus moves down.
findings.fix: Use --ui-line-hi (#4a5257) for idle borders on a --ui-panel (#16191b) fill. On focus, apply a 4px lime left bar plus a --ui-raised fill and a tx-1 label. Keep the solid lime fill for the single primary action only.

v.verdict: This is a readable raid HUD with a strong ammo hero number. It has a stray capital in 'run Info', two crowded panels in the left column, undersized text and near-invisible empty weapon slots.

findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a full-width 300px slab that crowds the room geometry and has no clear job.
findings.fix: Render it as 'run info'. Shrink the bar to about 200px wide and 40px tall on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and sit it on the 48px margin.

findings.what: A 300x300 panel with 24 rows of 14-16px text sits against the left edge at x=16. It is the largest block on the screen and competes with the ammo hero number. It is a wall of text and its margin does not match the other panels (roster at x=8, hp bar at x=24).
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line, 'f1 controls', at mid-bottom left (per rs-1). If the party demo must keep it open, cut it to one column of 8 rows, set every label to 16px tx-2, and put it on a 48px left margin with the same panel fill as the roster.

findings.what: Text is about 14px in tx-2 on a busy map, and the rows are crowded at about 18px pitch. The 'value at risk' header sits on the same baseline as the title and the '0 out · 3 dead' footer looks like an afterthought. The 'you' row is not set apart.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels on a 24px row pitch. Give the 'you' row a --ui-raised fill with a 3px amber (P1) left bar. Right-align the $ values in f-cond. Drop 'dead' into a --danger glyph. Put the panel on the 48px margin.

findings.what: The empty slots show ghosted silhouettes with numbers at about 20% contrast. They look like rendering debris, and the slot numbers float with no frame. Slots 1 and 3 are 100px tiles while the empty ones have no tile at all, so the row has no rhythm. The amber focus ring on slot 3 is fine but also competes with the lime accent rule.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles at an 8px gap, with a 1px --ui-line border. Show empty ones as flat --ui-panel with the number at 16px in tx-2 and no silhouette. Make only the selected slot 80px with a lime 2px border. Keep amber for P1 identity elsewhere.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is oversized (about 36px) and sits on a saturated green bar, which gives it two competing heroes alongside the 56px ammo number. The bar hugs the screen corner at x=24, y=1035 with no safe margin, and the green fill clashes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Set 'hp' at 16px label and '100' at 32px in tx-1 on a --ui-panel plate. Use a 12px bar in --ok. Place it on the 48px bottom-left margin. Reserve the 56px hero size for the ammo only.

findings.what: Two unlabelled 40px circular status icons with amber and teal rings sit above the hp bar. Their meaning is unclear and the ring colours borrow the P1 amber and extract teal tokens.
findings.fix: Align them to the hp bar's left edge on the 8px grid. Use 32px glyphs in --warn or --ok with a 16px tx-2 label or tooltip. Only use teal for extraction.

findings.where: top-centre extract banner and right 'c 152m' waypoint tag
findings.what: The 152m distance is drawn twice, in the 'extract 152m' banner and the 'c 152m' edge tag. The 'c' prefix is cryptic. The teal arc clipped on the right edge reads as an artefact. Per the one-place rule a line shown twice is a defect.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre banner. Make the edge marker a bare teal arrow with no text. Remove the 'c' prefix and the clipped arc, or complete the arc as a 96px ring.

findings.what: The 20 / 24 hero number is correct and strong. 'auto rifle' at about 20px and 'b / i backpack' at about 14px are too small and low contrast. The panel sits about 16px from the corner, not on the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Set 'auto rifle' at 20px tx-1 f-cond 600 and the hint at 16px tx-2. Add a 3px lime bar on the left edge of the panel only. Move it to the 48px right and bottom margins.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen I reviewed before, so there is no like-for-like comparison. The ammo readout is a clear hero number, but the open controls list, a duplicated extract cue, a stray capital and a few weak panels pull it down.

findings.what: The capital 'I' breaks the all-lower-case rule. The panel is also a lone bright header bar floating in the corner with nothing under it, and it reads as a different widget from the other HUD panels.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Use the same panel fill (--ui-panel), 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius as the other HUD panels. Put it at a 48px margin from the top and right.

findings.what: It sits open, roughly 20 rows tall, in the middle of the playfield, with 14 to 16px dim labels and a boxed key cap on every row. It is the largest block of text on screen and competes with the ammo number. In a career raid the list should be folded to one line at mid-bottom left.
findings.fix: In career, fold it to one 16px line, 'f1 controls', at mid-bottom left. In the party demo, if it must stay open, reduce it to the 8 most useful keys. Give the key caps no fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Set the labels in --tx-2 at 16px minimum.

findings.what: The same extraction distance is drawn twice, in two places and two styles. The raid rule is one place per line. The 'c 152m' chip also looks clipped against the building edge.
findings.fix: Keep only the top-centre teal pill, with the direction arrow inside it. Delete the right-edge chip.

findings.where: bottom contract banner 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'
findings.what: It is an explaining sentence with a gold-on-dark body line and an amber left tick. It is the third accent colour fighting the amber slot border and the teal pill. It also sits tight against the bottom edge of the controls panel.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the explanation. Make the text --tx-1 with a 3px --warn left bar. Show it as an alert in the top-centre banner slot, not at the bottom left. Leave a 24px gap from other panels.

findings.what: The three dead rows are dimmed below 4.5:1 at about 14px and are hard to read. The 'value at risk' header is tiny. The footer '0 out · 3 dead' repeats the information in the rows. The chevron is the only affordance for collapsing the panel.
findings.fix: Set the rows to --tx-2 (#aaa498) at 16px. Keep the 'you' row in --tx-1 with a 3px lime or amber bar. Drop the '0 out · 3 dead' footer. Align the $ values right with tabular numerals.

findings.what: The empty slots 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 show faint ghost silhouettes and floating numerals. This is visual noise, and the numerals are too dim to read. The 'f' tag on slot 1 is also unclear.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 56px squares with a 1px --ui-line border and no ghost art. Put the numeral at 16px in --tx-2 inside the corner. Only the filled slots keep art, with a lime border on the selected one.

findings.where: bottom-left 'hp 100' bar and the two round icons above it
findings.what: The oversized 'hp 100' type sits against the bottom edge, with only about 12px of margin against the 5% rule. A saturated green bar with white type is the loudest colour mass in the HUD. The two circular icons (an amber eye and a teal icon) have no labels and use amber and teal outside their stated meaning.
findings.fix: Set the hp type at 32px, in the bar. Move the bar up to a 48px bottom margin. Use a quieter --ok fill with a --ui-line track. Make the two status icons 32px, --tx-2 outline-only, and keep teal for extraction only.

findings.what: It is a lone chip on a green fill, sits at the edge with about 8px of margin, and uses a different colour from every other panel. It reads as debug text.
findings.fix: Remove it, or make it a 16px --tx-2 label with no fill at a 48px margin. Show the device only when it changes.

v.verdict: A readable, consistent dark HUD with a strong ammo hero number, but it is crowded on the left, and the raid-controls card and the wide-spaced 'packing floor' world label both break the quiet-HUD rules.

findings.what: The full 4-column key list is open and covers about 300x300px of the left side. The owner ordered it folded to one short line, with F1 to open it. It also sits right above the feed line and the scoreboard card, so the left edge reads as a stack of three dense blocks.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at mid-bottom left, as the owner ordered. If it must stay open, cut it to 6 rows and give it the same 8px padding and 4px radius as the other panels.

findings.what: It has nine lines of 14-16px text in a dense list. The 'dead' tags and the dollar values are in a dim grey, close to the 4.5:1 floor, and they sit on top of the busy world. The 'you' row is the only one that stands out, and the one purple name has no explanation. It competes with the minimap and the clock, and it is a lot to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Show the top 3 rows plus 'you', and fold the rest behind the chevron. Raise the text to 16px minimum in --tx-2 #aaa498, and use --ui-panel #16191b at 92% opacity so the world does not show through. Align the right-hand values on one column.

findings.what: The eye has no clear second stop after the ammo number. Four dense blocks (scoreboard, minimap, controls, ammo) all get the same weight. The scoreboard and the controls card are bigger than the hp bar and the weapon slots, which carry the real status.
findings.fix: Shrink or fold the scoreboard and controls. Make the hp bar 24px tall with a 16px label, and keep ammo as the one hero (56px). Everything else drops to 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The green bar sits flush against the screen edge, 12px from the left and 12px from the bottom. The 'hp 100' text is oversized, with its glyph tops touching the bar's top edge, and the bar is a flat saturated green with no panel. It does not look like the ammo card, which has a panel. It sits outside the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Move it to a 48px inset (the 5% margin), 24px tall, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-panel backing. Set the label to 20px f-cond 700 and centre it vertically. Use the --ok green #76b97c.

findings.what: The selected slot 2 has an amber/gold border and an empty dark gun icon. The accent is lime, and the gold is rarity-only. Slots 4-0 are ghosted, and their numerals are floating with no frame. The 'f' key badge in slot 1 is tiny, about 12px.
findings.fix: Use --acc #e6ff3d for the 2px selected border. Give slots 4-0 the same 4px-radius frame at 30% opacity, or drop the ghost icons. Set the key badge to 16px.

findings.what: The wide-tracked grey label is a different style from every other type on screen (about 24px, 0.2em tracking, low contrast on the tan floor). It reads as a leftover from another design, and it clashes with the f-cond HUD type.
findings.fix: Use f-cond 600 at 20px with 0.08em tracking in --tx-1 with a 1px dark shadow. Or use the same pill as the 'extract 63m' chip.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract chip (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: The 9:00 is the right size, but the teal 'extract 63m' pill is tight under it (4px gap). The teal arrow under the pill touches the pill edge. The sun icon beside the clock is 28px and the only coloured icon in the cluster.
findings.fix: Add an 8px gap between the clock and the pill. Move the arrow 8px lower. Make the icon the same 24px height as the clock digits.

findings.where: minimap and 'run info' bar, top-right (x1603-1902, y18-362)
findings.what: The minimap has a thick white-grey frame edge and a collapse chevron. Its label bar 'run info' is a full-width dark strip with a second chevron, and it carries no information. The map shows the world as abstract grey bars that do not match the playfield.
findings.fix: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius to match the other cards. Put the 'run info' strip at 16px with the same 8px padding. Make it 32px tall. Or remove the strip until it holds content.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is readable, but the open controls list, the loud hp bar and the two inconsistent top-left and top-right panels crowd the corners. Meanwhile the real focus (the player and the aim) is under-served, and several pieces are clipped or off-style.

findings.what: The full two-column controls list (about 20 key rows) is open on screen at the start of a raid. The owner ordered it folded to one short line, with F1 to open it. At 300x300 px it covers a large part of the playfield and competes with the scoreboard above it.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line ('f1 controls') at mid-bottom left with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Open it only on F1, and close it again after about 8 s of idle.

findings.where: right edge, mid and bottom ('the for', 'the seal 0%')
findings.what: The world labels are clipped by the screen edge ('the for' is cut off). 'the seal 0%' is light blue on a bright floor with no plate, so contrast is low and it reads as a debug label.
findings.fix: Clamp label anchors to 24px inside the viewport and flip them to the left of the object near the edge. Put a --scrim plate at 80% behind the text. Use tx-1 text, not a random blue.

findings.what: A flat saturated green bar with an oversized 'hp 100' at roughly 36px is the loudest object on screen, louder than the ammo hero number. It breaks the 'one bold thing' rule. The green is generic, and the text sits straight on the fill with no contrast control. The bar also runs off the screen's lower-left corner with no margin.
findings.fix: Make the bar 8px high and 280px wide with a --ui-panel track and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 24px from the edges. Use 20px f-cond label text. Fill with --ok, and switch to --danger below 30%.

findings.what: The panel is crowded. Nine rows of 15px grey text, a '$' value column and 'dead' tags are set at a different size and padding from the controls panel below it. The purple name (fbi_surveillance_van) looks like a stray colour. The caret at top right has no clear purpose, and the list is dense and hard to scan from a couch.
findings.fix: Show 'you' plus the top 3 rows, and collapse the rest behind the caret. Set rows at 16px with an 8px row gap. Use one panel style for every HUD box: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Mark the player's own row with a lime 3px bar only. Drop the purple, or explain it with a legend.

findings.what: The minimap has two different chevrons, and its tiny icons at about 10px are unreadable. The 'run info' bar below it has a different border and weight from the other panels. The minimap's cut-off right edge touches the screen edge with no margin.
findings.fix: Inset the minimap 24px from the edges. Use 16px minimum for map icons and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the 'run info' header 16px f-cond 600 in the same panel style and radius as the rest.

findings.where: centre top, timer and extract pill
findings.what: The '9:00' timer with its sun icon and the teal 'extract 63m' pill use different type treatments (heavy condensed against a plain body font). The teal arrow under the pill floats with no anchor. The 'packing floor' zone label below uses wide letter-spacing, which is a fourth text style on screen.
findings.fix: Use --fs-hero 56px f-cond 800 only for the timer, with the pill at 16px f-cond 600 +.04em. Put the arrow inside the pill. Set the zone label in 16px f-cond with the standard tracking, in tx-2.

findings.what: The ammo panel is decent, with a hero '12 / 60'. 'scav pistol [ads]' has square brackets, which look like debug text. 'b / i backpack' in 14px is the smallest text and low contrast. The panel is tight against the corner and overlaps the edge of the world art behind it.
findings.fix: Show 'ads' as a small 16px tag with a --ui-raised chip, not in brackets. Raise the footer hint to 16px tx-2. Move the panel 24px in from the edges.

findings.what: The slot tiles are good, and the lime/amber selected frame is clear. The empty slots 4-0 show only floating numerals at about 14px that nearly vanish on the grey wall. The loadout also sits in front of a wall texture and its hint text ghosts through at the bottom.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlined 72px tiles at 40% opacity, with 16px numerals in tx-2. Add a 6px --scrim plate behind the whole strip so the wall texture does not ghost through.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but five separate panels (leaderboard, controls, minimap, run info, weapon card) all pull on the eye at once, and the 4x scope view shows almost no scope effect.

findings.what: The screenshot is meant to show ADS zooming toward the aim, but the frame looks like a normal view. The only cue is a faint ring at the cursor and a thin red laser. The camera shows no obvious zoom, vignette or scope framing, and the player character is not visible, so the 4x state doesn't read.
findings.fix: Add a clear ADS state: darken the screen edges (vignette at about 35% black from radius 60% outward), tighten the reticle to a 2px cross with a 24px gap, and show the player character and the zoom factor next to the reticle.

findings.what: The controls list is always open and large (about 300x295px) in a career raid. The style guide says it should be folded to one short line, with F1 opening it. The 'move', 'fight', 'gear' and 'raid' group labels are a dim grey, and the two columns have uneven row spacing. It competes with the leaderboard directly above it.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 'f1 controls' line at 16px, bottom-left at x=48, y=1032. When it is open, use a 24px row pitch, 16px labels in tx-2 (#aaa498), and the same 4px radius and #16191b fill as the other panels.

findings.what: This is dense, clutter-level text: 9 rows of 15px type, with names and dollar values in a muted grey that is hard to read at couch distance. The header, the 'you' row and the dead rows barely differ, and 'you' $1,620 is not highlighted. 'dead' repeats on every row, and the '0 out · 7 dead' footer repeats the same information.
findings.fix: Show only 'you' and the top 3 rows at 16px minimum. Make the 'you' row tx-1 on a #1e2225 row fill with a 3px amber (P1) bar on the left. Drop the 'dead' suffix and show a skull glyph in danger red (#e5482f) instead. Remove the footer line.

findings.what: The ammo hero number '5 / 60' is good, but the '4x scope' text is small and thin, the 'b / i backpack' hint at 14px is below the 16px floor, and the card border and corner radius differ from the leaderboard and minimap panels.
findings.fix: Set the hint to 16px tx-2. Show '4x' as a lime (#e6ff3d) 16px tag in the card's top-right corner. Match the panel radius (4px) and border (#4a5257) to the other HUD panels.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' label sits inside the bar in a heavy 30px display weight that is bigger than anything else in the HUD apart from the ammo. The bar is a flat, saturated green with no frame, track or segmentation, and it looks like a generic template. The text is not centred vertically in the bar.
findings.fix: Lower the label to 20px f-cond 700, right-aligned inside the bar. Add a 2px #2e3337 track and a 4px radius, and make the bar 16px tall at 25 to 30% opacity behind the fill. Keep it clear of the controls panel by at least 24px.

findings.what: The minimap has no frame or title and runs to the top-right corner with about 18px margin, below the 5% margin the style guide wants. The 'run info' bar is a second dropdown with a chevron that looks like the leaderboard's chevron, so they look like duplicates. Only a few of the marker glyphs on the map are legible.
findings.fix: Inset the minimap to a 48px margin and give it a 1px #4a5257 border. Merge 'run info' into the minimap header at 16px. Enlarge the player arrow to 16px in amber.

findings.what: The empty slots 4 to 8 and 0 are ghosted gun silhouettes on a very low-contrast background. The numbers 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are tiny at about 13px, and the number 7 is lost against the crate in the scene. The selected slot 2 (fist) has a gold/amber border, but the style guide says only lime means 'selected'.
findings.fix: Hide empty slots, or draw them at 40% opacity with the numbers at 16px in tx-2. Change the selected slot border to --acc #e6ff3d at 3px.

findings.what: The '9:00' timer and the teal 'extract 63m' pill sit very close together, and the small teal arrow below it points at nothing in particular. The 'packing floor' location label is world-space lettering in wide letterspacing that is hard to read against the street and conflicts with the car. It reads as a different font.
findings.fix: Put 'extract 63m' on the same row as the timer, separated by 16px. Remove the lone arrow or merge it into the pill. Either render 'packing floor' in f-cond 20px, letterspacing 0.04em, with a 60% dark plate behind it, or drop it.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has a strong ammo hero number and a readable hotbar, but it is crowded: three panels fight for the left side, the controls list is fully open, and the type, label sizes and fills are inconsistent.

findings.what: The controls list is fully open and is the largest panel on screen. The owner's order (rs-1) is that it sits mid-bottom left, folded to one short line, and opens with F1. Here it covers a big part of the playfield and competes with the scoreboard directly above it.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 28px line ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, above the hp bar. Open it only on F1, and cap the open card at about 360x420px.

findings.what: A dense 8-row table in 14-15px type. The 'dead' tags and dim greys sit below 4.5:1 contrast on the dark panel. The footer ('0 out · 7 dead') adds more noise, and the purple name is an unexplained colour. It is clutter that a player glances at once. It also stacks directly over the controls panel with only about 170px between them.
findings.fix: Collapse it by default to the header and the 'you' row, as 'run info' at top-right already does. Raise the row text to 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Drop the purple name or give it a legend. Make the 'dead' tags --danger at 16px.

findings.what: The eye lands on the green hp bar and the 5/60 ammo number first, which is right. But the '9:00' clock and the 'extract 63m' pill are small and sit tight against the top edge. The extract pill is the key objective, yet it is a 16px teal chip. The 'sentry r-46' world label is a heavy grey slab at about 32px, bigger than any HUD label, and it competes with the objective.
findings.fix: Make the extract timer the hero (--fs-hero 56px, teal, f-cond 800) or at least 32px, and set the clock to 20px. Shrink the sentry label to 20px on a --scrim chip with 8px padding.

findings.what: A flat bright green fill with 'hp 100' in oversized text. The text is clipped and jammed against the bar's left and bottom edges. The bar sits flush to the screen corner, with no 5% margin and no panel or border, so it does not match the other panels, which use dark fills and a 1px border.
findings.fix: Inset the bar to 48px from the left and bottom edges. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the label to 20px f-cond and the fill to --ok. Put the number inside at a 16px left pad.

findings.what: Slot 2 has an amber/gold ring. The guide says lime (--acc) is the only 'selected' colour and gold is reserved for rarity. Slots 4-8 and 0 are near-invisible ghosts at low contrast, and their numbers ('4', '5', '6') float with no cell, so the row looks half-finished. The 'rb' badge and the '60' counts are tiny, at roughly 14px.
findings.fix: Change the selected ring to --acc #e6ff3d at 2px. Give the empty slots a 1px --ui-line cell at 72x72px, and lift the number labels to 16px --tx-2. Raise the ammo counts to 16px.

findings.what: The key caps ('ls', 'b', 'a', 'lb / rb') are plain grey boxes of different widths, so the action column starts at ragged positions in the left column. Group headings ('move', 'gear', 'fight') are dim grey at about 15px and sit uneven against the rows. There is no pad glyph, so a pad player has to decode the labels.
findings.fix: Set the key caps to a fixed 56px width. Use 16px headings in --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Align both columns' text to a common 8px grid. Use pad button glyphs for a, b, x and the triggers.

findings.what: '5 / 60' works as the hero number, but the header 'longshot 4x scope' is a different weight and the 'view backpack' hint is about 14px. The card is crowded into the corner at 10px from the edge, with a different border radius and fill from the controls panel.
findings.fix: Inset the card to 48px from the edge. Set the weapon name to 20px and the hint to 16px. Use the same 4px radius and a --ui-panel fill as the other panels.

findings.what: The minimap is a near-black rectangle with sparse white bars. Its chevron toggles and 'run info' bar are fine, but the 14px legend glyphs and the tiny yellow, red and teal markers are hard to read. The panel is cropped hard at the right edge with about 10px of margin, which looks cramped next to the left-side panels. The 'packing floor' zone label is faint letter-spaced grey text that is almost lost on the floor.
findings.fix: Inset the HUD panels to 48px from the screen edges. Make the minimap markers 12px minimum. Set the zone label to 20px in --tx-1 on a --scrim plate.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has a clear ammo hero and a readable hotbar, but it is cluttered: the controls card is open at left, the leaderboard and the run-info panel are heavy, and corner elements are clipped. Panel styles and type sizes vary, and none of it carries a strong identity.

findings.where: right edge, 'the seal 0' label at y~472
findings.what: The world label is clipped by the screen edge, and its light-blue colour is not a player colour (P2 should be cyan). It reads as a rendering bug.
findings.fix: Clamp the label inside a 48px safe margin, or move it to the left of its anchor. Use --extract or --tx-1 only if it is not the P2 tag.

findings.what: The 300x300px controls list is fully open in a raid. The style guide's order is one folded line, mid-bottom left, opened by F1. It covers a lot of the play field and competes with the hero ammo number.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line, 'f1 controls', at bottom-left (x 5%, y ~1000). Open it only on F1.

findings.what: A 9-row panel of 14-16px text at constant weight, with muted names. The 'you' row, which should be the only anchor, is barely separated from the rest. The '0 out · 7 dead' footer and the 'dead' tags repeat information. Purple and white name colours add a third hue with no meaning.
findings.fix: Collapse to the top 3 rows plus 'you' by default. Give the 'you' row a --ui-raised fill with a 3px amber bar. Drop the per-row 'dead' text. Make all names --tx-2.

findings.what: Slots 4-0 are bare, dim ghost silhouettes with no frame, and their digits are 16px low-contrast text. They collide with world props such as the barrel and crate at x~900 and x~1550. The slots are 100px wide, while the ghosts follow no slot grid. The selected slot 2 (amber border, empty icon) reads as the focused slot, but amber is P1 and the guide reserves lime for 'selected'.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots on one 88px grid, each with the same 1px --ui-line-hi frame on a --ui-panel fill at 80%. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border. Keep digits at --tx-2, at least 4.5:1 contrast.

findings.where: top-right minimap and 'run info' bar (x1603-1902, y18-363)
findings.what: The minimap's ragged black plate has no panel treatment matching the other cards: its corner radius differs and its border weight differs. The 'run info' bar is a different style again (chevron on a dark bar). The minimap sits 18px from the edge and the pickups stack is not visible, so the margins are not on the 5% rule.
findings.fix: Put the minimap and run info in one --ui-panel card with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 24px inner padding and a 5% screen margin. Make the 'run info' label 16px f-cond, with a chevron on the right.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text is oversized and heavy, about 32px, in a 33px-tall full-green bar. It competes with the ammo hero for the hero role. It touches the bottom edge, within 12px, with no margin. The bar is flat green, which fails the one-hero rule.
findings.fix: Set 'hp' at 16px label and '100' at 32px. Use a 12px bar with a --ok fill on a --ui-panel track. Lift it to the 5% bottom margin (y ~1026).

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract chip (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: The 9:00 clock is 28px with a sun icon in a dark circle. The 'extract 63m' chip is teal on dark green, and the small teal arrow below it points at nothing readable. Three small treatments sit in 65px of height.
findings.fix: Show the timer at 32px f-cond 700. Place the extract chip under it, 16px --extract text on a --ui-panel pill. Drop the arrow, or make it a 12px chevron in the same --extract.

findings.what: The hero '25 / 60' is well sized and has good contrast. The 'auto rifle 2x scope' header and the 'b / i backpack' footer are 14-16px grey on a black card, and the card is 8px from the right edge instead of the 5% margin. The slash and '60' are in a different grey from the '25'.
findings.fix: Move the card in to the 5% margin (96px from the right). Set the header at 16px --tx-2 and the footer at 14px --tx-2 (4.5:1 minimum). Keep '25' at 56px --tx-1 and '60' at 32px --tx-2.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but five separate boxes (a leaderboard, a full controls card, a minimap, an ammo card and a hotbar) compete for attention, no one of them clearly leads, and the type, weight and colour treatment differs from box to box.

findings.what: The full two-column controls list is open in the raid. The raid-controls order says it sits mid-bottom left, folded to one short line, and F1 opens it. Here it is a tall card with about 24 rows, and it sits over the playfield at the same visual weight as the HUD. It is also clutter.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line such as 'f1 controls' at mid-bottom left, and show the full card only on F1. If it must show for walk-up guests, shrink it to 6 keys and drop it after 10s.

findings.what: The panel is crowded. It has 10 lines at about 14-16px, a 'current pillagers 0' header, a 'value at risk' label, '$x dead' on every row and a '0 out · 7 dead' footer. Every row is the same weight, and the muted grey names are low contrast on the dark panel. The hierarchy is flat and the panel is the wrong size for a quiet raid HUD.
findings.fix: Keep 'you' at 20px in tx-1. Set the other rows to 16px tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, and drop the repeated 'dead' words in favour of a dim marker. Cut the header to one line and make the panel about 30% shorter.

findings.where: HUD boxes overall (leaderboard, controls, minimap, 'run info', ammo card)
findings.what: The panels do not match each other. Fills and borders vary, the corner radii vary between square and about 4px, and the headers differ: 'run info' has a chevron bar while the leaderboard has a caret in the corner. Type sizes and bold usage also vary. The result reads as unrelated boxes, not one system.
findings.fix: Use one panel fill (#16191b) with a 1px #4a5257 border, a 4px radius and a 16px padding grid for all of them. Use one header style: 16px f-cond 600 with the caret on the right.

findings.what: The timer '9:00' and the teal 'extract 63m' pill are small at the top centre, about 28px. The hero-number rule gives the timer 56px as the one hero, but ammo '25 / 60' is the biggest thing on screen. The extraction pill is a tiny, tight pill with a faint arrow glyph.
findings.fix: Make the timer about 40-56px f-cond 800 and give the pill 16px text with 8px/16px padding. Make the ammo number a secondary 40px.

findings.what: An explaining sentence in a banner: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'. It also sits against the controls card, with a gap of about 15px. Amber text with an amber bar competes with the lime-only-for-selected rule and with rarity gold. It is a tutorial line on a raid screen.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby', move it to the left feed at 16px, and drop the 'gold glow' explainer. Use a warn glyph and tx-1 text.

findings.what: Slot 2 is drawn with a lime-yellow outline and a dark empty gun. This could be the selected slot, but the outline reads as amber/gold, not the lime accent. Slots 4-0 are faded outlines at very low contrast, and the slot numbers float apart from them, so the row has no clear structure. Slot 1 shows an 'f' key tag that is not explained.
findings.fix: Use --acc #e6ff3d for the selected slot outline with a 2px stroke. Give the idle slots a #4a5257 1px border and number labels at 16px tx-2. Remove or explain the 'f' tag.

findings.what: The bar sits about 12px from the bottom edge. Its flat green fill with a large 'hp 100' in a near-black outline looks like a different, cruder style from the other panels, with no panel frame and no label hierarchy. It is also close to the screen edge, under the 5% margin rule.
findings.fix: Put it on a panel with a 4px radius and 1px border, place it about 54px (5%) from the bottom, and set 'hp' at 16px tx-2 and '100' at 32px f-cond 700.

findings.where: player 2 and keyboard tag, top-left (x8-105, y8-30)
findings.what: A small 'keyboard' tag in monospace-like type at about 16px sits at the very edge of the screen, and it is the one mono-style label on screen. Neither an identity nor a P2 colour is shown (the guide says P2 is cyan). The font breaks the Barlow-only rule.
findings.fix: Use f-cond 600 at 16px with a cyan #47d8c6-family P2 chip, inset to 5% margins, and show 'p2 · keyboard'.

v.verdict: The old scoreboard and controls panels are now folded to single chips, which fixes the worst clutter, but the HUD still mixes three chip styles and the hp bar, key badges and weapon row remain rough.

findings.what: The bar sits 24px from the edge and 12px from the screen bottom, and it has no frame. The 'hp 100' label is pixel-bold and oversized against the 20px body size. The fill is a flat green with no --ui-panel backing, so it reads as a debug bar.
findings.fix: Inset it to 48px from the left and 40px from the bottom. Make it 24px tall with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-panel backing. Set the label to 20px f-cond 700 in --acc-ink on --ok #76b97c, vertically centred. Use 16px for 'hp' and 20px for the number.

findings.what: The selected slot 2 is amber/gold (#ffc72e-like), but the guide says lime --acc is the only 'selected' colour and gold is rarity only. The slot-2 icon is almost invisible, and the key badge numerals are about 13px. Slot 1 carries a tiny 'f' badge that has no clear meaning.
findings.fix: Make the slot 2 border 2px --acc #e6ff3d, and use --ui-raised #1e2225 for its fill. Raise the icon contrast to 100% for the selected slot and 60% for idle slots. Set the key numerals to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Remove the 'f' badge or move it into the controls chip.

findings.what: Seven ghost weapon icons at about 20% opacity with 13px digits float with no frames. They read as stray artwork and hold no hierarchy. They are close to the ammo panel and are lost against the busy floor.
findings.fix: Either drop slots 4-0 until the weapons are owned, or give each a 4px-radius --ui-panel frame at 40% opacity, 56x56 like slots 1-3, with 16px digits. Keep the row on the 8px grid.

findings.where: top-left and top-right chips (x8-367 y143-168, x1603-1900 y20-54)
findings.what: The two collapsed chips use a different left inset from the screen margin (8px vs 1603 on the right), and they are different widths and heights. Their text is only about 16px in tight Barlow. They sit at different distances from the edge and neither lines up with the 5% margin. The chevrons are tiny.
findings.fix: Make both chips 36px high, with a 4px radius, a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Anchor them to the same 48px inset. Use 16px f-cond 600 text in --tx-1, a 16px chevron, and the same width of 320px.

findings.what: The card is right-aligned to just 10px from the edge. 'auto rifle' is about 20px, '25' is the 56px hero, and '/ 60' is slightly smaller. The 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and sits in a different baseline column. The card touches the edge and is not in the 48px safe margin.
findings.fix: Move the card to a 48px inset. Align 'auto rifle' (16px --tx-2) left with the hero number, and set '/ 60' at 32px --tx-2. Make the hint 16px --tx-2 on the same left edge.

findings.what: The 'f1 controls' chip is correctly folded, as the owner ordered, but it is only 24px tall and sits against the wall art at x437. It has a different border treatment from the top chips. The 'fl' key badge reads as 'fl' because the 1 looks like an l.
findings.fix: Match it to the top chips (36px high, 4px radius, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border). Anchor it at x48, above the hp bar with a 16px gap. Give the f1 badge a 16px f-cond 700 label with a 1px outline.

findings.where: world labels: 'the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'sentry r-46', 'packing floor'
findings.what: There are four label styles: cyan, orange, a boxed grey chip, and a wide-tracked grey 'packing floor' in a different pixel-looking font. 'packing floor' looks like an arcade font, which the owner banned. They vary between about 14 and 18px with no shadows, and the cyan is low contrast on the busy floor.
findings.fix: Use one world-label style: 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 with a 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.8) outline, and tracking of at most +.04em. Remove the 'packing floor' letter-spacing. Colour only the state with --extract or --warn.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract banner (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: The '9:00' clock and its icon crowd the 'extract 63m' pill. The extract pill is teal text on near-black with a 4px radius, but the clock has no backing and is hard to read against the tan wall. The hero is split, with the clock at about 30px and the extract number at 16px.
findings.fix: Put both in one 48px-high --ui-panel plate centred at the top, 16px from the edge. Set the clock at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 and 'extract 63m' at 16px --extract below it with an 8px gap.

v.verdict: The controls list is now folded to one line and the 'run info' and scoreboard bars are quieter, but the world is washed out by an overlay. The hp bar is still crude, the minimap is gone, and labels still clip at the screen edge.

findings.where: right edge, 'the for' label at y≈817
findings.what: The label is cut off by the viewport edge. 'the seal 0%' sits in unlit pale blue with no plate, so its contrast on the busy ground is weak.
findings.fix: Clamp every world label to at least 24px inside the viewport and flip it to the left of its object near an edge. Set tx-1 text at 16px on a --scrim plate at 80% with 4px radius and 8px padding.

findings.what: The bar runs flush to the left and bottom edges with no margin. The label is oversized and has no plate. It reads as a fat green slab pushed up against the hotbar. Its right end ends about 120px short of the first hotbar slot, which looks accidental.
findings.fix: Place it 24px from the left and bottom edges at 280x8px. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put the label in 20px f-cond 600 above the bar and the number in tx-1. Use --ok for the fill and switch to --danger below 30%.

findings.where: center scene, large pale wedge/circle overlay
findings.what: A large white translucent cone and circle covers about 40% of the screen. It reads as a rendering artifact or a washed-out vignette. It lowers contrast under the player and the sentry and competes with the HUD for first attention.
findings.fix: Cut the wedge to about 12% alpha with a 1px edge, or cap it at the weapon range. Darken the area outside it with a --scrim at 35% so the ads view reads as focus, not fog.

findings.where: bottom-right ammo panel ('scav pistol [ads]', '12 / 60', 'b / i backpack')
findings.what: The panel is the strongest hero element, but the weapon name and bracketed '[ads]' are the same weight as the ammo and read as noise. The 'b / i backpack' line is about 14px, and the panel overlaps world objects on its left, with a red barrel and a station showing through the panel's left edge.
findings.fix: Make the panel opaque (--ui-panel at 94%) with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show the name at 16px --tx-2, 12 at 56px lime (hero), and '/ 60' at 32px --tx-2. Show 'ads' as a 16px tag. Move the hint to 16px and drop 'backpack' from it.

findings.what: The selected slot has an amber border, but the guide says lime means selected and amber is P1's player colour, so the meaning is ambiguous. The empty slot numbers 4 to 0 float as bare grey glyphs on the wall with no cells, so the bar has no clear edge. They also overlap the wall texture and are low contrast.
findings.fix: Give every slot an 80x80px --ui-panel cell with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Use a 2px --acc border plus a 3px --acc bar on the selected slot. Show empty slots at 40% opacity in the same cell. Use 16px numbers in --tx-2.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' bars
findings.what: The two bars are almost the same, but the left one is 8px from the edge while the right one is about 18px, so the margins disagree. Their text is about 15px and the carets are small. The empty-state '0' row gives the left bar no reason to be visible.
findings.fix: Inset both bars 24px from the edges, using one 48px-high panel style. Use 16px f-cond 600 text and 16px carets. Hide the scoreboard bar when the count is 0, or show 'you' in its place.

findings.what: The clock, the sun icon, the teal chip and the small arrow stack up as four different treatments in 60px. The chip's text is about 15px. The teal colour is correct for extraction, but the arrow floats loose below it.
findings.fix: Lock the stack into one panel. Show the clock at 32px f-cond 700 and the chip at 16px with the arrow inside it. Keep the teal border only on the chip. Hold 8px between the elements.

findings.where: 'packing floor' zone label and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: 'packing floor' uses wide letter-spacing of about 0.2em with a thin grey stroke, a different style from every other label. The 'f1 controls' chip is 16px but sits on the wall texture. Its left edge, at x≈435, doesn't line up with the hp bar (x≈24) or the hotbar.
findings.fix: Set 'packing floor' at 20px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 on a --scrim plate. Move the chip to 24px from the left edge, directly above the hp label, with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

v.verdict: The HUD is much calmer than before: the controls panel is folded to one line, the leaderboard is a collapsed bar, and the weapon card has a clear hero ammo number. The ADS state itself is still weak, with no vignette or zoom feedback, and some HUD text is mixed in size and too small.

findings.what: Nothing reads as 'scoped in'. The frame is flat grey with no edge darkening, and the reticle is a faint 140px ring with a tiny glyph. The red laser is the loudest thing on screen, and the player is lost in a pale circle at left.
findings.fix: Add a vignette of about 35% black from 60% radius outward. Draw the reticle as a 2px lime #e6ff3d cross with a 24px gap and a 1px ring. Fade the laser to 40% opacity. Put a '4x' tag 16px beside the reticle.

findings.what: This bar is the lowest-contrast chrome on screen. A thin dropdown with a tiny 16px label and a chevron, sitting flush at x=8, which is off the 48px margin. It also shows a bare '0' with no meaning.
findings.fix: Move it to x=48, y=48. Use a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius. Set the label to 16px tx-2 and the count to 20px tx-1. Hide the bar when the count is 0.

findings.what: It is a second dropdown in the same style but sized differently (298 by 36 against 360 by 28) and sitting at a different margin. Together the two bars look like browser selects, not game HUD.
findings.fix: Make both bars 36px tall with the same radius and border. Align the right one to x=1872 (48px margin) and the left to x=48. Cut the width to what the label needs, about 200px.

findings.what: The bar is a flat, saturated green slab with a large 'hp 100' label overlapping the fill edge. It is 24px from the screen edge, off the margin, and crowds the 'f1 controls' chip at x=435.
