findings.fix: Move the bar to x=48. Make it 16px tall with a 2px #2e3337 track and a 4px radius. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 right-aligned inside. Keep 24px or more of clearance from the controls chip. Use --ok #76b97c, not a bright green.

findings.what: The hero ammo '5 / 60' works, but 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and dim. The '4x scope' sits in the title with no accent. The card runs to x=1910, so there is no right margin.
findings.fix: Shift the card left to end at x=1872. Set the hint to 16px tx-2 (#aaa498). Pull '4x' out as a lime 16px tag in the top-right corner. Match the 4px radius and #4a5257 border.

findings.what: The empty slots are ghost silhouettes with tiny 14px numbers. They compete with the three live slots and with the world crates behind them (a crate sits at slot 7). They read as clutter.
findings.fix: Drop the empty-slot icons to 15% opacity, or hide the empty slots. Keep numbers at 16px tx-2. Give the strip a #16191b 60% backing so the world does not bleed through.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract chip (905,10 to 1030,75)
findings.what: The extract chip is a teal pill with a 16px label and a stray small teal triangle under it. The clock is 36px, so it is neither the 32px nor the 56px token. The sun icon is crowded to the right of the clock.
findings.fix: Set the clock to 32px f-cond 700. Put 16px of padding between the clock and the icon. Drop the chip's triangle, or turn it into a 16px arrow inside the chip. Use a 4px radius and a 1px --extract border.

findings.what: The zone name is letter-spaced grey text dropped on a busy tile and overlapped by the truck, so the 'r' is half covered. Contrast is low and it looks like a stray string.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px tx-1 with a 1px dark shadow at 60% opacity. Move it to y=110, clear of the truck. Fade it out after 3s.

v.verdict: The controls list is gone and the HUD is much calmer, but the type is still too small and the style is inconsistent: the hp bar is cramped in the corner, the selected ring is amber instead of lime, and the extract timer carries no weight.

findings.what: The bar is jammed into the corner with no margin. The 'hp 100' label is oversized, off-style and has no padding. The fill is a bright flat green with no track, border or container, and a world prop sits behind it.
findings.fix: Inset the bar to 48px from the left and bottom edges. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ok fill. Set the label to 20px f-cond 600 with a 16px left pad. Drop the 'hp' word or set it at 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The selected ring is amber (#f5b73b-ish), so it reads as a rarity or warning colour. The guide says lime --acc means 'selected'. The empty slots 4-0 are ghost icons with no cells, and the number labels are about 12px and dim.
findings.fix: Make the selected ring 2px --acc #e6ff3d. Give every slot a 72x72px cell with a 1px --ui-line border and --ui-panel fill. Set the number labels to 16px --tx-2. Keep the ammo counts at 16px.

findings.what: The extract timer is a small 18px teal chip. The clock '9:00' is bigger and heavier than the timer, so the eye lands on the clock, which is the less important of the two. The teal arrow below it is orphaned.
findings.fix: Make the extract timer the hero: 32px f-cond 800 --extract, with the clock at 20px --tx-2 beside or above it. Attach the arrow to the chip with 8px of spacing, or drop it.

findings.what: The label is 32px light text on a flat grey rectangle with square corners. The rectangle overlaps the wall and the robot's head. It is far louder than the hp bar and the other HUD text, and it breaks the 4px radius rule.
findings.fix: Set the label to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1 on a --scrim chip with a 4px radius and 8px padding. Put it 8px above the robot's head so it doesn't clip.

findings.what: The weapon name is a regular-weight 24px, and 'view backpack' is about 14px, dim and tucked against the edge. The 5 / 60 hero number is correct at 56px. The card sits only 10px from the screen edge, not the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Set the weapon name to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Raise 'view backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom edges. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px padding.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' dropdowns (x8-367, y143-170; x1603-1901, y18-55)
findings.what: The two collapsed bars are different widths and heights. They sit at different margins (8px vs about 18px) and neither lines up with the 48px grid. The label is 16px bold, with a tight left pad and a thin chevron. They look like browser selects, not game panels.
findings.fix: Make both 40px tall with a 48px margin. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use 16px f-cond 600 labels, 16px left padding and an 8px chevron inset. Align the top edges to y48.

findings.what: It is wide-tracked grey text with no backing. It is hard to read against the wall and floor, and its letterspacing is a different style from every other label.
findings.fix: Use 20px f-cond 600 at +.04em tracking. Set it in --tx-1 with a 60% --scrim chip behind it, or drop the tracking to match the other labels.

findings.what: The panels use at least three treatments: a bordered dark card for ammo, a bordered chip for extract, borderless fills for hp and the sentry label. The type is a mix of heavy condensed (hp, 5/60) and light (sentry, weapon name), so there is no single system.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel fill at 90%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius. Pick the weights by role: 800 for the hero number only, 600 for labels. Apply it to the hp bar, extract chip, sentry label and both dropdowns.

v.verdict: The controls list is now a single line and the HUD is calmer, but the 'the seal' label still clips off the right edge, the hotbar is ragged, and the run info/pillagers bars are bare dropdowns that don't match the other panels.

findings.what: The label is cut off by the screen edge, and its '0' is half visible. It is blue on a busy wall, so it is hard to read. This is the same defect as last review and it was not fixed.
findings.fix: Clamp every world label to a 48px safe margin (x <= 1872). Flip the text to the left of its anchor when it would cross. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi chip on --scrim like the 'sentry r-46' tag.

findings.what: Slots 1-3 are 100px cards. Slots 4-0 are ghost icons with no frame, spaced unevenly (x~900-1470). The empty slot 2 has a lime-ish orange border, which looks like a different colour from --acc. The digits float at different heights. Two things end up looking selected.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 88px tiles on an 8px gap, each with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel at 80%. Select a slot with a 2px --acc border only. Leave empty slots as the same frame at 40% opacity. Put the digits at the top-left in 16px --tx-2.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' bar (x1603-1902, y18-55) and top-left 'current pillagers 0' bar (x8-367, y143-170)
findings.what: They are black form-select dropdowns with a thin white border and tiny text. They are not in the style guide's panel language. They sit at different margins (x8 against x1902). The top-left one is jammed against the screen edge. They look like HTML widgets. 'run info' also has a stray capital I ('Info'), which breaks the lower-case rule.
findings.fix: Fix 'run info' to lower case. Restyle both as --ui-panel chips with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond --tx-1 text, 8px/16px padding, and a chevron in --tx-2. Inset both to a 48px margin. Align the tops of the two chips.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, saturated green slab with 'hp 100' in oversized text. It runs to the bottom-left screen edge (24px margin, with the bar close to the bottom). It is the loudest element on the screen but it is not the hero element. The green is not a guide token.
findings.fix: Make the bar 8px tall in --ok on a --ui-line track, with '100' at 32px f-cond 700 above it. Place it at x 96, y 1000, matching the 5% margin. Only turn it --danger below 30%.

findings.what: The card is the right size, with the 56px hero number at 25 / 60. The card is 10px from the right edge. 'b / i backpack' is 14px or smaller. The weapon name 'auto rifle 2x scope' is crammed at the top and unlabelled. The card does not line up with the 'run info' bar above it (x1902 vs x1910).
findings.fix: Inset the card to a right margin of 48px and align it with the 'run info' chip. Set '25' at 56px in --tx-1 and '/ 60' at 20px in --tx-2. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

findings.what: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' has an explanatory second clause, which is clutter. Its amber left bar and amber text add a second warm accent next to the hero. It runs into the wall below the screen's left edge.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby'. Use --tx-1 text with a 3px --warn bar only. Move it to the left feed at x 48.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract chip (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: '9:00' is shown at about 32px with a sunrise icon and a teal 'extract 63m' chip. The chip is fine, but the timer hovers on a transparent background and its contrast drops against the green bush. The little teal arrow under it is unlabelled.
findings.fix: Put the timer and chip on one --scrim card with a 4px radius and 8px padding. Keep the chip in --extract. Remove the stray arrow or make it a 16px edge indicator on the screen's border.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag (x8-105, y8-30) and 'f1 controls' (x435-536, y930-952)
findings.what: The device tag is a green outlined chip in a different style from every other chip. The 'f1 controls' line sits at x435, floating near the hotbar and not at the 5% left margin I asked for. It has a dark box with a key-cap that matches nothing else.
findings.fix: Use one chip style for both: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond --tx-2. Put 'f1 controls' at x 96, y 1000-ish, aligned to the left feed column. Put the 'keyboard' tag at the 48px margin.

v.verdict: The controls card is now one folded 'f1 controls' line and the leaderboard is a single collapsed row, so the screen is far calmer; what remains is mismatched panel styles, small low-contrast text, and a hp bar that dominates.

findings.what: A full-width saturated green bar with a large 'hp 100' is the loudest element on screen. It is brighter than the ammo card and the timer, and its green reads as 'ok' rather than health. Its text is in an unrelated heavy style, and it butts against the screen corner at about 24px.
findings.fix: Shrink the bar to 240x16px with a 1px #4a5257 border on a #16191b track. Use 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 for 'hp 100', and fill the bar with tx-1 or --ok at 70%. Keep the bar and the weapon bar on the same 48px margin.

findings.where: hud panels overall: 'run info', 'current pillagers 0', 'keyboard', 'f1 controls', ammo card, extract pill
findings.what: Each box has a different style. Radii, fills and borders differ: the dropdowns are near-black with a thin border, the ammo card is a larger rounded dark box, the extract pill is teal-filled, and the keyboard tag has a green border. Header text is about 16px, bold and condensed, but tracks and weights vary.
findings.fix: Give every box --ui-panel #16191b, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius, with 8px/16px padding. Use 16px f-cond 600 for labels, with the caret on the right in tx-2. Make the 'keyboard' tag the same panel at 16px.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract pill (x905-1015, y12-75)
findings.what: The '9:00' clock is about 28px and the 'extract 63m' pill is about 16px, so there is no hero. The sun icon and the teal arrow under the pill add clutter. Teal text on a teal-tinted fill is low contrast.
findings.fix: Make the clock 40px f-cond 800 tx-1 and the pill 16px tx-1 on #16191b, with the teal used only as a 3px left bar or a small glyph. Remove the arrow under the pill, or make it a 12px glyph with 8px of space.

findings.what: '25 / 60' is the one hero number and it works. 'auto rifle' and 'b / i backpack' are about 16-18px grey on a busy background and sit tight to the edges, with 'backpack' about 14px. The card's right edge is about 10px from the screen edge, against 24px on the left.
findings.fix: Inset the card to a 48px margin (right edge x1872). Set 'auto rifle' to 16px tx-2 and 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2, with 16px padding. Keep the 56px hero number.

findings.what: The notice is shortened, but it still carries the 'gold glow marks the box' explainer. It sits at about 20px with a yellow left bar and a doc icon, which is yellow like the accent, and it floats at a different margin from the leaderboard (x8) and the hp bar.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 16px tx-1, with a warn amber glyph and no lime or gold bar. Align it to x48 in the left feed.

findings.what: The empty slot silhouettes at about 15% opacity are faint and clutter the strip. The slot numbers 4-8 and 0 are tiny dim grey at about 14px. The selected slot 2 has a thick amber border that reads as a different colour from the lime 'selected' accent, and its icon is nearly invisible.
findings.fix: Show only filled slots plus one empty slot, with numbers at 16px tx-2. Use a 2px --acc border for the selected slot (P2 is cyan elsewhere, so keep only the selection lime). Raise the empty-slot icon to 40% opacity so it reads.

findings.what: The fold is correct, but it sits at x436, on top of a wall, and not on the left margin. It is about 16px with a light-grey key chip, and it is tight against the first weapon slot.
findings.fix: Move it to x48 above the hp bar, or centre it with 16px of space above the weapon strip. Use the same 16px panel style and give the 'f1' chip a 1px #4a5257 border.

findings.where: world labels ('packing floor', 'the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'sentry r-46')
findings.what: The labels use different fonts, sizes and colours: the wide-tracked grey 'packing floor' is a different typeface, the blue and amber labels are about 16px with no backing, and the sentry is a tiny 14px chip. They are low contrast against the ground.
findings.fix: Use one world label style: 16px f-cond 600, 1px dark outline and a 60% #0b0c0d chip. Use f-cond rather than a spaced display face for the zone name, at 20px tx-2.

v.verdict: The HUD parts are readable, but they still sit at different insets and sizes with no shared grid. The hp bar is cramped into the corner, the selected slot is amber (not lime) and has an empty icon, and the ghost slots 4-0 are barely legible.

findings.what: The bar sits about 24px from the left edge and about 12px from the bottom. It is a flat green fill with no panel, border or track. The 'hp 100' label is a large condensed face that touches the bar's top edge. It is the loudest element on screen and also the most cramped.
findings.fix: Inset it to 48px from the left and 40px from the bottom. Make it 24px tall with a --ui-panel track and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the 'hp' label to 16px --tx-2 and the number to 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1, placed above the bar or inside it with 8px padding. Reserve the 56px hero size for the ammo count only.

findings.what: The selected slot has a thin amber/gold border and an almost black, empty icon, so the selected weapon looks missing or disabled. The guide says lime means selected, and amber is meant only for warnings and for P1, which the slot also reads as.
findings.fix: Use a 2px --acc #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised #1e2225 fill. Draw the icon at 100% opacity in --tx-1 (it is dim now). Draw idle slots at 60%.

findings.what: The weapon silhouettes are near-invisible, at about 15% opacity on the busy map. The digits are about 12px and float with no frame. The 3 filled slots are 100px frames while these have none, so the row breaks and ends up inconsistent.
findings.fix: Either hide slots 4-0 until the weapons are owned, or give each a 4px-radius --ui-panel frame at 40% opacity, 100x100 like slots 1-3, with 16px --tx-2 digits. Match the 8px gap.

findings.where: top-left chip 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' (x8-367 y143-168, x1603-1900 y20-54)
findings.what: The two chips are different sizes (360x28 vs 297x34) and sit at different insets (8px vs 20px). They float at different heights, and the left one overlaps the map edge. The text is about 15px. The chevrons are decorative and imply an open state with no focus treatment.
findings.fix: Make both chips 36px high, 4px radius, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 text. Anchor both at a 48px inset from their edges and make them the same width (about 320px). Align them to the same row, y=48.

findings.what: The card sits against the edge, 10px from the right and 28px from the bottom. The '/ 60' is nearly as heavy as the hero 25. 'auto rifle' is right-aligned but 'b / i backpack' is left-aligned, which gives mixed alignment. The card also overlaps a world crate.
findings.fix: Inset the card to 48px right and 40px bottom. Set '/ 60' to 32px --tx-2 at weight 600, keep the 56px 800 hero '25' in --tx-1, and left-align 'auto rifle' and the hint to the same edge at 16px --tx-2.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract chip (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: The clock '9:00' is 28px f-cond in white with no panel, and the teal 'extract 63m' pill sits right under it with a tiny arrow. The two stack with different treatments, and the clock reads weaker than the extract timer even though the teal is only for extraction.
findings.fix: Put both in one --ui-panel plate, 48px tall, 4px radius. Set the clock to 32px 700 --tx-1 and the extract text to 16px 600 --extract. Delete the arrow, or move it to a screen-edge marker.

findings.what: This is an explanatory sentence ('gold glow marks the box'), which the brief lists as a clutter defect. It uses an amber stripe plus an amber label in a third chip style, and it sits at x=15, which is not on the 48px inset.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' only. Use the same 36px chip as the top chips, with a 3px --warn bar and 16px --tx-1 text, on the 48px inset.

findings.what: It is a tiny 14px chip jammed at the edge of the map walls, away from the hp bar and the weapon row. It sits on neither's baseline, and the 'f1' keycap is nearly illegible.
findings.fix: Make it 36px high with a 16px label, on the 48px inset and the same row as the hp bar. Align its baseline with the hp bar's centre.

v.verdict: The ads view still looks like unfinished debug UI: a pale wedge washes out the scene, the hud sits in several different styles, and the ammo panel, hp bar and hotbar are the same as in my last review.

findings.what: The label is a large white condensed number sitting directly on a flat, bright green bar. The bar is about 400px wide and flush to the left and bottom edges, so it reads as a debug bar. The text has no padding and little contrast on the green.
findings.fix: Make the bar 280x8px at 24px from the left and bottom edges. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill, switching to --danger below 30%. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 above the bar and '100' at 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1.

findings.where: centre, pale wedge and circle aim overlay
findings.what: The wedge is roughly 25% white and covers the whole middle of the map. It flattens the walls and props, creates a hard light band across the wall at y≈450-520, and reads as fog rather than a focus cone. Its edge is soft and unfinished.
findings.fix: Cut the wedge fill to about 10% alpha and give it a 1px --tx-1 edge at 30%. Cap it at the weapon range. Dim the area outside it with a --scrim at 30%. Remove the circle, or draw it as a 1px ring.

findings.what: The panel is semi-transparent, and a red barrel and the forge icon show through it. Its type sizes are not on the scale: '12' is about 60px but in white rather than lime, '/ 60' is about 36px, and the tag '[ads]' sits in brackets in the title. The hint 'b / i backpack' is about 14px and almost invisible.
findings.fix: Make the panel opaque (--ui-panel at 94%) with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the name to 16px --tx-2 and show 'ads' as a separate 16px tag. Show '12' at 56px in --acc and '/ 60' at 32px --tx-2. Make the hint 16px --tx-2 and drop 'backpack' from it. Keep 24px from the edges.

findings.what: The slots are 100px dark tiles with different inner treatments. The selected slot has an amber border, which breaks the rule that lime means selected, and it also reads as the P1 colour. The empty slots 4-0 are bare digits floating on the wall with no cell. The slot digits are about 14px and the ammo counts are small and crammed into the corner.
findings.fix: Give all 10 slots an 80x80px --ui-panel cell with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Draw empty slots at 40% opacity in the same cell. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border and a 3px --acc bar, not amber. Set the numbers and counts to 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Keep a 8px gap between cells.

findings.where: world labels: 'the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'sentry r-46', 'packing floor'
findings.what: The labels are four different styles: a blue label on a dark plate, a yellow label with no plate, a grey label on a plate, and a wide-tracked grey one with no plate. 'the forge' is cut off at the right edge, about 20px from the screen edge, and it sits on a busy background. The sizes are all different and none is on the 16px scale.
findings.fix: Use one world-label style: 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1 on a --scrim plate at 80% with 4px radius and 8px padding. Use colour only for a 3px left bar. Keep labels at least 24px inside the viewport and flip them to the left of the object near an edge. Give the zone name 'packing floor' the same plate.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' dropdowns
findings.what: Both are native-looking select boxes with chevrons. They are about 360px and 300px wide, have no shared margin with the rest of the hud, and use a different font and fill from the panels below. They carry little information but take a lot of the top edge.
findings.fix: Make them one 16px collapsed chip each, 32px high, on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Place them 24px from the top and sides. Show the count as a lime '0' and expand only on a key press.

findings.where: left notice 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'
findings.what: The notice carries an explaining sentence, which is clutter. Its amber bar and icon are fine, but the 20px text is on a thin plate with only about 6px of padding, and it sits tight against the left edge.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Use 16px text with 8px padding, a 3px --warn left bar and a --scrim plate. Keep it 24px from the left edge and 16px above the controls hint.

findings.what: The clock is a 32px white number with a small sun icon, and the teal pill sits tight under it. Both are fine in colour, but the pill text is about 16px with 4px padding, and the teal arrow below it overlaps the world.
findings.fix: Put the pill 8px below the clock and give it 8px vertical padding. Keep teal for extraction only. Move the direction arrow into the pill, on the left of the text.

v.verdict: The scope view reads clearly, but the earlier fixes for the HUD margins, vignette and reticle were mostly not applied, and the corner widgets still look like unstyled browser dropdowns.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' dropdown (8,142 to 368,170) and top-right 'run info' (1602,18 to 1900,54)
findings.what: Both look like native select boxes. They are different heights (28px against 36px), sit at different margins (8px against 20px), use a different border and radius from every other panel, and have a heavy chevron. The pillagers bar is also shown when the count is 0.
findings.fix: Make both 36px tall with a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius. Put them at x=48 and right edge x=1872, with the same top y=48. Set the label to 16px tx-2 and the count to 20px tx-1. Make the chevron 12px in tx-2. Hide the pillagers bar while the count is 0. Cut the width to about 200px.

findings.what: There is no vignette and no tunnel focus, so zooming in feels like a flat camera change. The light blob around the player and the red laser compete with the reticle for attention.
findings.fix: Add a vignette of about 35% black, starting at 60% radius. Drop the laser to 40% opacity and 1px. Dim the light disc around the player by 30%.

findings.what: The ring is a faint 1px tan circle, and the inner crosshair is about 30px of low-contrast orange on a tan crate. It is nearly invisible, and it is the most important aim cue in this state.
findings.fix: Draw a 2px #e6ff3d cross with a 24px gap and arms 12px long. Add a 1px ring at 60% opacity. Add a 1px black outline behind it, and a '4x' tag in 16px lime 16px to the right.

findings.what: The card runs to x=1910, which is only 10px from the edge, and it ignores the 48px margin. '4x scope' is buried in the title. The 'b / i backpack' hint is about 14px and low contrast. The card is also about 1.5 times taller than the neighbouring hp bar.
findings.fix: End the card at x=1872 and y=1032. Name the weapon at 20px tx-1 and move '4x' to a 16px lime tag in the top-right corner. Set the hint to 16px #aaa498. Use a 4px radius and a 1px #4a5257 border. Keep the 56px ammo number as the hero.

findings.what: The bar is flat saturated green with a heavy, oversized '100' (about 32px) and no track. It starts at x=24, which breaks the margin, and it clips the screen bottom with 12px of clearance. It is the loudest element on the screen.
findings.fix: Move it to x=48 and bottom 48px. Make it 16px tall with a #2e3337 track and a 4px radius, filled with --ok #76b97c. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 tx-1, right-aligned inside the bar.

findings.where: top-centre timer and 'packing floor' label (870,155 to 1048,185)
findings.what: The 'packing floor' label has very wide letter spacing and about 35% contrast against the grey floor, and it overlaps the truck. The '9:00' timer and the 'extract 63m' pill use different styles from each other. The pill's teal arrow is detached below it.
findings.fix: Set 'packing floor' to 16px tx-2 with .04em tracking and fade it out after 3s. Put the timer at 32px f-cond 700 and attach the extract pill directly under it, with the arrow inside the pill.

findings.what: The slot number labels 4 to 0 are 14px and dim, and they overlap the ghost weapon icons. A crate sits behind slot 7. The selected slot's amber border looks like the P1 ring, not the lime 'selected' colour, and the slots have mixed widths.
findings.fix: Make every slot 100x100 with the number at 16px tx-2 in the top-left corner, and place the ghost icons at 30% opacity under the number. Use a 2px #e6ff3d border for the selected slot.

findings.what: The chip is tiny at about 14px, sits on busy ground, and has no panel fill, so it crowds the hotbar edge at x=555.
findings.fix: Use a 16px label on a #16191b chip with a 4px radius and a 1px border. Place it at x=48, y=984, which keeps 24px or more clear of the hp bar and the hotbar.

v.verdict: The hud is readable and fairly clean, but the earlier fixes were not applied: the hp bar still hugs the corner, the sentry label still clips the robot, the timer is still small and the left and right panels are mismatched.

findings.what: The bar is still 24px from the left and 12px from the bottom, with no border or track. The oversized 'hp 100' text is a different size from every other label and sits on a flat green fill. The bar is almost clipped by the screen edge and has no relation to the hotbar baseline.
findings.fix: Inset it to 48px left and 48px bottom, and make it 360x24. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill. Set the label to 20px f-cond 600, with the 'hp' word at 16px --tx-2 and the 100 at 20px --tx-1, with 16px left padding.

findings.what: The label is a square grey box with no radius. It overlaps the robot's head and the wall, and the text is bigger than the other in-world label ('packing floor'). It looks like a placeholder.
findings.fix: Use a --scrim chip with a 4px radius and 8px/16px padding, text at 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1. Anchor it 8px above the sprite's head (bottom edge near y360) so it doesn't touch the robot. Match the 'packing floor' label to the same style.

findings.what: The clock and the extract chip are small, and the extract timer does not read as the hero. The teal arrow below the chip floats about 10px away, detached from the chip, and the clock icon beside the 9:00 is a different style from the rest of the hud.
findings.fix: Make 'extract 63m' 32px f-cond 800 --extract, with 9:00 at 20px --tx-2 above it. Remove the detached arrow, or attach it 8px below the chip as a 16px triangle. Give the chip an 8px pad and a 4px radius.

findings.what: The card sits about 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, so it is not on the same margin as the hotbar or hp bar. The weapon name is bright and large for a secondary line, so it competes with the 5 / 60 hero number. 'view backpack' is about 14px and dim.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom. Set the weapon name to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Keep 5 / 60 at 56px 800. Set 'view backpack' to 16px --tx-2 with a key chip. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px padding.

findings.what: The first three slots are 100px cards and slots 4-0 are faint ghost icons with no cells, so the row has two visual systems. The selected slot's amber ring runs against the guide's rule that lime means selected. The number labels are tiny, and slot 2's 'rb' chip is cramped in the corner. The empty ghost icons also overlap a crate in the scene.
findings.fix: Give all slots a 72x72 --ui-panel cell with a 1px --ui-line border, and dim the empty ones to 40% opacity. Use a 2px --acc ring for the selected slot. Set the number labels to 16px --tx-2 and the 'rb' chip to 16px with 8px padding.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' dropdowns (x8-367, y142-171; x1603-1902, y18-55)
findings.what: The two dropdowns have different widths (359px and 299px) and different margins (8px and 18px). The text is about 16px, and they use a native-looking chevron. They sit apart from the 48px margin grid, and they are not aligned with each other vertically.
findings.fix: Use the same 320x40 size for both. Put both at 48px from their edges and align them at y48. Set the text to 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1 on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

findings.what: The label is spaced-out grey text sitting directly on busy ground. Its contrast is low and its letter-spacing differs from the rest of the hud. It reads as a leftover from a debug overlay.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2 with +.04em tracking, and put it on a --scrim chip with 8px/16px padding. Alternatively fade it out after 3s.

v.verdict: Gameplay reads fine, but the HUD is still a mix of unrelated widgets: the previous edge, hotbar, hp and chip fixes were not applied, and a capital 'I' is still on screen.

findings.what: The capital 'I' in 'Info' is still on screen, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The chip is a light-text dropdown that looks different from the other chips and sits tight to the screen edge.
findings.fix: Render 'run info' in lower case. Style it as a --ui-panel chip with a 4px radius, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond --tx-1 text and a --tx-2 chevron. Inset it to a 48px margin.

findings.what: The label is cyan on a cyan-tinted box in 28px type. It is far larger than the neighbouring 'sentry r-46' tag. It sits 28px from the right edge, and the object under it is cut off at the edge. It is an unframed world label that competes with the hero numbers.
findings.fix: Use the same chip as the sentry tag at 16px f-cond: --scrim fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --tx-1 text. Give the '0%' --extract colour. Keep the chip at x <= 1872.

findings.what: Slots 1-3 are 100px tiles, but slots 4-0 are bare ghost icons with no frame. The digits float at inconsistent heights. Slot 2 is selected in amber (#f5b73b-like), so it reads as the warn colour instead of the lime that means 'selected'. The empty 2 slot looks broken. The bar is also pushed down against the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 88px tiles on an 8px gap. Give each a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel at 80%, with empty slots at 40% opacity. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border only. Put the digits at the top-left in 16px --tx-2. Lift the bar so its bottom edge is 48px from the screen bottom.

findings.what: The bar is flush against the bottom and left edges with no margin. The 'hp 100' text is a 32px black-outlined number overlapping a flat green fill. The label and value are cramped. The bar is also not aligned with the hotbar or the ammo card.
findings.fix: Place it at x 48 and bottom 48. Draw an 8px tall --ok bar on a --ui-line track. Put '100' at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 above it with 'hp' at 16px --tx-2. Turn the bar --danger below 30%.

findings.what: The chip is 8px from the left edge, is almost the same size as the 'run info' chip, and is not aligned to it. It is also only 27px tall, with 16px text on a near-black fill and a thin white chevron. It sits over the wall art, so it reads as noise.
findings.fix: Use the same chip style as 'run info'. Inset it to x 48 and match its top and height (36px) to the 'run info' chip at y 48. Add 8px/16px padding.

findings.what: The card is only 10px from the right edge, so it is off the margin grid. The 'b / i backpack' text is about 14px, so it is too small. The card is the only HUD piece with a heavy panel, and it does not match the hotbar tiles beside it.
findings.fix: Set the right margin to 48px and the bottom to 48px, and align the bottom with the hp bar. Show '25' at 56px --tx-1 and '/ 60' at 20px --tx-2. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

findings.where: 'keyboard' tag (x8-105, y8-32) and 'f1 controls' hint (x435-536, y930-952)
findings.what: Both are small tags with different padding and fills, and the tag at top-left touches the screen edge. The 'f1 controls' text is about 15px, so it falls below the 16px floor. The hint floats above the hotbar with no alignment.
findings.fix: Draw both as 16px f-cond --tx-2 chips on --scrim with a 4px radius. Inset 'keyboard' to x 48, y 48. Left-align 'f1 controls' to the hp bar at x 48, 16px above it.

findings.where: 'packing floor' zone label (x870-1045, y160-182) and clock (x930-1030, y12-40)
findings.what: The zone name is wide-tracked grey text on grey wall art, so it has low contrast and a different type style from every other label. The clock is a large outlined number with a sun badge, and the teal 'extract 63m' chip is tucked underneath with a tiny arrow.
findings.fix: Set 'packing floor' at 16px f-cond +.04em --tx-1 on a --scrim chip. Make the clock 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1. Align the extract chip to the clock's centre line with 8px of spacing.

v.verdict: The reduced HUD mostly follows the style guide, but the panels still have inconsistent fills, borders and margins, the hp bar is still huge and the 'keyboard' tag is still too small.

findings.what: The bar is unchanged. It is 406px wide and flush against the screen bottom, and the 'hp 100' text is oversized, a different style from the 20px body text. It does not line up with the 48px margin and is much heavier than the weapon slots beside it.
findings.fix: Make the bar 240x16px on a #16191b track with a 1px #4a5257 border. Set its left edge at x48 and its bottom edge at y1032. Put 'hp 100' above it at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1.

findings.what: The card is flush with the right screen edge, with about 10px of margin against the 48px guide margin. 'auto rifle' and 'b / i backpack' are small and dim, and the card is much denser than the other panels.
findings.fix: Move the right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y1032. Set both labels to 16px tx-2 with 16px padding, and keep the 56px hero number.

findings.where: top-left and top-right panels: 'keyboard', 'current pillagers 0', 'run info'
findings.what: The three have three different sizes and positions: x8, x14 and x1603. All are near-black fills with a border and bold small text. The 'keyboard' tag is a tiny 20px tab with a green tint, and none of them sit on the 48px margin. Text sits at about 14px, below the 16px minimum.
findings.fix: Give all three a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border, a 4px radius and 8/16px padding. Set their text to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 and align them to x48 and y24. Make 'keyboard' a plain 16px tx-2 tag in the same panel style.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract pill (x905-1030, y12-75)
findings.what: The clock is a 28px light-weight number that has to compete with the room and sky colours. The teal extract pill is an outline pill with a tiny arrow and teal text, which is a different style from every other panel on screen.
findings.fix: Set the clock to 40px f-cond 800 tx-1 over a #16191b panel. Set the pill to 16px tx-1 on #16191b with a 3px teal left bar, and delete the arrow.

findings.what: It is a floating chip in a different shade and hugs the weapon bar, with an f1 key cap that is smaller than 16px. It also sits at x440, not on the left feed alignment.
findings.fix: Use a #16191b panel with a 1px #4a5257 border, 16px text and an 8px key cap, at x48 and y984. Keep it clear of the hp bar.

findings.where: weapon slots 1-3 and the empty slots 4-0 (x555-1470, y955-1058)
findings.what: The selected slot has a lime border, but the slot fills are inconsistent, and the empty slots 4-0 show faint gun silhouettes without borders, so they read as clutter. The slot numbers are tiny.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 96x96 tile on #16191b with a 1px #4a5257 border. Show only the selected slot with a lime border, and remove the ghost icons from the empty slots. Set the numbers to 16px tx-2.

findings.what: The labels are blue, yellow and grey on different tag styles at 14-16px, and they are hard to read over the grey walls. Colour is carrying meaning that is not clear.
findings.fix: Use one tag style: 16px tx-1 on #16191b at 80% opacity with a 4px radius. Colour only a 3px left bar, never the text.

findings.what: It uses wide-tracked letters in a faint tone on a tan floor, a style used nowhere else, and its contrast is poor.
findings.fix: Set it to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 at 70% opacity with a 0.04em letter-spacing and a #0b0c0d 40% drop panel, or drop it.

v.verdict: The controls card is the right content in the wrong place and at the wrong size: it sits open, mid-left, as a dense 4-column key list of about 15px text that covers the playfield, and the HUD around it breaks the type and case rules.

findings.where: controls card, left edge at y 505-800
findings.what: The card is fully open. The order for career raids is a single folded line, mid-bottom on the left, opened with F1. Here it is a 300x300 box of 22 rows. It covers the player's left approach and competes with the HUD, and it reads as a debug dump.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 32px line, 'f1 controls', anchored bottom-left at x=48px, y~960. Show the full card only after F1. If this shot is meant to show the opened state, auto-close it after 5s and dim it to 70%.

findings.where: controls card, type and key caps
findings.what: Labels such as 'move', 'gear', 'fight' and 'raid' are about 15px in tx-2 grey, below the 16px minimum. Key caps and action words are the same weight, so the eye has no entry point. Section headers sit among the rows with no divider, so groups run together. The 'raid' header and its keys sit at x~170, but the 'fight' header sits at x~28, so the columns look misaligned.
findings.fix: Set every label to 16px minimum and the action words to 20px tx-1. Give section headers 16px f-cond +.04em in tx-2, with a 1px --ui-line rule above each and 16px gap between groups. Align all headers to the same column x.

findings.what: The list is tiny, about 14px, with no clear header hierarchy. Names and '$' amounts crowd with 20px row pitch, and the chevron is a 10px target. Its pure-black fill and 2px outline do not match --ui-panel and the 4px radius. It floats at the screen edge with no 5% margin, and the player's own row is not marked with lime.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Inset 48px from the left edge. Set rows to 20px with 8px pitch. Make the 'you' row tx-1 with a 3px lime bar, and the others tx-2.

findings.what: The title text 'run Info' has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The bar is flat black, with a chevron so small it is hard to read, and it has no content when closed. It also has its own panel style, unlike the pillagers list beside it.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Use the same panel token, border and radius as the other panels. Set the chevron to 20px at tx-1. Align the right inset to 48px.

findings.where: top centre: timer, extract pill, and the 'c 152m' marker at right
findings.what: The extract distance appears twice, as 'extract 152m' and as 'c 152m' at x1812, which is a defect now that every line should show in one place. The teal pill is the only extract cue but at 16px is small. The timer glyph at 14:56 has a heavy outline that differs from the other type. The 'c' abbreviation is unclear.
findings.fix: Keep only the top-centre pill and delete the 'c 152m' label, keeping the teal arrow at the screen edge. Set the pill to 20px with 8px vertical padding. Use the --fs-hero 56px token for the timer only when extract is under 60s.

findings.what: The ammo block is well weighted, but 'scav pistol' uses a different, heavier italic-looking face. The '/ 24' is nearly as large as the 12, which weakens the hero number. The 'b / i backpack' hint is about 14px and low contrast. The card sits flush with the screen edge.
findings.fix: Use f-cond 700 at 20px for the weapon name. Render '/ 24' at 32px in tx-2 and keep '12' at 56px in tx-1. Raise the hint to 16px. Set the card margin to 48px from the edges.

findings.what: The slots are different sizes and one is selected with an amber border where the guide says lime for selected. Empty slots 3 and 5-0 show ghost icons at very low contrast, so they read as clutter or as rendering bugs. The numerals are 14px. The bar sits very close to the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Use a uniform 96px slot with a 2px --acc border on the selected one only. Hide empty slots' ghost icons. Raise the numerals to 16px. Lift the bar to 32px from the bottom.

findings.where: bottom-left status: hp bar and two round badges
findings.what: The 'hp 100' label is 32px with a heavy outline over a flat green bar. It clips the bottom edge, with about 8px margin, and is out of line with the 48px safe margin. The two round badges above it (amber and teal rings) have no labels and no meaning to the eye. The amber ring is the P1 colour, but it is used here as a status.
findings.fix: Lift the hp bar to y=1032 and set the left inset to 48px. Use a 16px 'hp' label in tx-2 and a 32px value. Put the badges in the same 48px grid with 8px gaps and give each a 16px tooltip label, or merge them into one status row.

v.verdict: A clean, consistent full-screen settings card with a clear lime focus row, but the detail pane is mostly empty, the list mixes raid and audio rows under one tab, and row text is small and dim.

findings.what: The pane is about 85% empty. It holds one short line and a key chip, and the lime top rule makes it look like a hero panel with nothing in it.
findings.fix: Show the current value and what each option does, or a preview. Otherwise narrow the pane to about 360px and give the list the freed width. Drop the lime top border unless the pane has focus.

findings.where: centre list, rows 'master volume' to 'effects volume'
findings.what: Audio rows sit at the bottom of the 'the raid' tab, behind a thin divider, even though 'audio' is its own tab. The tab content is unclear and the list is cut off at the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Move the volume rows under 'audio'. If the section has to stay, add a 16px label such as 'sound' in tx-2 with 24px spacing above it, and stop the list from being clipped mid-row at y=990.

findings.what: Unfocused labels are about 18px in a dim grey (about #8a8a85). That is below the 20px row-name size and below the 4.5:1 floor for text that is read. They are hard to read from a couch. The value text is brighter than the label, which inverts the hierarchy.
findings.fix: Set row names to 20px in tx-1 (#efe9dc) at weight 600, or in tx-2 (#aaa498) at the very least. Set idle tab labels to 20px tx-2. Keep values in tx-1.

findings.what: The active tab 'the raid' is marked only by a lime left bar and a faint fill, so it looks the same as a focused row. The gap before 'send play data' is unexplained. Tab spacing is 64px while row spacing is 56px.
findings.fix: Give the active tab a --ui-raised fill and tx-1 text, and keep the lime bar only for the focused item. Use one 56px rhythm for tabs and rows. Group 'send play data' under a 1px divider.

findings.what: The row has a lime bar, a lime arrow and a lime value. That is good focus, but the three lime spots and the pane's lime top border compete. The arrows on every other row are bright white, so they pull the eye away from the focused one.
findings.fix: Dim idle arrows to tx-2 at about 50% opacity. Keep lime only on the focused row's arrows and value, and remove the lime top border from the detail pane.

findings.what: The title is 32px and fits the scale, but it has a lot of dead space around it. The close X is thin and light grey, and 'esc close' in the footer duplicates it. The footer also sits in a 40px strip whose only content is that one hint.
findings.fix: Keep the X and make its hit area 48px with a visible focus state. Merge the footer into the list's bottom edge, or add the pad hint ('b back') beside 'esc close' at 16px so the strip earns its space.

findings.what: The scrollbar is a thin grey bar whose thumb is only a quarter of the track. It touches the list edge and is off-style, and the long list gives no hint that it scrolls.
findings.fix: Use a 4px thumb in --ui-line-hi inset 8px from the pane edge. Add a bottom fade of 24px so the clipped row reads as scrolling.

v.verdict: The timelord toast is a clear, readable confirmation, but it sits in a cluttered raid HUD with a large always-open controls card, mixed panel and type treatments, and a capital letter on screen.

findings.what: It reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The bar is also a different, lighter style from every other panel, and the chevron button is cramped against the right edge.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'run info'. Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px --f-cond 600 text and 16px inner padding. Inset the chevron 16px from the right.

findings.what: The full controls list is open and covers a large part of the playfield. The owner's order is a one-line folded list at mid-bottom left, opened with F1. The card also has two columns with no divider, and 'fight' and 'raid' headings in the wrong column order. The key caps are different widths and the text is about 14-16px grey on dark, which is hard to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single line, e.g. 'f1 controls', anchored mid-bottom left at 5% margin. When opened, give the keys uniform 40px caps, 20px action text and 16px --tx-2 headings, with 8px row gaps.

findings.where: hud consistency: 'current pillagers' card, 'run info', toast, ammo card, hp bar
findings.what: Panels use different fills, borders and corner radii. The pillagers card is pure black with a thin border, the ammo card is a different black with a rounded corner, and the hp bar is a flat green with no frame. Type sizes vary at about 14, 16, 20, 24 and 56px with no clear scale. This is the template look the guide warns against.
findings.fix: Put every HUD panel on one recipe: --ui-panel at 90% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, --rad 4px, and 16px padding. Limit type to 56/32/20/16/14. Make the hp bar a framed bar with a 16px label.

findings.what: It is the only feedback for the toggle, but it sits low-left, jammed against the controls card and overlapping a wall. It isn't in the top-centre banner position that the guide reserves for alerts. It is a small 20px bold label on a dark chip with no accent, so it reads as a debug string.
findings.fix: Show it as a top-centre banner under the clock, 20px --f-cond 700, with a 3px --acc left bar and 16px padding, and fade it out after 2s. Remove the low-left position.

findings.what: The card is dense, with 14px text and tight 18px row spacing. The 'value at risk' column header and the chevron are both small and grey. The $ figures are right-aligned and readable, but 'you' has no accent and the card has no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Use 16px labels in --tx-2 and 20px names. Set rows at 28px height and mark 'you' with a 3px --acc bar. Give the header 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The two round icons (hidden-eye amber, green ring) have no labels. They use different ring colours and sit tight against the hp bar. It is not clear what they mean, and P1 amber doubles as the warning colour.
findings.fix: Use one 40px icon size with a 1px --ui-line-hi ring and a 16px label or tooltip. Leave 16px between the icons and 24px above the hp bar.

findings.what: Empty slots are only faint ghost silhouettes, so the row has no consistent frame. The slot numbers are about 14px and low contrast, and the bar reads as three tiles floating on the map.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as 72px tiles with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Number them at 16px in --tx-2 and keep the focused slot lime-bordered.

findings.what: The off-screen extract marker is a tiny 14px chip with a cyan arrow, and its 'c' prefix is cryptic. It duplicates the 'extract 152m' banner at the top, so the same information is drawn twice.
findings.fix: Remove the chip, or show a 16px 'extract' label in --extract with a 24px arrow, anchored 24px in from the edge.

v.verdict: The controls list is still a full 440x770px slab of tiny text pinned to the top-left, so it hides the map and fights the HUD, and last round's advice to fold it to one line was not followed. The 'run info' bar, the stray 'info' capital and the duplicate 'c 152m' marker are also unfixed.

findings.what: This shot shows the opened state, but the card covers about a third of the left screen. It sits top-left, not mid-bottom-left as the owner ordered (rs-1). About 60 rows are shown at once, which is clutter. The text is about 13px tx-2 and the key column is the same weight as the description column, so nothing leads.
findings.fix: Fold the card to one 32px line, 'f1 controls', at x=48, y~960. When F1 opens it, anchor it bottom-left and cap it at 8 rows per group with a 2-column layout. Auto-close it after 5s.

findings.what: Group headers (move, fight, gear) are amber and the same size as the rows, so the amber reads like a warning or accent. The keys are tx-1 bold and the actions are tx-2, so the eye has no first stop. All text is under 16px.
findings.fix: Set every row to 16px minimum, with the action at 20px tx-1 and the key cap at 16px f-cond in tx-2. Make headers 16px f-cond +.04em in tx-2 with a 1px --ui-line rule above each. Use a 16px gap between groups. Drop the lime-adjacent amber.

findings.what: The card is near-black (#0b0c0d-like) with a faint border and no inset, and it sits 15px from the left edge and 30px from the top. It breaks the 48px margin and does not match the other panels. The 'f1 hide' footer is about 12px at low contrast.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 24px inner padding, inset 48px. Set 'f1 hide' to 16px tx-2 with a key cap.

findings.where: run info bar, top-right x1603-1900 y18-53
findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the lower-case rule. It is a sharp-edged black bar with a thin chevron and no border, so it does not match the other panels. It is 297px wide and crowds the right edge at 20px.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info' in all lower case. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the chevron to 20px tx-1. Inset 48px from the right edge.

findings.where: top centre, extract pill x903-1017 y47-73, and 'c 152m' at x1805-1890 y476-496
findings.what: The distance shows twice, as the 'extract 152m' pill and as a floating 'c 152m' marker. The second one is a line drawn twice, and 'c' is a cryptic label. The teal pill at about 16px is small under the 56px-class timer.
findings.fix: Delete the 'c 152m' text and keep only the teal edge arrow. Set the pill to 20px with 8px vertical padding. Use --fs-hero 56px for the timer only when extract is under 60s.

findings.what: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' is an explaining sentence. The gold bar and gold text compete with the amber card headers. The toast sits flush against the bottom-left panels at 18px.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Use tx-1 text at 20px with a 3px gold bar. Keep it clear of the other lines by 16px.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is hero-size white text, about 32px with a dark outline, on a full-width green bar. It is the loudest thing in the corner, but the ammo '12 / 24' is bigger, so two heroes compete. The bar is 25px from the left edge, not 48px.
findings.fix: Set 'hp 100' to 20px f-cond tx-1 with no outline. Inset the bar 48px. Leave one hero number, the ammo, at 56px.

findings.where: 'the long dock cache' tag, x1668-1798 y140-168
findings.what: A square-cornered floating label at about 14px, tx-1 on near-black with no border, does not match the other panels.
findings.fix: Use --ui-panel with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line border. Set the text to 16px minimum.

v.verdict: The controls card is now one folded line and the oversized left card is gone, but the HUD panels still don't share one recipe, the text is tiny, and the 'run info' label still has a capital I.

findings.what: The label reads 'run info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The bar is a full-width empty strip with a black fill. Its text is about 16px, and it has no panel border or radius to match the other cards.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Use --ui-panel at 90% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px --f-cond 600 text and 16px padding. Shrink the bar to its content, about 200px wide, and keep the chevron inset 16px from the right.

findings.where: HUD panel recipe: pillagers card, run info bar, ammo card, timelord toast, contract toast, 'f1 controls' chip, 'the long dock cache' label, 'c 152m' chip
findings.what: Every panel is a near-black fill with a different corner radius, border and padding. Type runs from about 12px to 56px and ignores the 56/32/20/16/14 scale. The 'the long dock cache' and 'c 152m' labels look like leftover debug chips.
findings.fix: Put every HUD panel on --ui-panel at 90%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Take all text from the 56/32/20/16/14 scale and nothing smaller than 14px. Restyle the two map chips as 16px --tx-2 text with no box, or remove them.

findings.what: The toast is still low-left, over the wall next to the player. The last review asked for a top-centre banner. It is also tiny and has no accent bar, and the contract toast at the bottom-left is styled differently.
findings.fix: Move it to a top-centre banner under the 'extract 152m' pill, at y about 96. Use 20px --f-cond 700 text, a 3px --acc left bar, 16px padding, and fade it after 2s. Show the contract-item line the same way, and stop it sitting beside the hp bar.

findings.what: Rows are about 18px tall with 13px text. The header, column label and chevron are crammed together. 'you' has no marker, and the money values are small and low-contrast.
findings.fix: Use 16px --tx-2 for the header and the 'value at risk' label, and 20px --tx-1 for names. Set rows to 28px and padding to 16px. Mark 'you' with a 3px --acc bar. Right-align the $ values in tabular numerals and keep the chevron 16px from the edge.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green slab with oversized text. It has no frame and no radius, and it sits only 12px from the bottom edge. The 'hp 100' label is a different size from every other label.
findings.fix: Draw a 1px --ui-line-hi frame with a 4px radius on a --ui-panel track, with --ok as the fill. Set the label to 16px --f-cond 600 above the bar, with the value in 20px on the right. Keep a 5% margin from the screen edge.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' chip (x437-537, y928-955) and the ability icons at (24-110, y940-980)
findings.what: The folded controls line is only about 14px, low in contrast, and tucked beside the weapon bar. It sits left of centre but not at the 5% margin or mid-bottom, so it reads as a stray label. The two circular icons have no label or text.
findings.fix: Anchor the chip at x 96 (5%) and y 1010, with 16px text, a 24px key cap and --tx-2 for 'controls'. Add 16px labels or key hints under the ability icons.

findings.what: The card is the strongest block on screen, but the hero '12' sits at about 56px and the '/ 24' next to it competes. 'b / i backpack' is about 13px and 'scav pistol' is right-aligned and small.
findings.fix: Keep '12' at 56px 800 in --tx-1. Set '/ 24' to 32px --tx-2. Put 'scav pistol' at 16px --tx-2 on the left. Use 14px for the footer hint and a 5% margin from the right and bottom edges.

findings.what: Only slots 1, 2 and 4 are filled. The faded ghost silhouettes for 3 and 5-0 add clutter. The slot numbers are about 12px. The selected slot's amber border contradicts the lime-only-for-selected rule.
findings.fix: Remove the ghost silhouettes for empty slots and keep a bare 1px --ui-line slot outline. Set the numbers to 16px. Draw the selected border in --acc (lime) rather than amber.

v.verdict: the hud is dark and flat in the right way, but the controls panel is open and large, the type is tiny and varied, and the corner widgets share no panel rules, so it reads as separate boxes and not one system.

findings.what: The list is fully open and covers about 300x300px of the play field. The owner's rs-1 order says it sits mid-bottom left, folded to one short line, and opens on F1. The panel also holds 20+ rows in two columns, which is clutter. Its two-column layout has uneven row spacing: 'fight' and 'raid' headings sit at different gaps than 'move' and 'gear'.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, aligned to the hp bar's left edge. When opened, keep one column per group, a 24px row pitch and a 16px gap between groups.

findings.where: type sizes across all hud panels
findings.what: Most text is about 13 to 15px at 1080: the pillagers roster, key caps, the 'run info' label, the 'c 152m' tag and the 'b / i backpack' hint. The guide's floor for anything read is 16px, and these will not read from a couch. Muted grey group labels ('move', 'gear', 'fight', 'raid') are also dim on the dark fill.
findings.fix: Set every read label to at least 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking. Use row names at 20px. Lift muted labels to --tx-2 #aaa498 so they reach 4.5:1.

findings.where: hud corner widgets (roster, run info, controls, ammo, status chips)
findings.what: There are too many different panel styles. The roster has a thin border and a sharp corner, run info is a pill with a chevron, the ammo card has a larger radius, and the concealed and in-cover chips use thick coloured borders. Fills, borders, radii and padding all differ. This contradicts the single-panel rule (--ui-panel #16191b, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius).
findings.fix: Give every panel the same fill #16191b at about 90% alpha, a 1px #4a5257 border, a 4px radius and 8 or 16px padding. Make the chip borders 1px, with the colour carried by the glyph or text only.

findings.where: extract banner and distance marker (top centre, and 'c 152m' at right)
findings.what: The same extraction information is drawn twice: 'extract 152m' in the banner and 'c 152m' with an arrow at right. The guide says one line is shown in one place. The teal banner pill also floats off-centre under the clock and its arrow sits underneath it, so the two read as separate pieces. The 'c' abbreviation is cryptic.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre banner and delete the 'c 152m' tag. Either point the banner's arrow at the extract as a screen-edge arrow, or drop the arrow under the banner. Centre the banner on the clock's axis.

findings.what: 'concealed' and 'in cover' use the amber and teal player colours at 20px in heavy outlined chips. The hp bar's 'hp 100' text is oversized (about 32px) over a flat green fill with no panel and no label hierarchy. The hp bar is also clipped at the screen edge with a 24px left margin, while the other widgets use 8 to 16px.
findings.fix: Make 'hp' a 16px label and '100' a 32px number on a #16191b track with a 1px border. Keep chips at 16px with an icon and no outline. Use one 24px left margin for the whole bottom-left stack.

findings.where: ammo card (bottom right) and hotbar (bottom centre)
findings.what: The ammo card is a good hero number, but 'scav pistol' is right-aligned at about 22px while the '12 / 24' number sits tight under it, and the 'b / i backpack' hint at about 14px has low contrast. The hotbar slot numbers 3 to 0 are dim ghost silhouettes that add noise, and the selected slot's amber border competes with lime as the 'selected' colour.
findings.fix: Add 8px between the name and the number. Raise the hint to 16px in #aaa498. Drop the ghost weapon silhouettes on empty slots. Use lime #e6ff3d for the selected-slot border.

findings.what: The header 'current pillagers 3' and the 'value at risk' column head are tiny, with 8 to 10px between them and the row names. The panel is also tucked against the left edge at 8px, where the guide asks for a margin of about 5%. The chevron at right is a dim, unlabeled control. 'you' has no highlight compared with the other rows.
findings.fix: Use a 16px header, 20px rows on a 28px pitch, and 16px of padding. Mark 'you' in lime or tx-1 and the rest in tx-2. Move the panel to a 48px margin from the edge, or match the same inset as the run info card.

findings.where: run info dropdown (top right) and map location label
findings.what: The 'run info' bar is a wide, empty 300x40px strip, and it overlaps the map building's wall and roof. The 'the long dock cache' tooltip is a loose white-on-black label floating mid-field, with a different border treatment from every other panel.
findings.fix: Shrink run info to fit its text (about 140px) and align it to the same 48px margin. Restyle the cache label to the standard panel, with a 16px tx-1 label and a 1px #4a5257 border.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is readable but scattered: a large always-open controls card, a top-left roster, an oddly cased top-right 'run info' panel and two crowded bottom-left status pills compete with each other, and the ammo and hp numbers are the only clear focal point.

findings.what: It reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The dropdown is an empty dark bar that clips the building edge and looks unfinished. It is not the vertical 1x1 list the HUD spec calls for, so the corner is unresolved.
findings.fix: Make the text 'run info'. Fix the corner to the cw-trcol vertical list, or reduce the bar to a 32px label with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill, aligned to the 5% margin (x=1824).

findings.where: left-middle controls card (move / fight / gear / raid)
findings.what: The spec says in a career raid the list is folded to one short line, mid-bottom left, and F1 opens it. Here it is fully open: about 300x300px of 3-column key caps that cover the map, with a bar of nearly the same weight as the ammo block. It is the biggest panel on screen and it is the least important. Its 14px labels ('move', 'fight', 'raid') are dim and small.
findings.fix: Collapse it to one line ('f1 controls', 16px --tx-2) at bottom-left, x=48, y=1000. Open it only on F1, with the --scrim fill and 16px minimum text.

findings.what: The 14px text is below the 16px minimum for anything read. The '$' values are right-aligned far from the names, so the eye has to cross about 200px. The caret is faint. The panel sits flush against the screen edge (x=8) instead of the 5% margin. The 'you' row has no highlight, and P1 amber is not used to mark it.
findings.fix: Set the text to 16px. Inset the panel to x=48, y=48. Tint the 'you' row in P1 amber and tighten the name-to-value gap. Give the panel a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: bottom-left status cluster (concealed / in cover / icons / hp 100)
findings.what: Two amber and teal pills plus two round icons repeat the same information, so each state is drawn twice, which the one-place rule forbids. The pills use different fill colours with no clear meaning, and the amber 'concealed' sits close to the contract banner (an amber outline) just above it. The hp bar is a flat green block with 'hp 100' in oversized text that is heavy against the thin bar, so the strongest weight ends up on a status instead of the main action.
findings.fix: Show each state once, as either icon or pill, not both. Use --warn for amber text only, never as a fill. Cap the hp label at --fs-body 20px inside a 12px bar. Align the baseline with the hotbar.

findings.where: contract banner 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'
findings.what: It is an explaining sentence on screen, which counts as clutter. It sits at the left edge of the bottom-left cluster and below the controls card. It uses 20px amber text on a dark strip with a gold bar, and the 'gold glow marks the box' hint is verbose.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby' only, or show an icon plus distance. Move it to the left feed, and make sure it is drawn once.

findings.what: Slots 3-0 are faint ghost silhouettes with unreadable numbers (about 3:1 contrast), and they float with no tile outlines, so they read as map clutter. Slot 2 is a lone fist with a tiny 'f' tag. The selected slot's lime border is good and is the clearest pad focus on the screen.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 72px tiles with a 1px --ui-line fill at 60% opacity. Raise the numerals to --tx-2 at 16px. Keep the lime border for the selected slot only.

findings.what: This is the strongest hierarchy on the screen: 56px '12 / 24' with the weapon name above it. It is let down by 'b / i backpack' at 14px, below the 16px minimum, and by 'scav pistol' at 20px right-aligned. The panel is heavy and sits flush to the corner (about 12px from the edges) rather than on the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Set the hint to 16px --tx-2. Move the block to the 48px margin (right 48, bottom 48). Keep 56px for the hero number.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract chip, plus the 'c 152m' edge marker
findings.what: '15:00' with a sun icon, then a teal 'extract 152m' chip, with the arrow tucked under it, is an acceptable teal-only use of the extract colour. The right-edge 'c 152m' marker repeats the same distance, which is a duplicate line, and its text is tiny and clipped against the building.
findings.fix: Keep the top-centre chip as the single place for the extract distance, and show only the arrow at the edge, with no text. Bring the timer up to 32px.

v.verdict: A clean, readable raid HUD with one clear hero (ammo) and consistent lime/teal/amber states, but the left-side stack of panels, the cramped keys list and a few tiny or clipped labels keep it below polished.

findings.what: The always-expanded controls panel is a dense 3-section, 2-column key table that dominates the left edge. The 'full f1' row sits in a different column rhythm, the section labels (move/fight/gear/raid) are dim grey and barely read, and 'lmb' appears twice (fight and use item). It is clutter during play and ignores the folded-to-one-line order for career raids.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line ('f1 controls') at mid-bottom left as ordered. If it stays open, raise the section labels to --tx-2 at 16px, remove the duplicate lmb row, and drop the panel opacity to 70%.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and right-edge 'c 152m' chip
findings.what: 'run info' sits in a wide dark bar clipped against the right edge of the screen, and its 'I' reads as a capital in the type. The 'c 152m' chip next to the cyan arrow is truncated ('c' for extract) and duplicates the top-centre 'extract 152m' banner. This breaks the rule that each line is shown in ONE place.
findings.fix: Delete the right-edge 'c 152m' chip and keep only the top-centre extract pill. Give 'run info' a 24px margin from the right edge and set it in lowercase 20px f-cond.

findings.what: The panel's header, 'value at risk' column label and chevron are all 16px or smaller in dim grey, and the rows are all the same weight. 'you $162' does not stand out from the other three players. It also sits flush against the screen edge (8px margin) and is rendered with a different black fill from the other panels.
findings.fix: Colour 'you' with the P1 amber and set its row in tx-1 at 20px. Set the others to tx-2 at 16px. Use a 24px margin and --ui-panel with a --ui-line-hi 1px border, matching the ammo card.

findings.where: bottom-left status row (concealed / in cover / hp 100)
findings.what: The hp bar is a plain flat green rectangle with 'hp 100' in a large 32px outline-less type that is much bigger than the neighbouring chips. Its edge sits 24px from the screen bottom while the weapon slots sit about 8px from it. 'concealed' in amber and 'in cover' in teal are two sizes of pill that do not line up with the bar's baseline.
findings.fix: Set the hp label to 20px f-cond 700 inside the bar. Make the chips a common 40px height. Align the row's bottom to the weapon slots at a 24px margin.

findings.where: contract alert 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (bottom centre-left)
findings.what: The alert is an explaining sentence, which the rules treat as a defect. Its amber text on a translucent dark strip over a busy map has weak contrast, and the strip's left bar is a 3px amber stub that looks unfinished. It also sits right on top of the weapon-slot row.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Place it in the top-centre alert slot, not at the bottom. Put it on an opaque --ui-panel fill with a 3px --warn bar.

findings.what: Slots 3 to 0 show their number labels and ghost silhouettes floating directly over the map with no panel. They are low contrast, while the selected slot 1 has a thick amber border. This breaks the lime-means-selected rule. Slot 2 shows an 'f' badge with no explanation.
findings.fix: Change the selected border to --acc lime at 3px. Give the empty slots a 1px --ui-line outline on a --ui-panel at 60% so they read as a row. Keep the key badge only where it adds meaning.

findings.what: The card is the right hero: '12 / 24' at about 56px, 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are in the right order. However, the 'b / i backpack' hint is under 14px and low contrast, and the card sits only about 8px from the screen's bottom and right edges. This is tighter than the 24px margin used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2 and move the card in to a 24px margin. Keep the 56px hero number as it is.

findings.what: '15:00' has a small sunrise icon but sits on the map with only a thin shadow, and the teal 'extract 152m' pill beneath it is a different shape (rounded with a filled teal border) from every other panel. The tiny arrow below it is clipped against the pill.
findings.fix: Put the timer and pill in one 4px-radius --ui-panel group. Make the timer 32px f-cond 700 and the pill 16px. Remove the stray arrow, or give it a 12px gap below the pill.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable and lower case, but it is a pile of unrelated boxes of different sizes with no hierarchy. The raid controls list sits fully open, and the screen shows a stray capital, a small clipped label, and weak contrast on the left panels.

findings.what: The controls list is fully open as a big two-column key table that covers a large part of the left side and the lane the player moves through. Per the style guide's raid-controls order, it should be folded to one short line, mid-bottom left, and opened with F1. This is also clutter.
findings.fix: Fold it to one line of about 24px height ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, x=5%, and open the full list only on F1. If the party demo needs it open for walk-up guests, label it as the demo exception and shrink the 20px rows to 16px.

findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The dropdown bar is also a different style from the other panels: its fill is darker, it has a different border, and it sits tight against the top edge, with a chevron that reads as a form control.
findings.fix: Render as 'run info'. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 32px height, a 24px inset from the screen edge, and a 16px chevron.

findings.where: top-right, 'the long dock cache' label and the 'c 152m' marker
findings.what: The 'c 152m' off-screen extract marker is clipped or truncated (it looks like a cut 'extract 152m') and sits half over the wall edge. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats over the map with no clear owner, and it shares the same box style as the run-info bar but not the same size or padding.
findings.fix: Show the marker as the same text as the top banner, 'extract 152m', in a pill 28px high with 8px padding, fully on screen at 24px from the edge. Give the cache tag the same 4px radius and 8px padding, and place it directly under run info.

findings.what: The panel has tiny 16px text with the money column in the same weight as the names, so 'you' is not distinguished from the other players. The header 'value at risk' is dim, and the chevron is a tiny control. Player colour (P1 amber) is not used, and the panel's translucent black fill is a different tone from the controls and ammo panels.
findings.fix: Make the 'you' row --tx-1 700 with an amber P1 tick, set the other rows to --tx-2, use 20px rows at 32px pitch with 16px padding, and align the money column to a tabular right edge. Use one --ui-panel fill at 92% opacity for all HUD panels.

findings.where: bottom-left status chips and hp bar
findings.what: The 'concealed' chip is amber and 'in cover' is teal, so the chips use two different outlines, fills and colours (warn amber and extract teal), though neither means warning or extraction. The round icon buttons are a third style. The hp bar is a flat green block with 'hp 100' at a large size, in a different font treatment, overflowing the bar's left edge, and it is not aligned with the icons above it.
findings.fix: Use one chip style (--ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi, 16px label, tx-1) with a 20px glyph and no coloured fills. Make the hp bar 12px tall with the number as a 20px label to its right and the left edge on the same x (5% margin) as the chips.

findings.what: The selected slot has a lime-amber border that is close to the gold of the rarity bar, and the unselected slots 3-0 are faint ghost silhouettes with numbers at about 14px and low contrast. The slot 2 fist tile is the same size but has a stray 'f' badge.
findings.fix: Use --acc 3px for the selected slot only. Raise the slot numbers on 3-0 to 16px and --tx-2 at 4.5:1 contrast, or hide empty slots, and put the 'f' key hint on the same corner as the slot number.

findings.what: The ammo is correctly the hero, but the '/ 24' is in the lime accent at nearly the same size, which competes with the '12'. The weapon name 'scav pistol' is right-aligned at 28px, which is larger than the 20px body size. 'b / i backpack' is at about 14px.
findings.fix: Set '12' at 56px 800 in --tx-1, '/ 24' at 32px --tx-2, the weapon name at 20px --tx-2, and the hint at 16px, with all on one 16px padding.

findings.what: Five panel styles (current pillagers, run info, controls, ammo, status chips) use different radii, border weights and fills, and each uses a different size of text, so the HUD reads as separate boxes and not one system. The clock at top centre has its own pill and the extract banner a third.
findings.fix: Define one HUD panel token (--ui-panel at 92%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding) and apply it to every panel, and limit text to the 56/32/20/16 sizes.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the open controls list, the loose left-side panels and the mixed corner widgets make it look like a debug overlay, not a polished extraction shooter.

findings.what: The full controls list is open and covers about 300x300px of the play area. The style guide says the career raid list should be folded to one short line at mid-bottom left and opened with F1. It reads as a manual and is the biggest thing on screen. It also has no title and uses two uneven columns, with the 'fight' and 'raid' section labels sitting at different heights in each column.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at the bottom left, about 24px above the hp bar. If it must stay open, give it a 32px title and align both columns to a shared row grid of 24px with 16px gutters.

findings.where: hp bar and status chips, bottom left
findings.what: 'hp 100' is drawn at about 32px, bold, on a flat green bar with no frame, no divider and no padding. It clashes with the dark panel style used elsewhere. The 'concealed' and 'in cover' chips use a different amber and teal border from the panels around them. The two round icons are tight against the chips and have a different border weight.
findings.fix: Put hp in a 4px-radius panel (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi border) with a 16px 'hp' label and a 20px number inside the bar. Use one chip height of 40px, an 8px gap, and the same border weight for the icons and the chips.

findings.what: The eye lands first on the hp text and the ammo '12 / 24'. The 15:00 timer and the 'extract 152m' pill are small by comparison, so the main objective is easy to miss. The ammo hero number is strong, but its size is not tied to the 56px hero token. The timer has a small icon beside it that carries no meaning at a glance.
findings.fix: Keep one hero number per screen. Make the timer 40-56px f-cond 800, or the ammo number, not both. Drop the icon or label it. Set the extract pill to 20px with a 16px padding.

findings.what: It is a 300px bar with a chevron whose closed state tells the player nothing. 'run Info' shows a capital 'I' (a capital letter on screen). The bar's black fill is darker than the other panels and it has no visible border.
findings.fix: Lowercase it to 'run info'. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and either narrow it to about 160px or show one live stat in it. Align its right edge to the 5% margin (96px at 1920).

findings.what: This panel sits flush to the left edge with only 8px of margin, while the other panels use 16-24px. It is a table of the same-weight rows 'you' and three names with dollar amounts. Nothing marks 'you' as P1, and the chevron is unlabelled. The panel hovers in empty space with no tie to the top-left corner or to the controls list below it.
findings.fix: Use a 24px left margin and 8px row padding. Highlight the 'you' row with the P1 amber 3px bar and --tx-1, and set the other rows to --tx-2. Put the list in a consistent column with the controls list.
