v.verdict: The controls panel is now folded to a chip, as advised, but an unstyled 'want easy mode?' modal sits over a HUD that is overloaded and overlapping at the top centre, which pulls the screen down.

findings.where: Top-centre cluster x778-1280 y18-250 (team score card, 'crawler … destroyed' banner stack, extract chip)
findings.what: The score card, the six-line orange alert stack and the extract chip overlap each other. 'you 350 sp' and 'p2 850 sp' collide with the faded alert lines, and the alert text is clipped behind the card. The same events also appear in the left feed and the right stack, so each kill is drawn three times. The 'one place per line' rule is broken.
findings.fix: Show at most 1 alert at a time in a single banner at x760-1160 y64 (the clock's row), with 16px text and a 4px radius. Delete the 5 queued lines. Widen the score card to 360px and put 'you' and 'p2' in two 16px columns with 16px padding. Move the extract chip to y236 and centre it on the card. Cut the right-hand 'killed crawler' stack.

findings.what: A square, flat, unbordered black slab with no scrim, so the HUD stays fully lit behind it and fights it. It has no title bar or hierarchy beyond the 32px title. The '7' countdown floats at the top right with no label, and the card spans 940px for 2 short buttons. The lime 'yes' fill is a 406x100px block, far heavier than the title, which breaks the rule of one bold element per screen. The card also covers the alert stack and the extract chip.
findings.fix: Add a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer over the whole screen. Make the card 640x300 and centre it at x640 y390. Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the title to 32px 700 tx-1 at 32px padding. Replace the loose '7' with a ring or a '7s' at 16px tx-2 on the same baseline as the title. Make the buttons 280x56px with 8px between them. Keep the lime fill on 'yes' only. Show a lime 2px focus outline on the focused button. Use the 4px radius on both.

findings.what: The 'y yes' and 'n no' labels are small (about 24px) and centred in oversized buttons. The key letter is the same weight as the word, so the key hint does not read as a hint. 'no' has a barely visible 1px border and no fill, so it reads as disabled.
findings.fix: Set the button text to 20px f-cond 600. Put the key letter in a 16px tx-2 chip at the left of the button, with 'yes' and 'no' centred. Give 'no' a --ui-raised fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 text. Keep the 56px height on both.

findings.where: Left feed x18-310 y678-780 and left perks x8-275 y430-546
findings.what: The two groups stack with mismatched widths and edges. The feed starts at x18, the perk cards at x8, and the 'player 2' tag at x16. The perk cards use 28px text against 22px in the feed, and the 3 feed rows have different left stripe colours (lime, blue, blue) with no legend.
findings.fix: Put all left-side groups on x24. Use a 24px row pitch in the feed, with 16px text. Use the 20px name and 16px sub line in the perk cards, and a 64px row height. Give every card --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line border and a 4px radius. Use the amber P1 and cyan P2 stripes only.

findings.what: The card is clipped at the right edge (x1910 against a 1896 margin) and has no padding at the right. '24 / 144' sits tight against the edge. The card is also crowded against the hotbar, which starts at x1250 and runs under the card. The weapon name is right-aligned at 28px, which is a fifth type size.
findings.fix: Set the right edge to x1896 and the bottom to y1032. Use 24px padding. Set the name to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1, '24' to 56px 800, and '/ 144' to 24px tx-2. Align all three on the right edge.

findings.what: The 'armour 60' and 'hp 100' bars are 20px and 34px tall and are two different heights. 'hp 100' is 32px text on a green fill, while 'armour 60' is 20px on blue, so the two readouts do not match. The hp bar touches the screen's bottom edge (y1068 of 1080), with no safe margin. The bars cover the slot-1 area and crowd the hotbar at x560.
findings.fix: Make both bars 260x12px. Put them at x24, with the hp bar at y1040 and the armour bar at y1020. Put a 16px tx-2 label and a 24px 700 tx-1 value on the line above each bar. Keep the 24px gap to the hotbar and the 24px bottom margin (y1056).

findings.what: The dropdown is 297px wide for a 7-character label, with a chevron at the far right and a 16px gap to the screen edge that is not the 24px margin used elsewhere. The border is faint.
findings.fix: Shrink it to 160px wide at x1736-1896, and use a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 text and a 12px chevron.

findings.what: The chip is folded as advised, but it floats at x410 in the middle of the bottom-left, 120px from the vitals. It has a faint fill and a 14px label, so it is hard to read over the busy ground.
findings.fix: Move it to x24 y1000, directly above the armour bar. Use --ui-panel at 90% fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, with 16px text and the 'f1' key in a tx-1 chip.

v.verdict: The disconnect banner is gone and a modal now shows, but the HUD is still a pile of unrelated boxes: hp, armour and hotbar sit at different heights, the top-right goals box has no panel shape, and the easy-mode modal is a flat black slab.

findings.what: The modal has a square-cornered flat black fill with no border and no scrim. The map stays bright behind it. The title sits at about 32px, but the '8' countdown is tiny and grey and floats far right. The buttons have different treatments: the yes button is a solid lime slab and the no button is a thin outline. The yes and no labels are small, and the 'y' and 'n' key glyphs are plain text. A 4px lime strip at the top-left looks like a bug rather than a countdown bar.
findings.fix: Put a --scrim (.80) behind the modal. Draw the card as --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make the button text 20px with the key as a 16px chip. Turn the lime strip into a full-width 4px countdown bar. Put the '8' at 32px --tx-1 on the same baseline as the title. Reduce the height to about 240px.

findings.what: The hp and armour bars are two stacked bars of different sizes, one blue and one green, set in the road with no panel. They are not aligned to the hotbar, and 'hp 100' uses a 32px glyph that reads as a different font size from 'armour 60'. The text sits on a bright fill with weak contrast.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel container at x=48, bottom=48. Make both bars 320x24 and stack them with 8px between. Use 16px --tx-2 labels and 20px --tx-1 numbers, with --acc-ink text on the fills. Align the bottom edge with the hotbar slot bottoms.

findings.what: Only slots 2 and 3 are drawn as tiles. Slots 1 and 4 to 0 are bare grey digits sitting on the pavement. The 'f' badge on slot 3 collides with its icon. The selected border is amber, and amber is the P1 colour rather than the 'selected' lime.
findings.fix: Draw ten 64px --ui-panel tiles at 60% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or hide the empty ones. Make the selected border 2px --acc. Put the digit at the top-left in 16px --tx-2, and move the 'f' badge outside the icon area.

findings.what: The left side has a buff list, a hex-badge row, a 'team combo x5' chip and a kill feed. They overlap: the badge row is cut off behind the beast mode row. They use mixed type sizes and mixed panel treatments, some outlined and some filled.
findings.fix: Stack them in one column at x=48 on a 8px grid, with 16px row gaps. Use the same 4px panel for every row and give the badge row its own 48px line. Keep the combo chip at 16px.

findings.what: The goals text is three lines of 20px copy with the names and the 'power-up' tags run together. Indents are ragged and the box has no title row or divider. The chevron is tiny at the top-right. The text is long and wordy.
findings.fix: Use a 32px header row with 'goals 0/3' at 16px --tx-2. Under it draw three 32px rows with the name at 20px --tx-1 and the progress right-aligned at 16px. Replace 'power-up' with a 16px icon. Right-align the box at x=1872, y=48.

findings.what: The timer, the menu button, the team score panel and the extract pill stack into a tall column of mismatched boxes. The score panel has a dark patch where the scene shows through, and the 'you' and 'p1' lines are small and low in contrast. The 'extract 182m' pill is narrower than the score panel above it.
findings.fix: Make the clock, the score and the extract pill all one width of 380px, each with the same --ui-panel fill and a 4px radius. Keep 8px gaps. Raise the 'you' and 'p1' text to 16px --tx-1.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' device chip is still in the corner of the raid HUD with a green-tinted fill and sits off the 48px margin. Last review's advice to remove it was not followed.
findings.fix: Remove it from the raid HUD. If it must stay, make it a --ui-line-hi chip with 16px --tx-2 text at x=48, y=48.

findings.what: The feed shows four rows of the same 'you killed crawler' text in 20px with mixed row widths. The player colours are inconsistent. Rows have no left colour bar, and the feed repeats the same info shown on the left feed.
findings.fix: Use fixed 32px rows with a 3px P1 amber or P2 cyan left bar. Merge repeated lines into 'crawler x4'. Show kills in one place only.

v.verdict: A clean, centred, consistent modal with the lime action, rarity bars and an X, but it is a plain list with no hierarchy beyond the title, a weak focus cue on the action, and an empty right half.

findings.what: The list is flat. The title (about 28px) is barely larger than the row names, and nothing says what the pack is worth or how many items it holds. Names sit hard left and the right two thirds of each row is empty, except for the xN counts. Nothing is the one hero element.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px 700. Add a 16px tx-2 count at the right of the title row (e.g. '7 items'), aligned to the X's baseline. Use 20px 600 row names. Put every quantity in a fixed 16px tx-2 column at x1340-1398, and show 'x1' on the single items so the column is not ragged.

findings.where: Rarity bars x610-614 on each row
findings.what: The rarity cue is a 2px sliver beside the name, and it is easy to miss. The colours read as arbitrary: compact smg is blue and burst carbine is purple, but medkit, armour plate and frag charge are all the same green. Bandage and smoke are grey. Rarity is hard to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Make the bar 3px wide and the full row height (y+8 to y+64) at the row's left edge x521, in the --r-* colour. Alternatively tint the 64px icon tile border with the rarity colour. Check that the item rarities are correct.

findings.what: The lime fill is correct as the one main action, but there is no visible focus ring or key hint, so pad focus can't be seen. The button text is about 18px with wide tracking, smaller than the 20px body size. The bottom padding below the button (57px) is much larger than the footer padding above it, so the footer looks unbalanced.
findings.fix: Set the text to 20px f-cond 700 with 0.04em tracking, and make the button 220x56. Add a 2px --acc-hover outline offset 3px as the focus ring. Right-align the button to x1398 at y836 with a 32px footer, and trim the card bottom to y900 so the padding above and below the button is equal.

findings.what: The X is a 48px box with a 1px border and sits at 17px from the top and 17px from the right edge, so it is not aligned to the content margin (x1398) or to the title baseline. It is also a heavier outlined box than the quiet controls elsewhere.
findings.fix: Right-align the X to x1398 and centre it on the title's y-centre (y236). Use a 40px box with a --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and a 2px lime focus outline when focused.

findings.what: A short lime stub sits at the top-left of the card border. It looks like a rendering artefact, not a design element, and is the only lime on the card besides the button, so it dilutes what lime means.
findings.fix: Remove it, or extend it to a deliberate 3px bar across the full card top at 100% width in --acc.

findings.where: Row dividers and icon tiles x521-1398
findings.what: The icon tiles are 64px boxes with 1px borders sitting on top of the 1px row dividers, so there are two competing line systems. The weapon icons are tiny and low contrast inside their tiles (the SMG and carbine are dark on dark).
findings.fix: Drop the tile borders and use a --ui-raised fill with a 4px radius. Scale the icons to 80% of the tile. Use the --ui-line divider only between rows, with 8px of inset on each side.

findings.where: Background behind the scrim, whole screen
findings.what: The card is dimmed to near black with a heavy blur, so the screen behind is unreadable. The scrim at about 90% is stronger than the --scrim .80 token, and a heavy vignette darkens the edges.
findings.fix: Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and cut the vignette. Keep the blur of the screen behind at 4px.

v.verdict: The modal is gone and the HUD is much cleaner, with a clear hero (timer, score, ammo), but the panels still don't share one style, and the left-column text and the bottom bar are crude.

findings.what: A flat green bar with 'hp 100' at roughly 32px, bold, over the fill. It is the loudest bottom-left element, it clips against the bottom edge, and it matches neither the ammo panel nor the dark panels. The armour bar is gone, so the bar floats alone.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel container (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi) at x=48, bottom=48. Make the bar 320x24, with a 16px --tx-2 'hp' label and a 20px --tx-1 number right-aligned. Fill it with --ok, not saturated green.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 have a panel. Digits 3-0 float as loose grey numbers over the map and are hard to read. The numeral position varies. The 'f' badge and the stack count overlap the icons. The amber selection border reads as P1, not 'selected' (lime).
findings.fix: Draw all ten as 64px tiles with a --ui-panel fill at 70% and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or show only the filled slots. Use a 2px --acc border for selected. Put 16px --tx-2 digits top-left inside each tile. Move the 'f' badge to a 16px chip beside the tile.

findings.what: Four blocks use four different treatments and left edges. The pillagers list is a 14px dim table with a pale caret. The pillager name bar is a tiny box with a green line. The buff cards use 20px bold text with no consistent panel. The 8px edge margin is far from the 5% rule, and the gaps are random.
findings.fix: Set one left margin of 48px. Give every block the same --ui-panel, 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 16px labels and 20px values, with 16px gaps between blocks. Use --tx-2 for the 'value at risk' header and --tx-1 for the rows.

findings.where: top-right goals bar and tag (1603-1901 x 20-130)
findings.what: The collapsed 'goals 1/3' bar is stuck to the screen top and right edges with no margin. Its chevron is tiny. The 'the long dock cache' label floats below it and looks like a separate tooltip. Neither lines up with the clock or the left column.
findings.fix: Right-align at x=1872, y=48, with a 32px header row. Put 'goals 1/3' at 16px --tx-2 and a 16px chevron. Use the same panel as the other blocks. Anchor the cache name to its map marker, not under the bar.

findings.where: score panel (860-1060 x 97-186) and extract chip (903-1018 x 195-222)
findings.what: The score card is a heavier box than the clock above it and has different padding. The teal extract chip is stacked tight beneath it at 16px, and the arrow below that is detached. Together they form a third stack with unrelated widths.
findings.fix: Make the clock, score and extract share one 240px column and one panel style, with 8px gaps. Make the 'score' label 16px --tx-2 and 'sp' 20px. Put the arrow inside the extract chip.

findings.what: A thin chip with a yellow-orange left bar and a lime-ish icon uses a third panel style, hangs at 8px from the edge, and sits just above the 'f1 controls' hint. Its text is 18px and its separator is a dot.
findings.fix: Use the standard panel at x=48, 16px label plus 20px text, and a 2px --acc left bar only. Place it 16px above the controls hint.

findings.where: f1 controls hint (440-540 x 941-965) and 'b / i backpack' (1684-1775 x 1020-1035)
findings.what: Both are at roughly 14-16px on a busy map, and they have different chip treatments. The controls chip has an 'f1' key box. The backpack hint is plain grey text inside the ammo panel and reads as faint.
findings.fix: Show both as key chip + 16px --tx-2 label in the same style. Put the controls hint at the bottom-left under the hp panel, and use a --tx-1 label for the backpack hint.

findings.where: keyboard tag (8-105 x 8-32) and compass 'c 146m' (1810-1895 x 485-515)
findings.what: The device tag is a small green-edged box with a different font colour, hard against the corner. The 'c 146m' chip is a tiny 14px label next to a cyan arc and arrow. It is cut off by the right edge and has no margin.
findings.fix: Put the device tag at x=48, y=48 as a 16px --tx-2 chip in the standard panel. Pull the compass chip in to x<=1872 and use the 16px label size.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the loot card I reviewed last time, so I can't judge progress on that card. The HUD is readable and mostly consistent, but the centre stack is crowded and the 'goal done' toast is washed out.

findings.where: Top-centre stack x778-1142 y18-258: timer, weather icon, team score panel and extract chip
findings.what: Four separately styled blocks are stacked with no shared width or edge. The score panel is much wider than the timer and the extract chip. The extract chip overlaps the score panel's bottom edge. 'you 350 sp' and 'p2 1,150 sp' sit crammed at the right with ragged baselines. The panel also covers the building, which makes the centre of the screen busy.
findings.fix: Use one 360px column centred at x960 with 8px gaps between blocks. Timer 56px hero, then the team score row, then the extract chip. Set the 'you' and 'p2' lines at 16px tx-2 in a fixed right column, aligned to the 1,500 sp baseline. Leave 8px between the chip and the panel.

findings.what: The toast is a low-contrast teal-grey on a translucent brown panel. It blends into the map, and the sub-line 'power-up' is nearly unreadable. The toast is the same weight as the HUD but has no solid fill, so it looks like a rendering bug. It also sits in the middle of the play area, close to the extract arrow.
findings.fix: Give it the --ui-panel fill at 92% opacity and a 3px --ok left bar. Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1 with a --ok icon. Set 'power-up' to 16px tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Move it to y150, under the top stack, and fade it out at 1.6s.

findings.where: HUD panel fills across the screen: goals chip, buff cards, ammo card, score panel
findings.what: Panels use different radii, borders and opacities. The buff cards at x8-268 have a hard 1px border. The ammo card has a rounded border. The goals chip is a near-black fill. The slot tiles use an amber outline. This reads as assembled, not designed.
findings.fix: Use one HUD panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 8px or 16px padding. Reserve the lime outline for the selected weapon slot only.

findings.where: Bottom-left hp and armour bars x22-430 y965-1068, and hotbar numbers 1-0 on the wall strip
findings.what: The bars are flat fills with 'hp 100' in condensed type at about 30px, which is heavier than the 20px body text. The armour and hp bars have different heights. The hotbar digits 1,3,4,5,7,8,9,0 are tiny grey text on a busy stone texture and are barely legible. Empty slots show only a digit.
findings.fix: Make both bars 20px tall with a 4px radius and 8px between them. Put the label and value inside at 16px 600. Keep the hp label at 20px. Draw the digits at 14px tx-2 inside a 64px dim slot tile with a --ui-panel fill at 60%, or hide the empty slots.

findings.what: The two buff cards are flush against the screen edge with 8px margins, below the 5% screen margin (about 96px). Name text is 24px, which is off the five-size type scale. The 3s timer and the damage tag are both muted at the same size, so nothing separates them. The cards sit tight over the player 2 bar.
findings.fix: Move them to x48 and keep a 24px gap. Set names to 20px 600 and sublines to 16px tx-2. Add a thin 3px timer bar along the card bottom in --acc for timed buffs.

findings.what: The '30 / 180' hero number is fine, but the card hugs the right and bottom edges at 10px, and 'compact smg' is right-aligned. The reserve count '/ 180' is almost as large as the hero 30, which weakens the hierarchy.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the screen edges. Set 30 at 56px 800 in tx-1 and '/ 180' at 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Left-align the weapon name at 16px.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint x410-536 y863-891 and 'bottomless clip 14s' bar x878-1043 y900-926
findings.what: The controls hint is a small low-contrast chip on the wall texture, about 16px. It is not aligned with the left HUD cluster. The pickup timer chip uses a yellow outline that reads as the lime accent, and its text is cramped at under 16px.
findings.fix: Anchor the f1 chip at x48, y1010, in the left column above hp, with a 16px label and the panel recipe. Make the timer chip 16px text with 8px padding and a --warn bar, not a lime outline.

findings.where: Top-left 'keyboard' tag x10-105 y8-30 and player 2 tag x15-170 y323-358
findings.what: The keyboard tag is a green-on-dark chip at the very corner. It looks like debug text and is much smaller than the other labels. The player 2 bar is a thin cyan strip with a name at 20px, which does not match the other HUD panels.
findings.fix: Remove the keyboard tag from raid, or move it to the pause menu. Style the player 2 tag with the panel recipe, 16px, with a 3px cyan player bar. Align it to the same x48 left margin.

v.verdict: The HUD is much cleaner than before: empty hotbar slots are gone, the ammo block is a strong hero number, and the top-centre cluster holds together. It still reads as a set of floating boxes with no shared margin, size or panel style.

findings.where: bottom-left hp and armour bars (22-432 x 965-1068)
findings.what: The hp and armour bars have no panel. They sit bare on the busy ground, and the hp number is a 30px bold green-on-green label with weak contrast. The 'armour 60' text is small and low-contrast on blue. Both bars sit flush against the screen edge at x=22, not the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Put both in one --ui-panel (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi) at x=48, bottom=48. Make the bars 320x20 with a 16px --tx-2 label and a 20px --tx-1 right-aligned number. Fill hp with --ok and armour with a darker blue. Remove the 30px weight.

findings.where: hotbar (960-1148 x 966-1054) and the digit strip (570-1472 x 970-990)
findings.what: The digits 1-4, 7-0 float on the wall texture as unframed, near-invisible grey text. Only slots 5 and 6 are tiles, so the row looks broken and offset from centre. Slot 5 uses an amber border rather than --acc. The 'f' badge is cramped against the tile edge.
findings.fix: Hide the unused digits, or draw all ten as 64px tiles at 70% --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Centre the row at x=960. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Put 16px --tx-2 digits top-left inside each tile. Move the 'f' badge into a 16px chip above the tile.

findings.where: top-centre stack: clock, team score, extract chip, goal-done toast (770-1150 x 18-395)
findings.what: Four blocks of different widths (148, 380, 144 and 230px) with different fills, stacked with uneven gaps. The team score panel is the widest and has two competing columns. The 'goal done' toast overlaps the extract arrow, and its teal edge differs from every other panel. The score panel's 40px hero number and the 56px clock fight for first read.
findings.fix: Use one 320px column at x=800, with a 16px gap between blocks and the same --ui-panel fill throughout. Make the clock the only 56px number. Shrink the team score to 32px, with the 'you' and 'p1' rows at 16px --tx-2. Place the toast 16px below the extract chip, with no overlap, and move the arrow inside the chip.

findings.what: The 'player 1' tag, the two buff cards and the combo chip all sit at different x offsets (8, 16, 20) and have different widths and styles. The buff text mixes sizes (26px name, 20px sub-line) with heavy bold. The combo chip has no panel and sits on the grass.
findings.fix: Set a 48px left margin and one 280px panel style for all of them. Use a 20px --tx-1 title and a 16px --tx-2 sub-line, in a 64px row with a 40px icon. Give the combo chip the same panel. Space the blocks 8px apart.

findings.what: The bar is tiny and cut off from the right margin (x=1901 instead of 1872). The label is 24px bold with a small chevron, and the panel is near-black with a different border from the others. It also sits 20px from the top while the clock sits at 18px, so the two are not aligned.
findings.fix: Right-align at x=1872, y=48, in the shared panel, with a 16px --tx-2 'goals' label, a 20px --tx-1 '1/3' and a 16px chevron.

findings.what: It floats mid-screen with a dark box that cuts into the wall art. It is the only element at that position and does not align to anything. The 'f1' chip is small and contrast is weak.
findings.fix: Anchor it at x=48, y=1080-48-120, above the hp panel, or move it to the footer legend. Use a 16px --tx-2 label and a 1px chip border.

findings.what: It is a tiny orphan chip with 14px text and a lime underline, floating above the hotbar. The 9s timer is lime, which clashes with the 'selected only' rule. It is not aligned to the hotbar or the ammo block.
findings.fix: Dock it directly above the selected hotbar slot at 16px, with the timer in --tx-1. Use a --warn or --acc bar only for the remaining time.

findings.what: The block is strong, but the 'support mg' label is 28px right-aligned. The '/ 360' is almost as large as the 60, which weakens the hero. The block runs to x=1910 rather than the 1872 margin, and its border is faint.
findings.fix: Set the label to 16px --tx-2. Make the '60' 56px and the '/ 360' 24px --tx-2. Pull the block in to x=1872 and bottom=48 to match the other corners.

v.verdict: The HUD is crowded and inconsistent: seven or more panels each use a different type size, panel style and border, and nothing clearly leads the eye. Capitals appear on screen, and the goals panel is dense and hard to read.

findings.where: goals panel (right, y 568-792) and minimap above it
findings.what: The goals panel is a wall of 16px text with no hierarchy: headers ('contracts', 'run goals') and rows share one weight and size. It also overlaps the world and sits tight under the huge minimap. It has no divider and no state for done versus open, and the '0/1' counts run straight into the text. The minimap is about 540x540 and dominates the screen, which is the opposite of the 'quiet hud' order.
findings.fix: Shrink the minimap to about 280px. Make the goals panel 20px rows with 16px tx-2 section labels, 8px row spacing, a 1px --ui-line divider between sections and right-aligned counts. Show only 3 rows, or fold the panel to one line by default. Use --ui-panel at 92% opacity.

findings.where: top-centre stack: timer 5:33, score card, 'extract 157m · closing' chip, 'extraction a closing' banner
findings.what: Four stacked boxes use four different styles: black timer, black score card, an amber-outlined chip and an amber-bordered banner. The same extraction information appears twice, in the chip and in the banner (157m and 'closes in 1:33'), which breaks the 'one place per line' rule. The banner heading is a 32px lime-or-amber bold title that competes with the 56px timer. The chip overlaps the score card's bottom edge. The banner text 'extraction a closing' looks garbled.
findings.fix: Keep only the banner for the alert and delete the chip. Fix the string to 'extraction closing'. Put the score inline under the timer with no separate card. Make the timer the only hero element at 56px. Use one panel style: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 8px gaps between boxes.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillagers 0 / you $1,770 / 0 out · 7 dead' panel
findings.what: The text is tiny at about 14px with an unclear hierarchy. The label 'value at risk' is far from its number, the chevron is cramped in the corner, and the 'you' row is too close to the panel edge. At 1080 from a couch it is unreadable. The panel is also stacked against the left feed and the contract hint, which adds crowding.
findings.fix: Use a 16px minimum and 20px for '$1,770'. Add 12px inner padding. Put the labels in tx-2 and the values in tx-1 right-aligned. Collapse 'current pillagers' to a single line, for example '7 dead · 0 out'.

findings.where: bottom-right ammo block 'compact smg 30 / 60' and 'air strike' bar
findings.what: The ammo block is washed-out ghost grey with low contrast. It has no panel, the gun name is dim, and 'b / i backpack' is about 14px at low contrast. The hero ammo number is faded, so the most important combat number reads weakest. The air strike bar is a different panel style at 14px. Its orange fill is a fourth accent colour, and it collides with the ammo block's edge.
findings.fix: Draw the ammo in tx-1 at 56px f-cond 800 on a --ui-panel fill, with the gun name in tx-2 at 20px. Drop the 'b / i backpack' hint or raise it to 16px at 4.5:1 contrast. Style the air strike bar like the other bars (a 16px label, a --acc fill) and leave a 16px gap above the ammo.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text sits on a mid-green bar at poor contrast, and the number has a stroke or shadow that looks soft. The bar is a flat pill with no panel, and its left edge nearly touches the screen edge at about 24px. The hotbar slots use three different treatments: the active slot has an amber border, the empty slots show only a faint number and the others have a dark tile. The ghosted weapon silhouettes for slots 5-0 add noise.
findings.fix: Put the hp in a --ui-panel bar with an --ok fill and --acc-ink text at 20px. Hide the empty slots 5-0, or draw them as 1px --ui-line outlines only. Use a lime border for the active slot only. Align the hp bar's left edge to the 5% margin (96px).

findings.where: bottom-left contract hint 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The contract hint is an explaining sentence on screen, which is a defect. It uses a third notice style (an amber left bar on a dark pill), and its two text weights fight each other. The 'f1 controls' chip is a tiny 14px key cap that sits right on top of the world and is hard to find. The two sit at different left x positions, so they do not align.
findings.fix: Shorten the hint to 'contract item nearby' and drop the explanation. Use the same notice style as the top banner. Align the hint and the 'f1 controls' chip on one left edge, 96px from the screen edge, with 8px between them. Make the chip text 16px.

findings.where: whole HUD: panel and border styles
findings.what: Panels have no consistent radius or border: the goals and top-left panels have square corners and no visible border, and the top boxes have soft corners. Fills vary from near-black to translucent. The result reads as a generic template, with nothing that ties the HUD to the game's look.
findings.fix: Standardise on --ui-panel (#16191b) at 90% opacity, 1px --ui-line-hi and a 4px radius for every HUD box. Put a 3px --acc left bar on the single active alert only.

findings.where: goals panel text, e.g. 'extract with a haul worth $1,600 or more 0/1', 'air strike $1,500'
findings.what: The goals text is long and reads as full explaining sentences. The mixed-case 'Item' / 'In' look suggests a font substitution (lower-case 'l' and capital 'I' look alike), so capitals may be on screen. The row text and counts are dense, and the reward amounts are not separated from the goals.
findings.fix: Shorten each row to a short noun phrase (for example 'haul $1,600'). Right-align the reward in tx-2. Confirm every string is lower-cased in code, because 'Item' and 'In' are capitals on screen.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but it is crowded with seven or more separate boxes in different styles. The goals panel sits on the minimap, the extraction message is shown twice, and there is no clear hero element.

findings.where: goals panel (right, y 567-792) over the minimap (y 20-555)
findings.what: The goals panel sits directly under the minimap with no gap. Its top edge butts against the minimap's translucent bottom edge, so the two read as one muddled block. The minimap itself is nearly invisible, with no border or fill, and blends into the map.
findings.fix: Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-panel fill at 85% opacity. Leave a 16px gap between it and the goals panel. Keep both right-aligned on the same 48px margin.

findings.where: extraction: 'extract 157m · closing' pill, the 'extraction a closing' card, and the 'extraction a available' tag at bottom left
findings.what: The same state appears in three places, which breaks the rule that a line is shown once. The card title 'extraction a closing' and the bottom-left 'extraction a available' also look like typos, probably a stray 'a' glyph. The card and the pill both use a yellow-amber treatment, so they compete with the score and timer for first attention.
findings.fix: Keep only the top-centre banner. Delete the 157m pill and the bottom-left tag, or merge the distance into the banner as one line. Fix the stray 'a' in both strings. Use --extract teal for extraction instead of amber.

findings.where: top-centre stack: timer 5:33 (y 18-90), score (y 98-186), pill, then the extraction card (y 250-320)
findings.what: Four boxes stack in one column, each with a different width, fill and border, and about 8-16px of uneven spacing between them. The timer is the largest text but carries no hero accent, and the score box repeats a small 'score' label. The hero 56px role is unclear, since the timer, the score and the 30 ammo number all compete.
findings.fix: Make the timer and score one 320px panel, with the timer at 56px as the single hero and the score at 20px below it. Space the card 16px below that. Use one border colour on all of them.

findings.what: This is a dense text block of about 12 lines. Its sub-headers ('contracts', 'run goals') are the same size and weight as the rows, so the hierarchy is flat. The mixed indents are inconsistent, 'open a vault item' has a stray capital 'I' in 'Item', and the '6pm clear' line is ambiguous clutter. The text is about 16px with tight line spacing.
findings.fix: Use 16px --tx-2 for the headers and 20px --tx-1 for the rows. Align all rows to one 16px left padding and use 8px row gaps. Fix 'Item' to lower case, and cut or fold the '6pm clear' line into the clock. Collapse the section by default and show only the open goal.

findings.where: 'current pillagers 0 / value at risk' panel (top-left) and 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (left)
findings.what: The party panel has two lines of 16px text with a chevron and a mixed layout: the right-aligned $1,770 is far from its 'you' label. The 'contract item nearby' notice is an explaining sentence, which is clutter. Its leading amber bar is a third accent style.
findings.fix: Shorten the notice to 'contract item nearby' and drop the sentence after the dot. Give both panels the same 4px radius and border. Make the 'you' row's label and value sit within 24px of each other, or add a divider line.

findings.where: bottom-right: air strike bar, then compact smg ammo panel
findings.what: The air strike strip is nearly full-width and tiny (about 12px label, '60%' at 12px), which is under the 16px floor. The orange bar looks like the amber warn colour, so it reads as a warning. The ammo panel has a good 56px hero number, but 'b / i backpack' at about 14px is faint, and the panel's vertical extent doesn't line up with the goals panel above it (x edge 1910 vs 1900).
findings.fix: Raise the labels to 16px. Align both panels to the same right edge at x=1872 (48px margin). Use lime or --tx-1 for the bar fill rather than amber.

findings.where: bottom-left: 'f1 controls' chip and the hp bar (y 940-1068)
findings.what: The 'hp 100' bar is a saturated green flat fill with oversized text, and it is the heaviest element in the corner. It has no panel or border and its bottom edge touches the screen edge. The 'f1 controls' chip floats and overlaps the map, with a faint grey fill. The hotbar numbers 3, 5-0 on the dim map have low contrast.
findings.fix: Inset the hp bar 48px from the left and bottom. Make it a 24px-tall bar with a --ui-panel frame and a 20px label. Give the f1 chip a --ui-panel fill and a 1px border. Raise the empty slot numbers to --tx-2 at 16px.

findings.what: Panel styles are inconsistent: some are solid black, some a translucent grey, and corner radii and borders differ. The amber, yellow, lime, orange and green accents all appear at once, so lime does not mean 'selected'. The hotbar's selected slot is amber rather than lime.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe: fill --ui-panel at 88%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Restrict amber to P1 identity and warnings. Use --acc lime only for the selected slot and the one primary item.

v.verdict: The raid hud has a good ammo block and a clear banner, but the faded score and timer are hard to read, the minimap and goals panel take over the right side, and there are stray capitals and overlaps.

findings.what: These are the hero numbers, but they are faded to about 30% opacity. A world prop (barrels) overlaps the score digits and hides them. The 'score' label is almost invisible. The faded panels look muddy, not deliberate.
findings.fix: Fade to no lower than 70% opacity. Where the hud fades over the player, keep text at full tx-1 and fade only the panel fill (rgba .5). Move the score panel up so it clears the props, or give it a solid --ui-panel fill. Make the score 32px, in lime only when it changes.

findings.what: The minimap is about 28% of the screen width. It is a flat black block with heavy white wall bars, and it has no panel border or title. It hides the play area, and it is the loudest thing on screen, louder than the player's own status. Its black fill is darker than --ui-void, and its edge lines are thin and unclear.
findings.fix: Shrink it to about 320x320 (1080p). Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius, and a --ui-panel fill at 85%. Dim the wall bars to --ui-line-hi. Keep one lime marker for the player.

findings.what: This is a big paragraph-like list of 10 lines, all the same weight and size. 'contracts' and 'run goals' headings look the same as the rows. It sits directly under the minimap and makes a heavy right-hand column. Typos show: 'criers', 'sump'. Rows run into each other because there are no dividers.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single line ('goals 0/3') by default, as the other HUD panels do, and open it with a key. If it stays open: headings in --tx-2 at 16px with .04em spacing, rows at 20px in --tx-1, 8px between groups, a 1px --ui-line divider between groups. Cap the panel at 4 rows.

findings.where: extraction banner plus the 'extract 157m · closing' pill
findings.what: The same message is drawn twice, one right above the other. The pill and the banner touch (about 4px apart). The brief says every line shows in one place. The banner carries a lime/amber bar on the left, but the pill has a full amber border, so they are two different treatments. The 'extraction a closing' text reads like a typo ('a closing').
findings.fix: Delete the pill. Keep the banner only and put the distance in its second line ('closes in 1:33 · 157m'). Fix the copy to 'extraction closing'. Give the banner the same 4px radius and the same left bar as the toast at the bottom left.

findings.what: The text is very small (about 14-16px) and dense: 'current pillagers 0', 'you $1,770', '0 out · 7 dead' are all the same weight. The label 'value at risk' is in tx-2 and mixed into the same line as the heading. The collapse caret has no meaning. The money value $1,770 is not emphasised, although it is the main fact here.
findings.fix: Make the $1,770 20px in --tx-1 at weight 700 with the label 'at risk' at 16px in --tx-2 below it. Drop the 'current pillagers 0' line or move it into the footer at 14px. Use 16px minimum everywhere.

findings.what: The slot numbers 3, 5, 6-0 float in the world with no slots. Slots 6-0 sit over a busy orange building and are unreadable. Slots 1, 2, 4 are filled and 3 and 5 are empty gaps, so the row looks broken. The selected slot has an amber outline, but the player colour is amber and lime means 'selected', so the cue clashes. The 'f1 controls' chip sits close to slot 1 with no alignment to anything.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles with a --ui-panel fill at 70% and a 1px --ui-line border, so empty slots read as empty. Selected: 2px --acc border. Move 'f1 controls' to align with the left edge of the hotbar, or to the left margin at 24px from the edge.

findings.where: hp bar, bottom-left, and the air strike bar, bottom-right
findings.what: The hp bar is a big saturated green bar that touches the screen edge, with the 'hp 100' text sitting on top of the fill and its edge. It is the biggest bar in the HUD, yet it is not the main action. The air strike bar is tiny (about 11px text) and sits outside the ammo block margin. The ammo block is clean, but the air strike strip above it breaks its right edge alignment and floats 12px away from it.
findings.fix: Inset the hp bar 24px from the left and bottom edges, make it 28px tall with a 4px radius, and use a dark --ui-panel track. Set the text at 20px, with the 'hp' label in --tx-2. Set the air strike label at 16px, and align the strip's right and bottom edges with the ammo block, using an 8px gap.

findings.where: bottom-left toast 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'
findings.what: It is an explaining sentence on screen, which is a defect. The bottom-left spot is close to the f1 chip, and the bright amber bar plus amber icon follow the banner treatment, but there are three amber elements in one band at the edge of the screen.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Remove the explanation. Use a 4px radius, and use --warn for the icon only, with the text in --tx-1.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is crowded: the top centre stacks four boxes, the goals panel spills over the hotbar and ammo, and the type sizes and panel treatments don't match.

findings.where: bottom right: goals panel, air strike bar, ammo block
findings.what: The goals panel (x1180-1898, y572-868) overlaps the faded air-strike bar and the ammo block. The ammo block ('30 / 60' at 56px+) is half hidden under it, and the goals panel is translucent so the world and hotbar slots 8, 9 and 0 show through its text.
findings.fix: Cap the goals panel at about 360px wide, anchor it to the top-right under the minimap, and give it an opaque --ui-panel fill. Keep y>880 clear for ammo and air strike. Make the ammo block the only hero number in that corner.

findings.where: bottom-left: contract item nearby toast, f1 controls chip, hotbar slot 1
findings.what: The 'contract item nearby · gold glow m...' toast is clipped by the hotbar and ends mid-word. The f1 controls chip sits on a wall with no background. Slot 1 touches the chip and the toast.
findings.fix: Stop the toast at 360px with ellipsis, or move it above the hotbar at y~640. Put the f1 chip in a --ui-panel pill at 8px from the left. Leave a 16px gap between every HUD element.

findings.where: top centre: timer, score, extract pill, extraction-closing banner
findings.what: Four stacked boxes in one 400px column say the same thing twice ('extract 157m · closing' and 'extraction a closing' with a countdown). The eye lands on the 5:33 timer and the 9,100 sp score, not on the urgent alert. The banner overlaps the extract pill's arrow, and its title is 32px bold amber against a 20px pill.
findings.fix: Delete the redundant 'extract 157m · closing' pill, or fold the distance into the banner as a line. Keep timer and score as one 56px/20px block. Give the alert one 3px --warn bar and 16px of space above it.

findings.what: Rows use at least three styles (white, green, grey) at about 20px with no section structure. 'goals 0/3', '6pm clear', 'contracts', 'run goals' are headers at the same size and weight as the items. Items collide with the hotbar slot numbers 8, 9 and 0. The text on top of the grey fill is dull and low in contrast.
findings.fix: Headers at 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 with .04em tracking, items at 20px tx-1, and a 1px --ui-line divider between groups. Use 8px row padding. Reserve green for completed items only.

findings.what: The minimap is a large 540x540 hard-edged black square with no border or rounding. It covers about 15% of the view, and its top and right edges touch the screen edge with no 5% margin. A 1px line and a collapse caret are the only chrome. It looks different from the other panels.
findings.fix: Shrink it to about 360px. Inset it 24px from the top and right. Use a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the other panels. Align its right edge with the goals panel.

findings.what: Three lines in different weights, with 'value at risk' and '$1,770' right-aligned in muted grey that fails the 4.5:1 floor. 'you', '0 out · 7 dead' and the caret have no clear hierarchy, and the panel is sized differently from the other three panels.
findings.fix: Make the hero number '$1,770' 32px tx-1 with 'value at risk' as a 16px tx-2 label. Move the pillager count to a second row. Use the same 4px radius, border and 16px padding as the other panels.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green slab, 'hp 100' is oversized (about 40px) and not centred. It touches the left and bottom edges at about 28px, off the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Use a 32px bar with a 1px frame. Put the label at 20px inside the bar, vertically centred. Inset it 48px from the left and bottom.

findings.what: Slots 3, 5, 6 and 7 are ghost icons with no clear frame. The selected slot 2 has an amber outline, but that is the player-1 colour, not lime. Slot numbers float outside the slots, and the slot pitch is uneven (slot 1 to 2 is about 118px, slot 2 to 4 about 235px).
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 72px square on an 8px pitch with a --ui-line-hi border. Put the number inside the slot's top-left corner at 14px. Mark the selected slot with a 2px lime --acc outline.

v.verdict: The HUD parts are all dark boxes at about the same weight, and the goals panel is a dense, overlapping, poorly aligned text block that collides with the weapon bar, the minimap and the air strike row. It reads as a developer overlay and not a polished raid HUD.

findings.what: A wide panel with about 12 lines of 16-20px text, no row dividers and no separation between the 'run goals' and 'contracts' sections. The weapon slots 8/9/0 and their faded gun icons show through it, and the digit labels collide with 'destroy 2 criers' and 'extract carrying'. The 'air strike' ability row is half hidden behind its lower edge. The panel runs about 720px wide and covers a large part of the playfield.
findings.fix: Make it opaque (--ui-panel at 92%) and cap it at about 360px wide, anchored under the minimap with a 16px margin. Collapse it to 3 lines by default: goals 0/3 plus the next goal. Put 16px of space between sections and keep slots 8/9/0 clear of it. Move the air strike row out of the panel's footprint.

findings.where: HUD overall, top-centre stack (timer, score, extract chip, extraction banner)
findings.what: Four stacked boxes at the top centre with nothing leading the eye. The 5:33 timer, the 'score 9,100 sp' card and the yellow 'extract 157m closing' chip all compete. The extraction banner then repeats the same message ('extraction closing' / 'closes in 1:33'), so the same thing is said twice and the alert chip and banner differ in style.
findings.fix: Keep one hero element: the timer at 56px in the lime accent only while extraction is active. Drop the 'extract 157m' chip, or merge it into the banner. Reduce the score card to about 20px, with no card of its own. Keep all boxes on one border and radius spec (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius).

findings.what: Three lines of mixed content: 'current pillagers 0', 'you', 'value at risk $1,770' and '0 out · 7 dead'. The label and value baselines don't line up, and 'you' is a floating word with no player colour chip. The collapse chevron at the top right is tiny. The text is about 16px, which is thin on a busy map, and the card has no identity, with no P1 amber or P2 cyan marker.
findings.fix: Use a two-column grid with 16px row gaps and labels in --tx-2 at 16px. Add a 3px amber bar (P1) or cyan bar (P2) on the left edge. Show value at risk as the one bigger number at 20-24px. Remove or rename 'current pillagers 0'.

findings.what: The slot numbers 1-7 float in different positions, some beside the slot and some bare ('3', '5', '6', '7'), and the empty slots are ghost icons with no frame. The selected slot is an amber ring, but selected should be lime. Ammo '60' badges and the small 'f' badge are tiny, and the slot sizes are uneven. The 'f1 controls' chip sits tight against the left slot and the wall.
findings.fix: Draw all 7 slots as identical 72px framed tiles with a 1px --ui-line border, the number inside the top-left corner at 16px, and the selected tile in a 2px --acc border. Lay out 8px gaps on the grid. Move 'f1 controls' 16px away from the bar, or into the left feed.

findings.what: The green bar is flush with the bottom screen edge, about 20px short of any safe margin, and the 'hp 100' text is large, outlined and low-contrast on the green fill. It is the widest element on screen and still the lowest-priority one, and its flat saturated green is off-palette.
findings.fix: Inset it 32px from the left and bottom (5% safe zone). Cut its width to about 320px and its height to 16px, with the number at 20px in --tx-1 right-aligned. Use --ok for healthy, --warn at 50% and --danger at 25%.

findings.what: 'compact smg' is right-aligned at 20px, '30 / 60' is large, and 'b / i backpack' is left-aligned in the same card, so the alignments clash. The card sits 10px from the screen edge, and the '/ 60' reserve is nearly as big as the magazine count. The card also overlaps the faded air strike row.
findings.fix: Right-align all three lines with 24px padding. Make the reserve count 24px in --tx-2 and keep 30 at 56px. Pull the card in 32px from the right and bottom edges, and give it a 16px gap from the goals panel.

findings.what: The minimap is a translucent grey tile with no border and the same colour as the world, so its edges blur into the map. It has an unexplained marker (diamond) and clipped icons at its right edge. It is huge compared with the other HUD elements, about 540x540.
findings.fix: Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --scrim fill at 80%, trim it to about 360px square, and inset it 32px from the top and right edges. Clip content inside the border and keep the chevron icon at one size.

findings.what: It is a tiny green-bordered tag at 14px, jammed against the corner at the screen edge, and it reads as a debug label. Its green is unlike every other border.
findings.fix: Remove it from the raid HUD, or restyle it as a 14px --tx-2 label with an 8px inset and a --ui-line border.

v.verdict: The HUD is full of overlaps: the player sprite covers the score, the goals panel covers the weapon slots and the air strike bar, and the contract line is clipped. The extraction message is shown twice, and no single element stands out.

findings.what: The player pillager and a crate sit on top of the 'score' label and the '9,160 sp' number, so the label is unreadable and the number is half hidden. The panel is also a faded translucent grey box with low contrast.
findings.fix: Make the score panel opaque (--ui-panel at 90%), or move it. Keep the sprite out of the HUD, or draw the HUD above world sprites. Set the score at 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1 with a 16px 'score' label above it, and put 16px of padding on all sides.

findings.where: bottom-right goals panel vs weapon slots and air-strike bar
findings.what: The goals panel is about 720px wide and its bottom rows ('search 3 crates', 'extract carrying 2x optics lens') sit over the faint weapon slots 8, 9 and 0. The air-strike cooldown bar (60%) is half hidden behind its bottom edge and clipped by it. The text collides with the slot digits ('8', '9', '0').
findings.fix: Cap the goals panel at about 420px wide and anchor it to the right margin at 5%. Keep it clear of the slot row and the air-strike bar, for example y 600-820 ending 24px above the bar. Hide empty slots 5-0, or give them a solid 4px-radius slot background so they don't read as text.

findings.what: The extraction message appears three times in the same area: the 'extract 157m · closing' pill, the 'extraction a closing' card and the 5:33 timer. The stray 'a' in 'extraction a closing' looks like a typo. This breaks the one-place-per-line rule and the no-explaining-text rule.
findings.fix: Keep the alert card only and delete the pill. Fix the string to 'extraction closing' (or 'extraction a closing' only if 'a' is a deliberate label). Put '1:33' at 56px hero in --extract teal, and drop the 'closes in' line.

findings.what: 'contract item nearby · gold glow m…' is cut off by the weapon slot 1, and the line sits right against the left screen edge. The f1 'controls' chip is next to it, crowded and tiny.
findings.fix: Shorten the text to 'contract item nearby', or put it above the f1 chip with a 24px margin. Make sure nothing overlaps slots 1-4. Give the f1 chip a 16px label size.

findings.what: The largest, brightest elements are the minimap (540px square, high contrast black) and the ammo '30 / 60'. The minimap is bigger than anything else on screen and pulls the eye away from the extraction alert and the player. The yellow-outlined alert is the only accent, so the lime accent has no clear job.
findings.fix: Shrink the minimap to about 360px and use a 1px --ui-line-hi border at 4px radius. Keep the hero accent for one element, the extraction timer. Make the other panels uniformly quiet (tx-2).

findings.what: 'current pillagers 0 / you / 0 out · 7 dead' reads as unclear debug text: the row labels don't line up with the values, 'you' has no value beside it, and 'value at risk $1,770' sits at a different baseline. The type sizes and weights are all about the same.
findings.fix: Use a two-column grid: 16px tx-2 labels on the left, 20px tx-1 values right-aligned. Drop 'current pillagers 0' as a row. Make '$1,770' the single emphasized value.

findings.what: All rows share one size and weight, so headers ('goals 0/3', 'contracts', 'run goals') don't stand out from the items. Item text like '6pm  clear' has uneven spacing, and the caret icon sits at the corner with no clear affordance.
findings.fix: Set headers at 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking, items at 20px tx-1 indented 16px, and 8px row spacing. Right-align the counts and prices (0/2, $1,500) in a tabular column.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' text has a heavy outline on a saturated green bar that reaches nearly to the edge, so it is a different style from every other panel. It looks like a default template bar.
findings.fix: Set the bar to 8px of height inside a --ui-panel container, with the number at 20px in tx-1, and set the fill to --ok. Keep it 24px from the screen edge and drop the outline.

v.verdict: The HUD has the same problems as the last review: the top-centre stack is crowded, the goals panel is dense, and the ammo is faded, so it still reads as a prototype overlay.

findings.where: top-centre stack: timer 5:33, score card, 'extract 157m · closing' chip, 'extraction a closing' banner
findings.what: Four stacked boxes with different fills, borders and paddings repeat the same extraction alert. The banner string still has a typo, 'a closing'. The chip is still there, so the alert is drawn twice, which the guide forbids. The score card is a second hero next to the timer.
findings.fix: Delete the chip. Change the banner to 'extraction closing' with 'closes in 1:33' at 16px. Make the timer the only 56px hero and put the score under it as a 20px inline line with no card. Use one --ui-panel style (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) and 8px gaps.

findings.what: The panel is still a dense 16px wall. It has no padding, no dividers and no right-aligned counts. The section labels ('contracts', 'run goals') look the same as the rows. The ghost text 'the seal 0%' overlaps the right edge, and the text touches the panel border. The minimap is about 300px and fills most of the corner.
findings.fix: Add 12px inner padding and 8px row spacing. Set the section labels to 16px tx-2 and the rows to 20px tx-1, with counts right-aligned. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between sections. Show 3 rows or fold the panel to the single line 'goals 0/3'. Fix or remove 'the seal 0%'. Shrink the minimap to 240-280px and use a --ui-panel fill at 92% opacity.

findings.where: bottom-right ammo block 'compact smg 30 / 60' and 'air strike' bar
findings.what: The ammo is a faded ghost with low contrast, so the hero number the player needs mid-fight is the weakest element on screen. The gun name is dim and the 'b / i backpack' hint is tiny and illegible. The air strike bar is a separate box with a different fill, jammed against the ammo with no gap.
findings.fix: Draw '30' at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1 and '/ 60' at 20px in tx-2, on an opaque --ui-panel fill. Set the gun name to 20px tx-2. Remove the backpack hint or raise it to 16px. Style the air strike bar like the other bars, with an --acc fill, and leave a 16px gap above the ammo.

findings.what: It is a 16px dropdown-style bar with a chevron and no padding, and it looks unlike every other panel. The previous review asked for the '$1,770' stat and the '7 dead · 0 out' line, and neither is visible. The chevron is the only clue that it opens.
findings.fix: Make it a --ui-panel block with 12px padding and a 4px radius. Show the labels in tx-2 and the values in tx-1 at 20px, for example '7 dead · 0 out' with '$1,770' right-aligned. Align it to the 96px margin.

findings.what: Slots 5-0 show only stray number digits and faint gun silhouettes floating over the ground. The slot sizes are inconsistent. The hp bar is a flat lime-green strip hard against the left edge, with 'hp 100' in a large display weight that fights the hero number. The hotbar and hp bar are not aligned to each other.
findings.fix: Hide empty slots 5-0, or draw them as 1px --ui-line outlines at 56px. Make the active slot's border the only lime element. Move the hp bar to x=96 and make it a --ui-panel bar with an --ok fill and 20px --acc-ink text. Align the hp baseline with the hotbar bottom.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' notice and 'f1 controls' hint
findings.what: The notice is a long explaining sentence on a bar with an amber edge, which is clutter and a defect under the guide. The 'f1 controls' chip is tiny, sits low and is styled differently from the notice. Both float at arbitrary x positions.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' at 20px and drop the explanation. Use the same --ui-panel style and left-align both at x=96 with 8px between them. Set 'f1 controls' to 16px.

findings.where: timer sun/extract icon and warm banner
findings.what: The small orange icon beside the timer is unexplained and sits off the centre line, so the stack is not symmetric. The banner and chip use amber for the extraction alert, but extraction is the teal --extract colour.
findings.fix: Drop the icon or put it inside the timer panel. Use --extract for the extraction banner's edge and glyph, and reserve --warn for warnings.

v.verdict: The minimap is now a transparent window with no border, and it butts against the goals panel. Extraction is still shown three times, the stray 'a' typos are still there, and the top-centre stack still has no clear hierarchy.

findings.where: top-centre: 'extract 157m · closing' pill, 'extraction a closing' card, and bottom-left 'extraction a available' tag
findings.what: The same extraction fact is drawn three times in three styles (amber pill, amber card, teal tag). Both strings still contain a stray 'a' ('extraction a closing', 'extraction a available'). This repeats last round's P0 and contradicts the one-place-per-line rule.
findings.fix: Keep only the top-centre card, in --extract teal, reading 'extraction closes in 1:33 · 157m'. Delete the pill and the bottom-left tag. Fix the strings to 'extraction closing' and 'extraction open'.

findings.what: The minimap has no border and no panel fill, so the world, walls and trees show through and the map is hard to read. It sits 10px above the goals panel with no deliberate gap. The right-edge icons clip at the frame edge, and the panel's border style differs from the others.
findings.fix: Give the minimap fill --ui-panel at 90% opacity and a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Inset the icons 8px. Keep a 16px gap above the goals panel, on the same right margin as that panel.

findings.where: timer 5:33, score panel and sun icon (top centre)
findings.what: The timer box (160px wide) and the score box (200px wide) are different widths, and the 5:33 and 9,100 sp are both large, so two competing heroes sit in one stack. The sun icon floats beside the timer with no frame. The score panel's label is 14px and thin.
findings.fix: Merge them into one 240px panel. Make the 5:33 timer 56px weight 800 as the hero, and put 'score 9,100 sp' at 20px tx-1 beneath it. Put the sun inside the panel, left-aligned. Leave 16px to the extraction card.

findings.what: The header, the 'clear' value, the section labels and the rows are all about 16px and nearly the same weight, with no hierarchy. 'item' is lower case but sits tight against 'a vault'. The text is 16px and cramped in 20px-tall rows, and the sun/'6pm clear' line is noise. The caret is thin.
findings.fix: Make the 'goals 0/3' header 20px tx-1. Make the section labels 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the rows 16px tx-1 with 8px gaps and 16px left padding. Remove the '6pm clear' line. Collapse 'run goals' by default.

findings.what: It is a full-width dropdown strip with a tiny 16px label and a chevron. It has no panel language shared with the other panels, and its meaning is unclear (the 'value at risk' text is gone). It reads as a stray bar.
findings.fix: Make it a 4px-radius --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px inset. Use the 16px label 'pillagers 0'. Shrink it to about 200px wide and align it to the 48px margin.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x15-410, y778-802)
findings.what: The notice still carries the explaining sentence after the dot. It is amber-on-dark with a tiny 16px label and a yellow tick edge that differs from the other cards. It also sits over the world feed and collides with the left-edge feed alignment.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby'. Use the same card style as the extraction card: 4px radius and a 3px left bar in --warn. Align it to the 48px left margin.

findings.where: bottom-left: 'elite ca…' label clipped behind the hotbar, 'f1 controls' chip, 'hp 100' bar
findings.what: 'elite ca' is cut off by the hotbar slot. The 'f1 controls' chip floats with no alignment to the hp bar or hotbar. The 'hp 100' text is in a bold style different from the other numbers.
findings.fix: Move the elite label to the left feed with 8px clearance, or truncate it with an ellipsis. Align 'f1 controls' to the hp bar's left edge. Put the hp number at 20px f-cond 700 inside the bar.

findings.where: bottom-right: air strike bar and compact smg ammo panel
findings.what: The air strike bar is a thin strip with a 14px label and an orange fill that clashes with the lime accent. The ammo panel's '30 / 60' hero is good, but the panel is a different width from the air strike bar and the 'b / i backpack' hint is tiny.
findings.fix: Make both panels the same 240px width with 8px between them. Colour the air strike fill --warn or lime. Raise the label and hint to 16px tx-2.

v.verdict: The minimap is smaller, which helps, but the score and timer are still faded under props and now read as ghosted grey boxes. The goals panel is still fully open and crowded. The extraction banner still has a typo and a duplicate pill, so it is a busy HUD with no clear first read.

findings.what: The faded grey panels are low contrast and sit over a prop and tree, which cuts through the score digits. The 'score' label is nearly invisible. The score also sits in a different box from the timer, and the two boxes are different widths.
findings.fix: Merge them into one 4px-radius --ui-panel plate at 85% opacity, about 240x96, centred at y=16. Keep the text at full --tx-1 and never fade it below 100%. Fade only the plate fill, and no lower than 70%. Make the score 32px weight 700, the timer 20px, and the 'score' label 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The copy is broken: 'extraction a closing'. The title is about 32px bold amber over a dark box and it competes with the score. The 'extract 157m · closing' pill above it repeats the same information. The banner has a lopsided left bar and no clear radius.
findings.fix: Fix the copy to 'extraction closing'. Delete the 'extract 157m · closing' pill and put the distance in line 2: 'closes in 1:33 · 157m' at 16px --tx-2. Use --extract teal for the icon and left bar, not amber, and give the banner a 4px radius and a 4px left bar. Drop the title to 20px weight 700.

findings.what: The panel is open with 8 rows in 14-16px text. The headings (6pm clear, contracts, run goals) are the same weight and colour as the rows, so there are no groups and the panel is a wall of text. It touches the minimap with no gap. It is too wide a footprint for a corner of the screen the player scans constantly.
findings.fix: Fold it to one line 'goals 0/3' by default and open it with a key. If it stays open: headings at 16px --tx-2 +.04em, rows at 20px --tx-1, 8px between groups, a 1px --ui-line divider between groups, a maximum of 4 rows, and a 16px gap below the minimap.

findings.what: This is a wide 360px bar for a single zero count. It has a chevron but no clear purpose, and its text is about 14px, below the 16px floor. It is the biggest dark bar in the corner and it carries the least information. The $1,770 at-risk figure from the previous review is missing.
findings.fix: Fold it to a 16px chip about 160px wide ('pillagers 0'). Add an 'at risk' row below it: $1,770 at 20px weight 700 --tx-1 with the 'at risk' label at 16px --tx-2. Make the chevron --tx-2 and 16px.

findings.what: The minimap is smaller, but it still has white wall bars that fight the map, a green tint, and no consistent border. The lime player marker is tiny. The collapse chevrons are drawn on the image edge. The minimap and the goals panel have different widths (298 and 300) and different corner radii.
findings.fix: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both panels, with the same width of 300px. Dim the wall bars to --ui-line-hi. Draw the player marker at 12px in --acc. Pad the chevrons 8px from the edge.

findings.where: bottom-right 'compact smg 30 / 60' and the air strike bar
findings.what: The ammo block is good, but 'b / i backpack' is 14px grey over a dark box and is hard to read. The air strike bar's label is about 12px, and its amber bar and '60%' text are tiny. The two boxes have different widths and different left edges.
findings.fix: Set both boxes to the same 300px width and right-align them to the 24px margin. Set the labels to 16px --tx-2 minimum, with the air strike '60%' at 16px --tx-1. Use --acc or --warn for the bar fill, not an orange of another hue.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, bright green 405px slab with the 'hp 100' text at about 32px, which is bigger than the title scale. It is the loudest element on screen and pulls the eye away from the score. The 'f1 controls' hint at 16px sits in a grey tab that clips the hotbar slots. Slots 3, 5, 6-0 have no art and their numbers float.
findings.fix: Narrow the hp bar to 280px and the height to 20px, with --ok fill, a --ui-panel track and 16px text inside. Move 'f1 controls' up 24px, into the left feed. Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlines on a --ui-panel fill, so every slot has a visible tile.

findings.what: There are six separate box styles: grey score plates, a black dropdown, an amber-bar banner, a black goals panel, a bordered minimap and an ammo block. Radii, borders and fills do not match. Nothing reads as the first thing to look at except the hp bar.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 85%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px padding. Use one accent per panel (lime for the player and selected, teal for extraction, red for danger). Make the hero 56px number the ammo count or the score only, not both.

v.verdict: The panels are now capped and anchored top-right, but the HUD is still crowded and inconsistent: the contract toast is clipped by hotbar slot 1, the top-centre stack repeats itself, and the bottom-right panels sit against each other with no gap.

findings.where: bottom-left: 'contract item nearby · gold glow m…' toast
findings.what: The toast runs under hotbar slot 1 and is cut off mid-word ('gold glow m'). It also sits tight against the f1 controls chip above it. The toast text itself is also a sentence that explains something.
findings.fix: Cap the toast at 340px with ellipsis, or shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Move it to y~640 above the hotbar. Leave a 16px gap to the f1 chip and a 16px gap to slot 1.

findings.where: bottom-right: air strike bar, ammo block, backpack hint
findings.what: The air strike bar (y~830) and the ammo panel (y~870) touch with no gap, and the two use different widths and fills. The ammo panel is a faint translucent box. The 30/60 hero number overlaps a world crate and the 'compact smp 2x scope' header is low contrast. The air strike bar's right edge runs past the goals panel above it, so the right column does not align.
findings.fix: Use one right-hand column of 360px with a 24px right inset, matching the minimap and goals panel. Give both the air strike bar and the ammo block an opaque --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put 16px between the two panels. Set the weapon name in tx-1 at 20px and the 56px 30 in --acc or tx-1.

findings.where: top-centre: timer, score, extract pill, extraction-closing banner
findings.what: Four stacked boxes, each with a different width, border and fill. The 'extract 157m · closing' pill and the banner say the same thing, and the banner's yellow-gold left bar uses a different border treatment from the pill's full outline. The banner's title is large (about 32px) and bold and competes with the timer.
findings.fix: Remove the pill and fold '157m' into the banner subline ('157m · closes in 1:33'). Make the timer and score one 360px panel. Give the banner a 3px --warn left bar only and no full outline. Leave 16px between the score block and the banner.

findings.what: The header, section labels and item rows are almost the same weight and size, so the panel reads as a flat list. The 'contracts' and 'run goals' labels are barely distinguished from the items. The panel text is dim against the busy map showing through, and the chevron sits in a different place from the minimap's.
findings.fix: Set the section labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with .04em tracking and the items at 20px tx-1. Add a 1px --ui-line divider between groups and 8px row padding. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill. Align the chevron with the minimap's at 16px from the right edge.

findings.what: A web-style select box with a chevron sits at the top-left, far from the other HUD elements. It is a different style (light border, 4px radius, no panel fill) and its purpose is unclear mid-raid. The 'keyboard' badge above it is also an unaligned chip.
findings.fix: Remove it from the raid HUD, or restyle it as a --ui-panel pill at 24px from the left and top. Fold the 'keyboard' badge into the same pill at 16px f-cond.

findings.what: The hp bar has a loud flat green fill with 'hp 100' in a large 40px label. It is a different size from the hotbar and other HUD numbers, and its left edge (x~28) does not align with the f1 chip, the toast (x~18) or the 'keyboard' chip (x~10).
findings.fix: Put every left-hand element on one 24px margin. Set the 'hp 100' label at 20px f-cond 700 and make the bar 360px wide, 16px high, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use --ok for the bar fill.

findings.what: Slot 1 and the active slot 2 have heavy dark tiles while slots 3 and 5–0 are faint ghost icons. The gap between slot 1 and slot 2 is tiny and the tiles use different sizes. The 'f' badge on slot 4 is unexplained and low contrast.
findings.fix: Use one 72px tile with an 8px gap and a 1px --ui-line border for empty slots. Show the active slot with a 3px --acc border only. Set the slot numbers at 16px tx-2.

v.verdict: The HUD is still crowded and inconsistent: the goals panel is still a long list of text, the top-centre stack is stacked three deep, and the left feed text is clipped by the weapon bar.

findings.where: left feed 'contract item nearby · gold glow m' (18-375 x 715-748)
findings.what: The line is cut off mid-word by weapon slot 1, so it is unreadable. The 'f1 controls' chip floats above it with no anchor.
findings.fix: Cap feed width at 340px and ellipsize or wrap it. Move the feed up to y≈640 so it clears the slot bar by 16px. Put 'f1 controls' at the bottom-left as a 16px line, 32px from the edge.

findings.what: Four cards sit in one column: timer, score, 'extract 157m · closing' chip and the 'extraction a closing' banner. The chip and the banner say the same thing twice, and the banner has a stray 'a' in its title. The yellow/amber on the chip and banner competes with the lime accent.
findings.fix: Delete the chip. Fix the banner text to 'extraction closing'. Give the timer the hero 56px and drop the score to a 20px line under it with no card. Use --warn only on the banner's 3px left bar.

findings.what: The panel is 8 text rows of 20px at the same weight, which is a wall of text. It is also wedged against the minimap and air strike bar with no spacing, and its text edge reaches the right margin at 1883 (about 20px, short of the 5% safe zone). 'run goals' and 'contracts' headers are barely different from the rows.
findings.fix: Default to a collapsed 3 rows (header 'goals 0/3' plus the next goal). Headers in --tx-2 16px, rows in --tx-1 20px, 16px gaps between sections. Inset 48px from the right edge and 16px from the minimap. Fill: opaque --ui-panel.

findings.what: Slots 1, 2 and 4 are framed tiles, while 3 and 5-0 are bare numbers over ghost icons, so the bar has no rhythm. The selected slot has an amber border, not lime. The 'f' badge and the '60' use different sizes.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px tiles with an 8px gap and a 1px --ui-line border. The selected tile gets a 2px --acc border, not amber. Numbers at 16px, inside the top-left corner of the tile. Dim empty tiles to 40%.

findings.where: bottom-right stack: air strike bar and ammo card (1535-1910 x 803-1047)
findings.what: The air strike bar and ammo card are different widths and run to within 10px of the screen edge, outside the 5% safe zone. The air strike bar's 14px label and 60% value are tiny, and its orange fill is a fourth accent colour. The ammo card has 4 text sizes in it.
findings.fix: Align both to a 320px column inset 48px from the right and bottom. Raise the air strike text to 16px, with the fill in --acc, or --warn when cooling down. Keep '30' at 56px and make '/ 60' 20px in --tx-2. Use the same 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the other panels.

findings.what: The bar hugs the bottom edge and left edge (about 28px, short of the 5% safe zone). It is a flat green fill with no frame, and the 'hp 100' text overlaps the fill at 40px, bigger than any other number except the ammo.
findings.fix: Inset 48px from the left and bottom. Reduce it to 320 x 16px with a 1px --ui-line border and --ok fill. Put the value at 20px, right-aligned, outside the bar. Switch to --warn at 50% and --danger at 25%.

findings.what: The meaning is unclear and the chevron suggests a menu, but it is not interactive on the HUD. It sits at 10px from the edge, with a different border and radius to the other panels. The 'keyboard' chip above it is also unexplained.
findings.fix: Remove it, or replace it with the player card (3px amber P1 bar, name, value at risk at 20px). Inset 48px. Move the 'keyboard' device chip into the pause menu.

findings.what: The minimap is translucent over a busy ground, so its walls merge with the world and its lines are hard to read. Its border differs from the goals panel, and the collapse chevron is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Fill with --ui-panel at 92% and a 1px --ui-line-hi border at 4px radius. Inset 48px from the top and right. Make it 320px square to match the column below.

v.verdict: The score and clock panels are now deliberately faded and the sprite shows through them, so the hero number is unreadable. The banner still has its duplicate pill and the 'extraction a closing' typo, and the goals panel is an unstructured text dump.

findings.where: top-centre clock (5:33) and score (9,160 sp) panels
findings.what: The fade-over-pillager effect leaves both panels at about 30% opacity. The pillager sprite sits on top of the score text and the 'score' label, and the clock is grey on grey. The most important numbers on the screen are the hardest to read, and the score is cut through by the sprite.
findings.fix: Fade the panel fill only and keep the text at 100% opacity, with a floor of 70% panel opacity. Alternatively, fade only while the player is within 120px, and keep the text at tx-1 32px f-cond 700. Draw the sprite below the HUD layer. Add 16px padding and put the 'score' label at 16px tx-2 on its own line above the number.

findings.what: The alert card is repeated by the pill above it. 'extract 157m · closing' and 'extraction a closing / closes in 1:33' say the same thing twice, which breaks the one-place-per-line rule. 'a closing' is also a typo, and the 5:33 clock above shows a different time from the 1:33 countdown, which is confusing.
findings.fix: Delete the pill. Keep one card that reads 'extraction closing' with '1:33' at 56px f-cond 800 in --extract teal, and drop the 'closes in' line. Show the 157m distance as a 16px tx-2 suffix. Remove or relabel the 5:33 clock so there is only one timer.

findings.what: The panel is a crowded text dump of 11 lines in one size and weight. The headers 'contracts' and 'run goals' look the same as the items, and one item wraps with an odd indent ('search 2 containers in the / long dock or scrap line'). The lines butt against the panel edge at the left and right with no padding, and the panel sits flush under the minimap with no gap. Everything is tx-1.
findings.fix: Use 16px tx-2 section labels with +.04em tracking and 20px f-cond 600 item rows. Put the counts right-aligned in lime or tx-2. Fix the wrap with a hanging indent of 16px. Use 16px padding and an 8px gap below the minimap. Show only the active 3 goals and collapse the rest behind the chevron.
