findings.what: At 360x360 it dominates the top-right corner and is the brightest, highest-contrast block on screen, so the eye goes there before the score or the extraction alert. The stray 'n' glyph and the clipped chevron are crammed against the border, and the diamond and arrow icons are tiny.
findings.fix: Reduce it to about 300px and dim the fill to --ui-void at 85%. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Move the 'n' to 8px inside the corner. Make the markers at least 16px.

findings.where: bottom-right ammo and air strike stack
findings.what: The air-strike bar and the weapon card are two boxes of different widths with misaligned left edges, and they overlap the orange ground. The 'air strike' label at about 14px is below the 16px floor. 'b / i backpack' is tiny and sits against the bottom edge. The weapon card has a ghost sprite that clashes with the text.
findings.fix: Make both 340px wide with a shared 5% right margin and a 16px gap. Set labels at 16px tx-2. Give the 'b / i backpack' hint 16px of padding from the bottom edge. Remove the ghost sprite or lower it to 10% opacity.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 0 float as bare grey digits over the world with ghost weapon silhouettes, so they read as stray text. The two filled slots are on a solid fill, and slots 1 to 4 are crammed at the edge of the 'f1 controls' chip.
findings.fix: Give every slot a 72px solid --ui-panel tile at 4px radius with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or hide the empty slots. Space them with an 8px gap. Keep lime only on the selected slot, which currently uses amber. Move the f1 chip 24px clear of slot 1.

findings.what: The green bar is flat, loud and large, with 'hp 100' text at about 40px outlined over it. It competes with the other numbers and runs to the screen edge with no margin. The hero treatment is spread across the clock, the ammo and the hp, so none of them wins.
findings.fix: Inset it 5% from the left and bottom edges, make it 320x24 with a 4px radius, and set 'hp' at 16px tx-2 with '100' at 32px tx-1 beside it. Keep the 56px hero only for the ammo count.

findings.what: The dropdown is a full-width bar with a chevron and the label 'current pillagers 0', which is the dev or debug look. It floats between the minimap and the clock with no relation to either. The 'keyboard' tag in green on a dark box is a different style from the other panels.
findings.fix: Reduce it to a 16px chip with 8px padding at the 5% margin, or hide it outside the party mode. Restyle the 'keyboard' tag as 16px tx-2 on --ui-panel at 4px radius.

v.verdict: The title screen has a clear hierarchy and a calm column, but the amber logo clashes with the lime accent, and the saves block and small text keep it from looking polished.

findings.where: Logo x802-1118 y292-372 against the lime '1 player' button
findings.what: The orange-gold gradient wordmark sits right above a lime fill. The guide says the accent is 24 degrees of hue from gold and the two must never sit side by side as fills. The gradient wash is also a template tell, and the logo competes with the lime button as the first thing the eye hits.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc), or flat --r-gold only as a 3px underline bar. Keep the lime fill as the only hot colour on the screen. Leave 48px between the logo and the tagline, and give the logo a 56px hero-weight cap-height.

findings.what: The selected save row has a lime 1px border and lime text. It reads as a second primary action competing with '1 player'. The name field, 'change name' and 'create a new save' are three more boxes at 14px text, which is too small and crowded. The field repeats the save name 'pillager'.
findings.fix: Show the selected save as a --ui-raised row with a 3px lime left bar and --tx-1 text, with no full lime border. Put the stats at 16px tx-2. Move 'change name' and 'create a new save' into the row's secondary controls at 16px, height 48px, with 8px gaps. Hide the name field until 'change name' is pressed.

findings.what: Four peer modes, including two near-duplicate 'arcade demo' entries, make the main menu cluttered. The '(same machine)' parenthetical is explaining text. The order is odd, with 2 player arcade demo before 1 player.
findings.fix: Order the entries 1 player, 2 player co-op, 1 player arcade demo, 2 player arcade demo. Drop '(same machine)' from the label. Group the demos under a 16px tx-2 'demos' label with 16px of extra space above, or move them to a secondary row. Keep the rows 56px tall with 8px gaps.

findings.where: Footer key legend x726-1194 y1030-1056 and version stamp x97-242 y1041-1055
findings.what: The legend and version text are about 14-15px tx-2 on near-black, and the keycap boxes are tiny. The version stamp is dim and condensed, and it sits left of the legend's baseline.
findings.fix: Set the legend at 16px with 24px gaps between pairs and keycaps 28px tall. Raise the legend to tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Put the version stamp at 14px f-body 500 aligned to the legend baseline, with a 48px left margin matching the top-right margin.

findings.what: 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' are small, with about 14px text and a heavy 1px bright border. They are far from the content and have no focus state. The right margin is 97px while the version stamp margin is about 97px on the left, which is fine, but the buttons look pasted on.
findings.fix: Use 56px-tall buttons with 16px f-cond 600 text, a --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-panel fill. Add a 3px lime focus underline. Align the top edge to y48, which is 5% of the screen height.

findings.where: Tagline x865-1054 y397-416 and 'saves' label x681-722 y693
findings.what: The tagline and the label are about 16px tx-2 or dimmer, and they are tiny against a 56px logo. The tagline has weak contrast on the dark background. The 'saves' label is f-body, not f-cond, so it is inconsistent with the other labels.
findings.fix: Set the tagline at 20px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, 16px below the logo. Set the 'saves' label at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with 16px of space above the row.

findings.what: The vignette is flat and the page is empty. The identity is a generic centred-column template, with nothing from the game on screen. The block is centred slightly low, with 290px above the logo and about 275px below the saves.
findings.fix: Add one muted raid art plate or a silhouette at 15% opacity behind the column, with a --scrim of .80. Shift the column up by 24px so the optical centre sits at y540.

v.verdict: A readable in-raid HUD with a strong ammo hero number, but the top-centre timer is clipped under the banner, there are typos and capitals on screen, and the left side is cluttered with competing panels.

findings.where: Top-centre extraction timer x925-995 y15-35 under the 'extraction a available / extract 74m' banner x855-1015 y30-72
findings.what: The 14:59 countdown is cut off at the screen top and the banner covers its lower half. The timer is the most important number in a raid and it cannot be read. The banner also contains a typo, 'a available', and it is stacked directly over the extraction ring and the 'the sump' label.
findings.fix: Move the timer to y48 (5% margin) at 56px hero f-cond 800 in --tx-1, or in --extract teal when extraction is open. Put the banner 16px below it, with no overlap. Fix the copy to 'extraction available'. Drop the 'the sump' map label while the banner is showing.

findings.where: Left stack x8-368 y143-260 (current pillagers), x15-170 y323-358 (pillager bar), x15-410 y775-802 (contract toast)
findings.what: Three separate boxes with three different fills, borders and text sizes run down the left edge. Money rows use 14-16px text in a different, mono-like weight. 'current pillagers 0' with 'value at risk' and a chevron adds up to a dense scoreboard that fights the map. Only the first box has a border radius, and padding differs between the boxes.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel (#16191b) fill at 80% alpha, 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border for every left-side box. Use 16px f-cond 600 for rows, with 24px gaps between boxes, and left-align them all to the 48px margin. Collapse the roster to a single line, 'value at risk $567', until it is expanded.

findings.where: Contract toast x15-410 y775-802 and 'pillager joined' toast x894-1025 y893-929
findings.what: The same kind of message is styled two ways. One has a gold left bar and an icon, and the other is a plain black box. The toast text is 16px in two colours with a '·' separator, plus an explaining sentence ('gold glow marks the box'), which counts as clutter. Placement is also inconsistent, since one is left and one is bottom-centre.
findings.fix: Use one feed component: --ui-panel fill, 3px left status bar (--warn for contract, --ok for joined), 16px tx-1 text. Delete 'gold glow marks the box'. Per the 186a order, send both to the left feed only, stacked 8px apart above the controls hint.

findings.what: A 295px wide bar with a 'run Info' label that has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. It sits at y18, off the 48px margin, and carries nothing useful when closed. It does not match the roster's chevron toggle on the left. It also clashes with the order for a vertical 1x1 top-right list.
findings.fix: Write 'run info' in lower case. Shrink it to a 160px-wide, 48px-tall --ui-panel chip at y48, right edge x1872. Use the same chevron style as the roster, and match the roster's border.

findings.where: Bottom-left x22-430 y995-1070 stamina and hp bars
findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, saturated green (#76b97c-like) fill with 'hp 100' at roughly 32px, which is bigger than the stamina label at about 20px and the hotbar numbers. The two bars use different heights, and the stamina's dark empty track looks like a different component. The green block is the loudest object on the screen.
findings.fix: Make both bars 16px tall with a 4px radius on the same --ui-line track. Put the 'hp 100' label at 20px f-cond 700 and the 'stamina' label at 16px tx-2. Keep hp at --ok. Align the left edge to x48 and the bottom to y1032.

findings.where: Hotbar x557-748 y968-1058 and key numbers 3-0 across y970-990
findings.what: The slot numbers 3 to 0 float across the whole bottom strip as faint grey text with no slots under them, and their contrast is below 4.5:1. The empty slots look like a bug. The selected slot has an amber/gold border, while the lime accent is meant for 'selected' (P1 amber is the owner's player colour, so the clash is a real ambiguity). The 'f1 controls' chip at x440-540 y942-964 sits in front of the hotbar and has a different style.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px --ui-panel squares with an 8px gap, centred, with the 16px index at tx-2. Use a 3px lime top bar on the selected slot instead of the amber border. Move 'f1 controls' to the mid-bottom-left line at 16px tx-2, aligned to the 48px margin.

findings.what: The ammo hero number is the strongest element, which is correct, but the card sits against the right edge with only 10px of margin where 48px is specified. The 'b / i backpack' hint at about 14px has low contrast. 'scav pistol' at 24px italic-like type does not match the type scale.
findings.fix: Pull the card in to a 48px right margin and bottom margin. Set the weapon name at 20px f-cond 600 and the hint at 16px tx-2 (4.5:1). Keep '12' at 56px hero and set '/ 24' at 32px tx-2.

findings.where: Overall HUD against the map, with the keyboard tag at x10-105 y5-33
findings.what: The 'keyboard' device tag sits in the top-left corner in a mono font on a green box, which matches no token (the guide forbids f-mono for anything but table numbers). The map has a dark vignette wash, which lowers the contrast of the HUD text at the edges. The panels have no shared style, so the HUD does not feel like one system.
findings.fix: Restyle the tag as a 16px f-cond 600 --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, at x48 y48. Cap the vignette at 25% so panel text keeps 4.5:1 or better.

v.verdict: This is an in-raid HUD, not the title menu the earlier review covered, and it is cluttered: the extraction banner overprints the timer, the 'run info' dropdown has a capital 'I', and the HUD panels share no common styling.

findings.what: The 'extraction is available' pill sits on top of the extract timer, so only the lower half of '14:55' shows. The text also reads 'a available' (a typo). The player loses the most important number in the raid, and the 'extract 76m' pill under it makes three stacked labels in one spot.
findings.fix: Put the timer in its own 56px hero row at y24-80. Move the banner to y96, fix the string to 'extraction available', and merge 'extract 76m' into the same pill. Use 16px f-cond 600 on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --extract border, and keep the banner and the timer from overlapping.

findings.what: The label has a capital 'I' ('run Info'), which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The control is a wide, empty bar with a chevron that explains nothing, and its style differs from every other HUD panel.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info'. Shrink it to a 160x40 chip with a 16px label and a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel at 4px radius. Align its right edge to the 5% margin (x1824) and its top to y48.

findings.what: Four text sizes and weights are packed into a 117px-tall box. 'value at risk' is a tiny muted header with a chevron. Rows carry tight 18px spacing and the 'dead' tags are the same grey as everything else. '$3,950 dead' reads like a price list, and the footer line ('0 out · 3 dead') repeats what the rows already say.
findings.fix: Use 20px names and 16px values, with 32px row height. Colour 'dead' --danger and 'you' --tx-1. Delete the footer line. Rename the header to 'pillagers' and drop the '0' after 'current pillagers'. Use 16px padding all round.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, saturated green slab with a 36px '100' in a different weight from the stamina bar above it. The two bars have different heights and different label sizes, and the stamina label sits on the bar's blue fill with weak contrast. There is no panel behind them, so they float over the terrain.
findings.fix: Use equal 24px bars on a --ui-panel plate with 8px padding. Put 16px f-cond 600 labels at the left, tx-1, and the hero number in --fs-hero only for hp. Keep the stamina label off the fill.

findings.what: This is the strongest element. However, the weapon name is right-aligned at 20px while 'b / i backpack' is a 14px label at the bottom left. The '12 / 24' hero number uses two sizes with a faint '/ 24'. The panel border is dim and its corner radius differs from the roster panel.
findings.fix: Left-align the weapon name and the backpack hint on the same 16px baseline. Make '/ 24' 28px in tx-2. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, the same as every other HUD panel.

findings.what: Slots 3-9 and 0 show bare numerals and ghosted weapon silhouettes on the road texture, at low contrast, with no slot boxes. Slot 1 has an amber ring while slot 2 has a white border, so the selected state doesn't use the lime accent. Slot 2 is overlapped by a tiny 'f' key badge.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 56px boxes on --ui-panel at 8px gaps. Show the selected slot with a 3px --acc bottom bar. Drop the ghost silhouettes. Put key numerals at 16px tx-2 in the top-left.

findings.where: 'keyboard' tag x10-105 y5-32 and 'f1 controls' x440-540 y942-964
findings.what: Both are small chips with different fills and borders (green text on dark vs grey on grey). 'f1 controls' sits on the road with low contrast and is not aligned with the hotbar or the vitals.
findings.fix: Restyle both as one chip: 16px f-cond 600, tx-2 on --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Align 'keyboard' to the 48px margin. Move 'f1 controls' to the hotbar's left edge with an 8px gap, on the same baseline.

findings.what: It is a black, square-cornered box with 16px text floating mid-screen above the hotbar. It has no border or radius matching the other panels, and it sits close to the hotbar and the aim reticle area.
findings.fix: Use the standard chip (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px text). Move it to the left feed position, and auto-hide it after 3s.

v.verdict: Only the countdown changed (15s to 9s) and the run info panel opened, which adds clutter. Most of the earlier advice on the ammo panel, the extract banner, the pickup pills and the top-right corner was not applied, so the screen is still a stack of unrelated dark boxes.

findings.what: The panel is still a translucent grey slab. The map shows through it, and 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are low-contrast grey on grey. Last review's fix was not applied.
findings.fix: Use an opaque --ui-panel (#16191b) fill at 90%. Put the weapon name and backpack line in tx-2 (#aaa498) at 16px or larger, and keep 12 / 24 at 56px tx-1. Use 16px of inner padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The expanded panel holds four lines of contract text at about 15px. It wraps badly ('search 2 containers in the / long dock or scrap line 0/2'), and its progress counts are glued to the text with no alignment. The 'noon clear' line is noise. The corner is also reserved for the cw-trcol column.
findings.fix: Collapse the panel by default during extraction. If it stays open, use 16px labels in tx-2 and right-align the 'n/m' counts in tx-1 in a fixed 56px column. Cut each contract to one line, drop 'noon clear', and use 16px padding on all sides.

findings.what: The 9s countdown is the same size as the label, so the key number does not stand out. The black slab is still wider than its text, and the hostiles strip is jammed under it with no gap.
findings.fix: Make '9s' 56px f-cond 800 in --extract. Set 'extract b inbound' at 20px tx-2 beside it. Shrink the slab to hug the text with 16px padding. Merge the hostiles line into the same card as a 16px danger-red label, or leave an 8px gap.

findings.where: bottom-left 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' toast
findings.what: This is an explaining sentence, which the owner counts as a defect. It uses yellow text on a translucent strip over a busy map and has no clear border. It is a different shape from the right-hand pickup pills.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the 'gold glow' clause. Use the same pill as the pickups: 32px high, 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 3px left bar in --warn, tx-1 text at 20px, and an opaque --ui-panel fill.

findings.where: right-hand pickup pills (medkit, titanium cell, induction cell)
findings.what: The three pills have different left-bar colours with no clear meaning. They are right-aligned to different widths and sit tight together. Their 'induction cell' name is blue and low-contrast on the dark fill.
findings.fix: Use one component: 32px rows with 8px gaps, tx-1 text at 20px, and a 3px left bar coloured by rarity only. Give all pills the same --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The 'you' row looks the same as the other rows, and the header is a different style from run info. The text is about 15px.
findings.fix: Add a 3px lime left bar and tx-1 text to the 'you' row, and set the other rows to tx-2. Use 16px text, 24px panel padding, and the same header style as run info.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat, saturated green slab with a large '100' in a different weight. It does not share the panel language and sits crowded against the screen edge. The hotbar number keys are tiny.
findings.fix: Put the hp bar in a --ui-panel frame with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px margin from the screen edge. Use --ok only for the fill. Set the hotbar key numbers at 16px.

findings.where: loot labels near top-right ('induction cell $1,418' and the lines below it)
findings.what: The stacked labels overlap and are blurry. The 'titanium cell' and 'medkit' lines are unreadable.
findings.fix: Show one label at a time, or space the lines 24px apart at 16px with a 1px dark outline. Hide the labels behind the nearest one.

v.verdict: The easy-mode prompt reads clearly, but the HUD around it is still cluttered and inconsistent: the timer is still not the hero, the panels use mixed styles, and text overlaps in several places.

findings.what: The card is lopsided. The title is at the far left, a stray '9' countdown floats at the right edge at x1232, and the header strip ends abruptly at y345. The lime 'yes' fill is the only button treatment, and its label is tiny and low-contrast against that fill. The 'y' key hint is doubled into the label ('y yes', 'n no'). The card has no x corner, no scrim, and covers the extraction banner and the compass arrow.
findings.fix: Use one --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put a 32px f-cond 700 title at 24px padding. Put the countdown in a 16px tx-2 chip at the top-right. Add a --scrim at 80% behind the card. Make the button labels 20px f-cond 700 in --acc-ink on the yes button and tx-1 on the no button, and draw the y/n key hints as 16px chips set apart from the label. Make both buttons 56px tall with a 16px gap.

findings.where: Top-centre cluster x855-1060 y15-215 (clock, team score, extract banner)
findings.what: Three stacked boxes with different widths, and the 'extract 141m' pill at x908-1005 is tiny at about 12px. The timer is still the largest element, but the extraction state is buried. 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' is about 11px, below the 16px floor. The extract arrow overlaps the pill.
findings.fix: Align all three boxes to one width of 220px, centred, with 8px gaps. Set 'extract 141m' at 20px f-cond 700 in --extract, with the arrow to its left rather than overlapping it. Set the 'you/p2' scores at 16px, in amber for P1 and cyan for P2 per the player-colour rule. Make 'team score' 16px tx-2.

findings.where: Left buff stack x10-215 y432-700 and player-2 bar x10-172 y323-358
findings.what: Buff rows have different widths (110-215px) with ragged right edges. Sub-labels such as '+15% damage', '5s' and '4s' are about 12px and are clipped or overlapped, and 'liquor 30s' collides with its icon box. The player-2 bar is a different component with a 10px label and no panel. Nothing aligns to the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Make every row a fixed 220px by 56px --ui-panel at 80% alpha with a 4px radius. Use a 20px name and a 16px tx-2 sub-label, with 8px gaps. Align the stack to x48. Restyle the player-2 bar as the same panel at 220px wide with a 16px label.

findings.where: Bottom-centre 'pillagers joined' toast x895-1020 y893-930, overlapping the players
findings.what: The toast is semi-transparent and sits on top of the two player characters, so it is unreadable ('pillag joined'). It also has no panel and no status bar.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed, per the 186a order. Give it a --ui-panel fill, a 3px --ok left bar and 16px tx-1 text, and keep it out of the play area.

findings.where: Bottom-left armour/hp bars x15-430 y962-1068, and 'f1 controls' x438-537 y943-967
findings.what: The armour bar (22px, blue, with a glow) and the hp bar (36px, green) are different heights with different label sizes, and the hp bar sits 4px from the screen edge. 'hp 100' is bold and distorted. The 'f1 controls' chip floats at an arbitrary offset with no relationship to either bar.
findings.fix: Make both bars 24px tall with a 4px radius on a --ui-line track, aligned to x48 and ending at y1032, with an 8px gap between them. Set the labels at 20px f-cond 700 on the left of the bar. Put 'f1 controls' on the left, mid-bottom, as one folded line, 16px, 24px above the bars.

findings.where: Hotbar x548-745 y968-1062 and ammo block x1703-1905 y922-1020
findings.what: The two hotbar slots use different treatments: slot 2 has an amber ring and slot 1 has none. The slot count digits are about 12px. The ammo block is a different panel style from every other box, and 'scav pistol' is about 14px tx-2 on a dark fill.
findings.fix: Make the slots 72px squares in --ui-panel, with a lime 2px border only on the selected one, not amber. Set counts at 16px. Match the ammo panel to the same fill and border, with 16px tx-1 for the weapon name and a 56px hero number. Align its right edge to x1872 and its bottom to y1032.

findings.where: Top-right 'goals 0/3' dropdown x1648-1898 y12-52, and the keyboard tag x8-105 y5-32
findings.what: The dropdown label is about 13px and cramped against its chevron. It sits 12px from the top and 22px from the right edge, so it is not on the margin. The 'keyboard' tag is an unstyled outline chip in the corner and does not match any other component.
findings.fix: Make the dropdown 200px by 48px with a 16px label, and align it at the 48px margin (right edge x1872, top y48). Restyle the 'keyboard' chip as a --ui-panel chip at the 48px margin, 16px tx-2, or hide it once a device is known.

findings.where: Faint '33' watermark and the ground-level 'the seal 0%' and 'player 2' labels, x1380-1500 y230-320
findings.what: A large ghosted '33' sits in the map right behind the modal's right side. The 'the seal 0%' world label is about 12px, hard to read, and in teal, which is reserved for extraction.
findings.fix: Remove or hide the '33' while a modal is open. Set world labels to 16px f-cond 600 on a dark chip, and use tx-1 rather than teal for non-extraction objects.

v.verdict: A bright lime 'want easy mode?' modal now dominates the screen, while the HUD underneath still has the crowded top-centre stack, the text-only goals dropdown and uneven panel styling that were flagged before.

findings.where: Top-centre stack x855-1060 y15-230: timer, team score, 'extract 109m' pill and arrow
findings.what: Four separate boxes with different fills, borders and sizes are stacked with no spacing system. The 'extract 109m' pill is 14px text jammed against the team-score box, and the teal arrow overlaps the pill. The timer is only about 40px, not the 56px hero size. 'you 0 sp' and 'p1 0 sp' are about 12px, below the 16px floor.
findings.fix: Make one column on a 16px grid. The timer goes in a 56px f-cond 800 hero row at y24-80. Put the team score below it in one --ui-panel box with 20px 'sp' and 16px per-player lines. Put 'extract 109m' in a 16px --extract pill at y+16 with the arrow outside it.

findings.what: The title is about 22px, not 32px. The countdown '9' is 14px and floats in the corner with no meaning. The card has a 1px progress sliver at the top-left and no 4px radius or visible border. Both buttons carry a redundant key letter ('y yes', 'n no'). The yes button is a flat lime slab with 20px text and no focus ring. The no button is nearly invisible against the panel.
findings.fix: Title 32px f-cond 700, tx-1, 24px padding. Make the countdown a 16px tx-2 label ('9s') right-aligned on the title baseline. Buttons are 56px high with a 4px radius. Yes is --acc fill with --acc-ink 20px text. No gets a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 text. Put key hints in a 16px tx-2 chip inside each button, and add a 2px --acc outline on the focused button. Give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The text is about 14px in a slim box with a tiny chevron. It is still the weakest element at the top right, and it sits at x1900, past the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Make it a 160x40 chip on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px f-cond 600 text. Align its right edge to x1824 and its top to y48. Enlarge the chevron to 16px.

findings.what: Names are about 18px with +15% inline, and the sub-labels ('damage', '5s', '30r') are about 11px, which is unreadable from a couch. Rows are different widths (108 to 212px). Icons are small and sit in mismatched boxes.
findings.fix: Use a fixed 220px width and 48px row height with 8px gaps. Names are 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Sub-labels are 16px tx-2. Put the timer right-aligned in a 16px --warn or tx-2 label, and the 30r value too. Icons are 32px with a consistent --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The armour bar is a bright blue and the hp bar is a green fill. The two bars are different heights, with 20px text over the fills, and they have no shared plate. They clash with the lime accent and crowd the edge at x18. The hp bar is much taller than the armour bar.
findings.fix: Put both bars on one --ui-panel plate with 8px padding and a 4px radius. Make both bars 24px high with 16px labels at the left. Use --ok for hp and a desaturated blue for armour. Make the 'hp 100' number the one hero at 56px. Align the plate left edge to x96 (5% margin).

findings.what: The weapon name is about 16px, right-aligned, and the '8 / 42' reads as slanted italic. The panel's right edge is at x1908, so it is not on the margin. It does not match the top-right chip or the top-centre boxes.
findings.fix: Use a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Left-align the weapon name at 16px tx-2. Show '8' at 56px --fs-hero, with '/ 42' at 28px tx-2. Align the right edge to x1824.

findings.where: Hotbar x548-1480 y965-1065 plus 'f1 controls' tag and 'in pillager's party' tooltip
findings.what: The slot numbers 2, 3, 5-0 are about 12px floating over the map with no slot plates. Only the two filled slots have frames. The 'f1 controls' tag is 14px and crowds the hotbar at x450. The 'in pillager's party' tooltip is a flat black box with different padding, floating at y895.
findings.fix: Give all 10 slots a 56px plate on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border. Put the numbers at 16px tx-2 inside the slot. Move 'f1 controls' to a 16px chip left of slot 1 with a 16px gap. Give the tooltip 16px padding and the same 4px radius and border as the panels.

findings.where: Top-left 'keyboard' tag x10-105 y8-32 and 'player 1' bar x10-170 y325-358
findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a bold 18px lime-ish label in a green border, which is a different style from every other chip. The 'player 1' health bar is 14px text over a tiny two-line bar, and the player colour (blue text) should be amber for P1.
findings.fix: Make 'keyboard' a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 chip on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px inset. Make the 'player 1' label 16px in the amber P1 colour, above one 8px bar. Align both to the 5% margin (x96).

v.verdict: the hud has the right ingredients (clock, extract chip, hp bar, weapon card) but the text is soft and cramped, the type sizes and panels disagree with each other, and the lime accent barely appears.

findings.what: rows are about 14px tall and the text is crushed. 'doubtdrulucas' overlaps the row above it and the $ values collide ('$2,028' is unreadable). The header 'value at risk' is about 11px, which is under the 16px floor. Four names, a header and a chevron are packed into a 200px-tall box with no row padding.
findings.fix: set rows to 32px with 16px f-cond 600 text. Put the name left and the value right in tx-1, with a tx-2 header at 16px. Give the panel 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line divider. Use amber for the P1 'you' row and cyan for P2. Keep the list to 4 rows.

findings.where: all hud text, especially 'hp 100', the buff names and the ammo '8 / 24'
findings.what: the type looks upscaled and blurry, with ragged edges and a faux-bold look. 'hp 100' sits on a bright green bar and has poor contrast. The buff names ('steady hand +15%', 'beast mode +15%') and the sub-labels ('4s', '30s', 'damage') are 12-14px grey on a dark panel, so they fail the readability floor at couch distance.
findings.fix: render at native resolution with f-cond. Set buff names to 20px tx-1 and the sub-lines to 16px tx-2 (#aaa498). Put hp in --ui-panel with a 4px green bar and a 20px tx-1 number outside the fill, or use --acc-ink on the green fill.

findings.where: hierarchy: ammo card, hp bar, clock
findings.what: the eye lands on the saturated green hp bar first, which is the biggest and brightest block, before the 56px hero number. The ammo '8' is about 48px and OK, but the card is a dim, low-contrast grey and competes with the hotbar. The clock '14:57' is small, with a red icon that reads as an alert.
findings.fix: make the hp bar 12px tall and 320px wide, with the fill in --ok at 70% saturation. Make the ammo hero number 56px --tx-1 with a lime --acc underline or reserve bar. Give the clock a 32px title size, and make the icon tx-2 unless it is a real alert.

findings.where: buff stack, left side (stim, active reload, steady hand, beast mode, liquor)
findings.what: the five panels have different widths (100 to 210px), different heights, mixed one-line and two-line content, and a different left edge from the player list above. The icon rings use different colours with no meaning (amber, teal, red), and the liquor sub-label '30s' is clipped. This is a ragged stack.
findings.fix: make every row a fixed 200x48 panel on a 16px left margin. Use a 32px icon in a --ui-line-hi ring, a 20px name and a 16px tx-2 timer right-aligned. Move the buff name and its '+15% damage' into one consistent pattern. Use one icon tint, with --warn for debuffs only.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' label
findings.what: the run info box is a thin full-width bar with a tiny 14px label and a chevron. Its right edge touches the screen edge at about 20px, off the 5% margin. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats over the map at 16px with no anchor. It sits mid-right and looks unrelated to the rest of the hud.
findings.fix: inset top-right to a 5% margin (96px at 1080 width) and use the same panel, 16px padding and 20px label as the player list. Anchor the cache tag to its world marker with a 4px line, or move it to the left feed. Align the two top panels on one baseline.

findings.what: the selected slot has a gold border that is close to the rarity gold and conflicts with the lime-only-means-selected rule. The unselected slot numbers 3 to 0 are about 12px, low-contrast and floating over art with no slot boxes. The faint weapon silhouettes are noise. 'f controls' sits on the map at 16px with no panel.
findings.fix: draw all 10 slots as 56px squares with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and the selected slot with a 3px --acc border. Numbers are 16px tx-2 in the top-left corner. Remove the ghost silhouettes. Put 'f controls' in a 16px --ui-panel chip with a 16px key glyph, aligned to the hotbar's left edge.

findings.where: extract chip '152m' and the edge arrow 'c 152m'
findings.what: the extract info is drawn twice, at top centre and at the right edge, with a truncated 'c 152m' label. That contradicts the one-place-per-line rule. The teal chip text is about 14px, and the right arrow chip is clipped against the screen edge.
findings.fix: keep one: the top-centre chip at 20px teal on --ui-panel. Turn the edge marker into an arrow-only 24px glyph with no text, inset 48px from the edge.

findings.where: bottom-left status icons (amber and green circles) and 'b / i backpack' under the ammo
findings.what: the two unlabelled 32px circular icons have no explanation, and their rings use amber and green, which are colours reserved for warn and ok. 'b / i backpack' is about 11px, which is under the 14px footer minimum.
findings.fix: align the status icons to the 16px left margin on the same grid as the buff stack, use tx-2 glyphs, and add a 16px tx-2 label only if the meaning is not obvious. Raise the backpack hint to 16px with key chips ('b' and 'i') and 16px padding.

v.verdict: The full controls legend is a washed-out, near-unreadable wall of tiny text over the map, and the status stack beside it has cramped, overlapping text and an inconsistent type scale.

findings.where: controls legend panel, left side x10-375 y165-815
findings.what: The legend is about 11px text in two columns, grey on a translucent dark panel with the busy map showing through. The key column and description column are barely legible, and the description column starts at a different x from its keys. It fails the 16px floor and the 4.5:1 contrast rule, and nobody can read it from a couch. It is also huge, covering a quarter of the play area, and it is a wall of explaining sentences.
findings.fix: Raise the text to at least 16px at 1080 in --tx-2 #aaa498, or --tx-1 for keys. Put it on an opaque --ui-panel #16191b at 92% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Group the rows into 3 or 4 short blocks with a 16px header each, drop the full-height panel to about 360px wide, and trim the descriptions to 2-3 words.

findings.where: legend section headers (move, fight, gear, world, team, also)
findings.what: The headers are lime/yellow-green, but they are the same size as the rows and tiny, so the hierarchy is lost. Lime means 'selected' in this guide, so it is misused on static labels. The rows under them have no dividers or padding.
findings.fix: Make the headers 16px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 with 24px space above each, and keep lime for focus only. Add 1px --ui-line dividers between groups.

findings.where: buff stack (stim, active reload x3, steady hand, beast mode, liquor), x560-760 y430-700
findings.what: The pills have different widths, with ragged right edges. The sub-labels ('5s', '4s', '+15% damage') are about 13px and low contrast, and the liquor timer '30s' is overlapped and struck through by the pill edge. Titles are about 18px, which is off the scale. The stack sits in the middle of the playfield, right next to the player, where it hides gameplay.
findings.fix: Use a fixed 200px pill width, 56px row height and 8px gap. Set the title to 20px --tx-1 and the sub-label to 16px --tx-2, and fix the liquor clipping. Move the stack to the left feed or the bottom-left edge, away from the player.

findings.where: ammo and weapon block, bottom right x1703-1908 y922-1048
findings.what: The weapon name 'scav pistol' is faint and clipped at the top of the box, which looks like a rendering bug. The '8 / 24' hero number is good, but it is not aligned with the name above it. The 'b / i backpack' hint is about 12px and almost invisible.
findings.fix: Add 16px padding inside the box, set the name to 16px --tx-2 with a 24px line height, and right-align it with the number. Raise the hint to 16px with a 4.5:1 contrast ratio, or drop it.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 are drawn as tiles. Slots 3-0 are faint number labels floating over ghosted gun art, and they are stuck on the map with no panel. The numbers are about 12px and low contrast. Slot 1 is boxed in amber/gold, which collides with the guide's rule that lime means selected.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles with --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line border, with the number at 16px in the top-left. Mark the selected slot with a --acc 2px border instead of amber.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' tag
findings.what: The dropdown looks like a web select control, with a chevron and a different border style from the other HUD pieces. The 'c 152m' marker at right is tiny, and its text is about 12px.
findings.fix: Restyle it as a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip with a 16px label, and match the border and radius of the other HUD elements. Raise the marker text to 16px.

findings.where: top timer and extract chip, x905-1010 y10-65
findings.what: The timer '14:57' is about 24px with a pixel-like stroke, and it competes with the small extract chip under it. The chip text is about 14px, and the teal arrow floats below it.
findings.fix: Make the timer 32px f-cond 700 with a clean 1px dark shadow, not a heavy outline. Set the chip text to 16px and attach the arrow inside the chip.

findings.where: hp bar, bottom left x20-430 y1030-1068
findings.what: The 'hp 100' text uses a stylised, heavy outlined font that does not match the Barlow Condensed in the rest of the HUD. The bar touches the screen's bottom edge with under 12px of margin, and the status icon circles above it are small.
findings.fix: Set 'hp 100' in f-cond 800 at 32px with no stroke. Lift the bar to a 24px bottom margin. Make the icons 40px, each with a 1px --ui-line-hi ring.

v.verdict: The modal and toast from last time are gone and the left buff stack is now tidy, but the top-centre cluster is still a ragged overlap of three differently sized boxes, and the bottom-left hp and armour bars, the weapon slots and the ammo panel still don't share one panel language or one margin.

findings.where: Top-centre cluster, clock, team score and extract tag, x858-1062 y17-200
findings.what: The clock (x891-1029) is 138px wide, the team-score box (x858-1062) is 204px wide and the extract tag is about 95px wide. The score box butts straight against the clock with no gap, so the three read as one lumpy overlap. The 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' text is about 12px, below the 16px floor, and sits with no padding against the right edge. The score text is bottom-heavy inside its box, and the team score is a second 0 sp readout that competes with the clock.
findings.fix: Stack them in one 220px-wide column centred at x960 with 8px gaps: clock y16-72, score y80-144, extract chip y152-184. Set the 'you' and 'p2' lines at 16px, in amber for P1 and cyan for P2. Use 24px internal padding. Make 'team score' 16px tx-2 and the 0 sp a 32px figure, so the 56px hero stays on the clock or the ammo.

findings.where: Bottom-left armour and hp bars, x24-430 y962-1068, and 'f1 controls', x443-540 y943-967
findings.what: The armour bar (about 20px tall, blue, with a pill radius) and the hp bar (about 32px tall, green, with a darker segment) differ in height, colour treatment and radius, and they are not panels like the rest of the HUD. The 'hp 60' label is about 30px with a larger glyph than 'armour 60', which is about 16px, so the two labels disagree. The bars run to y1068, 12px from the bottom edge, while the buff panels sit at x10. 'f1 controls' floats on the map at the right end of the armour bar instead of sitting mid-bottom left as the folded line the guide asks for.
findings.fix: Put both bars on one --ui-panel block at x48-448, y~960-1032, with 24px bars, a 4px radius and an 8px gap. Use 20px f-cond 700 labels in tx-1 inside the bars at the same size. Keep the armour blue as a rarity-like colour only if it is the identity colour, otherwise use tx-2. Move 'f1 controls' to a 16px chip 16px above the block at x48.

findings.where: Left buff stack x10-230 y432-704 and player-2 bar x14-170 y324-360
findings.what: The five panels now share a width and gap, which is an improvement. They still sit at x10, hard against the screen edge instead of the 5% margin. Titles are about 18px and sub-labels about 13px, below the 16px floor. Four rows are ~50px tall but the rows are not on the 8px grid. The player-2 bar is a different width (156px), and it uses a 12px label on a translucent fill that fights the orange floor behind it. Five stacked buffs is a lot of clutter, and 'steady hand' and 'beast mode' both say +15% damage.
findings.fix: Move the stack and the p2 bar to x48. Make every panel 220x56 at 80% --ui-panel with 20px names and 16px tx-2 sub-labels. Make the p2 bar the same 220px wide with a 16px label. Collapse the buffs that have no timer into one 'damage +15%' row.

findings.what: The slot row is unevenly built. Slot 1 and slot 5 have art and a lime or amber frame, while 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 0 are bare 14px digits floating on the map with no tile, so the row has no boundary. The selected slot 1 has a thick amber border, so selection reads as amber and not lime, against the guide's rule. The row is not centred (the 0 sits at x1470, so the span is not symmetric to x960). The 42 ammo counts are about 14px with no panel behind them.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 64x64 --ui-panel tiles with an 8px gap, centred on x960 and 24px from the bottom. Use a 2px --acc border only on the selected tile. Set the key digit at 16px tx-2 in the top-left of each tile. Put the ammo count at 16px tx-1 bottom-right, and dim the empty tiles to 40%.

findings.what: The 56px hero '8 / 42' is the right call and the strongest element on screen, but the panel is pinned about 10px from the right edge, while the weapon name 'scav pistol' is a 16px label with no gap above the hero, and the 42 reserve is the same size as the magazine count, so the number that matters is not set apart. The panel is a flat black rectangle with a 0px radius, unlike the 4px elsewhere.
findings.fix: Move the panel in to x1824 (48px margin) and set it 220x96 with a 4px radius. Put the magazine count at 56px in tx-1 and the reserve at 24px in tx-2. Put the weapon name at 16px tx-2 with 8px of space before the digits.

findings.where: Top-right goals dropdown, x1653-1900 y18-50, and compass icon, x1038-1064 y36-62
findings.what: 'goals 0/3' is about 14px tx-1 in a flat panel with a heavy chevron, so it looks like a web form select, and it is 247px wide against the 220px column used elsewhere. The compass icon sits loose beside the clock with no panel of its own, and its 26px circle matches nothing else. The career HUD list is meant to be a 1x1 vertical list with equal-size items, and this is a lone wide bar.
findings.fix: Make it 220x40 at x1652 with a 4px radius, a 16px f-cond 600 label and a 16px chevron in tx-2. Put the compass in a 40x40 --ui-panel tile with an 8px gap to the right of the clock. Use the same fill as the clock.

findings.where: World labels, 'meridian strongbox' x1488-1597 y245-259, 'player 2' x1680-1718 y546-558, 'shield' x1622-1655 y597-608
findings.what: The labels are about 12px with no backing and are poorly legible over the orange or purple floor. 'meridian strongbox' is amber on orange and nearly disappears. The 'player 2' and 'shield' tags use different tag styles, one blue-filled and one green-filled, so there is no label standard.
findings.fix: Give every world label a 16px f-cond 600 text on a 70% --ui-void pill with 8px side padding and a 4px radius. Use tx-1 for names, cyan for P2 and --warn only for a warning word. Use one tag fill.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' badge is a green-tinted outline chip at about 16px, a one-off style that matches no other element, parked in the corner where the career HUD should sit. It is a debug-looking tell.
findings.fix: Re-skin it as a 16px tx-2 chip on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius at x48 y16, or hide it once the input device is obvious.

v.verdict: The modal is gone and the buff list, timer and ammo plate now read as one dark-plate system, but the top-centre stack is still a staggered pile, the vitals bars are loose, and the player 1 plate in the left margin is nearly unreadable.

findings.what: The timer (x891-1028), team score (x858-1060) and extract pill (x912-1008) each have a different width and left edge, so they stack ragged. Inside the score box a 'team score' label and 'you 0 sp / p1 0 sp' lines sit in tiny type, and the 0 sp hero is only ~24px. The extract arrow overlaps the wall and crate art.
findings.fix: Make timer and score one 240px-wide column centred on x960 with 8px gaps. The timer is a 56px f-cond 800 hero. Drop the 'team score' label and keep 20px '0 sp'. Put the per-player lines at 16px tx-2 on one row. Make the extract pill 240x32 with a 16px --extract label, and move the arrow to its left edge at 24px.

findings.what: The armour and hp bars are different heights (about 22px and 34px) and are not on a shared plate. The 'hp 60' label is bigger than the armour label, but both are floating text on the bars rather than a hierarchy. The bar sits on a busy tile and wall. The left edge at x22 is nowhere near the 5% margin the buff list uses.
findings.fix: Put both bars on one --ui-panel plate with 8px padding and a 4px radius, left edge x48 to match the buff list at x10 -> x48. Make both bars 24px high with 8px between them. Use 16px labels at the left and the 56px hero for 'hp' only if there is room, otherwise 20px. Make the armour fill a desaturated blue (#5a8fc4).

findings.what: The plate has 11px text and two 3px bars crammed into 33px of height, so the name is illegible from a couch. It has no relation to the buff list below, which has a different left edge and width.
findings.fix: Make it 220x48 to match the buff rows, align left to x10, set the name at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1, and make the bars 8px high with a 4px gap. Put 8px between it and the first buff row, and a 1px --ui-line-hi border on both.

findings.what: The 'f1 controls' chip floats at x445-538 y944-966 and touches the hotbar slot 1 number. The slot numbers 2, 4-9 and 0 are bare grey text on map art with no slots behind them, so the bar looks half-built. Slot 1 has an amber outline, the same colour as the P1 ring, while the accent is lime.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 56x56 --ui-panel tiles with 8px gaps, with 16px tx-2 numbers inside at the top-left. Make the selected slot's border 2px --acc. Move the 'f1 controls' chip to 16px tx-2 at y=920, left-aligned to the first slot.

findings.what: The chip hugs the screen edge with 20px of margin against the 48px elsewhere. The text is 14px and the chevron is tiny and hard to see against the dark fill. Its top edge (y15) matches neither the timer (y20) nor the version tag.
findings.fix: Make it 200x40 with 16px text and a 16px chevron. Put its top at y24 to match the timer top and its right edge at x1872. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The rows are uniform and readable, but the sub-labels ('4s', '5s', '+15% damage') are about 14px tx-2 and carry the duration in the same place as a description. The 'active reload x3' and 'steady hand' rows do not show a timer. Icon borders vary between green, amber and white.
findings.fix: Set sub-labels to 16px. Put durations in a right-aligned 16px --warn label on each row. Use one icon style: a 32px circle with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a single glyph colour of tx-1. Use --ok only on the healing icon.

findings.what: The plate is clean, and the 8 / 360 hero is the right focal point. The plate has no border, so it dissolves into the wall behind it. 'scav pistol' is about 18px, close to the body size, and the right edge is at 1912, 8px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the weapon name to 16px tx-2. Move the right edge to x1872 to match the goals chip.

findings.what: The tag has its own box and bold type, a mix not used anywhere else, and it sits at the corner on the 8px grid rather than the 5% margin. It reads as debug UI.
findings.fix: Set it to a 16px tx-2 f-cond 600 label with no fill, at x48 y24. Alternatively, hide it after the first 3s of the raid.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a cluster of small, tightly packed panels. The player list text is tiny, the buff stack is uneven, the top-right 'run info' bar looks unfinished, and the ammo card is the strongest piece but still sits against the bezel.

findings.what: The text is about 12px and the rows are about 15px high. The panel is cramped with no padding. The names and the right-aligned $ values are hard to read from a couch. There is no amber or cyan marking for the 'you' row, and the header, caret and values all sit at different weights. The panel is also pressed against the screen edge.
findings.fix: Use 32px rows and 16px f-cond 600 text, tx-1 for names and values, and a tx-2 header. Add 16px panel padding and a 1px --ui-line divider under the header. Mark the 'you' row with an amber dot or bar, and P2 in cyan. Inset the panel to the 96px margin.

findings.what: The 'hp 60' text is about 30px, in a heavy font with a dark outline, and it sits directly on the green fill, the empty track and the map. It reads as a different style from the rest of the HUD. The bar is thin and stuck to the screen corner, and its dark empty section blends into the map. The two status icons above it are small and unlabeled.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel card with 16px padding. Make the bar 12px tall and 320px wide with a --ui-line track and an --ok fill. Put a 20px f-cond tx-1 number outside the fill. Move the bar to the 96px margin and give the status icons 32px rings with a 16px tx-2 label.

findings.where: left buff stack (healing, stim, active reload, steady hand, beast mode)
findings.what: Each row's name and sub-line sit tight against the icon, and the names mix lower-case styles ('x3', '+15%'). The sub-lines are '4s', '5s', 'damage' and '+15% damage', which do not follow one pattern. Sub-line contrast is weak at about 12px. The rows touch each other with only a 4px gap, and all five rows use the same weight, so nothing stands out. The stack also runs close to the left edge.
findings.fix: Make every row a fixed 240x48 panel with an 8px gap between rows. Use a 32px icon with a --ui-line-hi ring. Make the name 20px tx-1, and put the timer in 16px tx-2 right-aligned. Move the '+15% damage' effect into a tooltip or a single line after the name. Use a 96px left margin.

findings.what: This is the best-composed element, but the '8 / 24' number is only about 48px and uses a lighter style for '/ 24'. 'b / i backpack' is about 12px and too faint. The card has no padding on the right and sits about 10px from the screen edge, so it will be clipped on TV overscan. There is no indication of the reserve beyond the number.
findings.fix: Make the hero number 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, with '/ 24' at 32px tx-2. Raise the footer hint to 16px tx-2. Inset the card to 48px from the edges and use 16px padding. Add a 3px --acc bar under the number to show how much ammo is in the magazine.

findings.where: top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' tag
findings.what: The dropdown is a full-width bar about 250px wide with a very small label and a lone caret. It reads as an empty text field rather than a panel. It also sits on the very top edge and overlaps the building wall behind it. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats in the world with no anchor and uses a different panel style from the player list. The 'c 152m' indicator is tiny and also sits against the edge.
findings.fix: Set the run info panel to 240x40 at a 96px top-right inset. Use 16px f-cond with the same --ui-panel fill and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the player list. Anchor the cache tag to its world marker with a 4px line and match it to the same panel style. Make the distance chip 16px and inset it to the same margin.

findings.what: The clock '14:56' is about 24px and reads as the equal of the list text. The alert icon next to it has no label. The 'extract 152m' chip uses a teal outline that does not match any of the other panels. The pointer arrow sits below it and looks detached. This is the spot where the eye should land first for the extract timer, and it does not.
findings.fix: Make the clock 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 and the extract timer 56px hero only when extraction is active. Put both in one --ui-panel with 16px padding. Keep the teal --extract for the arrow and the countdown only, and attach the arrow directly under the chip with an 8px gap.

findings.what: The slot numbers 3 to 0 are about 14px, in a low-contrast grey, and float over the map with no slot outlines. They cluster with the faded weapon silhouettes, so the row looks noisy. The selected slot has a good amber border, but slot 2 has no state. The 'f' key chip is tiny. The 'f1 controls' hint also overlaps the pool in the map and has no clear panel.
findings.fix: Draw all ten slots as 56px --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border. Drop the empty-slot silhouettes. Set the numbers at 16px tx-2. Keep the lime or amber border for the selected slot only. Move 'f1 controls' to the mid-bottom left, in a 16px chip with 8px padding.

findings.what: At least five different panel styles show up: the dark list, the rounded buff rows, the teal chip, the dropdown bar and the ammo card. Corner radii, border treatments and text sizes all vary. Text rendering also looks blurred in places. The screen reads as a collection of separate widgets rather than one system.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe for all of them: --ui-panel fill at 90% opacity, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Use only the 56/32/20/16/14 type scale, and render all text at native resolution with f-cond.

v.verdict: The controls legend is still a translucent grey slab with tiny, low-contrast text that bleeds into the map, and the buff stack and hotbar have barely changed, so the main earlier advice was not followed.

findings.what: The panel is semi-transparent over the map. Text is about 10-11px, grey on a busy background, and unreadable at couch distance. Key and description are separate columns about 80px apart, so a row is hard to follow. The panel is also 360px wide by 650px tall and covers much of the left play area. Some descriptions overflow the panel edge ('heal or plate and let go', 'call for extraction, then extract'), and the long lines are mostly sentences, which counts as clutter.
findings.fix: Use an opaque #16191b panel at 92% with a 1px #4a5257 border. Set the text to 16px f-cond, keys in #efe9dc and descriptions in #aaa498. Put each key right next to its action on a 32px row. Cut descriptions to 2-3 words, wrap or clip them inside the panel, and set the panel to about 360px wide with 16px padding. Per the owner's raid-controls order, fold it to one short line at bottom-left and open it on F1.

findings.where: legend group headers (move, fight, gear, world, team, also)
findings.what: The headers are the same size and weight as the rows and only faintly lighter, so the groups do not separate. There is no spacing or divider between groups.
findings.fix: Set the headers to 16px f-cond 700 in #efe9dc with 24px of space above each group and a 1px #2e3337 divider. Show at most 3-4 groups at once.

findings.what: The stack sits in the middle of the screen, left of the player and the crosshair, and covers the playfield and part of the legend panel. Rows are about 48px tall with a 7px gap. Titles run about 18px and sub-labels about 13px, and the sub-labels are low contrast. The row text is inconsistent: 'healing' and 'stim' carry only a duration, while 'steady hand +15%' and 'beast mode +15%' put the percentage in the title.
findings.fix: Move the stack to the left feed or the bottom-left edge. Use a fixed 200px width, a 56px row height and an 8px gap. Set the title to 20px #efe9dc and the sub-label to 16px #aaa498, and use one format for every row: name, then effect and time in the sub-line.

findings.what: Only slots 1 and 2 are drawn as tiles. Slots 3-0 are just faint numbers over ghost weapon silhouettes with no frame, so the bar looks broken. The selected slot uses an amber border, but amber is the player-1 colour and the guide reserves lime for 'selected'. Slot numbers are about 14px.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles with #16191b fill and a 1px #2e3337 border, with 16px numbers at the top-left and 8px gaps. Mark the selected slot with a 2px #e6ff3d border. Dim the empty slots to 50% rather than showing ghost art.

findings.what: The name 'scav pistol' (about 16px) and the hint 'b / i backpack' (about 12px, low contrast) are tight against the panel edge. The 8 / 24 numeral is good, but the hint is clutter that is hard to read.
findings.fix: Use 16px padding. Set the name to 16px #aaa498. Raise the hint to 16px #aaa498 and fold it into the legend, or drop it. Keep the numeral at 56px as the hero number.

findings.what: The bar is near-black on a dark map, with a small caret and about 15px text, so it is barely distinguishable from the scene. Its left edge also collides with the building wall. Below it a second 'c 152m' pill repeats the distance already shown in the top-centre 'extract 152m' banner, which the guide calls a defect (one place per line).
findings.fix: Give the dropdown a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border, 20px text and 8px margins. Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' pill.

findings.where: bottom-left status icons and hp bar, x24-430 y950-1065
findings.what: The two status icons (about 32px) have thin amber and teal rings that look like unrelated colours, and they are unlabelled. The hp bar is a flat green with a dark empty segment, a 'hp 60' label in a heavy 28px weight that competes with the hero number, and a marker line at x=268 with no explanation.
findings.fix: Set the status icons to 40px on #16191b tiles with a 1px #4a5257 border and a colour that matches their meaning. Set the hp label to 20px f-cond 700 and keep the 56px hero for ammo only. Tint the bar #76b97c and drop the unexplained marker.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract banner, x912-1025 y10-65
findings.what: The timer is about 24px white with no panel and sits over a busy map. The teal 'extract 152m' pill below it is about 14px and cramped, and the tiny arrow under it is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Put the timer on a #16191b pill at 32px f-cond 700. Set the extract pill text to 16px with 8px padding. Enlarge the direction arrow to 16px.

v.verdict: A clean, calm column menu with a clear lime primary action and good focus, but the amber gradient logo clashes with the lime accent, the menu has four same-weight modes and a crowded saves block, and the type sits too small for a couch.

findings.what: The orange-gold gradient wordmark with a drop shadow fights the lime accent. The guide says to keep gold and lime from sitting side by side, and it bans gradient washes. The title and the lime button both shout, which breaks the rule of boldness in one place per screen.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) at 56px f-cond 800 with no gradient or shadow, or use a flat --acc only on the logo and make the button an outlined primary. Give it 24px of space to the tagline.

findings.where: mode list (2 player co-op, 2 player arcade demo, 1 player arcade demo)
findings.what: Four modes are stacked in one flat list. Three of them are secondary and look identical, and the two 'arcade demo' rows are unexplained and look like clutter. 'co-op (same machine)' is a parenthetical explaining sentence, which the rules treat as a defect. The 'arcade demo' wording is also an arcade wink.
findings.fix: Keep '1 player' and '2 player' as the main rows. Move the demo modes into a single quiet 'demo' row or into settings. Drop '(same machine)'. Use 20px f-cond 600 rows on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps.

findings.where: saves block (saves label, pillager new row, name field, change name, create a new save)
findings.what: The block is crowded and ambiguous. A lime-outlined save row, a text field and two buttons sit within 8px of each other. The save row is the selected state but looks like a second primary. The name field and 'change name' are unlabeled, and 'pillager new' vs 'pillager' is confusing. The 'saves' label is tiny and low contrast.
findings.fix: Put 24px between the mode list and the saves section. Make the save row a --ui-raised row with a lime 3px left bar, not a full lime border. Make the 'saves' label 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Merge name editing into the save row (select, then edit), leaving one 'new save' action.

findings.what: The 'saves' label, the '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' stats, the tagline and the bottom key legend look about 14-16px in grey. That is below couch-readable at 1080. The tagline 'ascend. pillage. extract.' is faint and sits tight under the logo.
findings.fix: Set stats and labels to a 16px minimum at --tx-2 (#aaa498) or lighter. Set the tagline to 20px --tx-2. Keep the 14px size only for the version stamp.

findings.where: bottom key legend (wasd move, mouse aim, lmb fire, e search, f1 controls)
findings.what: The legend works as a quiet footer, but the white-outlined key caps are brighter than the labels, and the labels are small and grey. It is detached from the menu with a large empty gap, and the legend is the only thing at the bottom besides a tiny version stamp.
findings.fix: Make the keycaps --ui-line-hi bordered with --tx-2 text at 16px. Align the legend baseline with the version stamp at 48px from the bottom. Keep it as the footer legend.

findings.what: The two buttons sit as bordered chips at 14-16px. Their 56px-from-edge margin does not match the 5% rule or the centred column, and they carry the same border weight as the main rows. No focus order or pad hint is visible.
findings.fix: Set the margin to 5% (96px horizontal, 54px vertical). Make the buttons 16px f-cond 600 with a --ui-line-hi border, 40px high, a 16px gap, and a 4px radius. Consider an icon for settings.

findings.what: The screen is a centred column on a vignette with no game-world art, nothing like the ARC Raiders or Zero Sievert feel, and about 40% of the screen is empty. It reads as a generic template menu.
findings.fix: Add a dim blurred top-down scene or a hideout render behind the scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)), and left-align the column per Halo Reach, with the logo above it. Give it at least a vignette plus one identity element, such as an extraction-zone motif.

findings.what: 'v0.1279 · oct 29 9:11 am et' is at the legal 14px size but is cramped, with condensed bold, and the lowercase 'et' reads oddly. It is bolder than the other fine print.
findings.fix: Use f-body 500 at 14px in --tx-2 at 60% opacity, and align it to the legend baseline.

v.verdict: This is an in-raid HUD, not the title screen the previous review covered. The top-left list, the key legend and the stacked progress bars all compete with each other. Two progress bars run at once, and 'run Info' has a capital I.

findings.what: A capital 'I' is on screen ('run Info'). That breaks the all-lower-case order. The label also sits in a bright, full-width header bar that is out of step with the other panels.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info'. Give the header bar the same --ui-panel fill and 4px radius as the other HUD panels, at 16px f-cond 600.

findings.where: top-left roster panel ('current pillagers 0', 7 dead rows)
findings.what: The roster is 360x190px, taller than the score block, and holds 8 lines of equal-weight text. The seven '- dead' rows are noise and bury the one row that matters ('you $210'). The purple name is an unexplained extra colour. The title and the footer line ('0 out · 7 dead') say the same thing twice.
findings.fix: Collapse the panel to one line, 'pillagers 0 out · 7 dead', at 16px, and open the full list on a key. If the list stays, drop the 'dead' rows to --tx-2 at 14px, set 'you' to 20px --tx-1, and remove the footer. Stop using purple as a one-off tint.

findings.where: mid-left controls panel (move, fight, gear, raid)
findings.what: The controls panel is about 300x300px and shows about 22 keycap rows. That is the full manual on screen, and it competes with the roster directly above it. The spec says it should be folded to a single short line. The text is about 14px, and the section labels are dim.
findings.fix: Fold it to one line at bottom-left, 'f1 controls', at 16px --tx-2. Open the full list only on F1. If it must stay open, show a maximum of 6 rows.

findings.where: centre bottom, 'slotting armour plate' and 'applying bandage' bars
findings.what: Two 500x56px bars sit on top of each other and cover the playfield below the player. They are blue and green, which are not tokens, and the bandage bar is not clearly a second action. The text is centred over the bar and gets lost. The task is about no heal or plate while reloading, so the player needs to see which action is cancelled or blocked, and this does not show it.
findings.fix: Show a single bar. Make it 360x32px, in --acc on a --ui-raised track, with a 16px label to its left and the time to its right. If two actions are allowed at once, show the second as a thin 4px bar under the first. Move the group 24px above the hotbar.

findings.where: top-centre stack (9:00 clock, score, extraction pill)
findings.what: The clock (about 140x70px), the score box (about 200x88px, offset to the left of the clock's centre) and the teal extraction pill form a ragged stack. Their widths and left edges do not line up. The score box overlaps the building art behind it. The 'score' label is small, and the '0 sp' hero is only about 28px, well short of the 56px hero size.
findings.fix: Make all three the same width (220px), centred on one axis, with 8px gaps. Draw the score in 56px f-cond 800 and the label in 16px --tx-2. Keep the extraction pill teal as --extract at 16px.

findings.what: The 'hp 30' label is big, bold amber text with a gradient fill, and it overlaps the bar. The bar is only about 30% filled, and the empty part is nearly black, so it is hard to read. The amber fill also reads as the old accent, not as a health colour.
findings.fix: Draw 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 and '30' at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1, placed outside the bar. Make the bar 8px tall, 320px wide, with a --ui-line track and a --danger fill when health is low.

findings.where: bottom-right ammo card and air strike bar
findings.what: The ammo card is a good use of a 56px hero number. The 'air strike' bar above it is tiny, about 14px text on a thin orange bar, and sits flush against the card edge with no gap. Its orange is a third warm colour next to the amber hp bar and the lime accent.
findings.fix: Put 16px of space between the two and match the widths at 240px. Draw the air strike bar in --warn on a --ui-line track, with 16px labels.

findings.what: The slot numbers 3 to 6 and 0 are faint, floating over the empty gaps with no slot boxes, so the row reads as broken. Slots 1, 2 and 7 to 9 have boxes, and the lime border on slot 1 is the only focus signal.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64x64px boxes on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Keep the lime 2px border for the selected slot only. Set the slot numbers at 14px --tx-2.

v.verdict: This is a cluttered in-raid HUD, not the title screen I reviewed before. Six panels all carry equal weight, and the two stacked progress bars and the controls card compete with the play area.

findings.what: The panel is large and dense, with 9 lines of 16px text. Seven of them read '- dead'. Rows are dimmer than the 4.5:1 floor, and the purple name has no rule behind it. It is the biggest block on screen while carrying the least useful information.
findings.fix: Fold it to one line, 'you $210 · 1 left', and show the full list only on tab. If it stays, drop the dead rows to a single 'out · 7 dead' line and set rows to 16px --tx-2 (#aaa498) on --ui-panel.

findings.where: run info panel (right, under the minimap)
findings.what: The text is ragged and broken: 'lost  broken, you healed' is red with a missing word, and two contract lines wrap with hanging indents ('search 2 containers in the / long dock or scrap line'). Sizes and weights are mixed, there is no padding rhythm, and it sits flush against the minimap above it.
findings.fix: Use 16px rows with an 8px gap and a 16px inner padding. Truncate or write contract names so each fits on one line, ending '0/2' right-aligned. Put 8px between the minimap and this panel. Fix the missing noun in the 'lost … broken' line.

findings.what: It is a permanent 2-column key sheet with 22 rows at about 280px wide. This contradicts the order that it sits folded to one short line with F1 to open. It covers the play area and has no clear hierarchy: the section labels (move, gear, fight, raid) are as dim as the descriptions.
findings.fix: Show it as a single folded line at mid-bottom left, 'f1 controls', 16px --tx-2. Open the full card only on F1. When open, make section labels 16px --tx-1 and keycaps 1px --ui-line-hi.

findings.where: centre-bottom progress bars (slotting armour plate / applying bandage)
findings.what: Two full-width 500px bars stack at the same weight. They are the largest HUD element at the centre of the screen, ahead of the reticle, and use blue and green fills that appear nowhere else in the palette. The 20px label is squeezed against the bar's top edge.
findings.fix: Show one bar at 320px wide and 12px tall, with the label above at 16px. Queue the second action as a text line. Use --acc for the fill, or --ok for a heal, and 8px padding.

findings.what: Three separate boxes at three different widths are stacked and touch each other. The timer is the hero element, but the score box is larger and the extraction pill overlaps the score's lower edge. There are two different corner treatments.
findings.fix: Use one 4px-radius card with two rows: timer at 56px f-cond 800, then 'score 0 sp' at 20px beneath. Put the extraction chip 8px under it in --extract with 16px text.

findings.where: bottom-right (air strike bar and compact smg ammo card)
findings.what: The air strike bar floats unlabelled at about 12px, in a different panel style, and sits 8px from the ammo card. The ammo number is correctly the hero, but 'b / i backpack' at about 14px is barely readable.
findings.fix: Set the air strike label to 16px, give the bar 16px of padding, and leave 16px between it and the ammo card. Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: Slots 3-6 and 0 are empty and drawn as bare numerals with no frame, while 1, 2, 7, 8 and 9 are boxed. The row looks broken and uneven. The 12px slot numbers are too small, and the amber selection frame on slot 1 reads clearly but is an old colour, not --acc.
findings.fix: Draw every slot at the same 64px size with a 1px --ui-line border, and dim empty slots to 40% opacity. Make the number 16px and the selected frame 2px --acc.

findings.what: The 'hp 30' label is drawn over a gold-filled bar in 32px type with no padding, and the bar is 30% filled. The bar is the only element with a different outline style and touches the screen edge at about 24px.
findings.fix: Set the bar to 280x16px, put 'hp' at 16px and the value 30 at 32px beside it, not over the fill. Use --danger when low and keep 48px from the screen edges.

v.verdict: A clean, calm welcome-pack card, but the close x is misplaced and collides with the list, the hero is the wrong element, and the empty right half makes the rows look unfinished.

findings.where: close x, right edge at about y 488
findings.what: The x button sits on the card's right inner edge at mid-height, over the medkit/bandage rows. It overlaps the 'x2' quantity and breaks the 'x in the corner' window rule.
findings.fix: Move it to the top-right corner of the card, 16px in from the top and right edges (box about 40x40 at x 1384-1424, y 172-212), on the title row. Keep it clear of the list column.

findings.what: The quantities are small, grey and pushed to the far right edge, about 700px from the item names. The eye cannot connect them to their rows. The 'x2' beside the x button reads as a glitch. Rows with no quantity leave gaps.
findings.fix: Put quantities in tx-1 at 20px f-cond 700 right after the name, or in a fixed 64px column right-aligned at the row edge. Show 'x1' on the single-item rows for a consistent column.

findings.where: hierarchy: title vs 'take the pack' button
findings.what: The lime button is the strongest element, which is right. But the title is only about 28px, below the 32px --fs-title. Nothing says what the screen is for. There is no hero, so the list of seven items has equal weight and no sense of reward.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Add a thin lime 3px marker or a short subline of three to four words only if it adds meaning. Otherwise cut padding so the card hugs its content.

findings.what: The thin 3px rarity bars are the only rarity signal. Common (grey) and uncommon (green) are hard to tell apart. The weapons are blue and purple, but nothing names the tier. Item text is 20px but bold-white on every row, so all rows are the same weight.
findings.fix: Make the rarity bar 4px by the full 64px row height. Drop item names to f-cond 600 at 20px in tx-1. Add a 16px tx-2 type tag ('smg', 'heal', 'grenade') after the name so the rows carry a second layer.

findings.what: The 960px-wide card holds one narrow column of content. There is a large empty void between the names and the quantities. The bottom padding below the button (about 58px) is larger than the top padding above the title (about 62px), and the title sits low. The lime tick at the card's top-left (x 503-540) looks like a rendering artifact.
findings.fix: Narrow the card to about 640px and centre it. Use 24px padding on all sides, with the title baseline 32px from the top. Remove the orphan lime tick or extend it into a full 3px top rule.

findings.what: The 64px icon tiles hold tiny pixel-art icons (about 30px) with a lot of dead margin. They vary in contrast: the smg and carbine are dark on dark, and the medkit is saturated. They clash with the clean modern flat style.
findings.fix: Scale the icons to fill 48px inside the tile. Put a rarity-tinted --ui-raised fill behind the weapons so they separate from the tile.

findings.what: No visible pad focus ring on the 'take the pack' button beyond its fill. The 1px --ui-line-hi row dividers are very faint against the panel at couch distance.
findings.fix: Add a 2px --acc outline with a 3px offset on the focused button. Raise the dividers to --ui-line-hi.

findings.what: The blurred menu behind the card is still visible, with a lime ghost of 'enter raid' at the top. It adds noise to the modal.
findings.fix: Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) as in the token and add a 12px blur, so no background text can be made out.

v.verdict: The shot is a readable raid HUD, but the corners hold a handful of unrelated widget styles, there are stray capitals and a lot of clutter, and the mark and ping this build is about hardly shows.

findings.where: run info header under the minimap, top right
findings.what: The text reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The 'run info' bar is also a different shape and style from the minimap above it.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info'. Set the bar to the same 4px radius and --ui-panel fill as the other collapsed headers, and match its 16px label size.

findings.where: the mark ('pillager · 15m' tag and cyan diamond), centre-left
findings.what: The mark this build is about is weak. The cyan diamond outline is about 30px with a thin stroke, and it sits far from its label, which floats about 50px up and left. Nothing ties the two together. It also looks nothing like the minimap marker, which is a filled white diamond, so ping and map mark are not visibly one recipe.
findings.fix: Draw the diamond filled in the shared mark colour at 24px with a 2px dark outline. Put the label directly above it with a 4px gap and a 1px leader. Use the identical glyph and colour on the minimap.

findings.where: HUD corners overall (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)
findings.what: Four unrelated widget styles compete: the dropdown bars at top left and top right, the green hp slab, the ammo card with its large '12 / 24', and the slot tiles. Corner and edge padding is uneven, ranging from roughly 8px to 24px. The 'current pillagers 3' bar and the 'pillager' health box on the left are redundant with each other. The result is visual noise, not an ARC Raiders-style hierarchy.
findings.fix: Put every HUD block on a 24px margin with the shared 4px radius, the --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Fold the 'pillager' box into the 'current pillagers' list. Keep one hot accent, which is the lime on the selected slot.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is oversized (about 36px, outside the 56/32/20/16/14 scale) and runs flush into the screen edge at x≈24, y≈1050 with no bottom margin. The bar is a flat, saturated green slab with no frame, and the label competes with the ammo number as a second hero element.
findings.fix: Set the label to 20px f-cond. Make the bar 12px tall inside a framed panel with a 24px bottom margin. Use --ok for the fill. Keep the 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3 and 5 to 0 float at about 40% opacity with ghosted gun silhouettes, so empty slots read as clutter.
