findings.fix: Set the name to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-2 and the hint to 16px. Keep the 56px figure for the loaded ammo and drop the reserve '/ 24' to 28px --tx-2 so only one hero number is dominant.

findings.where: centre: 'in host check's party' toast and 'e search crate' prompt
findings.what: The party toast floats at the bottom-centre as a flat black rectangle with 14px text, right above the hotbar. It uses a different panel treatment from every other box. The 'e search crate' prompt has a lime key tag, but its text is 14px and the whole chip is smaller than the 'host check' name tag directly above it, so the two stack into a muddle.
findings.fix: Restyle the toast as a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px text, and move it 24px above the hotbar. Set the prompt text to 16px and move it 16px below the player, clear of the name tag.

findings.what: 'host check' appears three times at once: the bar at the left, the name tag over the player and the toast. The same name drawn three times is a duplicated line, which the guide calls a defect.
findings.fix: Keep the name tag over the head only. Remove the left 'host check' bar, or fold it into a 4px health line under the tag. Reword the toast to 'in party'.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but its edges are still ragged: the controls list is still fully open and covers the map, the roster is tiny and tight against the screen edge, and the cards share no common margin, radius or border.

findings.what: The previous advice was not followed. The full 2-column key list is still open, which is clutter. It is 345px tall, hides the map, and its small 15px text is dim grey on a busy scene. Under the 2026-10-24 order it should be folded to one line.
findings.fix: Default it to a single 16px line 'f1 controls' at x=48, y=~1000, in --tx-2. F1 opens it as a card with 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px text and a 32px row pitch. Remove the 'full list' footer.

findings.what: Row text is about 14px, below the 16px minimum. The panel is 8px from the screen edge, the header is cramped, and the values are the same weight as the names. Pink and white names give no obvious 'you' highlight.
findings.fix: Move the panel to x=48. Use 16px text on a 32px row pitch with 1px --ui-line dividers, and 8px padding. Make your own row --acc and the others --tx-1. Use --tx-2 for the 'value at risk' header, and fold the list to one 20px row by default.

findings.what: The hp reads as a loose green bar with an oversized 'hp 100' label stuck on the left. There is no panel, the bar touches the screen bottom, and it does not match the bordered ammo card.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, at x=48 and 32px from the bottom. Inside, use a 16px 'hp' label, a 56px --fs-hero number in --tx-1, and an 8px bar about 240px wide in --ok.

findings.what: The 12/24 ammo hero is good, but the card is 10px from the right edge. 'b / i backpack' is crammed in the corner, and 'scav pistol' is right-aligned while the hp card is not.
findings.fix: Inset the card to 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom. Use 16px for 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' in --tx-2, with 16px padding. Make the denominator 32px in --tx-2.

findings.what: The map is flush to the top-right corner, about 18px from the top and 18px from the right. It has no border or radius. 'run info' is a separate bar with a chevron, and the two items are not tied together.
findings.fix: Inset to 48px from the top and right. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make 'run info' a 32px row with 16px text and 8px padding, attached under the map with no gap.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract chip (x900-1030, y10-90)
findings.what: The 9:00 timer floats on the map with no plate. The icon beside it is tiny. The extract chip is a different green from --extract, and the arrow below it is a tiny 12px glyph that is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Put the timer in a --ui-panel plate at 32px --fs-title, with 8px padding and y=24. Make the chip 16px in --extract on --ui-panel, and attach a 24px arrow to its bottom edge.

findings.what: Slots 3-9 and 0 are faint numbers over ghost icons at about 30% contrast. The slot 1 selection ring is amber, a different colour from the --acc 'selected' rule. The 2 slot shows a white fist with a tiny 'f' badge.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 64px --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border and 16px --tx-2 numbers. Use a 2px --acc border for the selected slot. Make the badge 16px.

findings.where: 'guest check' tag and 'guest check joined' toast (x15-170, y332-368; x878-1042, y893-930)
findings.what: The same label appears three times, including in the world. The top-left tag and its bar have no panel and are a third style. The toast is a heavy black box with 17px text and its own border, so it matches no other card.
findings.fix: Fold the top-left tag into the roster. Restyle the toast as a --ui-panel card with a 4px radius, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px text, at y=~160 under the timer in the centre.

v.verdict: The earlier fixes were only partly applied: the controls line is folded and the hotbar is cleaner. But the HUD still sits on a 4–20px inset, the 'run info' label still has a capital I, and every corner uses a different panel style.

findings.what: The label reads 'run info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. This was flagged last time and not fixed. The bar is also glued to the minimap with no gap, and the pair sits about 20px from the top and right edges instead of 48px.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'run info'. Merge the minimap and bar into one 1px --ui-line-hi panel with 4px radius, or put a 16px gap between them. Inset the pair 48px from the top and right edges.

findings.what: The bar is about 410px wide and about 30px tall, in saturated green, and it nearly touches the left and bottom edges (about 22px and 10px). The 'hp 100' text is a big 32px+ label crammed into the fill. It is the loudest element on screen and competes with the ammo hero number. The 240x16 bar from the earlier advice was not applied.
findings.fix: Make the bar 240x16 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-panel track. Use --ok for the fill. Put 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 above the bar. Inset 48px from the left and bottom edges.

findings.where: top-centre timer, extract chip and bolt icon
findings.what: The '9:00' timer is only about 28px, below the 56px hero size. The extract chip is a dark pill with a teal border, wedged against the timer with 2px of space. The unlabeled bolt circle is still there. All of it sits on a bright wall with no scrim, and the chip's teal arrow overlaps the wall edge.
findings.fix: Set the timer to 56px f-cond 800 --tx-1. Put the chip 8px below it with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --extract border. Remove the bolt icon or label it. Put a 40% --scrim behind the group. Move the group down to a 48px top inset.

findings.where: left roster 'current pillagers 7', 'host check' bar, and 'f1 controls' hint
findings.what: The roster is a large always-open panel with 16 rows at about 14px. That is small and cluttered, and the mixed money colours are hard to scan. It is wedged 8px from the left edge. The 'host check' bar below is a different, unstyled box with a green line. 'f1 controls' is a tiny chip floating at an arbitrary spot above the hotbar. It does not sit in the same column as the roster, bar or hp.
findings.fix: Collapse the roster to its header row by default and open it on a key. Give every left-side panel a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding and a 48px edge inset. Set row text to 16px --tx-1 with money in --tx-2. Dock 'f1 controls' as a 16px --tx-2 line on the 48px bottom-left inset.

findings.what: The card is the right hero ('12 / 24' at about 56px), but it has a different panel style from the roster, minimap and bar, and a different bottom inset than the hotbar and hp bar. 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are about 16px and 14px, set in dim grey on the dark panel. The card's edge is about 10px from the bottom of the screen.
findings.fix: Use the shared panel spec: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Place it at a 48px right inset and a 48px bottom inset, the same as the hotbar and hp bar. Set the weapon name to 20px --tx-1 and the hint to 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: Slot 1 has a good amber selection border, but amber is a P1 tint and lime means selected. Slots 3–0 show ghost weapon icons, and their digits are small and dim at about 13px. The bar is not aligned to the hp bar or ammo card baselines.
findings.fix: Draw the selected slot with a 2px --acc border. Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlines with no ghost icons. Set the digits to 16px --tx-2. Align the bar bottom at a 48px inset.

findings.what: A bare black box floats mid-lower screen. Its text is about 15px, it has no border or radius to match the other panels, and it is the sort of explaining sentence the brief calls clutter.
findings.fix: Remove it, or fold it into the roster header. If it stays, use the shared panel spec with 16px text and a 3s fade.

findings.where: world labels 'host check' tag and 'e search crate' prompt
findings.what: The name tag is 12px blue on dark and the prompt is a tiny lime key chip with about 12px text. Both are hard to read from a couch at 1080. The two overlap the player's feet and a crate.
findings.fix: Raise both to 16px minimum. Use a 2px --acc border on the key chip, offset the prompt 16px above the crate, and keep the name tag in the P1 or P2 colour.

v.verdict: The previous advice was mostly ignored: the full controls list is still open on the left, the HUD is still a pile of differently styled boxes hugging the screen edges, and the mix of pixel-ish and clean type makes it read as a prototype.

findings.what: This is the same open 300x345 card as before. It has about 24 key chips and covers the play area. A career raid should show it folded to one line, and F1 should open it. Two column headers, 'move' and 'gear', are in --tx-2 at 16px, but the key chips and the 20px labels compete with each other. The 'full list' footer is still there.
findings.fix: Fold it by default to one 16px line 'f1 controls' at x=48, y=1000 in --tx-2. F1 opens a card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 32px row pitch. Delete the 'full list' footer and drop the chip fills to a 1px outline.

findings.what: The panel is 8px from the screen edge, not 48px. It has 8 rows at about 18px pitch with no dividers, and its tight text is crowded. The player names look pixelated. Only the second row is tinted (pink/purple). It has no clear primary row, and the 'value at risk' header text is too small and too close to the chevron.
findings.fix: Move to x=48, y=48. Use a 32px row pitch, 16px text and 1px --ui-line dividers. Make your own row --acc or amber, and use --tx-1 for the others. Use --tx-2 for the header. Fold to one 20px row by default.

findings.what: The hp bar is a bare green slab tight to the screen edge. The 'hp 100' text is in a different font, with a drop shadow, at x=24, y=1035. It has no panel, no 56px hero number and no hierarchy. It collides visually with the hotbar at x=558.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border at x=48, 32px from the bottom. Inside, use a 16px 'hp' label, a 56px --tx-1 number and an 8px bar about 240px wide in --ok.

findings.what: The map sits 18px from the top and 18px from the right, so it is not on the 48px grid. The 'run info' bar has a different border and fill from the map. It is heavy next to the roster on the left, and the mix of 18-20px labels is unclear.
findings.fix: Inset to 48px from the top and right. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both. Make 'run info' a 32px row with 16px text and 8px padding, attached under the map with no gap.

findings.what: The card is tight to the right edge at about 10px, not 48px. 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are at 16-18px and in the wrong place. '12 / 24' is the biggest element on screen at about 60px in white, and it fights the hp bar for the first look. The denominator '/ 24' is in the same weight as the numerator.
findings.fix: Inset 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom. Use 16px --tx-2 for the labels, a 56px --fs-hero numerator in --tx-1 and a 32px --tx-2 denominator. Put 16px padding inside.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract banner (x903-1017, y10-75)
findings.what: The '9:00' timer is bare text on the map with only a shadow, and the weather icon next to it is a cramped 28px circle. The teal 'extract 135m' pill is a different shape and size from every other panel, and its arrow is a stray glyph at x=958, y=82.
findings.fix: Put the timer in a 56px --fs-hero style on a --ui-panel plate. Keep the pill in --extract, but give it a 4px radius and 16px text. Remove the stray arrow or fold it into the pill.

findings.where: 'guest check' tag and bar (x14-170, y333-367) and toast 'guest check joined' (x878-1042, y893-930)
findings.what: The 'guest check' tag is a third small panel with a blue underline in a pixel-ish font. The toast is a plain black box with a different radius and 20px text, and it sits very close to the hotbar. Neither follows the panel and border recipe.
findings.fix: Restyle both as --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Use 16px text. Move the toast to the top-centre banner position, and dock the guest tag in the roster.

findings.what: The slot numbers 3-9 and 0 float over the map with no slot fill, so they are unreadable, with ghost icons below them. Slot 1 has an amber outline and slot 2 has none, so selected and idle read the same except for the colour. The gap between the slots and the hp bar is only 128px.
findings.fix: Give each of the 10 slots a 64px --ui-panel tile with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot only. Put the numbers at 16px --tx-2 inside the tile corners.

v.verdict: The attract hub reads as a debug capture. The 'pillagers' title is stamped over a stale 'enter raid!' label and is hard to read. The scene has a letterbox frame with grey bars, and 'press any key' is small and low in the frame.

findings.where: top centre, title band at y≈90-190
findings.what: The 'pillagers' title overlaps the 'enter raid!' station label, which is in dark olive and partly hidden. The two texts collide and the title is smeared. It shows a layering bug: the title is drawn over the world label. The title also sits on a translucent grey band that cuts across the scene, and the 'enter raid!' label has an exclamation mark.
findings.fix: Hide world station labels while the attract title is up, or move the title block to y≈120-260 on a solid scrim (--scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80)) with no overlap. Draw the title at 56px (--fs-hero) f-cond 800 in --tx-1. Drop the '!' from 'enter raid'.

findings.where: outer frame, left x<200 and right x>1720, top and bottom strips
findings.what: The scene is boxed inside a grey letterbox with mismatched translucent bars at the top (0-45 and 45-195), the bottom (940-1080), and the sides. It looks like a broken viewport. The frame is not --ui-void, and the 4 bars have inconsistent opacity. The game fails to fill the 16:9 screen.
findings.fix: Make the world render fill 1920x1080 edge to edge. Use one vignette of rgba(6,7,8,.8) on the top 160px and bottom 120px only. Remove the grey side bars (#6b6b6b-ish) and replace them with --ui-void #0b0c0d.

findings.where: bottom centre, 'press any key' at y≈968
findings.what: This is the primary action on the walk-up screen. It is about 28px and is placed in the dark band at the bottom edge of the letterbox, partly clipped by the grey bar. It has no pulse or underline, and it competes with the bright title. The prompt does not name the device in use.
findings.fix: Raise it to y≈900 and set it at 32px f-cond 700 in --acc on a --scrim pill (padding 8x24, radius 4). Add a 1.2s gentle bounce (--m-ease). Read 'press any key' for keyboard and 'press a' for pad.

findings.what: This is a warning in amber with asterisks. It is a capital-free explaining sentence, but it is tiny at about 14px and crammed against the 'the last pour' label. It looks like a debug tag, and the asterisks clash with the straight-copy rule. It is clutter on an attract screen.
findings.fix: Remove it from the attract view. Where it must remain, show it as a 16px --warn word 'beta' in a 4px-radius chip under the label with 8px spacing, with no asterisks.

findings.what: The labels are about 20px but in 7 inconsistent positions. 'the stash' and 'the last pour' sit at the bottom of their circles, 'fashion' is offset at x≈683, and the rest sit above. 'wirt the gambler' and 'the mainframe' look washed out and dimmer than the rest. Pill padding and fill vary. They are low-contrast against the busy backdrop.
findings.fix: Anchor every label 24px above its station centre, with one fill (--ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, radius 4), 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1, and 8x16 padding. Give every label the same opacity of 1.

findings.what: The large overlapping translucent discs in purple, teal, gold, grey and red muddy the floor. In the top right they overlap each other, and the purple and teal sit in competing hues. They add colour noise with no hierarchy, and they ignore the rule that lime means selected.
findings.fix: Cut the disc alpha from about 0.3 to 0.12. Limit each to a 160px radius, make them non-overlapping, and use one neutral --ui-line-hi ring. Show a coloured ring only on the focused station.

findings.what: The crowd of NPCs fills the centre with no focal point. The title and prompt are the only UI, and the eye lands on the bright, busy characters in the middle rather than the title. The attract loop looks like a capture and not like a designed hero screen.
findings.fix: Dim the scene by 35% (a black overlay of rgba(6,7,8,.35)) and add a centre-weighted vignette. Put the title lock-up at 20% of the screen height with a 3px --acc underline of 96px width, kept from the existing underline.

findings.what: The lime underline is thin at about 2px and short at about 48px, and it floats below the title with a gap of about 16px. It reads as a stray mark and not an intended accent.
findings.fix: Make it 4px high and 120px wide, centred, with 12px spacing from the baseline, in --acc.

v.verdict: A readable in-raid HUD with a good ammo hero number, but it has several competing mini-panels, a capital letter on screen, mixed sizes and no shared panel language.

findings.what: The label reads 'run Info' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case order. The panel is also a thin dark bar with a chevron that looks like a web select, and it sits flush against the building art.
findings.fix: Change the string to 'run info'. Use the --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and inset it 5% from the screen edge. Use 16px f-cond for the label.

findings.where: hierarchy: top centre and left roster
findings.what: The eye splits between the timer, the extract chip, the 'current pillagers' table and the ammo block. The timer at 15:00 is small (about 30px) and has no hero weight. The roster is as dense as a spreadsheet, with a left-aligned name column and a muted 'value at risk' header.
findings.fix: Make the timer 56px f-cond 800 (--fs-hero) and keep the extract chip quiet under it. Cut the roster to 16px rows with 8px padding, put the money column in tx-1 and align it to a fixed right edge. Drop the 'value at risk' caption to tx-2 at 14px.

findings.what: The HUD uses at least four panel treatments: a black rounded box for the roster, a pill chip for extract, an outlined box for ammo, and bordered tag chips ('concealed', 'in cover') with different radii and border colours. The 'the long dock cache' tag and the 'c 152m' chip are different again.
findings.fix: Use one panel fill (#16191b at 90% alpha), a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius on every HUD element. Reserve colour for state glyphs and text only.

findings.where: bottom-left status cluster and hp bar
findings.what: The 'concealed' chip is yellow-amber text and the 'in cover' chip is green. The hp bar is a flat bright green with 'hp 100' crammed against its left edge at a different size. The icons are 40px circles with different outlines. The cluster touches the bottom edge, and the hp bar sits under the weapon slots with no margin.
findings.fix: Put the bar on the 5% margin (at least 48px from the bottom). Make the bar 16px tall with the 'hp 100' label in tx-1 at 20px, outside or right-aligned. Use one chip height of 32px and set the text to --warn and --ok at 16px.

findings.what: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' is an explaining sentence, and it floats with a yellow bar on a translucent strip over the busy scenery. The text is small and the contrast is low.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby', or drop it. Put it on a solid --ui-panel chip at 16px with a 3px rarity-gold bar.

findings.what: The empty slots show only ghosted gun silhouettes and floating numbers with no frame, so they read as scenery noise. The active slot's yellow outline is the only strong cue, and 'f' on slot 2 is a tiny badge.
findings.fix: Draw the empty slots as 1px --ui-line frames at 40% alpha, or hide them. Make the slot numerals 16px tx-2. Keep the lime border only on the selected slot.

findings.what: The block is the strongest element, but 'b / i backpack' is about 14px, and the weapon name 'scav pistol' is right-aligned over a left-weighted number. The block is very close to the screen corner.
findings.fix: Set the 12 / 24 numbers at 56px and the name at 20px, left-aligned with the number. Raise the key hint to 16px tx-2. Inset the block 48px from the right and bottom edges.

findings.what: The red 'rec' pill is a different shape and colour from the other chips, and it is tiny at 16px. The 'c 152m' marker repeats the extract distance already shown at top centre, so it is a second place for the same line.
findings.fix: Restyle the 'rec' chip as the standard 4px-radius panel with a small red dot. Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' label, or keep it only as an edge arrow with no text.

v.verdict: The title now sits in a clean black plate and 'press any key' is lime and legible, but the screen is still letterboxed with grey bars, the title is small, and the station labels and the asterisk tag are still messy.

findings.where: outer frame, left x<200 and right x>1765, top y<45 and bottom y>975
findings.what: The world is still letterboxed. Grey #6b6b6b bars frame the arena and black bars sit outside them, so it reads as a window inside a window. This was flagged last time and not fixed.
findings.fix: Render the world edge to edge at 1920x1080. If the border must stay, fill it with --ui-void #0b0c0d. Add one vignette of rgba(6,7,8,.8) on the top 160px and bottom 120px.

findings.what: The title is about 48px in a small box. It is a hard black rectangle with square corners that overlaps the blue pillar tops behind it. The lime underline is the only accent and it is tiny. It is not the hero of the screen.
findings.fix: Set 'pillagers' at 56px (--fs-hero) f-cond 800 in --tx-1. Use a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) plate with 4px radius and 24px padding, centred at y≈120-240 so it clears the pillars. Make the underline 4px by 96px in --acc.

findings.what: It uses asterisks and about 14px text in amber on black. It butts against 'the last pour' label with no gap and looks like a debug string. It is clutter and it is an explaining sentence.
findings.fix: Remove it from the attract view. Where it must stay, show a 16px --warn chip reading 'beta', radius 4, 8px below the label, with no asterisks.

findings.what: The text is lime and readable, but the plate overlaps the stash counter and sits at the bottom edge. It is about 30px and has no motion cue. The black box is hard-edged and sits close to the inner arena edge at y≈975.
findings.fix: Move it up to y≈880-930 so it clears the counter. Use a --scrim pill with 8x24 padding and 4px radius. Add a 1.2s bounce with --m-ease. Show 'press a' when a pad is in use.

findings.where: station labels (wirt the gambler, the mainframe, shop craft and hire, settings, the stash, fashion, the last pour)
findings.what: The labels are black pills with different widths and different gaps to their stations. 'shop, craft, and hire' covers the grey slab, 'fashion' and 'the stash' float beside their stations, and the label text is only about 18px. They are tidy enough but inconsistent.
findings.fix: Anchor every label 24px above its station centre. Use one fill, --ui-panel at 90%, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 with 8x16 padding.

findings.where: station glow circles and characters, whole arena
findings.what: Large translucent purple, teal, grey and amber discs overlap each other, for example at (1440,270) and (960,550). They look like smudges, not designed zones. They add colour noise behind the labels and characters.
findings.fix: Cut disc opacity to 0.10 at most and use one radius of 120px per station. Stop discs from overlapping. Tint them with the station's rarity or accent colour only.

findings.what: The eye lands on the black title box and then on the busy characters. Nothing signals ARC Raiders-style tension. The black rectangles look like a generic template.
findings.fix: Dim the world to 60% brightness behind the UI with a rgba(6,7,8,.5) layer. Keep the title and prompt at full brightness. Use rows of 8px multiples for all plates.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the timer is still small, every panel is a different shape, and the 'run info' label has a capital I and sits behind the building. The earlier advice was mostly not applied.

findings.what: The label shows a capital 'I' ('run Info'). The bar is a near-transparent black box with a chevron that runs over the building art. It sits tight against the right edge and the top, so it is not on the 5% margin. It also reads as a text field rather than a control.
findings.fix: Render the string as 'run info'. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Inset it 48px from the right and 32px from the top. Make it 16px f-cond with a 32px row height.

findings.what: The timer '15:00' is about 30px, the same weight as the labels around it. It is the main number on the screen and it does not read first. The extract chip under it is teal fill with bright text, so it competes with the timer. The sun icon beside it is cramped.
findings.fix: Make the timer 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1. Turn the extract chip into a 16px --extract text label on a --ui-panel fill, 8px below the timer. Leave 16px between the timer and the icon.

findings.what: The panel is stuck to the left edge, only 8px in. The rows are about 14px, and the dollar column is tight at 16px. The header row is the same weight as the rows. The panel is a different fill and radius from the other HUD pieces.
findings.fix: Move the panel to x=48. Set the rows to 16px with 8px padding. Make the header tx-2 and the names and money tx-1. Right-align the money to one edge. Use --ui-panel, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

findings.what: Seven different treatments sit on one screen: the red 'rec' pill, the black roster, the dropdown, the teal chip, the yellow contract bar, the status chips and the ammo box. Border colour, fill and radius all differ. Nothing lines up on one margin, so the screen looks like parts from different games.
findings.fix: Use one chip style on every HUD piece: #16191b at 90% alpha, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Align the corner clusters to a 48px margin. Colour only the text or the glyph, not the fill.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and status chips
findings.what: The 'hp 100' label is about 32px and sits on the green bar edge. The bar sits against the bottom edge, about 8px from the bottom, so it is cut close. The hp label is the loudest text in the corner. The 'concealed' and 'in cover' chips use yellow and green text at different sizes.
findings.fix: Lift the bar to y=1032 or higher, at least 48px from the bottom. Make it 16px tall. Put 'hp 100' at 20px in tx-1 on the right of the bar. Make both chips 32px high with 16px text.

findings.what: The line 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' explains itself in a sentence. The text is yellow on a dark bar, and the gold bar is only 4px wide. It crowds the status icons beneath it.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby', or drop it. Put it on the standard chip at 16px with a 3px --r-gold bar. Leave a gap of at least 24px above the status row.

findings.where: mid-right 'c 152m' chip and 'the long dock cache' label
findings.what: The 'c 152m' chip is cut at the right edge with a cyan arrow. The 'the long dock cache' tag floats over the map and has no panel style. Both use a different treatment from the chips elsewhere.
findings.fix: Move the 'c 152m' chip in to the 48px margin and give it the standard chip style. Set the cache tag to 16px on the same chip.

findings.what: The '12 / 24' number is a good hero element, but 'scav pistol' and 'b / i backpack' are tiny and dim. The panel sits tight against the screen edges. The black fill differs from the other panels.
findings.fix: Set the weapon name to 20px tx-1 and the hint to 16px tx-2. Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom. Use the standard panel fill.
